paras.en: Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov expressed appreciation for an offer of help on Monday from Trump, although without making clear if Moscow planned to accept it.
paras.zh: 克里姆林宫发言人德米特里·佩斯科夫对特朗普周一提出的帮助表示赞赏，但没有明确莫斯科是否计划接受。

paras.en: "It's always good when mutual assistance is offered," Peskov told reporters.
paras.zh: 佩斯科夫对记者说：“提供互助总是好的。”

paras.en: Trump on Monday described the situation as a "big problem for Russia." U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio said on Tuesday it was incumbent on Moscow to share more information.
paras.zh: 特朗普周一将这种情况描述为“俄罗斯的一个大问题”。美国国务卿卢比奥周二表示，莫斯科有责任分享更多信息。

paras.en: Health Canada told CBC News it is also monitoring the situation, though it sees no risk to Canada at this time.
paras.zh: 加拿大卫生部告诉加拿大广播公司新闻，它也在监视局势，但目前认为加拿大没有风险。

articles.title: Kenya confirms 1st Ebola case imported from Congo

paras.en: Kenya confirms 1st Ebola case imported from Congo
paras.zh: 肯尼亚确认第一例从刚果输入的埃博拉病例

paras.en: Officials are tracing dozens of contacts after man's death at Nairobi Hospital
paras.zh: 内罗毕医院一名男子死亡后，官员们正在追踪数十名接触者

paras.en: Kenyan authorities on Tuesday confirmed the country's first imported Ebola case from Congo, making Kenya the latest country affected by the fast-moving outbreak.
paras.zh: 肯尼亚当局周二确认该国首例从刚果输入的埃博拉病例，使肯尼亚成为最新一个受到疫情快速蔓延影响的国家。

paras.en: Health Minister Aden Duale said a Kenyan citizen who arrived in the country on Saturday from Congo, via its neighbour Uganda, had been isolated and treated at Nairobi Hospital, where he tested positive for the Ebola virus and died late Monday.
paras.zh: 卫生部长亚丁·杜阿勒表示，周六从刚果经邻国乌干达抵达该国的一名肯尼亚公民已在内罗毕医院接受隔离和治疗，他在那里的埃博拉病毒检测呈阳性，并于周一晚间死亡。

paras.en: Ebola is highly contagious and spreads in the human population through contact with bodily fluids such as vomit, blood or semen, and with contaminated surfaces and materials, such as bedding and clothing.
paras.zh: 埃博拉病毒具有高度传染性，通过接触呕吐物、血液或精液等体液以及被污染的表面和材料（如床上用品和衣服）在人群中传播。

paras.en: The current outbreak was declared in mid-May, months after it had been spreading in a remote part of eastern Congo. At least 8,400 cases have been recorded, including more than 4,000 deaths, according to government data, making it the fastest-growing outbreak of the disease in history.
paras.zh: 目前的疫情是在五月中旬宣布的，几个月前疫情已在刚果东部偏远地区蔓延。根据政府数据，至少有 8,400 例确诊病例，其中 4,000 多人死亡，这是该病历史上增长最快的一次。

paras.en: Kenya had never had an outbreak of Ebola, according to the Kenya Medical Research Institute. Dozens of contacts have either been identified or are being traced.
paras.zh: 据肯尼亚医学研究所称，肯尼亚从未爆发过埃博拉病毒。数十名接触者已被识别或正在追踪中。

paras.en: Duale said Kenya was well-prepared to respond to Ebola cases, having trained nearly 5,000 health workers across the country on prevention and management.
paras.zh: 杜阿勒表示，肯尼亚已做好应对埃博拉病例的充分准备，已在全国范围内对近 5000 名卫生工作者进行了预防和管理方面的培训。

paras.en: Kenya is the fourth country to record an Ebola case in the current outbreak.
paras.zh: 肯尼亚是本次疫情中第四个出现埃博拉病例的国家。

paras.en: Uganda has recorded 20 cases and France one. Before Kenya reported its case, there had been no active cases outside Congo since Uganda declared its outbreak over in late August.
paras.zh: 乌干达记录了 20 例，法国记录了 1 例。在肯尼亚报告病例之前，自乌干达八月下旬宣布疫情结束以来，刚果境外没有出现活跃病例。

paras.en: Health authorities in Kenya have placed the country's border points on high alert and are monitoring for possible additional cases.
paras.zh: 肯尼亚卫生当局已将该国边境口岸置于高度戒备状态，并正在监测可能出现的其他病例。

paras.en: Kenya's Health Minister Aden Duale holds a news conference in Nairobi on Tuesday, announcing the first case of Ebola in the country. (Monicah Mwangi/Reuters)
paras.zh: 肯尼亚卫生部长亚丁·杜阿勒周二在内罗毕举行新闻发布会，宣布该国出现首例埃博拉病例。 （莫尼卡·姆旺吉/路透社）

paras.en: Duale said 28 contacts, including family members and health workers who cared for the patient, had been identified. Another 23 passengers who travelled on the same flight from Uganda were being traced.
paras.zh: 杜阿莱表示，已经确定了 28 名接触者的身份，其中包括患者的家人和照顾该患者的卫生工作者。正在追踪另外 23 名乘坐同一航班从乌干达出发的乘客。

paras.en: He said the patient had been living in Congo for the past seven years and fell ill about a month ago. He was treated at various hospitals before travelling by road to Kampala, where he boarded a flight to Nairobi, arriving on Saturday afternoon.
paras.zh: 他说，该患者过去七年一直住在刚果，大约一个月前发病。他在多家医院接受了治疗，然后经陆路前往坎帕拉，在那里登上飞往内罗毕的航班，于周六下午抵达。

paras.en: The contacts will remain in isolation for 21 days and will be released after testing negative for the virus, the Health Ministry's director, Patrick Amoth, said.
paras.zh: 卫生部长帕特里克·阿莫斯表示，这些接触者将被隔离 21 天，病毒检测呈阴性后将被释放。

paras.en: The patient's relatives later took him in a private vehicle to Nairobi Hospital, where he was immediately isolated. He will be buried within 24 hours in accordance with recommended public safety protocols.
paras.zh: 该患者的亲属随后用私家车将他送往内罗毕医院，他立即在那里被隔离。根据建议的公共安全协议，他将在 24 小时内被埋葬。

paras.en: The minister said Kenya had tested 267 samples at five laboratories across the country since May before this first case was detected.
paras.zh: 该部长表示，自 5 月份发现第一例病例以来，肯尼亚已在全国五个实验室检测了 267 个样本。

paras.en: Congo's outbreaks 'like fighting a megafire'
paras.zh: 刚果的疫情爆发“就像扑灭大火”

paras.en: In Congo, where the outbreak has spread to seven provinces, conditions are difficult. Responders have faced attacks on health teams, misinformation about the virus, a failure by locals to report symptoms and rebel violence that has limited access to treatment centres.
paras.zh: 在刚果，疫情已蔓延至七个省，情况十分困难。救护人员面临着对卫生团队的攻击、有关病毒的错误信息、当地人未能报告症状以及叛乱暴力导致进入治疗中心的机会受到限制。

paras.en: - Congo's Ebola outbreak surpasses 4,000 deaths amid violence and mistrust
paras.zh: - 刚果埃博拉疫情因暴力和不信任导致超过 4,000 人死亡

paras.en: - Suspected Ebola case at Montreal hospital turns out to be a false alarm
paras.zh: - 蒙特利尔医院疑似埃博拉病例结果是虚惊一场

paras.en: While cases have slowed in Ituri province, the epicentre, the outbreak is spreading in emerging hot spots in North Kivu and South Kivu provinces.
paras.zh: 虽然疫情中心伊图里省的病例数量有所放缓，但疫情正在北基伍省和南基伍省的新兴热点地区蔓延。

paras.en: "It is like fighting a megafire. Multiple outbreaks are developing at the same time, with varying intensity and in different locations," Stephanie Hoffmann, with Doctors Without Borders, said in a statement.
paras.zh: 无国界医生组织的斯蒂芬妮·霍夫曼（Stephanie Hoffmann）在一份声明中表示：“这就像扑灭一场特大火灾。多处疫情同时爆发，强度不同，地点不同。”

paras.en: The World Health Organization has warned this could surpass the deadliest Ebola outbreak in history, which erupted more than a decade ago and killed some 11,000 people in West Africa.
paras.zh: 世界卫生组织警告称，这可能超过历史上最致命的埃博拉疫情，该疫情十多年前爆发，在西非造成约 11,000 人死亡。

articles.title: As more Iranian women reject hijab rules, regime looks at new ways to force compliance

paras.en: Women appearing in public without wearing a hijab has become an increasingly common sight across Iran, marking one of the most visible social changes since the 2022 "Woman, Life, Freedom" protests, which were sparked after a woman died in police custody after she was arrested for allegedly wearing her headscarf improperly.
paras.zh: 女性不戴头巾出现在公共场合已成为伊朗各地越来越常见的景象，这是自 2022 年“妇女、生命、自由”抗议活动以来最明显的社会变化之一。此次抗议活动是在一名妇女因涉嫌佩戴头巾不当而被捕后在警方拘留期间死亡而引发的。

paras.en: Authorities have been unable to restore the level of street enforcement that existed before the protests. But the relative retreat of so-called "morality police" patrols does not mean the compulsory hijab has disappeared.
paras.zh: 当局无法恢复抗议前的街头执法水平。但所谓“道德警察”巡逻的相对撤退并不意味着强制戴头巾已经消失。

paras.en: Now, authorities and conservative groups are experimenting with different ways to resist that change without necessarily recreating the same street confrontations that helped fuel the 2022 protests.
paras.zh: 现在，当局和保守派团体正在尝试不同的方式来抵制这一变化，但不一定会重演助长 2022 年抗议活动的同样的街头对抗。

paras.en: Judiciary chief Gholamhossein Mohseni Ejei recently called for action against what he described as social "abnormalities," "indecency" and "nudity," urging prosecutors to coordinate with police, intelligence bodies and government institutions.
paras.zh: 司法部长戈拉姆侯赛因·莫赫森尼·埃杰最近呼吁对他所说的社会“异常”、“猥亵”和“裸体”采取行动，并敦促检察官与警方、情报机构和政府机构协调。

paras.en: At the same time, supporters of hijab mandates have circulated online campaigns encouraging people to avoid businesses run by women who do not follow the state dress code and instead patronize women who do.
paras.zh: 与此同时，头巾强制规定的支持者在网上开展活动，鼓励人们避开不遵守国家着装规范的女性经营的企业，而光顾遵守国家着装规范的女性。

paras.en: The result is a more fragmented form of enforcement, moving in some cases from police patrols toward workplaces, businesses and access to everyday services.
paras.zh: 其结果是执法形式更加分散，在某些情况下从警察巡逻转向工作场所、企业和日常服务。

paras.en: The online campaigns call for what supporters describe as "conscious purchasing," encouraging consumers to support hijab-observing vendors.
paras.zh: 这些在线活动呼吁支持者所谓的“有意识的购买”，鼓励消费者支持戴头巾的供应商。

paras.en: A female lawyer in Tehran told DW that such campaigns risk deepening social divisions rather than encouraging adherence to a social norm.
paras.zh: 德黑兰的一名女律师告诉德国之声，此类活动可能会加深社会分歧，而不是鼓励人们遵守社会规范。

paras.en: "This is a deliberate attempt to categorize people by identity and put them against one another," she said under condition of anonymity for safety concerns.
paras.zh: 出于安全考虑，她不愿透露姓名，她说：“这是一种蓄意的尝试，试图根据身份对人们进行分类，并使他们相互对立。”

paras.en: She argues that encouraging economic pressure against people solely because of their appearance goes beyond an individual's right to choose where to shop.
paras.zh: 她认为，仅仅因为人们的外表而鼓励对他们施加经济压力超出了个人选择购物地点的权利。

paras.en: "When economic sanctions are imposed on them [the regime], they call it pressure, injustice and economic warfare," she said. "But when they use the same logic domestically to force part of society to change its behavior, it becomes 'support for values.'"
paras.zh: “当对他们（政权）实施经济制裁时，他们称之为压力、不公正和经济战，”她说。 “但当他们在国内使用相同的逻辑来迫使社会的一部分改变其行为时，它就变成了‘对价值观的支持’。”

paras.en: She also questioned the assumption that women who conform to one particular dress code uniquely represent Iranian social values.
paras.zh: 她还质疑“遵守特定着装规范的女性独特地代表伊朗社会价值观”的假设。

paras.en: "The reality of Iranian society is much more complex than that," she said.
paras.zh: “伊朗社会的现实比这复杂得多，”她说。

paras.en: Accounts posted by Iranian women suggest that dress-code enforcement can also appear in everyday services, with some women reporting on social media being denied access to clinics and banks for not wearing a headscarf.
paras.zh: 伊朗女性发布的账户表明，着装规范的执行也可能出现在日常服务中，一些女性在社交媒体上报告称，由于不戴头巾而被拒绝进入诊所和银行。

paras.en: Shirin Shams is an exiled Iranian political activist and director of the Women's Revolution Organization, which advocates for secularism, women's liberation, and human rights in Iran.
paras.zh: 希林·沙姆斯 (Shirin Shams) 是一名流亡的伊朗政治活动家，也是妇女革命组织的主任，该组织倡导伊朗的世俗主义、妇女解放和人权。

paras.en: She told DW the recent campaigns targeting women who ditch the compulsory hijab are an attempt to revive social divisions that were weakened during the "Woman, Life, Freedom" movement.
paras.zh: 她告诉德国之声，最近针对放弃强制戴头巾的女性的运动是试图恢复在“妇女、生命、自由”运动中被削弱的社会分裂。

paras.en: "The Islamic Republic has tried for years to divide women according to their clothing," the Germany-based activist said.
paras.zh: 这位德国活动人士表示：“伊斯兰共和国多年来一直试图根据女性的着装来划分女性。”

paras.en: She describes the compulsory hijab as one of the Iranian state's most important ideological lines and argues that the widespread presence of women without headscarves shows how far social reality has moved beyond official expectations.
paras.zh: 她将强制戴头巾描述为伊朗国家最重要的意识形态路线之一，并认为不戴头巾的妇女的普遍存在表明社会现实已经远远超出了官方的预期。

paras.en: The renewed campaigns, in her view, are about more than clothing, representing an effort to reconstruct a boundary between women who comply and those who do not.
paras.zh: 在她看来，新的运动不仅仅关乎服装，还代表着重建遵守规定的女性与不遵守规定的女性之间界限的努力。

paras.en: Saeed Paivandi, a professor at the University of Lorraine in France, says the conflict reflects a broader struggle over social control.
paras.zh: 法国洛林大学教授赛义德·派万迪表示，这场冲突反映了更广泛的社会控制斗争。

paras.en: He told DW that Iranian authorities have spent years creating distinctions between women considered "properly" veiled and those officially labeled "badly veiled" or "unveiled."
paras.zh: 他告诉德国之声，伊朗当局多年来一直在区分被认为“适当”戴面纱的女性和那些被官方标记为“严重戴面纱”或“未戴面纱”的女性。

paras.en: "The government is once again turning women's bodies into a social, moral and even security issue," Peyvandi said.
paras.zh: “政府再次将女性的身体变成一个社会、道德甚至安全问题，”佩万迪说。

paras.en: A woman without a headscarf is not interpreted merely as someone making an individual choice, he said. For parts of the political establishment, she can also represent a visible challenge to an ideological order.
paras.zh: 他说，不戴头巾的女性不仅仅被理解为做出个人选择。对于部分政治机构来说，她也代表着对意识形态秩序的明显挑战。

paras.en: While Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian has repeatedly spoken about social cohesion and national unity, conservative judicial and political figures continue to demand tougher enforcement of dress regulations.
paras.zh: 尽管伊朗总统马苏德·佩泽什基安多次谈到社会凝聚力和民族团结，但保守派司法和政治人物仍然要求更严格地执行着装规定。

paras.en: This produces an uneasy balance and exposes differences within Iran's political establishment.
paras.zh: 这造成了不稳定的平衡，并暴露了伊朗政治机构内部的分歧。

paras.en: Parts of the establishment appear aware that a return to large-scale confrontations between police and women could carry significant social and political costs. Others are unwilling to accept the normalization of women appearing in public without wearing a hijab.
paras.zh: 部分机构似乎意识到，警察和妇女之间再次发生大规模对抗可能会带来巨大的社会和政治成本。其他人则不愿意接受女性不戴头巾出现在公共场合的常态化。

paras.en: The result is neither the old system of comprehensive street enforcement nor an end to compulsory dress rules.
paras.zh: 其结果既不是旧的全面街头执法制度，也不是强制着装规定的终结。

paras.en: Instead, pressure can appear intermittently through courts, workplaces, businesses, administrative procedures and social campaigns.
paras.zh: 相反，压力可能会通过法院、工作场所、企业、行政程序和社会活动间歇性地出现。

paras.en: Enforcement without the 'morality police'
paras.zh: 没有“道德警察”的执法

paras.en: Paivandi believes direct coercion has reached its limits and that supporters of Islamic dress codes are looking for alternative ways to enforce conformity.
paras.zh: 派万迪认为，直接强制已经达到了极限，伊斯兰着装规范的支持者正在寻找其他方法来强制遵守。

paras.en: That could shift part of the burden from state institutions to society itself.
paras.zh: 这可能会将部分负担从国家机构转移到社会本身。

paras.en: A bank employee, clinic receptionist, employer, shopkeeper or customer can become involved in enforcing standards even without a police officer being present.
paras.zh: 即使没有警察在场，银行员工、诊所接待员、雇主、店主或顾客也可以参与执行标准。

paras.en: This makes the boundary between law, personal discretion and ideological pressure increasingly unclear.
paras.zh: 这使得法律、个人自由裁量权和意识形态压力之间的界限越来越模糊。

paras.en: Paivandi also warns that linking religion to humiliation, exclusion and coercion could further alienate younger Iranians from religious institutions.
paras.zh: 派万迪还警告说，将宗教与羞辱、排斥和胁迫联系起来可能会进一步疏远年轻的伊朗人与宗教机构。

paras.en: Women who choose to wear a hijab may also be drawn into a confrontation they did not choose, he said, if their clothing is presented as a marker of political loyalty.
paras.zh: 他说，如果女性选择戴头巾的服装被视为政治忠诚的标志，那么她们也可能会陷入一场她们没有选择的对抗。

articles.title: Paramount and Warner Bros merge into one Hollywood giant

paras.en: Paramount on Tuesday finalized its takeover of Warner Bros. Discovery, completing a hostile acquisition that was months in the making and almost faltered at several hurdles.
paras.zh: 派拉蒙周二完成了对华纳兄弟探索公司的收购，完成了一项酝酿数月、几乎因重重障碍而动摇的敌意收购。

paras.en: The takeover cost a total of around $81 billion (roughly €72 billion), or almost $111 billion including the Warner Bros. debts passed on as part of the deal.
paras.zh: 此次收购总成本约为 810 亿美元（约合 720 亿欧元），包括作为交易一部分转嫁的华纳兄弟债务，即近 1,110 亿美元。

paras.en: The merger brings together two of the oldest US filmmaking studios and will form a new giant called Skydance Corporation.
paras.zh: 此次合并将美国两家最古老的电影制作工作室合并在一起，并将形成一个名为 Skydance Corporation 的新巨头。

paras.en: Why Skydance Corp.? Who's behind the new behemoth?
paras.zh: 为什么选择 Skydance 公司？谁是新巨头的幕后黑手？

paras.en: The new name Skydance hails from billionaire investor David Ellison, who first bought out Paramount and its subsidiaries and then moved on to target the much larger fish that is Warner Bros.
paras.zh: 新名称 Skydance 源自亿万富翁投资者大卫·埃里森 (David Ellison)，他首先收购了派拉蒙及其子公司，然后又瞄准了更大的鱼，即华纳兄弟 (Warner Bros.)。

paras.en: The bid faced stiff competition in a bidding war with Netflix, and later scrutiny from US regulators and politicians, but ultimately went through.
paras.zh: 此次收购面临着与 Netflix 的激烈竞购战，随后又受到美国监管机构和政界人士的审查，但最终还是获得了通过。

paras.en: "Today is a historic day, not just for Skydance but for our entire industry," said Ellison, whose family has ties to US President Donald Trump.
paras.zh: “今天是历史性的一天，不仅对 Skydance 来说，而且对我们整个行业来说，”埃里森说，他的家族与美国总统唐纳德·特朗普有联系。

paras.en: Skydance shares began trading on the New York Stock Exchange on Tuesday under the ticker SKYD, while Warner Bros. Discovery shareholders will receive about $31 per share.
paras.zh: Skydance 股票于周二在纽约证券交易所开始交易，股票代码为 SKYD，而华纳兄弟探索公司 (Warner Bros. Discovery) 股东将获得每股约 31 美元的收益。

paras.en: The deal closed less than a week after a federal judge in California approved a settlement between Paramount and 12 US states that had sued to block the transaction on antitrust grounds.
paras.zh: 不到一周后，加州联邦法官批准派拉蒙公司与美国 12 个州达成和解，这些州曾以反垄断为由起诉阻止该交易。

paras.en: As well as the two giant film studios, Paramount Pictures and Warner Bros. Pictures, the deal also brings together the CBS News and CNN news networks, and the HBO and CBS television brands. Ellison says he plans to merge the subscription streaming platforms Paramount+ and HBO Max.
paras.zh: 除了两大电影制片厂派拉蒙影业和华纳兄弟影业之外，该交易还汇集了哥伦比亚广播公司新闻和美国有线电视新闻网新闻网络，以及 HBO 和哥伦比亚广播公司电视品牌。埃里森表示，他计划合并订阅流媒体平台 Paramount+ 和 HBO Max。

paras.en: Ellison will serve as chairman and CEO of the new company. Former Mattel boss Ynon Kreiz is operating as co-CEO in charge of day-to-day operations.
paras.zh: 埃里森将担任新公司的董事长兼首席执行官。美泰前老板 Ynon Kreiz 担任联席首席执行官，负责日常运营。

paras.en: Skydance Corp. looks set to have a total revenue in the region of $70 billion, based on the performance to date of its component parts. It says it's targeting cost savings of around $6 billion within three years as it takes advantage of overlaps created by the merger.
paras.zh: 根据迄今为止其零部件的表现，Skydance Corp. 的总收入预计将达到 700 亿美元。该公司表示，其目标是利用合并带来的重叠，在三年内节省约 60 亿美元的成本。

paras.en: If you rely on our team for trusted reporting, please take a moment to select us as your Preferred Source on Google, so you'll always see our verified news first.
paras.zh: 如果您信赖我们团队的可信报道，请花点时间选择我们作为您在 Google 上的首选来源，这样您始终会首先看到我们经过验证的新闻。

articles.title: France’s conundrum: How to cut spending amid protests

paras.en: France’s Prime Minister Sebastien Lecornu is unlikely to have had a quiet weekend. For almost two weeks, students across France have been protesting, angered by class cancellations, overcrowded classrooms and run-down school buildings. The protests have increasingly been overshadowed by serious clashes with police.
paras.zh: 法国总理塞巴斯蒂安·勒科尔努不太可能度过一个平静的周末。近两周来，法国各地的学生一直在抗议，他们对课程取消、教室过度拥挤和校舍破旧感到愤怒。抗议活动日益被与警察的严重冲突所掩盖。

paras.en: At the same time, the government accuses the left-wing party La France Insoumise (LFI) of exploiting the protests for political purposes and fueling the blockades.
paras.zh: 与此同时，政府指责左翼政党“无畏法兰西”（LFI）利用抗议活动达到政治目的并助长封锁。

paras.en: On Friday, Education Minister Edouard Geffray tried to ease tensions by meeting with student representatives. It was unsuccessful.
paras.zh: 周五，教育部长爱德华·格弗雷（Edouard Geffray）试图通过与学生代表会面来缓解紧张局势。但没有成功。

paras.en: Instead, a nationwide day of protest took place on Tuesday.
paras.zh: 相反，周二发生了全国范围的抗议活动。

paras.en: On Sunday evening, the prime minister took charge of the crisis. In a letter to several ministers, Lecornu called for concrete proposals: Class cancellations should be addressed more quickly, school buildings should be upgraded to cope with hotter summers, and the controversial university admissions system "Parcoursup" should become more transparent.
paras.zh: 周日晚上，总理接管了这场危机。勒科尔努在给几位部长的信中呼吁提出具体建议：应该更快地解决停课问题，升级校舍以应对炎热的夏季，以及有争议的大学招生系统“Parcoursup”应该变得更加透明。

paras.en: Initial decisions, along with funding and a timetable, are expected to be announced this month. But Macron's ally Lecornu faces one key problem: He has to promise young people more government support while his government is imposing an austerity budget on the entire country.
paras.zh: 初步决定以及资金和时间表预计将于本月公布。但马克龙的盟友勒科努面临一个关键问题：他必须向年轻人承诺更多的政府支持，同时他的政府正在对整个国家实施紧缩预算。

paras.en: Last Thursday, the government submitted its 2027 budget proposal to parliament. The budget deficit is expected to fall from a projected 5.4 % of economic output this year to 5% in 2027. To make up the shortfall, the government plans to make spending cuts worth billions of euros. France is already subject to an EU excessive deficit procedure and is expected to bring its budget gap back toward the 3% limit set by the European Union.
paras.zh: 上周四，政府向议会提交了2027年预算提案。预算赤字预计将从今年占经济产出的 5.4% 降至 2027 年的 5%。为了弥补缺口，政府计划削减数十亿欧元的支出。法国已经受到欧盟超额赤字程序的约束，预计其预算缺口将回到欧盟设定的3%的上限。

paras.en: "It is an austerity budget," says Eileen Keller of the Franco-German Institute (dfi) in Ludwigsburg. At the same time, the draft is a signal to the financial markets. The government wants to show "that it is taking responsibility" and lay out a path toward reducing the deficit.
paras.zh: “这是一项紧缩预算，”路德维希堡法德研究所 (dfi) 的艾琳·凯勒 (Eileen Keller) 说道。同时，该草案也是向金融市场发出的一个信号。政府希望表明“它正在承担责任”并制定减少赤字的道路。

paras.en: The government plans to cut spending by the state itself, local and regional authorities, as well as in the social sector. Overall, Paris aims to reduce the budget by around €54 billion ($60.8 billion) compared with previously projected spending plans. Pensions alone are expected to make savings to the tune of around €5.5 billion, and more cuts are also planned in healthcare.
paras.zh: 政府计划削减国家本身、地方和地区当局以及社会部门的支出。总体而言，巴黎的目标是比之前预计的支出计划减少约 540 亿欧元（608 亿美元）的预算。仅养老金一项预计就能节省约 55 亿欧元，医疗保健方面也计划进一步削减。

paras.en: Whether the budget will actually be passed in its current form is still wide open. Lecornu's government does not have a parliamentary majority and relies on opposition votes. But with presidential elections coming next spring, an austerity budget is even less attractive to the opposition than it would otherwise be.
paras.zh: 预算能否真正以目前的形式获得通过仍然是一个悬而未决的问题。勒科尔努政府在议会中不占多数，依赖反对派选票。但随着明年春天总统选举的到来，紧缩预算对反对派的吸引力甚至更小。

paras.en: More money for schools — and more protests
paras.zh: 为学校提供更多资金——以及更多抗议

paras.en: The issue of education in particular shows that France's problem cannot be reduced to the formula "The state is cutting too much." The education budget is set to increase by around €1.2 billion in 2027. At the same time, the government expects around 1.7 million fewer schoolchildren by 2035.
paras.zh: 特别是教育问题表明，法国的问题不能归结为“国家削减太多”。 2027 年教育预算预计增加约 12 亿欧元。同时，政府预计到 2035 年学童人数将减少约 170 万。

paras.en: For Keller, this contradiction shows that money is only part of the problem. Public dissatisfaction is linked to what she calls "priorities" and the fundamental direction of the education system, including the transition from school to higher education.
paras.zh: 对于凯勒来说，这种矛盾表明金钱只是问题的一部分。公众的不满与她所说的“优先事项”和教育体系的基本方向有关，包括从学校到高等教育的过渡。

paras.en: Financing education is getting more costly
paras.zh: 教育经费的成本越来越高

paras.en: The difficult outlook for France is compounded by another factor: the financial markets. For many years, France was used to financing its high levels of debt at relatively low interest rates. But those days are over. The yield on 10-year French government bonds has risen sharply in recent weeks. At times, the spread over German government bonds widened to around 1.5 percentage points, the highest level since the euro debt crisis in the 2010s. The business daily Les Echos ran the headline on Monday that the country was in the "eye of the cyclone."
paras.zh: 另一个因素加剧了法国艰难的前景：金融市场。多年来，法国习惯于以相对较低的利率为其高额债务融资。但那些日子已经结束了。近几周法国10年期国债收益率大幅上升。德国政府债券的利差有时会扩大至1.5个百分点左右，这是自2010年代欧元债务危机以来的最高水平。商业日报《回声报》周一的头条新闻称，该国正处于“旋风眼”。

paras.en: Market skepticism is hitting France at a particularly difficult time. With debt at around 119% of economic output, France is almost twice as heavily indebted as Germany, whose debt ratio stands at around 64%.
paras.zh: 在一个特别困难的时期，市场的怀疑情绪正在袭击法国。法国债务占经济产出的119%左右，其负债率几乎是德国的两倍，德国的债务比率约为64%。

paras.en: Step by step, old government bonds that were issued at very low interest rates are increasingly having to be replaced with new and more expensive debt. The effects of this are clearly visible in the 2027 budget. Estimated around €74 billion, the government will have to spend more on its interest payments than it can afford to spend on schools or defense. According to Finance Minister Roland Lescure, interest payments already consume more than half of the overall budget deficit.
paras.zh: 逐步地，以极低利率发行的旧政府债券越来越多地被新的、更昂贵的债务所取代。其影响在 2027 年预算中清晰可见。预计政府将不得不花费约 740 亿欧元的利息支出，超出其在学校或国防方面的支出能力。财政部长罗兰·莱斯库尔表示，利息支付已经消耗了预算赤字总额的一半以上。

paras.en: Keller stresses that it is therefore crucial that France continues to be seen by investors as a "credible debtor." These days, however, that credibility depends on more than just economic data.
paras.zh: 凯勒强调，因此至关重要的是，法国继续被投资者视为“可靠的债务国”。然而如今，这种可信度不仅仅取决于经济数据。

paras.en: Markets keeping a close eye on election campaigns
paras.zh: 市场密切关注竞选活动

paras.en: In spring 2027, the French will elect a new president. "The election campaign, which is now gaining intensity, is being watched by the financial markets," Keller says. In an analysis for the dfi, she puts the need for fiscal consolidation at between €75 billion and €160 billion, depending on the calculation.
paras.zh: 2027年春天，法国将选出新总统。凯勒表示：“金融市场正在关注目前愈演愈烈的竞选活动。”在 DFI 的分析中，她认为财政整顿的需求在 750 亿至 1600 亿欧元之间，具体取决于计算结果。

paras.en: From the markets' perspective, political consensus on the need for the nation to tighten its belt would be helpful. But, at present, there is no sign of clarity. How the burden will be shared in the future is instead likely to become a central issue in the election campaign.
paras.zh: 从市场的角度来看，就国家勒紧裤腰带的必要性达成政治共识将会有所帮助。但目前还没有任何明确的迹象。未来如何分担负担反而可能成为竞选的核心问题。

paras.en: A French problem with a European dimension
paras.zh: 具有欧洲维度的法国问题

paras.en: France is an especially acute case. But many other European countries are also currently grappling with fiscal consolidation and how to finance the state. Europe wants to spend more on defense, modernizing its infrastructure and transitioning to renewable energy sources. At the same time, citizens still expect a certain standard of education, pensions and healthcare.
paras.zh: 法国的情况尤其严重。但许多其他欧洲国家目前也在努力解决财政整顿以及如何为国家融资的问题。欧洲希望在国防、基础设施现代化以及向可再生能源转型方面投入更多资金。与此同时，公民仍然期望一定水平的教育、养老金和医疗保健。

paras.en: In France, this conflict can be observed almost in real time. The issue is not only whether the government can respond to the demands of young people, but also whether it can avoid further violence. In Paris, many are wary of the prospect of a new broad-based social movement, like the Yellow Vests protests of the past. For Prime Minister Sebastien Lecornu, the coming days will be a major test.
paras.zh: 在法国，这场冲突几乎可以实时观察到。问题不仅在于政府能否回应年轻人的诉求，还在于能否避免进一步的暴力。在巴黎，许多人对一场新的、基础广泛的社会运动的前景持谨慎态度，就像过去的黄背心抗议活动一样。对于总理塞巴斯蒂安·勒科尔努来说，未来几天将是一次重大考验。

paras.en: This article was originally published in German.
paras.zh: 本文最初以德文发表。

articles.title: Djokovic wins China Open after de Minaur retires, Alcaraz wins Japan Open

paras.en: Novak Djokovic won the China Open after his opponent Alex de Minaur retired from the final with injury, while Spaniard Carlos Alcaraz retained his Japan Open crown to continue his resurgence after a lengthy wrist injury layoff.
paras.zh: 诺瓦克·德约科维奇在对手亚历克斯·德米纳尔因伤退出决赛后赢得了中国公开赛冠军，而西班牙选手卡洛斯·阿尔卡拉斯则卫冕了日本公开赛冠军，在手腕伤势长期休战后继续复苏。

paras.en: The 39-year-old Serbian won the first set in the tie-break 7-6 (7-3) and was down a game in the second set when the Australian ended the match with retirement on Tuesday.
paras.zh: 这位39岁的塞尔维亚人在抢七中以7-6（7-3）赢得了第一盘，并在周二澳大利亚人退役时在第二盘中落后一局。

paras.en: Djokovic extended an astonishing unbeaten streak in Beijing and winning the 102nd title of his career.
paras.zh: 德约科维奇在北京延续了惊人的不败纪录，赢得了职业生涯的第102个冠军。

paras.en: De Minaur left the court for a medical timeout after losing the first-set tie break but played on with his left thigh heavily bandaged. However, he had to stop after winning the first game of the second set, leaving him trailing 7-6(3) 0-1.
paras.zh: 德米纳尔在输掉第一盘抢七后离开球场接受医疗暂停，但他的左大腿缠着绷带继续比赛。然而，他在赢得第二盘第一局后不得不停下来，以7-6(3) 0-1落后。

paras.en: “I don’t feel great … I want to say sorry to all the amazing fans,” de Minaur said at the trophy presentation.
paras.zh: “我感觉不太好……我想向所有出色的球迷说声抱歉，”德米纳尔在奖杯颁奖典礼上说道。

paras.en: “I didn’t want to finish like this … hopefully see you next year,” added the 27-year-old fifth seed.
paras.zh: “我不想这样结束……希望明年再见，”这位 27 岁的五号种子补充道。

paras.en: Alcaraz made another slow start before cruising past unseeded Czech Jiri Lehecka 7-6(4) 6-4 in the Japan Open final on Tuesday.
paras.zh: 阿尔卡拉斯开局缓慢，随后在周二的日本公开赛决赛中以 7-6(4) 6-4 击败非种子捷克选手吉里·莱赫卡 (Jiri Lehecka)。

paras.en: The ATP 500 tournament victory is Alcaraz’s third of the year after the Australian Open and Qatar Open, before the 23-year-old was sidelined by an injury for nearly five months and returned at the US Open in late August.
paras.zh: ATP 500 赛事的胜利是阿尔卡拉斯继澳大利亚公开赛和卡塔尔公开赛之后今年第三次获得胜利，此前这位 23 岁的选手因伤休战近五个月，并于 8 月底在美国公开赛上复出。

paras.en: “I’m really happy to be able to lift a trophy again,” Alcaraz said. “It’s been a while and obviously it’s extra special after my injury and my comeback, in the second tournament that I’m playing.
paras.zh: “我真的很高兴能够再次举起奖杯，”阿尔卡拉斯说。 “已经有一段时间了，显然，在我受伤和复出之后，在我参加的第二场比赛中，这是特别特别的。

paras.en: “It was a really tough week and I didn’t play my best tennis and my best level but I did find good solutions and that’s what matters in the end.”
paras.zh: “这真是艰难的一周，我没有打出最好的网球和最好的水平，但我确实找到了很好的解决方案，这才是最终重要的。”

paras.en: Alcaraz became the first man to go back-to-back in Tokyo since American Pete Sampras won the men’s title in both 1993 and 1994.
paras.zh: 阿尔卡拉斯成为自美国选手皮特·桑普拉斯于1993年和1994年两次夺得男子冠军以来第一个在东京背靠背夺冠的男子选手。

paras.en: The world number three started shakily, dropping serve in the first game, but soon recovered and dialled up the intensity to break world number 19 Lehecka’s serve with a scorching backhand to level at 3-3.
paras.zh: 世界排名第三的开局不稳定，首局就丢掉了发球局，但很快就恢复过来并加大力度，以一记灼热的反手破掉了世界排名第19的莱赫卡的发球局，将比分追成3-3平。

paras.en: More uncharacteristic errors from Alcaraz gave Lehecka hope in the tiebreak, but the Spaniard unleashed a sublime drop-shot en route to clinching the opening set to lay the platform for his 27th title overall.
paras.zh: 阿尔卡拉斯更多反常的失误给了莱赫卡在抢七中带来了希望，但西班牙人在开局中打出了一记精彩的吊球，锁定了首盘，为他的第 27 个总冠军奠定了基础。

paras.en: The seven-time Grand Slam champion took control midway through the second set, breaking to claim a 4-3 lead before sealing victory by forcing an error on match point and then celebrating wildly with his team courtside.
paras.zh: 这位七届大满贯冠军在第二盘中段控制了局面，以4-3领先，随后在赛点上强行犯下失误，并在场边与球队疯狂庆祝，锁定胜局。

paras.en: Alcaraz said his triumph helped erase the doubts that he faced during his injury break.
paras.zh: 阿尔卡拉斯表示，他的胜利帮助消除了他在伤病期间面临的疑虑。

paras.en: “A lot of negative thoughts come to your mind,” Alcaraz added: “If you’re going to come back healthy, if you’re going to come back the same as you were before, if I will be able to hit the ball normally without pain. I trusted myself and it worked out.”
paras.zh: “你的脑海中浮现出很多消极的想法，”阿尔卡拉斯补充道：“如果你能健康地回来，如果你能像以前一样回来，如果我能够正常击球而不会感到疼痛。我相信自己，一切都成功了。”

paras.en: Alcaraz will return to action at the Shanghai Masters where he will take on Argentina’s Juan Manuel Cerundolo or a qualifier first. The main draw of the ATP 1000 event begins on Wednesday.
paras.zh: 阿尔卡拉斯将在上海大师赛上重返赛场，他将首先迎战阿根廷选手胡安·曼努埃尔·塞伦多洛或预选赛选手。 ATP 1000 赛事的正赛将于周三开始。

articles.title: Kenya confirms first Ebola case as man dies in Nairobi after DRC return

paras.en: Kenya has confirmed its first Ebola case after the death of a Kenyan national in Nairobi, who had returned from the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC).
paras.zh: 一名从刚果民主共和国（DRC）返回的肯尼亚国民在内罗毕死亡后，肯尼亚确认了首例埃博拉病例。

paras.en: The patient, who had lived in the DRC for seven years, had been ill for about a month before travelling by road from the DRC to Uganda’s capital, Kampala, and then flying to Nairobi on Saturday, Aden Duale, Kenya’s health secretary told a news conference on Tuesday.
paras.zh: 肯尼亚卫生部长亚丁·杜阿勒 (Aden Duale) 在周二的新闻发布会上表示，这名患者在刚果民主共和国生活了七年，病了大约一个月，然后从刚果民主共和国经陆路前往乌干达首都坎帕拉，然后于周六飞往内罗毕。

paras.en: Duale said 28 contacts, including family members and health workers who cared for the patient, had been identified. Another 23 passengers who travelled on the same flight from Uganda were being traced.
paras.zh: 杜阿莱表示，已经确定了 28 名接触者的身份，其中包括患者的家人和照顾该患者的卫生工作者。正在追踪另外 23 名乘坐同一航班从乌干达出发的乘客。

paras.en: Patrick Amoth, director-general of the Kenyan Ministry of Health, said the contacts will remain in isolation for 21 days and will be released if they test negative for the virus.
paras.zh: 肯尼亚卫生部总干事帕特里克·阿莫斯表示，这些接触者将被隔离21天，如果病毒检测呈阴性，将被释放。

paras.en: Uganda reported 20 cases and two deaths earlier in the year but was declared Ebola-free in August.
paras.zh: 乌干达今年早些时候报告了 20 例病例和 2 人死亡，但在 8 月份宣布已消除埃博拉病毒。

paras.en: The current outbreak, which is the DRC’s 17th, has spread rapidly since it was officially declared on May 15.
paras.zh: 此次疫情已是刚果民主共和国第 17 次爆发，自 5 月 15 日正式宣布以来，疫情蔓延迅速。

paras.en: The outbreak has claimed more than 4,000 lives, according to figures released by the government on Friday, and confirmed cases have reached 8,300 across seven provinces, making it the worst Ebola epidemic in the country’s history.
paras.zh: 据政府周五公布的数据，疫情已夺去4000多人的生命，七个省份的确诊病例已达8300例，是该国历史上最严重的埃博拉疫情。

paras.en: The World Health Organization has warned that the epidemic is “far from over” and on track to surpass the regional 2014-2016 West Africa Ebola outbreak, which killed more than 11,000 people, primarily in Guinea, Liberia and Sierra Leone.
paras.zh: 世界卫生组织警告称，疫情“远未结束”，并有望超过2014-2016年西非地区埃博拉疫情，当时的埃博拉疫情主要发生在几内亚、利比里亚和塞拉利昂，导致11,000多人死亡。

articles.title: Tuareg rebels withdraw from strategic town of Kidal in northern Mali

paras.en: Mali’s Tuareg rebels have announced they are withdrawing from the strategic town of Kidal, in the north of the country.
paras.zh: 马里的图阿雷格叛军宣布他们将从该国北部的战略城镇基达尔撤军。

paras.en: The Azawad Liberation Front (FLA), a coalition formed in 2024 uniting Tuareg and northern separatist factions, said in a statement on Tuesday that it had decided to carry out a “controlled withdrawal” from Kidal six months after capturing the town and amid fresh air strikes by Mali’s military backed by Russian fighters.
paras.zh: 阿扎瓦德解放阵线 (FLA) 是一个于 2024 年成立的联盟，由图阿雷格人和北部分离主义派系组成，该联盟周二在一份声明中表示，在占领基达尔六个月后，在俄罗斯武装人员支持的马里军队发动​​新的空袭之际，该联盟决定从基达尔“有控制地撤军”。

paras.en: “The FLA specifies that this is a temporary operational measure, also intended to preserve its human and logistical capabilities intact. This methodical withdrawal from the area took place without any direct combat having yet pitted its forces against the enemy,” the statement said.
paras.zh: 声明称：“FLA 明确表示，这是一项临时行动措施，也是为了完整地保护其人员和后勤能力。这次从该地区的有条不紊的撤军是在没有与敌人发生任何直接战斗的情况下进行的。”

paras.en: Earlier on Tuesday, Mali’s military said it had launched large-scale air and ground operations in the region around Kidal.
paras.zh: 周二早些时候，马里军方表示已在基达尔周边地区发起大规模空中和地面行动。

paras.en: The goals of the operations included “tracking down and neutralizing” armed groups in the area, destroying their supply networks, and restoring “lasting security” and free movement for people and goods, a Malian military statement said.
paras.zh: 马里军方声明称，行动的目标包括“追查并消灭”该地区的武装团体、摧毁其供应网络、恢复“持久安全”以及人员和货物的自由流动。

paras.en: Pro-government fighters, including Russian paramilitaries, re-entered Kidal on Tuesday afternoon, a security source said.
paras.zh: 一名安全消息人士称，包括俄罗斯准军事人员在内的亲政府武装分子于周二下午重新进入基达尔。

paras.en: Mali has been gripped by conflict since 2012, when a Tuareg separatist rebellion in the north was overtaken by al-Qaeda-linked Islamist militants, who later consolidated under Jama’at Nusrat al-Islam wal-Muslimin (JNIM) in 2017.
paras.zh: 自 2012 年以来，马里一直陷入冲突，当时北部的图阿雷格分离主义叛乱被与基地组织有联系的伊斯兰武装分子所取代，这些武装分子后来于 2017 年在伊斯兰努斯拉特穆斯林大会 (JNIM) 的领导下合并。

paras.en: While the FLA presents itself as a secular nationalist movement seeking independence for Mali’s Azawad region and JNIM is an al-Qaeda-affiliated group, the two sides have set ideological differences aside to confront the Malian government.
paras.zh: 虽然FLA自称是一个寻求马里阿扎瓦德地区独立的世俗民族主义运动，而JNIM是一个与基地组织有关联的组织，但双方都抛开了意识形态分歧来对抗马里政府。

paras.en: The FLA says it remains committed to independence for Azawad, the name separatists use for northern Mali, while JNIM says it is fighting to “liberate” Mali and overthrow the government.
paras.zh: FLA 表示，它仍然致力于阿扎瓦德的独立，这是分裂分子对马里北部的称呼，而 JNIM 则表示，它正在为“解放”马里并推翻政府而奋斗。

paras.en: The military has ruled the country since a 2021 coup, pledging to restore order and unity.
paras.zh: 自 2021 年政变以来，军方一直统治该国，并承诺恢复秩序和团结。

paras.en: JNIM has gained in strength since the Malian soldiers who seized power expelled French forces and some 15,000 United Nations peacekeepers, and turned to Russian paramilitaries for defence support.
paras.zh: 自夺取政权的马里士兵驱逐法国军队和约 15,000 名联合国维和人员并向俄罗斯准军事部队寻求防务支持以来，JNIM 的实力不断增强。

paras.en: Since the FLA and JNIM launched a joint offensive in April, the conflict has escalated with increasing attacks on the military-backed government forces.
paras.zh: 自FLA和JNIM于4月发起联合攻势以来，冲突不断升级，对军方支持的政府军的攻击不断增加。

paras.en: The Malian government says it is working to restore state authority and dismantle what it calls a “terrorist alliance” between the FLA and JNIM.
paras.zh: 马里政府表示，正在努力恢复国家权威，并瓦解 FLA 和 JNIM 之间所谓的“恐怖联盟”。

articles.title: Vietnamese police arrest 12 suspected of prowling city streets at night, snatching cats for meat
articles.author: The Associated Press

paras.en: Vietnamese police arrest 12 suspected of prowling city streets at night, snatching cats for meat
paras.zh: 越南警方逮捕12名涉嫌夜间在城市街道徘徊、抢走猫肉的嫌疑人

paras.en: HANOI, Vietnam — Police in Vietnam's Ho Chi Minh City arrested 12 men suspected of operating a citywide ring that stole and resold about 2,700 cats for meat, Vietnamese state media said.
paras.zh: 越南河内——越南官方媒体称，越南胡志明市警方逮捕了 12 名涉嫌经营全市团伙的男子，该团伙偷窃并转售约 2,700 只猫以换取肉类。

paras.en: Police identified 39-year-old Luu Thanh Binh as the alleged leader of the network. He and 11 others were being investigated for theft, state media said Monday.
paras.zh: 警方确认 39 岁的 Luu Thanh Binh 是该网络的涉嫌领导人。官方媒体周一称，他和其他 11 人因盗窃罪正在接受调查。

paras.en: Investigators said Binh bought stolen cats, kept them at a facility in the city's north and resold them for meat. He worked with suppliers who recruited others to ride motorcycles through residential neighborhoods between 11 p.m. and 4 a.m., hunting for cats and trapping four to 10 cats each night.
paras.zh: 调查人员称，平购买了被盗的猫，将它们饲养在该市北部的一个设施中，然后将它们转售为肉。他与供应商合作，招募其他人在晚上 11 点到晚上 11 点之间骑摩托车穿过居民区。凌晨 4 点，每晚狩猎并捕获 4 到 10 只猫。

paras.en: Eating dog and cat meat is not unique to Vietnam and has been practiced in parts of Asia, though it is not common practice. In Vietnam, cat meat traditionally is more commonly consumed in the north, among older generations.
paras.zh: 吃狗肉和猫肉并不是越南独有的，亚洲部分地区也有这种做法，尽管这种做法并不常见。在越南，猫肉传统上在北方的老一辈人中更常见。

paras.en: The practice has declined with growing pet ownership and urbanization, and younger Vietnamese are more likely to regard dogs and cats as companion animals.
paras.zh: 随着宠物数量的增加和城市化的发展，这种做法已经减少，年轻的越南人更有可能将狗和猫视为伴侣动物。

paras.en: In 2024, more than 250,000 people signed a petition calling for an end to Vietnam's dog and cat meat trade. The city of Hoi An also pledged in 2021 to end the sale and consumption of dog and cat meat.
paras.zh: 2024年，超过25万人签署了请愿书，呼吁结束越南的狗肉和猫肉贸易。会安市还承诺在 2021 年停止销售和消费狗肉和猫肉。

paras.en: Some believe eating cat meat brings good luck, though there is no scientific evidence for such claims.
paras.zh: 有些人认为吃猫肉会带来好运，尽管没有科学证据证明这种说法。

paras.en: Police raided the network on July 8 and found about 50 cats and dozens of traps, state media reported.
paras.zh: 据官方媒体报道，警方于 7 月 8 日突击搜查了该网络，发现了约 50 只猫和数十个陷阱。

paras.en: The suspects told investigators they had stolen and sold about 2,700 cats, the reports said. Police did not say how long the operation had been running.
paras.zh: 报道称，嫌疑人告诉调查人员，他们偷了并出售了约 2,700 只猫。警方没有透露行动已经持续了多长时间。

paras.en: Police returned 13 of the cats confiscated in the raid to their owners. A nonprofit animal rights group was caring for the others while authorities sought to identify their owners.
paras.zh: 警方将突袭中没收的 13 只猫归还给它们的主人。一个非营利性动物权利组织正在照顾其他动物，而当局则试图查明它们的主人。

paras.en: Under Vietnamese law, dogs and cats are considered private property, and stealing them is considered theft. Criminal prosecution generally applies when the value of the stolen property exceeds 2 million dong ($77).
paras.zh: 根据越南法律，狗和猫被视为私有财产，偷窃它们被视为盗窃。当被盗财产价值超过 200 万越南盾（77 美元）时，通常会受到刑事起诉。

paras.en: In a separate raid in June, police reported they had rescued more than 400 cats. At least 40 were reunited with their owners, but dozens of dead cats were found packed in ice.
paras.zh: 在 6 月份的另一次突袭中，警方报告称他们已经解救了 400 多只猫。至少有 40 只猫与它们的主人团聚，但人们发现了数十只死猫，它们被冰封着。

articles.title: What to know about nationwide protests in India over voter list changes
articles.author: The Associated Press

paras.en: What to know about nationwide protests in India over voter list changes
paras.zh: 关于印度因选民名单变更而发生的全国性抗议活动，您需要了解什么

paras.en: NEW DELHI — Protests have spread across India in the past week as opposition parties and civil society groups demand the resignation of the country's election chief over alleged manipulation of voter lists.
paras.zh: 新德里——过去一周，抗议活动在印度各地蔓延，反对党和民间社会团体因涉嫌操纵选民名单而要求该国选举负责人辞职。

paras.en: The campaign has been led in part by India's "Cockroach" youth movement, which previously organized street protests that forced the education minister to resign in July.
paras.zh: 该运动在一定程度上是由印度“蟑螂”青年运动领导的，该运动此前曾组织街头抗议活动，迫使教育部长于 7 月辞职。

paras.en: Protesters demand the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar and an end to the poll body's ongoing revision of voter lists. They accuse the revision could disenfranchise millions of voters and benefit Prime Minister Narendra Modi's ruling Hindu nationalist Bharatiya Janata Party, or BJP. The commission and government deny any wrongdoing.
paras.zh: 抗议者要求首席选举专员贾内什·库马尔辞职，并要求民意调查机构停止对选民名单的持续修改。他们指责这一修订可能会剥夺数百万选民的选举权，并使总理纳伦德拉·莫迪领导的执政的印度教民族主义印度人民党（BJP）受益。该委员会和政府否认有任何不当行为。

paras.en: India is the world's largest democracy with hundreds of millions of people voting in national and state elections. The Election Commission plays a central role in determining voter eligibility and administering elections, making changes to electoral lists politically significant.
paras.zh: 印度是世界上最大的民主国家，有数亿人在国家和邦选举中投票。选举委员会在确定选民资格和管理选举方面发挥着核心作用，使选举名单的变化具有政治意义。

paras.en: The dispute centers on a nationwide voter list revision known as the Special Intensive Revision, or SIR. It began last year in the eastern state of Bihar ahead of local elections and has since expanded to most of India's states and federally administered territories.
paras.zh: 争议的焦点是一项名为“特别强化修订”（SIR）的全国选民名单修订。去年，该项目在地方选举之前在东部比哈尔邦启动，此后已扩展到印度大部分邦和联邦直辖地区。

paras.en: Under the process, voters are required to provide documents showing they are eligible to remain on the lists.
paras.zh: 根据这一程序，选民必须提供证明他们有资格留在名单上的文件。

paras.en: The Election Commission says the exercise is needed to remove duplicate and ineligible entries and ensure legitimate voters remain registered. Critics say it could instead exclude legitimate voters, particularly poorer and other vulnerable communities.
paras.zh: 选举委员会表示，需要进行这项工作，以删除重复和不合格的条目，并确保合法选民继续登记。批评者表示，这可能会排除合法选民，特别是较贫困和其他弱势群体。

paras.en: They also say the requirements are confusing and difficult for many people to provide, particularly those who lack older government records or other documents.
paras.zh: 他们还表示，对于许多人来说，这些要求令人困惑且难以提供，特别是那些缺乏较旧的政府记录或其他文件的人。

paras.en: Critics say the changes could benefit Modi's party
paras.zh: 批评者称这些变化可能有利于莫迪的政党

paras.en: India's Election Commission is an independent constitutional body overseeing elections and maintaining voter lists, but opposition parties accuse the commission of favoring Modi's party. They allege the changes could remove people more likely to support opposition parties while preserving or adding voters who favor the BJP.
paras.zh: 印度选举委员会是一个独立的宪法机构，负责监督选举和维护选民名单，但反对党指责该委员会偏袒莫迪的政党。他们声称，这些变化可能会消除更有可能支持反对党的选民，同时保留或增加支持印度人民党的选民。

paras.en: The BJP and the Election Commission reject the allegations and say the revision has no political motive. Modi's party says the list is being updated to weed out what they call "infiltrators."
paras.zh: 印度人民党和选举委员会否认这些指控，并表示修订没有政治动机。莫迪的政党表示正在更新名单，以清除他们所谓的“渗透者”。

paras.en: The issue was prominent in West Bengal's crucial state elections earlier this year after a voter list revision removed about 9 million names, or roughly 12% of the electorate. The deletions left millions of eligible voters unable to cast ballots. Modi's party won the state for the first time.
paras.zh: 这个问题在今年早些时候西孟加拉邦关键的州选举中尤为突出，选民名单修订后删除了约 900 万名选民，约占选民的 12%。这些删除导致数百万合格选民无法投票。莫迪的政党首次赢得了该州的胜利。

paras.en: Indian law requires a majority vote of commission members to enact changes making disagreements among its members potentially significant.
paras.zh: 印度法律要求委员会成员的多数票才能实施变革，这使得其成员之间的分歧可能会很大。

paras.en: The Indian Express newspaper reported in September that two of the three election commissioners had formally objected to several decisions involving voter list revisions, registration procedures and the commission's digital systems.
paras.zh: 《印度快报》9 月份报道称，三名选举专员中的两名已正式反对涉及选民名单修改、登记程序和委员会数字系统的几项决​​定。

paras.en: The newspaper reported Kumar, the election chief, rejected those objections.
paras.zh: 据该报报道，选举负责人库马尔拒绝了这些反对意见。

paras.en: The Election Commission said the report reflected "differing views and deliberations" rather than formal written objections.
paras.zh: 选举委员会表示，该报告反映了“不同的观点和审议”，而不是正式的书面反对意见。

paras.en: Protesters seek end to changes that could reshape elections
paras.zh: 抗议者寻求结束可能重塑选举的变革

paras.en: The "Cockroach" movement, opposition parties and civil society groups have called for Kumar to resign or be removed and for an inquiry into his conduct, including possible criminal proceedings. They want the current revision halted and the previous electoral lists used for future elections.
paras.zh: “蟑螂”运动、反对党和民间社会团体呼吁库马尔辞职或被免职，并要求对其行为进行调查，包括可能的刑事诉讼。他们希望停止当前的修订，并将之前的选举名单用于未来的选举。

paras.en: They also demand a more independent and transparent process for appointing election commissioners.
paras.zh: 他们还要求任命选举专员的程序更加独立和透明。

paras.en: Election Commission data indicates voter lists in some regions could shrink by as much as 30%, fueling concerns among opposition parties and protest groups over potential exclusions.
paras.zh: 选举委员会的数据显示，一些地区的选民名单可能会缩减多达30%，这加剧了反对党和抗议团体对可能被排除在外的担忧。

paras.en: The dispute is likely to intensify as the changes resulting from the revision expand throughout India, which is facing a series of state elections early next year.
paras.zh: 随着修订带来的变化扩大到整个印度，这场争端可能会加剧，印度正面临明年初的一系列邦选举。

articles.title: France's police fire tear gas and water cannons as school protests sweep the country
articles.author: The Associated Press

paras.en: France's police fire tear gas and water cannons as school protests sweep the country
paras.zh: 法国警方发射催泪瓦斯和高压水枪，学校抗议席卷全国

paras.en: PARIS — Police fired tear gas to control crowds in Paris and elsewhere in France on Tuesday as more than a quarter of a million people rallied nationwide to support school pupils demanding more education funding, according to government figures. The protests increased pressure on the administration of outgoing President Emmanuel Macron.
paras.zh: 巴黎——根据政府数据，周二，巴黎和法国其他地方有超过25万人集会支持小学生要求更多教育经费，警方发射催泪瓦斯控制人群。抗议活动增加了即将离任的总统埃马纽埃尔·马克龙(Emmanuel Macron)政府的压力。

paras.en: As pupils again blockaded high schools, large crowds waving flags and placards gathered in Marseille, Strasbourg and other cities. The demonstrations showed how protests that began at a high school in the Paris region in mid-September have grown into a nationwide movement — the latest of many that have marked Macron's nearly decade-long tenure.
paras.zh: 随着学生再次封锁高中，大量挥舞旗帜和标语牌的人群聚集在马赛、斯特拉斯堡和其他城市。这些示威活动展示了九月中旬在巴黎地区一所高中开始的抗议活动如何发展成为一场全国性的运动——这是标志着马克龙近十年任期的众多抗议活动中的最新一次。

paras.en: "We need to listen to them," said Léa Monimart, a demonstrator in the northern city of Lille. "They are 17 years old; they are not completely clueless, and they know what they are talking about. It's important to show that there are adults who support them."
paras.zh: “我们需要听取他们的意见，”北部城市里尔的示威者莉亚·莫尼马尔 (Léa Monimart) 说。 “他们已经 17 岁了；他们并不是完全无知，他们知道自己在说什么。重要的是要表明有成年人支持他们。”

paras.en: The Interior Ministry estimated that 256,000 people took part in demonstrations across the country on Tuesday, including 56,000 in Paris, where small groups of protesters clashed with riot officers at a city square during a largely peaceful march through the city.
paras.zh: 内政部估计，周二全国有 256,000 人参加了示威活动，其中巴黎有 56,000 人参加，在巴黎的一次基本和平的游行中，一小群抗议者在城市广场与防暴警察发生冲突。

paras.en: The widespread use of arrests, tear gas and riot-control weapons against teenagers is fueling defiance and angering some parents and teachers.
paras.zh: 对青少年广泛使用逮捕、催泪瓦斯和镇暴武器加剧了反抗行为，并激怒了一些家长和老师。

paras.en: Interior Minister Laurent Nuñez said the police response had been proportionate in "almost all cases" and that the protests had at times turned into riots, requiring police intervention.
paras.zh: 内政部长洛朗·努涅斯表示，在“几乎所有案件”中，警方的反应都是相称的，抗议活动有时会演变成骚乱，需要警方干预。

paras.en: French Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu said the government and school leaders must listen to students' concerns and find solutions.
paras.zh: 法国总理塞巴斯蒂安·勒科尔努表示，政府和学校领导必须倾听学生的担忧并找到解决方案。

paras.en: Questioned in parliament on Tuesday about the protest movement, Lecornu denounced "ultra violence" threatening schools. Responding to criticism of police tactics, he pledged that any "accidents" would be investigated and described allegations that the police are racist as a "lie."
paras.zh: 周二，莱科努在议会接受有关抗议运动的质询时，谴责了威胁学校的“极端暴力”。在回应对警察策略的批评时，他承诺将对任何“事故”进行调查，并将有关警察种族主义的指控描述为“谎言”。

paras.en: Class boycotts with police making thousands of arrests
paras.zh: 罢课，警察逮捕数千人

paras.en: More than two weeks of class boycotts and school blockades, and policing that has led to more than 6,100 arrests, mostly of minors, have become a flashpoint in the early days of the presidential election campaign.
paras.zh: 两周多的罢课和学校封锁，以及导致 6,100 多人被捕（其中大部分是未成年人）的治安行动，已成为总统竞选初期的一个热点。

paras.en: Felix Barney, a university student, described the police response as disproportionate, saying it doesn't make "any sense to hit minors."
paras.zh: 大学生菲利克斯·巴尼 (Felix Barney) 称警方的反应不成比例，并表示“殴打未成年人没有任何意义”。

paras.en: "Riot police, batons, rubber bullets, tear gas," said Aurélien Le Coq, a lawmaker with the far-left France Unbowed party. Its presidential candidate is strongly backing the protests.
paras.zh: “防暴警察、警棍、橡皮子弹、催泪瓦斯，”极左翼法国不屈党议员奥雷利安·勒科克 (Aurélien Le Coq) 说。其总统候选人强烈支持抗议活动。

paras.en: The violence is "absolutely unbearable," Le Coq said.
paras.zh: 勒科克说，暴力行为“绝对令人难以忍受”。

paras.en: Nuñez defended police tactics despite a growing number of severe injuries blamed on officers' riot-control weapons. In the latest case, a 15-year-old boy lost a hand Monday in an incident involving a police stun grenade. He said 715 officers had been injured.
paras.zh: 尽管越来越多的严重受伤归咎于警察的防暴武器，努涅斯还是为警察的战术辩护。在最新的一起案件中，一名 15 岁男孩周一在一次涉及警察眩晕手榴弹的事件中失去了一只手。他说，715 名警察受伤。

paras.en: The teenage protesters have struck a chord amid widespread discontent in France. Frustrations extend beyond immediate difficulties, such as fuel prices that have soared because of the Iran war, to broader concerns about constraints on public spending, rising poverty and wealth inequality under Macron, who can't run for a third consecutive term.
paras.zh: 在法国普遍的不满情绪中，青少年抗议者引起了共鸣。令人沮丧的不仅仅是眼前的困难，例如因伊朗战争而飙升的燃油价格，还包括对马克龙领导下的公共支出限制、贫困和财富不平等加剧的更广泛担忧，而马克龙无法连续第三个任期。

paras.en: Against that backdrop, pupils' complaints that education funding shortfalls are endangering their futures have found a sympathetic audience.
paras.zh: 在此背景下，学生们对教育资金短缺危及他们未来的抱怨得到了同情。

paras.en: "You say 'young people are the future,' so listen to them," read a handwritten placard attached to a metal barrier outside a Paris school.
paras.zh: “你说‘年轻人是未来’，所以听听他们的吧，”巴黎一所学校外的金属栅栏上贴着一张手写的标语牌。

paras.en: Ministry offers online portal for complaints
paras.zh: 该部提供在线投诉门户

paras.en: At the Hélène Boucher lycée, or high school, in Paris' 20th district, protesters tipped over trash cans and bicycles onto their sides to create a makeshift barricade.
paras.zh: 在巴黎第 20 区的 Hélène Boucher lycée（即高中），抗议者将垃圾桶和自行车翻倒在地，以搭建临时路障。

paras.en: Like hundreds of others around the country, the school was closed. Authorities began shutting schools last week to take some steam out of the demonstrations after widespread damage to schools and mounting injuries among staff, students and police. Classes were totally or partially suspended on Tuesday at 891 schools, according to the Education Ministry.
paras.zh: 与全国数百所其他学校一样，这所学校也被关闭。由于学校遭到广泛破坏，教职员工、学生和警察受伤人数不断增加，当局上周开始关闭学校，以平息示威活动。据教育部称，周二，891 所学校全部或部分停课。

paras.en: Facing accusations that it was ignoring protesters, the ministry launched an online portal inviting high school students to anonymously describe the difficulties they face at school and the changes they want to see.
paras.zh: 面对无视抗议者的指责，教育部推出了一个在线门户网站，邀请高中生匿名描述他们在学校面临的困难以及他们希望看到的变化。

paras.en: Student protests have drawn attention to rundown classrooms
paras.zh: 学生抗议引起人们对破旧教室的关注

paras.en: At Hélène Boucher, parents and other adults positioned themselves on Tuesday between protesters and police keeping watch.
paras.zh: 周二，在海伦·鲍彻 (Hélène Boucher)，父母和其他成年人站在抗议者和监视警察之间。

paras.en: "They are our children. Teachers, parents, federations, we all share the same goal: the protection of children's rights, and it is a legitimate right to demonstrate and to make demands," said Emilia Sichili Suriam, who is a member of an association of parents.
paras.zh: “他们是我们的孩子。老师、家长、联合会，我们都有一个共同的目标：保护儿童权利，示威和提出要求是合法权利，”家长协会成员艾米莉亚·西奇利·苏里亚姆 (Emilia Sichili Suriam) 说。

paras.en: Demonstrators have voiced a range of grievances, often centering on a lack of resources and opportunities for students in disadvantaged schools, despite the promise of France's national motto: "Liberty, Equality, Fraternity."
paras.zh: 尽管法国的国家座右铭是“自由、平等、博爱”，但示威者表达了一系列不满，往往集中在贫困学校学生缺乏资源和机会上。

paras.en: Students have drawn attention to rundown classrooms that lack basics such as desks and chairs, become sweltering in summer without air conditioning and, in some cases, are infested with rats. Other common complaints include staff shortages and exhausting workloads. French high school students' compulsory classroom hours are among the highest in Europe.
paras.zh: 学生们注意到破旧的教室缺乏课桌椅等基本设施，没有空调，夏天变得闷热，有时还出没老鼠。其他常见的抱怨包括人员短缺和工作量过大。法国高中学生的必修课时数在欧洲名列前茅。

paras.en: Suzanne Nijdam, president of the federation of student associations, vowed that demonstrations would continue until authorities address the complaints.
paras.zh: 学生协会联合会主席苏珊娜·尼丹 (Suzanne Nijdam) 誓言，示威活动将继续下去，直到当局解决这些投诉。

paras.en: "So, we really need to act now, and it's in the government's hands, to see these demands through to the end," she said. "It's a matter of political priority, a matter of prioritizing the youth and the future of our country."
paras.zh: “所以，我们真的需要现在就采取行动，而这一切都在政府的手中，将这些要求贯彻到底，”她说。 “这是一个政治优先事项，一个优先考虑年轻人和我们国家未来的问题。”

articles.title: Former Miss Germany is stepping into the ring for her first professional boxing match

paras.en: Model Tatjana Genrich is more than a pretty face who was once crowned Miss Germany. She can fight and announced on Tuesday that she's stepping into the ring next month for her first fight as a professional boxer.
paras.zh: 模特塔贾娜·根里奇 (Tatjana Genrich) 不仅仅是一张漂亮的脸蛋，曾荣获德国小姐称号。她可以参加比赛，并在周二宣布她将于下个月踏上拳击场，这是她作为职业拳击手的第一次比赛。

paras.en: The 33-year-old model isn't new to lacing up the gloves.
paras.zh: 这位 33 岁的模特对系手套并不陌生。

paras.en: Before being crowned Miss Germany 2022 and taking home the "Best in Swimsuit" award and the "Miss Intercontinental Europe" crown at the Miss Intercontinental 2022 pageant, she was an amateur boxer.
paras.zh: 在加冕 2022 年德国小姐并在 2022 年洲际小姐选美比赛中获得“最佳泳装”奖和“欧洲洲际小姐”桂冠之前，她是一名业余拳击手。

paras.en: Not any amateur boxer either. The German outlet Bild reports that Genrich was an amateur state champion in the flyweight division for three consecutive years from 2007 to 2009.
paras.zh: 也不是任何业余拳击手。德国媒体《图片报》报道称，根里奇从 2007 年到 2009 年连续三年获得蝇量级业余州冠军。

paras.en: "I became enthusiastic about the sport very early on. I was often bullied at school, and I wanted to fight back somehow," she said. "That's how it all started."
paras.zh: “我很早就对这项运动产生了热情。我在学校经常被欺负，我想以某种方式反击，”她说。 “一切就是这样开始的。”

paras.en: Obviously, Genrich had modeling to do and pageants to compete in before finally making her dream of going pro in boxing a reality. But here we are, the former Miss Germany is preparing to step into the ring for a pro fight.
paras.zh: 显然，在最终实现成为职业拳击运动员的梦想之前，根里奇还要做模特，参加选美比赛。但现在，这位前德国小姐正准备走上职业拳击台。

paras.en: She was approached about getting back in the ring because she sponsors ring girls for SES Boxing events, and they were apparently aware of her past. She's set to appear on the promotion's November 14 fight card.
paras.zh: 有人联系她重返拳击场，因为她赞助了 SES 拳击比赛的拳击女孩，而她们显然知道她的过去。她将出现在 11 月 14 日促销活动的战斗卡上。

paras.en: The former amateur champ, who looks great in a bikini, is working with coach Dirk Dzemski. He previously helped train Robert Stieglitz, a former German boxer who had two reigns as WBO super-middleweight champ.
paras.zh: 这位身穿比基尼看起来很棒的前业余冠军正在与教练德克·泽姆斯基一起工作。他此前曾帮助训练前德国拳击手罗伯特·斯蒂格利茨，后者曾两次夺得 WBO 超中量级冠军。

paras.en: "I want to be a role model for young women and show them that you can be successful in both your career and sports," Genrich added.
paras.zh: “我想成为年轻女性的榜样，向她们展示你可以在事业和运动上取得成功，”根里奇补充道。

paras.en: She's in the gym working on her boxing five days a week preparing for an unknown opponent. She said of the training, "I work up a good sweat. But no pain, no gain. I'm really enjoying it, though."
paras.zh: 她每周五天在健身房练习拳击，为未知的对手做准备。她谈到训练时说：“我流了很多汗。但没有痛苦，就没有收获。不过，我真的很享受它。”

paras.en: Tatjana Genrich isn't just going through the motions with another best in swimsuit award on her mind. Bild reported "her ultimate goal is to become world champion one day."
paras.zh: 塔贾娜·根里奇 (Tatjana Genrich) 并不是只是走走过场，她心里想着另一个最佳泳装奖。 《图片报》报道称“她的最终目标是有一天成为世界冠军。”

articles.title: Liberal justices look for 'escape hatch' as high-stakes climate case lands at Supreme Court, experts say

paras.en: Justices Ketanji Brown Jackson and Sonia Sotomayor's repeated questions concerning whether the Supreme Court has jurisdiction to hear a high-profile climate case that could expose oil companies to lawsuits across the country steered conservative lawyers to believe that the liberal justices are seeking an "off-ramp."
paras.zh: 大法官科坦吉·布朗·杰克逊和索尼娅·索托马约尔反复质疑最高法院是否有权审理一起备受瞩目的气候案件，该案件可能会让石油公司在全国范围内面临诉讼，这让保守派律师相信自由派大法官正在寻求“出口”。

paras.en: "The fact that they kept going back to trying to create a jurisdictional problem tells me they don't feel confident that they have the votes in this space," Carrie Severino, president of JCN, a conservative judicial group, told Fox News Digital. "Jackson and Sotomayor were looking for an escape hatch."
paras.zh: 保守派司法组织 JCN 主席凯莉·塞维里诺 (Carrie Severino) 告诉福克斯新闻数字频道：“他们不断试图制造管辖权问题，这一事实告诉我，他们对自己在这个领域拥有选票没有信心。” “杰克逊和索托马约尔正在寻找逃生口。”

paras.en: The Supreme Court began its new term Monday, hearing its first oral arguments for Suncor v. Boulder, in which they will rule on whether state tort laws can be used to seek damages from oil companies for climate change, even when the alleged harms are occurring outside the state or continent. The justices will also rule on whether the Supreme Court has jurisdiction to hear this case now, as the case is still before the Colorado Supreme Court.
paras.zh: 最高法院周一开始新一届任期，听取了森科尔诉博尔德案的首次口头辩论，其中他们将裁定是否可以利用州侵权法向石油公司寻求因气候变化造成的损害，即使所指控的损害发生在州或大陆之外。法官们还将裁定最高法院现在是否有管辖权审理此案，因为此案仍在科罗拉多州最高法院审理。

paras.en: The case before the high court is in an unusual procedural posture, meaning the justices could resolve it without ever reaching the blockbuster state-versus-federal power fight at its center. That dispute centers on whether Colorado can use its own laws to seek damages for alleged harms caused by emissions from other states or whether it's an issue for the federal government and Congress to regulate.
paras.zh: 高等法院审理的此案处于一种不同寻常的程序状态，这意味着法官们可以在不涉及州与联邦权力之争的中心的情况下解决该案。这场争议的焦点是科罗拉多州是否可以利用自己的法律为其他州的排放造成的所谓损害寻求赔偿，或者这是否是联邦政府和国会监管的问题。

paras.en: "The questions by Jackson and Sotomayor trying to say it would be premature for the court to issue an opinion are simply the liberal justices trying to find an off-ramp for the case because they are afraid they will be outvoted on the main issue: does federal law such as the Clean Air Act preempt all state claims like those asserted here," Hans von Spakovsky, senior legal fellow with Advancing American Freedom, told Fox News Digital.
paras.zh: 推进美国自由高级法律研究员汉斯·冯·斯帕科夫斯基告诉福克斯数字新闻：“杰克逊和索托马约尔试图表示法院发表意见为时过早，这只是自由派法官试图为本案找到一个出口，因为他们担心自己会在主要问题上被否决：《清洁空气法案》等联邦法律是否会优先于所有州的主张，就像这里所主张的那样。”

paras.en: While questioning Suncor attorney Kannon Shanmugam, Jackson suggested the dispute may have reached the Supreme Court too soon, calling it "premature from the standpoint of this court exercising its jurisdiction."
paras.zh: 杰克逊在询问森科尔律师坎农·尚穆根时表示，这场纠纷可能太早提交到最高法院，并称“从本法院行使管辖权的角度来看，还为时过早”。

paras.en: She also repeatedly questioned why the court couldn't wait to hear the case, saying the court doesn't "have the whole set of facts" and that the court doesn't "really know enough to be confident" that the theories posed are applicable.
paras.zh: 她还多次质疑法院为何迫不及待地审理此案，称法院没有“掌握全部事实”，也没有“真正了解足够的信息来确信”所提出的理论是适用的。

paras.en: "It feels to me like the defendants ... are bringing it back to federal court before the state courts have really had a chance to sort out who is the source, what is their allegation with respect to how this causation is happening," Jackson told Principal Deputy Solicitor General Sarah Harris, who argued in support of Suncor.
paras.zh: “在我看来，被告……在州法院真正有机会弄清楚谁是消息来源、他们对这种因果关系如何发生的指控是什么之前，就将其带回联邦法院，”杰克逊告诉首席副检察长莎拉·哈里斯(Sarah Harris)，后者支持森科尔。

paras.en: Meanwhile, Sotomayor refused to drop her line of questioning on jurisdiction with Shanmugam, proposing that the Supreme Court send the case back to the Colorado Supreme Court.
paras.zh: 与此同时，索托马约尔拒绝放弃对尚穆根管辖权的质疑，建议最高法院将案件发回科罗拉多州最高法院。

paras.en: "If we're unsure of your characterization, because there's certainly a number of amici brief who disagree with that characterization, shouldn't we be certifying this question to the Colorado court instead of us deciding it? We have to be sure of our jurisdiction before we take it," Sotomayor said.
paras.zh: 索托马约尔说：“如果我们不确定你的定性，因为肯定有许多法庭之友不同意这种定性，那么我们不应该向科罗拉多州法院证明这个问题，而不是我们自己决定吗？在接受之前，我们必须确定我们的管辖权。”

paras.en: Republican Alabama Attorney General Steve Marshall told Fox News Digital it was clear that the liberal justices were trying to cast doubt on whether they have jurisdiction.
paras.zh: 阿拉巴马州共和党总检察长史蒂夫·马歇尔告诉福克斯新闻数字频道，很明显，自由派法官试图质疑他们是否拥有管辖权。

paras.en: "Well, I think you saw both Justice Jackson and Justice Sotomayor try to find an out for this court, basically saying the court doesn't have jurisdiction at this stage of the case to be able to make a final ruling. I think that you saw the advocates on behalf of Suncor be able to distinguish that."
paras.zh: “好吧，我认为你看到杰克逊法官和索托马约尔法官都试图为法庭找出答案，基本上是说法院在案件的现阶段没有管辖权来做出最终裁决。我认为你看到代表森科尔的辩护人能够区分这一点。”

paras.en: If the Supreme Court declines to reach the federalism issue, the Colorado Supreme Court's ruling allowing Boulder's state-law claims to proceed would remain in place, leaving the broader question of how far states can use tort law to pursue climate claims against energy companies unresolved.
paras.zh: 如果最高法院拒绝解决联邦制问题，科罗拉多州最高法院允许博尔德的州法律索赔继续进行的裁决将继续存在，从而使各州可以在多大程度上利用侵权法对能源公司提出气候索赔这一更广泛的问题得到解决。

paras.en: Chief Justice John Roberts pressed Boulder attorney Kevin Russell on whether a Boulder win could trigger similar lawsuits nationwide. Russell said there are legal limits, but acknowledged to Justice Clarence Thomas that Boulder's theory could allow other fossil-fuel businesses to be sued.
paras.zh: 首席大法官约翰·罗伯茨向博尔德律师凯文·罗素施压，询问博尔德的胜利是否会在全国范围内引发类似的诉讼。拉塞尔表示存在法律限制，但向克拉伦斯·托马斯法官承认，博尔德的理论可能允许其他化石燃料企业受到起诉。

paras.en: "The chief justice and the court do not like issuing rulings with no limiting principles, rulings that could open up unlimited litigation and claims. Kannon Shanmugam, the lawyer for Suncor, emphasized this again at the very end of the oral argument when he pointed out that there are not only 90,000 political jurisdictions that could sue, but individuals could also sue claiming damages from global warming," von Spakovsky said.
paras.zh: 冯·斯帕科夫斯基表示：“首席大法官和法院不喜欢做出没有限制性原则的裁决，这些裁决可能会引发无限的诉讼和索赔。森科公司的律师坎农·尚穆根在口头辩论的最后再次强调了这一点，他指出，不仅有9万个政治管辖区可以提起诉讼，个人也可以提起诉讼，要求因全球变暖造成的损失。”

paras.en: "And he also pointed out something the conservative majority frowns upon: that Boulder is trying to resolve a major policy issue in the courts instead of in the legislative branches," von Spakovsky continued.
paras.zh: “他还指出了保守派多数人不赞成的事情：博尔德试图在法院而不是立法部门解决重大政策问题，”冯·斯帕科夫斯基继续说道。

paras.en: Supporters of Suncor say the lawsuits could "bankrupt" oil companies and cause the price for consumers to go up.
paras.zh: 森科尔公司的支持者表示，这些诉讼可能会使石油公司“破产”，并导致消费者的价格上涨。

paras.en: "It's to basically create a carbon tax on both producers and emitters across the country, which would include, by the way, my cattlemen in Alabama producing beef for our country, those that are creating concrete to be able to build structures and be able to grow our economy," Marshall told Fox News. "They ultimately want to bankrupt that industry to have their preferred climate change policies be in play."
paras.zh: 马歇尔对福克斯新闻表示：“这基本上是对全国的生产者和排放者征收碳税，其中包括我在阿拉巴马州为我们国家生产牛肉的牧民，以及那些正在建造混凝土以建造结构和发展我们经济的人。” “他们最终希望让这个行业破产，以便让他们偏爱的气候变化政策发挥作用。”

paras.en: "They're literally addressing behavior that takes place all over the world," Utah Attorney General Derek Brown told Fox News Digital. "They want to regulate not just what happens in Colorado, but what happens in my state of Utah or in Saudi Arabia. That's not the way the system works. So, really, this case comes down to one main issue and that is who gets to decide things like energy policy. And ultimately, under our system, it should be Congress."
paras.zh: 犹他州总检察长德里克·布朗对福克斯新闻数字频道表示：“他们实际上是在解决世界各地发生的行为。” “他们不仅想监管科罗拉多州发生的事情，还想监管我所在的犹他州或沙特阿拉伯发生的事情。这不是系统的运作方式。所以，实际上，这个案子归结为一个主要问题，那就是谁有权决定能源政策等事情。最终，在我们的系统下，应该是国会。”

paras.en: Meanwhile, Boulder alleged ExxonMobil and Suncor knew for decades about the climate risks associated with fossil fuels but misled the public about those risks. The communities estimate that taxpayers could face more than $100 million in costs to adapt to climate-related impacts, including wildfires, drought and damage to roads and other infrastructure.
paras.zh: 与此同时，博尔德声称埃克森美孚和森科几十年来就知道与化石燃料相关的气候风险，但却在这些风险上误导了公众。这些社区估计，纳税人可能面临超过 1 亿美元的成本来适应气候相关影响，包括野火、干旱以及道路和其他基础设施的损坏。

paras.en: Former Washington Gov. Jay Inslee, a Democrat and longtime advocate for aggressive action on climate change, argued those costs are already being felt by communities across the country.
paras.zh: 前华盛顿州州长、民主党人、长期倡导积极应对气候变化行动的杰伊·英斯利 (Jay Inslee) 认为，全国各地的社区已经感受到了这些成本。

paras.en: "As governor, I've worked with so many families who've lost their homes," Inslee told Fox News Digital. "So many communities have essentially burned down, and they ought to be able to have a day in court to hear the evidence, to determine whether the lies of the oil and gas industry legitimately, they make it so that they're held accountable."
paras.zh: “作为州长，我曾与许多失去家园的家庭一起工作，”英斯利告诉福克斯新闻数字频道。 “这么多社区基本上被烧毁了，他们应该能够在法庭上听取证据，以确定石油和天然气行业的谎言是否合法，以便追究他们的责任。”

paras.en: The complaint pointed to a 1977 internal memo from ExxonMobil that circulated among the company's highest-level managers. The memo reported that "current scientific opinion overwhelmingly favors" that fossil fuels contribute to the rise in CO2 emissions.
paras.zh: 投诉提到埃克森美孚公司 1977 年的一份内部备忘录，该备忘录在公司最高层管理人员中流传。该备忘录称，“目前的科学观点压倒性地支持”化石燃料导致二氧化碳排放量增加。

paras.en: "Their own scientists knew that their product was dangerous, that it was going to cause more fires. And they knew this for decades, 1967, their own scientists told them it could be catastrophic, so they knew about it, they lied about it," Inslee said. "Now it's an American right to be in court. Nobody should bar an American from their day in court."
paras.zh: “他们自己的科学家知道他们的产品是危险的，会引起更多火灾。他们几十年来都知道这一点，1967 年，他们自己的科学家告诉他们这可能是灾难性的，所以他们知道这一点，但他们对此撒了谎，”英斯利说。 “现在出庭是美国人的权利。任何人都不应该阻止美国人出庭。”

articles.title: Cornell picks former deputy US attorney general to review sex assault response

paras.en: Cornell University has enlisted former Deputy U.S. Attorney Sally Yates to conduct a review of the institution's responses to sexual assault.
paras.zh: 康奈尔大学已聘请美国前副检察官萨莉·耶茨对该机构对性侵犯的反应进行审查。

paras.en: Cornell announced the review on Tuesday, saying the review will generally cover Cornell's policies aimed at preventing and responding to sexual assault.
paras.zh: 康奈尔大学周二宣布了这项审查，称审查将总体涵盖康奈尔大学旨在预防和应对性侵犯的政策。

paras.en: Yates will also conduct a "detailed review of the University’s response to the allegations involving Jane Doe and members of the Chi Phi fraternity in October 2024, including whether Cornell followed its policies and procedures in responding to the matter."
paras.zh: 耶茨还将“在 2024 年 10 月对大学对涉及无名氏和 Chi Phi 兄弟会成员的指控的回应进行详细审查，包括康奈尔大学在回应此事时是否遵循其政策和程序。”

paras.en: "The review will examine Cornell’s policies, practices and resources across the full range of prevention and response, including how reports are received and investigated; how students are supported; how hearings, disciplinary decisions and appeals are handled; the role, processes and response of campus police; coordination with other law enforcement agencies and prosecutors; campus safety reporting; and policies and oversight involving fraternities, sororities and other student organizations. It will also examine the Board’s oversight of these issues," Cornell said in a statement.
paras.zh: 康奈尔大学在一份声明中表示：“此次审查将审查康奈尔大学在预防和应对方面的政策、做法和资源，包括如何接收和调查报告；如何支持学生；如何处理听证会、纪律决定和上诉；校园警察的作用、流程和反应；与其他执法机构和检察官的协调；校园安全报告；以及涉及兄弟会、姐妹会和其他学生组织的政策和监督。还将审查董事会对这些问题的监督。”

paras.en: Anne Meinig Smalling, who chairs the Cornell University Special Committee of Board of Trustees, said Yates will conduct a "rigorous examination" of Cornell's handling of the issue as student protests have taken over the campus this week.
paras.zh: 康奈尔大学董事会特别委员会主席安妮·梅尼格·斯莫林表示，随着本周学生抗议活动席卷校园，耶茨将对康奈尔大学处理这一问题的方式进行“严格检查”。

paras.en: "Sally Yates brings extraordinary experience, independence and judgment to this work....The questions raised by the Jane Doe matter warrant a rigorous examination of Cornell’s response to that case, but our responsibility is broader," Smalling said in a statement. "We have asked Ms. Yates and her team to examine Cornell’s overall approach to preventing and responding to sexual misconduct, identify where we are doing things well and where we can do better, and recommend changes that will help make our community safer."
paras.zh: 斯莫林在一份声明中表示：“莎莉·耶茨为这项工作带来了非凡的经验、独立性和判断力……无名氏事件提出的问题需要对康奈尔大学对此案的回应进行严格审查，但我们的责任更广泛。” “我们已要求耶茨女士和她的团队检查康奈尔大学预防和应对不当性行为的总体方法，确定我们在哪些方面做得很好，哪些方面可以做得更好，并提出有助于使我们的社区更安全的改变建议。”

paras.en: Seven former Chi Phi fraternity brothers are accused in a lawsuit of drugging and raping a female Cornell student during a night of drinking, drugs and group sex at their fraternity house in October 2024.
paras.zh: 七名前 Chi Phi 兄弟会兄弟被指控于 2024 年 10 月在兄弟会会所的一个晚上喝酒、吸毒和群交时对一名康奈尔大学女学生下药并强奸一名女学生。

paras.en: The accuser, identified in court papers by the pseudonym Jane Doe, alleges the men sexually assaulted her after she arrived intoxicated and was pressured into taking ketamine and other substances. The men have denied wrongdoing, with some maintaining the sexual activity was consensual and others denying they participated in it. No criminal charges have been filed against the seven men.
paras.zh: 法庭文件中的原告化名简·多伊 (Jane Doe)，她声称，在她醉酒抵达并被迫服用氯胺酮和其他物质后，这些男子对她进行了性侵犯。这些男子否认有不当行为，其中一些人坚称性行为是双方同意的，另一些人则否认参与其中。尚未对这七人提出刑事指控。

paras.en: The case has now erupted into a political and legal firestorm, with New York Attorney General Letitia James announcing Friday that her office is conducting an "active criminal investigation" after Gov. Kathy Hochul appointed the Office of the Attorney General as special prosecutor. Cornell has separately agreed to retain outside counsel to conduct an independent review of the university's handling of the allegations.
paras.zh: 此案现已引发一场政治和法律风暴，纽约州总检察长利蒂蒂亚·詹姆斯周五宣布，在州长凯西·霍赫尔任命总检察长办公室为特别检察官后，她的办公室正在进行“积极的刑事调查”。康奈尔大学已单独同意聘请外部律师对大学对指控的处理进行独立审查。

paras.en: At the center of the controversy are sharply conflicting accounts of what happened that night, including differences between what Doe said in the weeks afterward, what prosecutors say they received from Cornell police and the explosive allegations contained in a lawsuit filed nearly two years later.
paras.zh: 争议的中心是对当晚发生的事情的严重矛盾的描述，包括多伊在几周后所说的话、检察官所说的他们从康奈尔警方收到的内容以及近两年后提起的诉讼中包含的爆炸性指控之间的差异。

articles.title: Greek prime minister vows to ‘ramp up’ efforts to regain Parthenon marbles
articles.author: Helena Smith in Athens

paras.en: The Greek prime minister has vowed to “ramp up” his country’s claims to get back the Parthenon marbles from the British Museum, emphasising that his UK counterpart, Andy Burnham, was hugely supportive of restitution efforts before he moved into Downing Street.
paras.zh: 希腊总理发誓要“加大力度”希腊从大英博物馆收回帕台农神庙大理石雕像的主张，并强调英国首相安迪·伯纳姆在入主唐宁街之前就大力支持归还工作。

paras.en: Kyriakos Mitsotakis said he would raise the issue in the strongest of terms when he met Burnham, who was culture secretary in a previous Labour government.
paras.zh: 基里亚科斯·米佐塔基斯表示，当他会见前任工党政府文化大臣伯纳姆时，他将以最强烈的措辞提出这个问题。

paras.en: “Unfortunately they have not progressed,” he told a conference in Athens when asked about talks with London over a muted “hybrid” deal to repatriate the fifth-century BC marbles in return for a treasure trove of other antiquities.
paras.zh: 当被问及与伦敦就一项无声的“混合”协议进行谈判时，他在雅典举行的一次会议上表示：“不幸的是，他们没有取得进展。”该协议旨在归还公元前五世纪的大理石，以换取其他文物宝库。

paras.en: “We will very clearly ramp up the intensity of our claims, not just with the British Museum, but also with the British government. I would also like to remind the audience that the new prime minister of the UK, unequivocally, was supportive of the return of the Parthenon sculptures before he became prime minister.”
paras.zh: “我们将非常明确地加大我们的主张力度，不仅是向大英博物馆，而且是向英国政府。我还想提醒观众，英国新首相在就任首相之前就明确支持归还帕台农神庙雕塑。”

paras.en: It was the first time Mitsotakis had conceded that negotiations with the British Museum, under the aegis of its chair, George Osborne, had failed to make headway.
paras.zh: 这是米佐塔基斯第一次承认，在大英博物馆主席乔治·奥斯本的主持下，与大英博物馆的谈判未能取得进展。

paras.en: Upping the ante, he suggested the fate of the artworks was also connected to Burnham’s stated desire for the UK to have closer ties with the EU. Sculpted to adorn a monumental frieze that embellished the Parthenon, the carvings have been split between Athens and London since their controversial removal at the behest of Lord Elgin, Britain’s ambassador to the Ottoman empire, more than 200 years ago.
paras.zh: 他提高了赌注，表示这些艺术品的命运也与伯纳姆表示的英国与欧盟建立更密切关系的愿望有关。这些雕刻品是为了装饰帕台农神庙的巨大饰带而雕刻的，自 200 多年前英国驻奥斯曼帝国大使埃尔金勋爵要求将这些雕刻品移走以来，这些雕刻品一直在雅典和伦敦两地被分割。

paras.en: “For those of us who were saddened to see the United Kingdom leave the European family, we took great interest in the comments made by the UK PM,” said the Greek leader, citing the possibility of “a stronger relationship between the UK and Europe”.
paras.zh: 这位希腊领导人表示：“对于我们这些因英国脱离欧洲大家庭而感到悲伤的人来说，我们对英国首相的言论非常感兴趣。”他指出，“英国与欧洲之间的关系可能会更加牢固”。

paras.en: “The Parthenon sculptures will be part of this debate, this is not just an issue for Greece. It’s an issue for Europe.”
paras.zh: “帕台农神庙雕塑将成为这场辩论的一部分，这不仅仅是希腊的问题。这是欧洲的问题。”

paras.en: The combative remarks come amid thinly disguised disdain in Athens for Burnham’s seeming about-turn on the sculptures. In private, Greek officials have voiced dismay that within days of assuming office, he should so publicly reverse his position, stating in one of his first interviews that the dispute was “an issue for the British Museum” to resolve.
paras.zh: 在发表这些好斗的言论之际，雅典人对伯纳姆对雕塑的态度发生了明显的转变，毫不掩饰地表示蔑视。私下里，希腊官员对他在上任几天内就公开改变立场表示失望，并在他的第一次采访中表示，这一争端是“大英博物馆需要解决的问题”。

paras.en: Long seen as an advocate of repatriation, Burnham’s support for the antiquities to be returned to Athens dates back 25 years with Greek officials seeing his elevation as the best hope yet of finally ending the row.
paras.zh: 伯纳姆长期以来一直被视为归还的倡导者，他对将古物归还雅典的支持可以追溯到 25 年前，希腊官员将他的提升视为最终结束争端的最佳希望。

paras.en: In 2023, as mayor of Greater Manchester, he appeared to go further than ever before, posting on social media: “Send them back, no strings. And let’s use culture to change how Britain is seen around the world.”
paras.zh: 2023年，作为大曼彻斯特市长，他似乎比以往任何时候都走得更远，在社交媒体上发帖称：“把他们送回去，不附加任何条件。让我们用文化来改变世界对英国的看法。”

paras.en: “His change in stance caused great disappointment,” said one well-placed Greek heritage expert who has legally advised successive governments on the issue. “There was more than an element of perfidious Albion about it.”
paras.zh: “他立场的改变令人非常失望，”一位曾就该问题向历届政府提供法律咨询的希腊遗产专家表示。 “这不仅仅是背信弃义的阿尔比恩的成分。”

paras.en: The British Museum has been home to about 160 metres of the frieze since 1816, when a bankrupt Elgin was forced to sell the marbles in what, even then, was viewed as a controversial acquisition by the British government.
paras.zh: 自 1816 年以来，大英博物馆一直收藏着约 160 米长的大理石饰带，当时破产的埃尔金被迫出售这些大理石，即使在当时，英国政府也认为这是一项有争议的收购。

paras.en: Mitsotakis, whose centre-right administration has sought to refocus the campaign on the idea of reunifying the masterpieces within view of the Acropolis, said on Tuesday that changing attitudes in Britain could not be dismissed.
paras.zh: 米佐塔基斯领导的中右翼政府试图将竞选重点重新集中在将雅典卫城视野范围内的杰作重新统一起来的想法上，米佐塔基斯周二表示，英国态度的转变不容忽视。

paras.en: There was, he said, still room for a “win-win” solution with the imminent closure and renovation of the National Archaeological Museum in Athens allowing gems that had never been seen outside Greece to be sent to the UK in exchange for the sculptures.
paras.zh: 他说，随着雅典国家考古博物馆即将关闭和翻新，仍然存在“双赢”解决方案的空间，允许将从未在希腊境外见过的宝石送往英国以换取雕塑。

paras.en: “[The marbles] reunification in Athens would also set a precedent for a unique cultural partnership between Greece and the UK, and in particular between Greece and the British Museum,” he said. “I will certainly make the case very forcibly to the British PM when I meet him. I think the time has come. British public opinion supports reunification of the sculptures and I do believe that now is the time to push in this direction.”
paras.zh: “[大理石]在雅典的统一也将为希腊和英国之间，特别是希腊和大英博物馆之间独特的文化伙伴关系开创先例，”他说。 “当我见到英国首相时，我肯定会非常有力地向他阐述这一点。我认为时机已经到来。英国公众舆论支持雕塑的统一，我确实相信现在是朝这个方向推动的时候了。”

articles.title: Outcry in Trinidad and Tobago after passing of police bill that could threaten press freedom
articles.author: Natricia Duncan Caribbean correspondent

paras.en: Journalists in Trinidad and Tobago have called for an urgent amendment to a sweeping new bill that increases police powers of search and seizure, which they argue threatens the country’s much-vaunted freedom of the press.
paras.zh: 特立尼达和多巴哥的记者呼吁紧急修正一项全面的新法案，该法案增加了警察搜查和扣押的权力，他们认为这威胁到了该国大肆吹嘘的新闻自由。

paras.en: The government says the special operations bill 2026, passed on 24 September, is designed to tackle alarmingly high crime and murder rates in the Caribbean nation.
paras.zh: 政府表示，9 月 24 日通过的《2026 年特种作战法案》旨在解决这个加勒比国家惊人的高犯罪率和谋杀率。

paras.en: The country has spent more than a year in an almost perpetual state of emergency, with police empowered to bypass normal constitutional rights around arrest, detention, and search and seizure.
paras.zh: 该国一年多以来一直处于几乎永久的紧急状态，警察有权绕过逮捕、拘留、搜查和扣押的正常宪法权利。

paras.en: But journalists in Trinidad and Tobago have called for explicit exemptions in the new legislation to prevent police from searching and seizing their notebooks, phones and laptops.
paras.zh: 但特立尼达和多巴哥的记者呼吁在新立法中明确豁免，以防止警方搜查和扣押他们的笔记本电脑、手机和笔记本电脑。

paras.en: In the past, journalists have been forced to challenge warrants empowering police to raid their homes and offices.
paras.zh: 过去，记者被迫质疑警方搜查其住宅和办公室的搜查令。
