articles.title: China launches Guowang, Yaogan-40 satellites, sets up busy Q4 manifest
articles.author: Andrew Jones

paras.en: HELSINKI — China completed its ninth and tenth launches of September, sending Guowang and Yaogan satellites into orbit, ahead of an intense finish to the year.
paras.zh: 赫尔辛基——中国在 9 月份完成了第九次和第十次发射，将“国王”号和“遥感”卫星送入轨道，为今年的紧张收官做好准备。

paras.en: A Long March 8A lifted off at 9:32 a.m. Eastern (1332 UTC) Sept. 23 from the Hainan commercial spacecraft launch site, carrying the 26th group of satellites for China’s Guowang national low Earth orbit satellite internet project. Less than a day later, a Long March 6A lifted off at 4:46 a.m. Eastern (0846 UTC) Sept. 24 from Taiyuan Satellite Launch Center with the fourth group of Yaogan-40 satellites.
paras.zh: 9月23日东部时间1332年上午9时32分，长征八号A运载火箭从海南商业航天发射场升空，搭载着中国国网国家低轨卫星互联网工程第26组卫星。不到一天后，长征六号甲运载火箭于9月24日东部时间凌晨4时46分（世界标准时间0846）从太原卫星发射中心升空，搭载第四组遥感四十号卫星。

paras.en: The pair of launches capped a September in which Chinese launchers flew at a pace that frequently saw multiple orbital missions within days, including four different rockets launching from three sites within 48 hours Sept. 15–16.
paras.zh: 这两次发射为9月份画上了圆满的句号，中国运载火箭的飞行速度经常在几天内执行多次轨道任务，其中包括9月15日至16日48小时内从三个地点发射的四枚不同的火箭。

paras.en: China Aerospace Science and Technology Corp. (CASC) stated the Guowang satellites had entered their planned orbits. The satellites were later tracked by U.S. Space Force in roughly circular 1,100-kilometer-altitude orbits inclined by 50 degrees. The batch was developed under the overall leadership of the China Academy of Space Technology (CAST), CASC’s main spacecraft maker, according to the corporation.
paras.zh: 中国航天科技集团公司（CASC）表示，国网卫星已进入预定轨道。这些卫星随后被美国太空军在大约 1,100 公里高、倾斜 50 度的圆形轨道上进行跟踪。据该公司称，这批产品是在中国航天科技集团公司主要航天器制造商中国空间技术研究院（CAST）的全面领导下研制的。

paras.en: Guowang is run by China SatNet, a state-owned enterprise established in 2021, and is planned to comprise around 13,000 satellites. The constellation uses satellites from multiple manufacturers and is launched on a range of Long March vehicles, with the Long March 8A, which debuted in February 2025, now launching regularly from Hainan’s commercial pads.
paras.zh: 国网由成立于 2021 年的国有企业中国卫星网运营，计划包含约 13,000 颗卫星。该星座使用多个制造商的卫星，并在一系列长征运载火箭上发射，其中长征八号甲于 2025 年 2 月首次亮相，现在定期从海南的商业发射场发射。

paras.en: The three Yaogan-40 (04) satellites will mainly be used for electromagnetic environment detection and related technology experiments, Xinhua reported, using boilerplate language typical of Yaogan launches. The satellites were also developed under CAST’s leadership.
paras.zh: 据新华社报道，三颗遥感四十（04）卫星将主要用于电磁环境探测和相关技术实验，使用遥感发射典型的样板语言。这些卫星也是在中国科协的领导下研制的。

paras.en: The satellites entered near polar orbits with altitudes of around 800 km, joining three earlier batches in similar orbits. Analysis by Integrity ISR indicates that the Yaogan-40 groups are placed into orbital planes separated by 72 degrees in right ascension of the ascending node, suggesting a fifth group will be needed to complete the constellation.
paras.zh: 这些卫星进入了高度约 800 公里的近极轨道，加入了类似轨道上的三批早期卫星。 Integrity ISR 的分析表明，Yaogan-40 群被放置在升交点赤经中相距 72 度的轨道平面中，这表明需要第五个群来完成该星座。

paras.en: The Long March 6A, a kerosene-liquid oxygen core with solid boosters, is one of CASC’s main vehicles for both Yaogan and megaconstellation missions from Taiyuan. The rocket has now flown 27 times since its debut in March 2022, with all flights successfully reaching orbit, though the upper stage has experienced a number of breakup events after payload deployment.
paras.zh: 长征六号甲运载火箭是带有固体助推器的煤油液氧核心，是中国航天科技集团公司在太原执行遥感和巨型星座任务的主要运载工具之一。自 2022 年 3 月首次亮相以来，该火箭现已飞行 27 次，所有飞行均成功进入轨道，尽管上级在有效载荷部署后经历了多次解体事件。

paras.en: The pair of launches take China to 70 orbital launch attempts for 2026. With the country aiming to surpass 100 launches in a calendar year for the first time, the final quarter will see heavy activity. China launched 26 times in Q3, following 26 in Q2 and 18 in Q1, and would need to conduct at least 31 launches in Q4. The country’s annual launch schedule is typically backloaded with a greater number of launches later in the year.
paras.zh: 这两次发射使中国在 2026 年进行了 70 次轨道发射尝试。由于该国的目标是在一个日历年内首次超过 100 次发射，因此最后一个季度将出现大量活动。中国在第三季度发射了 26 次，继第二季度 26 次和第一季度 18 次之后，第四季度需要至少进行 31 次发射。该国的年度发射计划通常会在今年晚些时候进行更多的发射。

paras.en: One major mission will be Shenzhou-24. China’s next crewed mission now appears likely to launch around November, using a Long March 2F from Jiuquan. The crew is expected, though not officially confirmed, to include a Pakistani payload specialist, chosen from one of two Pakistan Air Force pilots in training at the Astronaut Center of China. The selected astronaut would become the first foreign astronaut to visit Tiangong.
paras.zh: 神舟二十四号将是一项重大任务。中国的下一次载人任务现在看来可能会在 11 月左右发射，使用的是酒泉的长征二号F。尽管尚未正式确认，机组人员预计将包括一名巴基斯坦有效载荷专家，他是从在中国宇航员中心接受训练的两名巴基斯坦空军飞行员中挑选的。入选的宇航员将成为第一位访问天宫的外国宇航员。

paras.en: A press conference a day ahead of the Shenzhou-24 launch may also provide updates or insights into the schedule for the first launch of the Mengzhou new generation spacecraft and the Long March 10A, both of which are related to China’s crewed lunar plans.
paras.zh: 神舟二十四号发射前一天的新闻发布会还可能提供孟州新一代飞船和长征十号甲首次发射时间表的最新情况或见解，这两者都与中国的载人登月计划有关。

paras.en: Possible debut launches include Orienspace’s Gravity-2, iSpace’s Hyperbola-3 with a first stage recovery attempt, and Zhihang-1 from Zenk Space, which earlier aimed for a launch in June. These would add to 2026 debuts including Tianlong-3 (April), Kinetica-2 (March), the Long March 12B (June), Long March 10B (July) and Pallas-1 (Sept. 1).
paras.zh: 可能的首次发射包括Orienspace的Gravity-2、iSpace的Hyperbola-3（进行第一阶段回收尝试）以及Zenk Space的Zhihang-1（其早些时候计划于6月发射）。这些将在 2026 年首次亮相的基础上增加，包括天龙三号（4 月）、动能二号（3 月）、长征十二号乙（六月）、长征十号乙（七月）和帕拉斯一号（九月 1 日）。

paras.en: Numerous launches for the Guowang and Qianfan constellations are expected. Other notable possible payloads in the coming months include Fengxing-1 on a Gravity-1 solid rocket, which could be China’s first commercial orbital transfer vehicle, from Future Space. Also expected are space computing payloads. The schedule for the planned debut flight of the Haolong reusable spaceplane for cargo to Tiangong from AVIC on a Zhuque-3 rocket from Landspace is currently unknown.
paras.zh: 国望星座和千帆星座预计将进行多次发射。未来几个月其他值得注意的可能有效载荷包括来自未来空间的重力一号固体火箭上的风行一号，这可能是中国第一个商业轨道转移飞行器。预计还有太空计算有效载荷。昊龙可重复使用航天飞机计划通过蓝箭朱雀三号火箭从中航工业飞往天宫的首次飞行时间表目前尚不清楚。

articles.title: Agile Space Industries Strengthens Board and Corporate Development to Support Continued Growth
articles.author: Agile Space Industries

paras.en: DURANGO, Colo., Oct. 5, 2026 — Agile Space Industries today announced that Jonathan Baliff has joined its Board of Directors, bringing extensive experience in aerospace, finance, and corporate leadership. His appointment, alongside the addition of Theo Squires as Director of Strategy & Corporate Development, strengthens Agile’s ability to execute its long-term growth strategy, support capital formation, and pursue strategic opportunities as the company continues to scale.
paras.zh: 科罗拉多州杜兰戈，2026 年 10 月 5 日 — Agile Space Industries 今天宣布 Jonathan Baliff 加入其董事会，带来了航空航天、金融和企业领导方面的丰富经验。他的任命以及 Theo Squires 担任战略与企业发展总监的任命，增强了雅居乐执行长期增长战略、支持资本形成以及随着公司规模不断扩大而寻求战略机遇的能力。

paras.en: Agile is entering its next phase with growing opportunities across the commercial and national security space. In particular, the company’s recent selection for the SpaceWERX Strategic Funding Increase (STRATFI) program reflects support for adding the ability to supply complete propulsion subsystems. As Agile expands its capabilities and production capacity, the company is also strengthening the financial and strategic foundation needed to support its long-term objectives.
paras.zh: 敏捷正在进入下一阶段，商业和国家安全领域的机会越来越多。特别是，该公司最近选择的 SpaceWERX 战略资金增加 (STRATFI) 计划反映了对增加提供完整推进子系统的能力的支持。随着敏捷公司扩大其能力和生产能力，该公司也在加强支持其长期目标所需的财务和战略基础。

paras.en: “Agile has built significant momentum, and our next phase of growth requires the financial capability and oversight to match our technical expertise,” said Chris Pearson, CEO of Agile Space Industries. “Jonathan’s experience in aerospace, capital formation and corporate transformation, combined with Theo’s focus on strategy and corporate development, will help us evaluate new opportunities, make strategic investments and position Agile for sustainable, long-term growth.”
paras.zh: Agile Space Industries 首席执行官克里斯·皮尔森 (Chris Pearson) 表示：“敏捷已经建立了强大的势头，我们下一阶段的增长需要与我们的技术专长相匹配的财务能力和监督。” “乔纳森在航空航天、资本形成和企业转型方面的经验，加上西奥对战略和企业发展的关注，将帮助我们评估新的机会，进行战略投资，并为敏捷的可持续、长期增长做好准备。”

paras.en: Jonathan Baliff Joins Board of Directors
paras.zh: 乔纳森·巴利夫 (Jonathan Baliff) 加入董事会

paras.en: Baliff brings extensive experience across aerospace, finance, and corporate leadership. A former U.S. Air Force aviator and engineer, he currently serves as an operating partner at Genesis Park, where he played a central role in the formation and financing of Redwire Corporation and later served as its chief financial officer. He previously served as president and CEO of Bristow Group and held senior leadership positions at NRG Energy and Credit Suisse. His experience raising capital, guiding strategic investments, and leading organizations through periods of growth and transformation will support Agile as the company continues to scale.
paras.zh: 巴利夫在航空航天、金融和企业领导方面拥有丰富的经验。他曾是美国空军飞行员和工程师，目前担任 Genesis Park 的运营合伙人，在 Redwire Corporation 的组建和融资过程中发挥了核心作用，后来担任该公司的首席财务官。他此前曾担任 Bristow Group 总裁兼首席执行官，并在 NRG Energy 和 Credit Suisse 担任高级领导职务。他在筹集资金、指导战略投资以及领导组织经历成长和转型时期的经验将为敏捷公司的不断扩张提供支持。

paras.en: “Agile has proven it has the technology and operational expertise to compete, win, and profitably grow in a rapidly evolving space market,” said Baliff. “Our customers and capital providers will partner with us as we scale Agile’s technology, expand capacity, and efficiently deploy capital to support the company’s growth. I look forward to working with Chris, our proven team and board to help Agile capitalize on the significant opportunities ahead.”
paras.zh: 巴利夫表示：“敏捷已经证明，它拥有在快速发展的太空市场中竞争、获胜并实现盈利增长的技术和运营专业知识。” “我们的客户和资本提供商将与我们合作，扩展 Agile 的技术、扩大产能并有效部署资本，以支持公司的发展。我期待与我们久经考验的团队和董事会 Chris 合作，帮助 Agile 抓住未来的重大机遇。”

paras.en: Expanding Corporate Development to Support Long-Term Strategy
paras.zh: 扩大企业发展以支持长期战略

paras.en: Squires serves as Agile’s Director of Strategy & Corporate Development. Before joining Agile, he served as an intelligence officer in the Royal Australian Navy, where his work included a bilateral space program involving the United States and Australia. He also worked at Boston Consulting Group, advising advanced manufacturing companies on strategy and operations. At Agile, his experience supports capital formation, strategic investments and potential acquisitions of complementary technologies and capabilities to support the company’s broader growth strategy.
paras.zh: Squires 担任 Agile 的战略与企业发展总监。在加入敏捷之前，他曾在澳大利亚皇家海军担任情报官，其工作包括涉​​及美国和澳大利亚的双边太空计划。他还曾在波士顿咨询集团工作，为先进制造公司提供战略和运营方面的咨询。在敏捷，他的经验支持资本形成、战略投资以及互补技术和能力的潜在收购，以支持公司更广泛的增长战略。

paras.en: “Scaling advanced propulsion hardware requires both technical innovation and a disciplined approach to capital investment,” said Squires. “Our focus is on building a financial foundation to support higher-rate production while identifying strategic opportunities that complement Agile’s existing capabilities. We see significant potential to expand what we can offer customers as the space propulsion market continues to evolve.”
paras.zh: “扩展先进的推进硬件需要技术创新和严格的资本投资方法，”斯奎尔斯说。 “我们的重点是建立财务基础以支持更高的生产速度，同时寻找补充敏捷现有能力的战略机会。随着太空推进市场的不断发展，我们看到了扩大我们为客户提供服务的巨大潜力。”

paras.en: As part of the board’s evolution, Tom Rubin is departing Agile’s Board of Directors and will continue to support the company in an advisory capacity.
paras.zh: 作为董事会发展的一部分，汤姆·鲁宾 (Tom Rubin) 将离开敏捷董事会，并将继续以顾问身份为公司提供支持。

paras.en: During his board service, Rubin contributed valuable legal expertise and counsel as Agile navigated a period of significant growth. The company is grateful for his contributions and looks forward to continuing to benefit from his experience and institutional knowledge in his advisory role.
paras.zh: 在担任董事会职务期间，鲁宾为敏捷公司度过了一段显着增长的时期，贡献了宝贵的法律专业知识和建议。该公司感谢他的贡献，并期待继续受益于他在顾问角色中的经验和机构知识。

paras.en: Agile Space Industries develops advanced chemical propulsion solutions that enable spacecraft to move, maneuver, and operate in space. From early concepts to the high-rate production of flight hardware, Agile brings together propulsion expertise, additive manufacturing, and in-house testing to rapidly solve complex challenges and accelerate delivery. Agile partners with leading aerospace companies and the U.S. Government on spacecraft and launch vehicle programs. Learn more at agilespaceindustries.com.
paras.zh: Agile Space Industries 开发先进的化学推进解决方案，使航天器能够在太空中移动、机动和运行。从早期概念到飞行硬件的高速生产，Agile 汇集了推进专业知识、增材制造和内部测试，以快速解决复杂的挑战并加速交付。 Agile 与领先的航空航天公司和美国政府就航天器和运载火箭项目开展合作。请访问agilespaceindustries.com 了解更多信息。

articles.title: Resource competition intensifies with surge in megaconstellations
articles.author: Hope Hodge Seck

paras.en: Amazon wants more than 5,000 satellites in orbit. Blue Origin has proposed another 5,400. Chinese companies have filed plans encompassing vastly more. Elon Musk has talked about a constellation numbering 1 million.
paras.zh: 亚马逊希望将 5,000 多颗卫星送入轨道。 Blue Origin 还提出了另外 5,400 个。中国公司已经提交了包含更多内容的计划。埃隆·马斯克曾谈到过一个数量为 100 万的星座。

paras.en: There is one issue: building all of them.
paras.zh: 有一个问题：建造所有这些。

paras.en: The unprecedented rush to put satellites into low Earth orbit is colliding with shortages of specialized components and materials, suppliers struggling to keep up and competition from the booming artificial intelligence industry. The squeeze is forcing satellite companies to rethink designs, accept delays and confront a more fundamental question about the timelines for what’s possible.
paras.zh: 将卫星送入近地轨道的空前热潮正与专业部件和材料的短缺、供应商的疲软以及蓬勃发展的人工智能行业的竞争相冲突。这种挤压迫使卫星公司重新考虑设计，接受延误，并面对一个更根本的问题，即可能发生的事情的时间表。

paras.en: Competition for scarce resources and supplies amid surging demand is forcing tradeoffs in industry that threaten to delay launches and may push companies out of the market or trigger greater consolidation.
paras.zh: 在需求激增的情况下，对稀缺资源和供应的竞争正在迫使行业进行权衡，这可能会推迟发布，并可能将公司赶出市场或引发更大的整合。

paras.en: “Companies right now are just looking at where they might be able to take additional risk,” said Steve Jordan Tomasweski, vice president of space systems for the Aerospace Industries Association. He participated in a supply chain analysis with audit firm PricewaterhouseCoopers earlier this year that involved talking to dozens of industry representatives.
paras.zh: 航空航天工业协会太空系统副总裁史蒂夫·乔丹·托马斯维斯基（Steve Jordan Tomasweski）表示：“公司现在只是在考虑在哪些方面可以承担额外的风险。”今年早些时候，他参加了审计公司普华永道的供应链分析，其中涉及与数十名行业代表的交谈。

paras.en: Tomasweski said supply chain challenges have companies looking for “where they can maybe downgrade something to not using a space-qualified component … Maybe they’re okay waiting a year for a certain type of valve because they know that’s going to be something they really have to deliver on.”
paras.zh: Tomasweski 表示，供应链面临的挑战让公司寻找“他们可以将某些产品降级为不使用符合太空要求的组件……也许他们可以为某种类型的阀门等待一年，因为他们知道这将是他们真正必须交付的东西。”

paras.en: The 54-page analysis isolated nine critical components contributing to supply chain bottlenecks due to an inability to keep up with demand, ranging from valves and actuators to switchgears and transformers. The report incorporated insights from about 30 professionals representing various parts of the satellite supply chain.
paras.zh: 这份长达 54 页的分析列出了由于无法满足需求而导致供应链瓶颈的九个关键组件，从阀门和执行器到开关设备和变压器。该报告融合了代表卫星供应链各个部分的约 30 名专业人士的见解。

paras.en: “We hear from companies that because demand is so high and capacity is not keeping up with demand,” Tomasweski said. “That’s what’s forcing them to really make some of those hard decisions.”
paras.zh: “我们从公司那里得知，由于需求如此之高，而产能却跟不上需求，”托马斯维斯基说。 “这就是迫使他们真正做出一些艰难决定的原因。”

paras.en: According to some estimates, the next few years could mean the nearly 19,000 satellites now in LEO joined by 70,000 more. And while analysts who spoke with SpaceNews were, across the board, unwilling to speak to companies’ plans and challenges on the record, they agreed that the coming demand signal will only exacerbate already-felt bottlenecks around limited and necessary resources.
paras.zh: 据一些估计，未来几年可能意味着近 19,000 颗卫星目前位于低地轨道，届时将增加 70,000 颗。尽管接受《SpaceNews》采访的分析师普遍不愿公开谈论公司的计划和挑战，但他们一致认为，即将到来的需求信号只会加剧有限和必要资源方面已经存在的瓶颈。

paras.en: As space companies face a ramp-up in competition from Earth-based data centers for the minerals and materials they need to launch megaconstellations, experts say something’s got to give, in the form of delays, industry consolidation, material substitutions or favorable new policies. And, amid increasing global instability, certain industry shocks could be sudden and severe.
paras.zh: 由于航天公司面临着来自地球数据中心对发射巨型星座所需的矿物和材料的激烈竞争，专家表示，必须采取一些措施，例如延迟、行业整合、材料替代或有利的新政策。而且，在全球不稳定因素日益增加的情况下，某些行业冲击可能是突然且严重的。

paras.en: One bottleneck stems from access to the rare earth minerals that are crucial for electronic components.
paras.zh: 一个瓶颈源于对电子元件至关重要的稀土矿物的获取。

paras.en: Carla Filotico, partner and managing director at the European consulting firm Novaspace, told SpaceNews she’s particularly concerned about gallium nitride (GaN) and germanium, two minerals used to build high-efficiency solar cells. For common satellite materials like aluminum, the possibility of running out isn’t much of a concern, she said.
paras.zh: 欧洲咨询公司 Novaspace 的合伙人兼董事总经理 Carla Filotico 告诉 SpaceNews，她特别担心氮化镓 (GaN) 和锗，这两种用于制造高效太阳能电池的矿物。她说，对于铝等常见卫星材料来说，用完的可能性并不大。

paras.en: “If we assume an average of 500 kilos of mass per satellite, and we make a pure calculation of the amount of aluminum necessary, we can say that, from the primary aluminum production that is currently quite large globally, this space sector is still a niche,” Filotico said.
paras.zh: 菲洛蒂科说：“如果我们假设每颗卫星的平均质量为 500 公斤，并纯粹计算所需的铝量，我们可以说，从目前全球相当大的原铝产量来看，这个航天领域仍然是一个利基市场。”

paras.en: Space applications make up a few percent of the market demand for GaN, on the other hand, and China’s chokehold on production, at around 98%, leaves U.S. and European companies vulnerable, she said. China is also a dominant producer of germanium, for which space applications make up an even larger market share.
paras.zh: 她表示，另一方面，太空应用仅占 GaN 市场需求的几个百分点，而中国对 GaN 产量的控制（约 98%）使美国和欧洲公司处于弱势。中国也是锗的主要生产国，其空间应用占据了更大的市场份额。

paras.en: She added that any restrictions on gallium export could cause a shortage for the space sector that could hit at any time.
paras.zh: 她补充说，对镓出口的任何限制都可能导致航天领域随时可能出现短缺。

paras.en: Even aluminum has become more scarce and costly amid shipping disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz caused by the U.S.-Iran conflict.
paras.zh: 由于美伊冲突导致霍尔木兹海峡航运中断，就连铝也变得更加稀缺和昂贵。

paras.en: “Supply chain resilience has been a topic that has been very popular since COVID, but it’s just accelerated with more and more of these conflicts and disruptions,” said Doug Anderson, a partner at PwC’s Operations and Supply Chain Services practice who collaborated on the joint AIA report on space supply chain bottlenecks, released in March.
paras.zh: 普华永道运营和供应链服务业务合伙人道格·安德森 (Doug Anderson) 表示：“自新冠肺炎疫情以来，供应链弹性一直是一个非常热门的话题，但随着越来越多的冲突和干扰，供应链的弹性正在加速。”他参与撰写了 3 月份发布的美国建筑师协会关于太空供应链瓶颈的联合报告。

paras.en: “The Strait of Hormuz has impacted aluminum, has impacted helium. These are things that are very important for the space supply chain,” he said.
paras.zh: “霍尔木兹海峡影响了铝，也影响了氦。这些对于太空供应链来说非常重要，”他说。

paras.en: It’s a problem with a dangling threat but no clear solution, although the last year has seen efforts to establish new mineral supply pipelines, such as a May 2025 agreement between defense prime RTX and Emirates Global Aluminum to start up gallium production in Abu Dhabi. Filotico said the worst of the resource squeeze is likely to be felt in the next five years, with the planned peak of the new constellation launch wave set to hit by 2030.
paras.zh: 这是一个悬而未决的问题，但没有明确的解决方案，尽管去年人们努力建立新的矿产供应管道，例如国防总理 RTX 与阿联酋全球铝业公司于 2025 年 5 月达成协议，在阿布扎比启动镓生产。 Filotico表示，未来五年可能会感受到最严重的资源紧张，计划中的新星座发射浪潮将在2030年达到峰值。

paras.en: A trade disruption or geopolitical crisis that disrupts access to GaN and germanium “could certainly cause space sector shortage,” Filotico said.
paras.zh: 菲洛蒂科表示，贸易中断或地缘政治危机会扰乱获取 GaN 和锗的渠道，“肯定会导致航天部门短缺”。

paras.en: And megaconstellations, due to the realities of scaling and maintenance, exacerbate the hazard of a sudden disruption to mineral supply. At one to two solar arrays per satellite, a single megaconstellation can easily require 10,000-20,000 solar panels.
paras.zh: 而巨型星座，由于规模和维护的现实，加剧了矿产供应突然中断的危险。每颗卫星配备一到两个太阳能电池阵列，单个巨型星座很容易需要 10,000-20,000 个太阳能电池板。

paras.en: “We are talking about thousands of satellites per company per year at least, because you need to replenish the satellites every four or five years, depending on the orbital height,” Filotico said.
paras.zh: “我们谈论的是每家公司每年至少有数千颗卫星，因为你需要每四到五年补充一次卫星，具体取决于轨道高度，”菲洛蒂科说。

paras.en: The PwC-AIA analysis earlier this year revealed, among other things, that parts shortages are due not only to an inability to move faster and produce more, but also an unwillingness to do so.
paras.zh: 普华永道-友邦保险今年早些时候的分析显示，零部件短缺不仅是因为无法更快地行动和生产更多，而且还因为不愿意这样做。

paras.en: The report described suppliers who were passing up changes to bid on space work, “citing high complexity requirements and low return on effort.” It described one case specifically in which a legacy supplier opted not to rebid on making composite overwrapped pressure vessels, needed to store high pressure gases, because the work would take about one-third of all the available engineering time while only generating “low single-digit revenue.”
paras.zh: 该报告描述了那些放弃太空工作投标变更的供应商，“理由是复杂性要求高，工作回报率低”。它特别描述了一个案例，其中一家传统供应商选择不再重新投标制造需要储存高压气体的复合材料包裹压力容器，因为这项工作将占用所有可用工程时间的大约三分之一，同时只能产生“低个位数的收入”。

paras.en: At the Air Force Association’s Air Space & Cyber conference in September, Gurpartap “GP” Sandhoo, director of the Space Development Agency, said his organization continues to face supply-chain throughput and quality problems as it builds out its missile-tracking and data-transport constellations.
paras.zh: 在 9 月份的空军协会航空航天与网络会议上，太空发展局局长 Gurpartap“GP”Sandhoo 表示，他的组织在建设导弹跟踪和数据传输星座时继续面临供应链吞吐量和质量问题。

paras.en: “We have had a demand signal, but the quality control and being able to produce things at scale has been a challenge,” Sandhoo said.
paras.zh: “我们已经收到了需求信号，但质量控制和大规模生产一直是一个挑战，”桑德胡说。

paras.en: He pointed to optical communications hardware and focal-plane arrays as areas where suppliers have struggled with throughput, as well as the difficulty of manufacturing hardware that can withstand launch.
paras.zh: 他指出，光通信硬件和焦平面阵列是供应商在吞吐量方面苦苦挣扎的领域，以及制造能够承受发射的硬件的难度。

paras.en: Compounding the challenges, Tomasweski said, are a surfeit of parts pipelines with just one or two suppliers, leading to single points of failure, and new customer competition in the form of AI data centers.
paras.zh: Tomasweski 表示，只有一两家供应商的零部件供应渠道过多，导致单点故障以及人工智能数据中心形式的新客户竞争，这使得挑战更加复杂。

paras.en: Some suppliers are approaching changing buying patterns by designing parts that can scale to perform in both critical and risk-tolerant mission scenarios, Ken Stoler, a space business development lead for Arrow said on SpaceNews’ Space Minds podcast. He argued that a strong supply chain must be resilient and diverse.
paras.zh: Arrow 太空业务开发主管肯·斯托勒 (Ken Stoler) 在 SpaceNews 的 Space Minds 播客中表示，一些供应商正在通过设计可扩展以在关键和风险承受任务场景中执行的零件来改变购买模式。他认为，强大的供应链必须具有弹性和多样性。

paras.en: The demand for data centers has notably increased even in the months since the supply chain report was released, he said, and the builders of those centers may represent a more attractive and profitable customer for suppliers of critical components than satellite constellation-makers. With switchgears and transformers specifically, the report found AI companies were “gobbling these things up at scale” and creating years-long parts backlogs.
paras.zh: 他表示，即使在供应链报告发布后的几个月内，对数据中心的需求也显着增加，对于关键部件供应商来说，这些数据中心的建设者可能比卫星星座制造商更具吸引力和利润。报告发现，特别是开关设备和变压器，人工智能公司正在“大规模吞噬这些东西”，并造成长达数年的零件积压。

paras.en: “For a space company to come in and say, ‘Hey, we want to buy 10 of these for a new factory’ — compare that to … a big artificial intelligence company or data center company buying 10,000 of these things,” Tomasweski said.
paras.zh: “对于一家航天公司来说，‘嘿，我们想为新工厂购买 10 个这样的东西’——与……一家大型人工智能公司或数据中心公司购买 10,000 个这样的东西相比，”Tomasweski 说。

paras.en: “The scale of it, even with the surge in space, isn’t big enough to kind of change the trajectory of where those electrical boxes are going.”
paras.zh: “即使空间激增，它的规模也不足以改变这些配电箱的运行轨迹。”

paras.en: A challenge to broader efforts to ensure space companies have what they need to execute on their launch plans is a consistent and continual way to measure available resources, he said. There’s no guarantee, he added, that the nine critical components highlighted in March would still be at the top of the list today, and no simple way to find out.
paras.zh: 他表示，确保航天公司拥有执行发射计划所需资源的更广泛努力所面临的挑战是衡量可用资源的一致且持续的方法。他补充说，不能保证 3 月份强调的九个关键组成部分今天仍然位于列表的首位，而且没有简单的方法可以找出答案。

paras.en: “It’s been the problem with space that there hasn’t been kind of consistent awareness of where those issues are across programs, across you know national security space, civil space and commercial space,” Tomasweski said.
paras.zh: 托马斯韦斯基说：“太空问题一直存在，人们对这些问题在各个项目、国家安全太空、民用太空和商业太空中的具体位置缺乏一致的认识。”

paras.en: That kind of data could also make it easier to enact policy interventions. For example, Tomasweski proposes a “skip the line” authority that would allow the space industrial base to get in front of data centers and other competitors for resources.
paras.zh: 此类数据还可以使政策干预措施的实施变得更加容易。例如，托马斯韦斯基提出了一种“免排队”权限，允许航天工业基地领先于数据中心和其他竞争对手获取资源。

paras.en: “If we want to deliver on all these great capabilities from space and explore the solar system and beat China, you know, back to the moon, we might need to make sure that space is prioritized amongst all the other national priorities that we have,” he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“如果我们想从太空发挥所有这些强大的能力，探索太阳系并击败中国，重返月球，我们可能需要确保太空在我们所有其他国家优先事项中占据优先地位。”

paras.en: Tomasweski said he was encouraged by steps from the federal Office of Space Commerce to allow government and industry players to strategize over supply chain issues and discuss possible regulatory moves that could help.
paras.zh: 托马斯韦斯基表示，联邦太空商务办公室采取的措施让他感到鼓舞，这些措施允许政府和行业参与者就供应链问题制定战略，并讨论可能有帮助的监管举措。

paras.en: “One big thing I think really still needs to get figured out is where the belly button is for fixing supply chain issues, especially at different government agencies,” he said. “Supply chain is a challenge because it is everybody’s problem, but it’s also nobody’s problem.”
paras.zh: “我认为真正需要弄清楚的一件大事是解决供应链问题的肚脐在哪里，特别是在不同的政府机构，”他说。 “供应链是一个挑战，因为它是每个人的问题，但也不是任何人的问题。”

paras.en: Another unspoken reality, according to multiple experts, is that some megaconstellation launch plans simply won’t come to fruition, at least not as originally envisioned. Space-watchers expect to see an increase in vertical integration, in which larger companies fold parts of their supply chain into themselves. But they also anticipate industry consolidation, along with some companies dropping out of the market as they find themselves unable to achieve their objectives on their own.
paras.zh: 多位专家表示，另一个不言而喻的现实是，一些巨型星座发射计划根本不会实现，至少不会像最初设想的那样。太空观察家期望看到垂直整合的增加，即大公司将部分供应链纳入自身。但他们也预计行业整合，一些公司会因为发现自己无法实现自己的目标而退出市场。

paras.en: “Ten, 12 years ago, when the applications were submitted with the FCC for constellations of low Earth orbit satellites, no one expected all of them to move forward, and some of them just decided not to move forward with their plans,” said Doug Stroup, president of the Satellite Industry Association. “I suspect that we’ll see some of the same thing happening with respect to the recent round of applications that have been filed.”
paras.zh: 卫星工业协会主席道格·斯特鲁普 (Doug Stroup) 表示：“10 年、12 年前，当向 FCC 提交近地轨道卫星星座申请时，没有人期望所有这些卫星都会向前推进，其中一些只是决定不再推进他们的计划。” “我怀疑我们会在最近一轮提交的申请中看到一些同样的事情发生。”

paras.en: This article first appeared in the October 2026 issue of SpaceNews Magazine.
paras.zh: 本文首次发表于 2026 年 10 月号《太空新闻》杂志。

articles.title: A Journey to the Depths of Ancient Mars?

paras.en: Written by Alex Jones, Ph.D. candidate at Imperial College London
paras.zh: 由亚历克斯·琼斯博士撰写伦敦帝国理工学院候选人

paras.en: After spending the last six months exploring “Lac de Charmes,” a region of ancient rock beyond Jezero crater’s western rim, Perseverance has stumbled upon a vast field of light-toned rocks peppering the Martian surface.
paras.zh: 在花了过去六个月的时间探索“魅力湖”（Jezero 陨石坑西缘以外的一个古老岩石区域）后，毅力号偶然发现了火星表面布满了一大片浅色岩石。

paras.en: Light-colored rocks are a strange sight on Mars, a planet dominated by dark-colored basaltic rocks. This many light-colored rocks in one place piqued the Science Team’s interest… what are they? How did they get here?
paras.zh: 浅色岩石在火星上是一种奇怪的景象，火星是一颗以深色玄武岩为主的行星。一处这么多浅色岩石引起了科学小组的兴趣……它们是什么？他们是怎么来到这里的？

paras.en: To answer the first question, Perseverance has been investigating the composition and textures of these rocks. Data so far indicates that many of them are igneous rocks called gabbro, which are dominated by minerals rich in iron and magnesium. Such rocks typically form by slow cooling and crystallization of magma deep in the crust.
paras.zh: 为了回答第一个问题，毅力号一直在研究这些岩石的成分和纹理。迄今为止的数据表明，其中许多是被称为辉长岩的火成岩，其主要成分是富含铁和镁的矿物质。此类岩石通常是由地壳深处的岩浆缓慢冷却和结晶形成的。

paras.en: So how did these deep fragments of Mars find their way to the surface?
paras.zh: 那么这些火星深处的碎片是如何到达地表的呢？

paras.en: Perseverance has spent the last week trying to answer this question by investigating a patch of possible bedrock poking out between the light-toned boulders and loose regolith.
paras.zh: 上周，毅力号一直试图通过调查浅色巨石和松散风化层之间可能出现的一块基岩来回答这个问题。

paras.en: Initial images suggest that the rock is made up of light- and dark-colored, angular fragments of rock, forming what geologists call a breccia. One possibility the team is investigating is that the light-toned boulders scattered across the hillside have eroded out of this breccia.
paras.zh: 最初的图像表明，这块岩石是由浅色和深色的有棱角的岩石碎片组成，形成了地质学家所说的角砾岩。该团队正在调查的一种可能性是，散布在山坡上的浅色调巨石已经从角砾岩中侵蚀出来。

paras.en: Breccias often form through violent processes involving the fracturing and transport of rock to produce their angular shapes. Layers of breccia observed outside Jezero have previously been attributed to asteroid impacts on early Mars. Perhaps similar impacts (or the Jezero impact itself?) could be responsible for digging up these light-colored blocks.
paras.zh: 角砾岩通常是通过剧烈的过程形成的，涉及岩石的破裂和运输以产生其棱角形状。此前在杰泽罗外观察到的角砾岩层被认为是小行星撞击早期火星造成的。也许类似的撞击（或者杰泽罗撞击本身？）可能是挖掘出这些浅色块的原因。

paras.en: Only time (and of course, Perseverance), will tell.
paras.zh: 只有时间（当然还有毅力）才能证明一切。

articles.title: Curiosity Blog, Sols 5029-5035: Back in the Lab

paras.en: Written by Michelle Minitti, MAHLI Deputy Principal Investigator
paras.zh: 作者：MAHLI 副首席研究员 Michelle Minitti

paras.en: Earth planning date: Friday, Oct. 1, 2026
paras.zh: 地球规划日期：2026 年 10 月 1 日星期五

paras.en: The majority of Curiosity plans involve mosaics from Mastcam and ChemCam, chemistry analyses from ChemCam and APXS, images from MAHLI and MARDI, and systematic measurements from REMS, RAD, and DAN. It is only when we stop to drill that we fully live up to our Mars Science Laboratory designation, using CheMin and SAM to analyze Martian rock. This was one such week, where our focus was wrapping up CheMin analysis of a sample from the “Basque Lakes” drill hole (pictured above), preparing SAM for its analysis, and analyzing the sample with the SAM tunable laser spectrometer (TLS). The CheMin data were key to SAM deciding to analyze the sample at all, and SAM will wait to receive the results from the TLS run (measurement of the volatiles present) to decide if they want to follow up with a separate mass spectrometry analysis next week.
paras.zh: 大多数好奇号计划涉及来自 Mastcam 和 ChemCam 的马赛克、来自 ChemCam 和 APXS 的化学分析、来自 MAHLI 和 MARDI 的图像以及来自 REMS、RAD 和 DAN 的系统测量。只有当我们停止钻探时，我们才完全达到了火星科学实验室的称号，使用 CheMin 和 SAM 来分析火星岩石。这周就是这样的一周，我们的重点是完成对“巴斯克湖”钻孔样本（如上图所示）的 CheMin 分析，准备 SAM 进行分析，并使用 SAM 可调谐激光光谱仪 (TLS) 分析样本。 CheMin 数据对于 SAM 决定分析样品至关重要，SAM 将等待收到 TLS 运行（存在的挥发物测量）的结果，以决定是否要在下周进行单独的质谱分析。

paras.en: The laboratory activities require a significant portion of the daily power budget of the rover so the rest of the payload largely takes a back seat during drill campaigns, a worthy trade for CheMin and SAM’s valuable data. However, using the power that was available, we gathered data to contextualize our drill location and continued our systematic environmental monitoring. Mastcam acquired a 360-degree mosaic of our surroundings to build a full picture of the geologic setting of the sample. Its color and improved resolution relative to Navcam also guided subsequent science requests, such as more focused Mastcam imaging of structures near the workspace, and ChemCam RMI imaging of the “Cordillera” butte. Mastcam, coupled with Navcam, also planned a series of seven photometry observations spread across fixed times of day. These observations evaluate how the observed spectral characteristics of targets change as the Sun angle on them changes. They help us better interpret images from the rover and from cameras in orbit. ChemCam gathered more chemistry data from the variety of materials in the workspace, from the Basque Lakes drill hole interior, to sand ripples ("French Creek”) covering the bedrock, to loose gray clasts of unknown origin (“Wooley" and “Fireside”) sprinkled across the workspace. Our environmental monitoring activities included regular REMS, RAD, and DAN measurements and Navcam and Mastcam monitoring of dust loading in the atmosphere, cloud activity, and dust-devil activity.
paras.zh: 实验室活动需要流动站每日电力预算的很大一部分，因此其余有效载荷在钻探活动期间基本上处于次要位置，这对 CheMin 和 SAM 的宝贵数据来说是值得的交易。然而，利用可用的电力，我们收集了数据来了解我们的钻探位置，并继续进行系统的环境监测。 Mastcam 获取了我们周围环境的 360 度马赛克图像，以构建样本地质环境的全貌。其颜色和相对于 Navcam 改进的分辨率也指导了后续的科学要求，例如对工作空间附近的结构进行更集中的 Mastcam 成像，以及对“科迪勒拉”山丘进行 ChemCam RMI 成像。 Mastcam 与 Navcam 相结合，还计划在一天中的固定时间进行一系列七次光度测量观测。这些观测评估了观测到的目标光谱特征如何随着太阳角度的变化而变化。它们帮助我们更好地解释来自流动站和轨道上摄像机的图像。 ChemCam 从工作区的各种材料中收集了更多化学数据，从巴斯克湖钻孔内部到沙纹（“法国溪”） 覆盖基岩，到散布在工作空间中的来源不明的松散灰色碎屑（“Wooley”和“Fireside”）。我们的环境监测活动包括定期 REMS、RAD 和 DAN 测量，以及对大气中粉尘含量、云活动和尘暴活动进行导航摄像头和桅杆摄像头监测。

articles.title: The Beaver Brown Waters of Rupert Bay

paras.en: The Cree word pahtaaunaakun seems particularly apt for describing the distinctive brown hues of the waters that drain into Hannah Bay and Rupert Bay in Canada. Meaning the "color of singed beaver" in Southern East Cree, the word evokes the rich brown of the humic-substance-stained waters that were flowing into the two bays in late September 2026, as well as the role that beavers have long played in the mythology and history of the region.
paras.zh: 克里语单词 pahtaaunaakun 似乎特别适合描述流入加拿大汉纳湾和鲁珀特湾的水域独特的棕色色调。在东克里语中，这个词的意思是“烧焦的海狸的颜色”，这个词让人想起2026年9月下旬流入两个海湾的被腐殖质污染的海水的深棕色，以及海狸长期以来在该地区的神话和历史中扮演的角色。

paras.en: As the rivers and streams that flow into the two bays—the southernmost extensions of James Bay—wind through the boreal forests and boggy wetlands of northern Quebec and Ontario, they often carry water stained brown by colored dissolved organic matter (CDOM), which absorbs light in the blue and ultraviolet parts of the electromagnetic spectrum and causes water to appear brown. CDOM, including organic substances derived from tannins and lignins, leaches from decaying leaves, roots, bark, and soils into streams and rivers. Similar substances are what stain tea water brown.
paras.zh: 当流入两个海湾（詹姆斯湾最南端的延伸部分）的河流和溪流蜿蜒穿过魁北克省北部和安大略省北部的北方森林和沼泽湿地时，它们经常携带被有色溶解有机物（CDOM）染成棕色的水，这种物质吸收电磁波谱中的蓝色和紫外线部分的光，使水呈现棕色。 CDOM，包括源自单宁和木质素的有机物质，从腐烂的叶子、根、树皮和土壤中浸出到溪流和河流中。类似的物质使茶水呈棕色。

paras.en: When the OLI (Operational Land Imager) on Landsat 9 captured this image on September 27, 2026, the Moose, Nottaway, and Harricanaw rivers were carrying tea-colored water across the broad mudflats of Hannah and Rupert bays and mingling with the darker blue waters of James Bay.
paras.zh: 当 Landsat 9 上的 OLI（运营陆地成像仪）于 2026 年 9 月 27 日拍摄到这张图像时，穆斯河、诺塔威河和哈里卡诺河正带着茶色的河水穿过汉纳湾和鲁珀特湾的广阔泥滩，并与詹姆斯湾深蓝色的海水混合在一起。

paras.en: The mudflats, the light brown areas along the shore, are a product of the shallow, sloping bathymetry in the southernmost part of James Bay. Postglacial rebound is slowly lifting the entire landscape, and rivers continually deposit fine mud particles and other sediments that build up the flats. The comings and goings of tides and river currents often stir up the mud, producing the lighter brown plumes of suspended sediment that mix with the incoming river water.
paras.zh: 泥滩是沿着海岸的浅棕色区域，是詹姆斯湾最南端浅、倾斜测深的产物。冰河后的反弹正在慢慢抬升整个地貌，河流不断沉积细小的泥颗粒和其他沉积物，形成平坦的地面。潮汐和河水的来来往往会搅动泥浆，产生浅棕色的悬浮沉积物羽状物，与流入的河水混合。

paras.en: Differences in moisture levels and vegetation patterns likely contribute to the green dendritic, veinlike patterns visible onshore. Denser, more forested growth along stream channels appears dark green, while the poorly drained landscapes in the surrounding peat bogs have less extensive tree cover and appear lighter green.
paras.zh: 湿度水平和植被模式的差异可能导致岸上可见的绿色树枝状、静脉状图案。沿着河道更密集、更多的森林生长呈现深绿色，而周围泥炭沼泽排水不良的景观树木覆盖范围较小，呈现浅绿色。

paras.en: Beavers have long played a role in the history and mythology of the lake-dotted landscapes in this part of Canada. The Cree people, who have lived in the region for thousands of years, have traditionally hunted beaver for both meat and pelts. European traders arrived in Rupert Bay as early as the 1660s to pursue the animals as well, leading to the establishment of several trading posts along the bay's shores and the founding of the Hudson's Bay Company to cultivate the fur trade, especially in beaver pelts.
paras.zh: 海狸长期以来在加拿大这一地区湖泊星罗棋布的历史和神话中发挥着重要作用。克里人在该地区生活了数千年，传统上捕猎海狸以获取海狸的肉和毛皮。早在 1660 年代，欧洲商人就抵达鲁珀特湾追逐这些动物，从而在海湾沿岸建立了多个贸易站，并成立了哈德逊湾公司，以发展毛皮贸易，尤其是海狸毛皮贸易。

paras.en: Beavers also feature prominently in the area's Cree mythology and environmental history in other ways. For instance, one Cree myth about this area, recorded by the anthropologist Alanson Skinner, tells of a giant pursuing an enormous mythical beaver down the Nottaway River until the beaver escaped into Rupert Bay. According to the myth, the giant then picked up a huge rock and hurled it at the fleeing animal, missing the beaver but creating Stag Rock, the distinctive island found in the river's mouth today.
paras.zh: 海狸还以其他方式在该地区的克里神话和环境历史中占有重要地位。例如，人类学家阿兰森·斯金纳（Alanson Skinner）记录的有关该地区的克里族神话讲述了一个巨人沿着诺塔威河追逐一只巨大的神话海狸，直到海狸逃进鲁珀特湾。根据神话，巨人随后捡起一块巨大的岩石，向逃跑的动物扔去，虽然没有击中海狸，但却创造了雄鹿岩，即今天在河口发现的独特岛屿。

paras.en: In an early example of a managed beaver preserve in Canada, the Hudson's Bay Company worked with local Cree people in the 1830s and again a century later to set up Charlton Island as a place to raise beavers for later trapping. After predators had been removed and several breeding pairs delivered to the island, its beaver population ballooned, according to historical accounts.
paras.zh: 在加拿大管理海狸保护区的早期例子中，哈得逊湾公司在 1830 年代与当地克里族人合作，并在一个世纪后再次合作，建立查尔顿岛作为饲养海狸以供日后诱捕的地方。根据历史记录，在捕食者被清除并将几对繁殖对带到岛上后，岛上的海狸数量激增。

articles.title: ICC unseals four arrest warrants over Taliban persecution of women and girls

paras.en: ICC unseals four arrest warrants over Taliban persecution of women and girls
paras.zh: 国际刑事法院针对塔利班迫害妇女和女童发出四项逮捕令

paras.en: The International Criminal Court (ICC) has made public four arrest warrants against senior Taliban figures, accusing them of persecuting women and girls in Afghanistan, which amounts to a crime against humanity.
paras.zh: 国际刑事法院（ICC）公布了四项针对塔利班高级人物的逮捕令，指控他们在阿富汗迫害妇女和女童，构成反人类罪。

paras.en: In a decision on Monday, judges unsealed warrants for Taliban Supreme Leader Haibatullah Akhundzada and Chief Justice Abdul Hakim Haqqani, whose existence was announced in July 2025, and for two further suspects, Habibullah Agha and Neda Mohammad Nadim.
paras.zh: 在周一的一项裁决中，法官对塔利班最高领导人海巴图拉·阿洪扎达 (Haibatullah Akhundzada) 和首席大法官阿卜杜勒·哈基姆·哈卡尼 (Abdul Hakim Haqqani) 以及另外两名嫌疑人哈比布拉·阿加 (Habibullah Agha) 和内达·穆罕默德·纳迪姆 (Neda Mohammad Nadim) 发出了逮捕令，他们的存在于 2025 年 7 月宣布。

paras.en: The four warrants were issued between July and September 2025.
paras.zh: 这四份认股权证是在 2025 年 7 月至 9 月期间发行的。

paras.en: The court said there are reasonable grounds to believe all four are criminally responsible for ordering, inducing or soliciting persecution, a crime against humanity under article 7(1)(h) of the Rome Statute, the ICC’s founding treaty.
paras.zh: 法院表示，有合理的理由相信，所有四人都对下令、诱导或教唆迫害负有刑事责任，根据国际刑事法院的创始条约《罗马规约》第 7 条第 1 款第 (h) 款，这是一项危害人类罪。

paras.en: It says the persecution was carried out on gender grounds against girls, women and other people who did not conform to the de facto Taliban government’s policy on gender, gender identity or expression. It was also carried out on political grounds against people seen as “allies of girls and women”.
paras.zh: 报告称，迫害是基于性别原因，针对女孩、妇女和其他不符合塔利班事实上的政府性别、性别认同或表达政策的人。它还出于政治理由针对被视为“女孩和妇女盟友”的人。

paras.en: According to the court, the crimes were committed in Afghanistan from 15 August 2021, when the Taliban seized power, until at least 20 January 2025.
paras.zh: 法院称，这些罪行是从2021年8月15日塔利班夺取政权起至至少2025年1月20日期间在阿富汗犯下的。

paras.en: Judges found that the Taliban had put in place a policy that led to serious violations of the civilian population’s fundamental rights and freedoms, linked to murder, imprisonment, torture, rape and enforced disappearance.
paras.zh: 法官发现，塔利班实施的政策导致严重侵犯平民的基本权利和自由，涉及谋杀、监禁、酷刑、强奸和强迫失踪。

paras.en: While some Taliban rules applied to everyone, the court said girls and women were specifically targeted because of their gender.
paras.zh: 虽然塔利班的一些规则适用于所有人，但法院表示，女孩和妇女因其性别而成为特别目标。

paras.en: Through decrees and edicts, they were severely deprived of their rights to education, privacy and family life and of the freedoms of movement, expression, thought, conscience and religion.
paras.zh: 通过法令和法令，他们的受教育权、隐私权和家庭生活权以及行动、言论、思想、良心和宗教自由被严重剥夺。

paras.en: Other Afghans were targeted because certain expressions of sexuality or gender identity were considered at odds with Taliban policy.
paras.zh: 其他阿富汗人也成为目标，因为某些性行为或性别认同的表达被认为与塔利班政策不一致。

paras.en: The judges also found that people seen as opposing these policies – even passively, or by failing to act – were targeted as political opponents. They included those described as “allies of girls and women”.
paras.zh: 法官还发现，那些被视为反对这些政策的人——即使是被动地反对，或者没有采取行动——也被视为政治对手。其中包括那些被称为“女孩和妇女的盟友”的人。

paras.en: In the warrants, the judges said that the Rome Statute’s definition of gender goes beyond a purely biological idea of sex, in line with current developments in international law.
paras.zh: 法官在逮捕令中表示，《罗马规约》对性别的定义超越了纯粹的生物学性别观念，符合国际法当前的发展。

paras.en: They said it must recognise the socially constructed roles, behaviours, expectations and hierarchies traditionally linked to people because of their sex – commonly known as gender norms – when assessing gender-based persecution.
paras.zh: 他们表示，在评估基于性别的迫害时，必须认识到社会建构的角色、行为、期望和等级制度，这些角色、行为、期望和等级制度传统上与人们的性别有关——通常称为性别规范。

paras.en: The court added that such persecution covers not only direct violence, but also systemic and institutionalised harm, including the imposition of discriminatory social norms.
paras.zh: 法院补充说，这种迫害不仅包括直接暴力，还包括系统性和制度化的伤害，包括施加歧视性的社会规范。

paras.en: The ICC Prosecutor applied for the first two warrants on 23 January 2025, and judges issued them on 8 July that year, initially under seal to protect victims and witnesses and safeguard the proceedings, though the court disclosed they existed.
paras.zh: 国际刑事法院检察官于 2025 年 1 月 23 日申请了前两项逮捕令，法官于当年 7 月 8 日发出了逮捕令，最初是密封的，以保护受害者和证人并保障诉讼程序，尽管法院披露了它们的存在。

paras.en: At the time, the ICC Prosecutor said further applications against other senior Taliban members would follow.
paras.zh: 当时，国际刑事法院检察官表示，针对其他塔利班高级成员的进一步申请将随之而来。

articles.title: Extreme heat making pregnancy a ‘new fault line’ in climate crisis

paras.en: Extreme heat making pregnancy a ‘new fault line’ in climate crisis
paras.zh: 极端高温使怀孕成为气候危机的“新断层线”

paras.en: Pregnancy and childbirth have become a “new fault line in the global climate crisis” as extreme heat worsens, the head of the UN climate action body (UNFCCC) warned on Monday, calling for maternal and newborn health to be built into countries’ climate plans.
paras.zh: 联合国气候行动机构（UNFCCC）负责人周一警告说，随着极端高温的加剧，怀孕和分娩已成为“全球气候危机的新断层线”，呼吁将孕产妇和新生儿健康纳入各国的气候计划。

paras.en: Speaking in Fiji at an event organized by global charitable foundation Wellcome, ahead of the COP31 climate conference in Antalya, UNFCCC chief Simon Stiell said a deep test of climate action was “far, far simpler” than degrees, targets and finance: “whether we protect life at its most fragile”.
paras.zh: 在安塔利亚举行的 COP31 气候大会之前，联合国气候变化框架公约 (UNFCCC) 主席西蒙·斯蒂尔 (Simon Stiell) 在斐济由全球慈善基金会惠康 (Wellcome) 组织的一次活动上发表讲话，他表示，对气候行动的深入考验比程度、目标和资金“简单得多”：“我们是否保护最脆弱的生命”。

paras.en: “Rising temperatures mean rising danger in pregnancy,” he told first day of the pre-COP ministerial meeting, noting that extreme heat during pregnancy is increasingly linked to premature birth, stillbirth, low birth weight and maternal complications.
paras.zh: 他在缔约方会议前部长级会议第一天表示：“气温上升意味着怀孕期间的危险增加。”他指出，怀孕期间的酷热与早产、死产、低出生体重和孕产妇并发症的关系越来越密切。

paras.en: Mr. Stiell cited new data, released on Monday, from a survey commissioned by Wellcome of maternal health professionals in five countries across five continents.
paras.zh: 斯蒂尔先生引用了周一发布的新数据，该数据来自惠康委托对五大洲五个国家的孕产妇保健专业人员进行的调查。

paras.en: Some 73 per cent reported that heat-linked cases or complications had increased over the past five years, while 81 percent were concerned or very concerned that extreme heat would increasingly out maternal, foetal and newborn health at risk without more action.
paras.zh: 约 73% 的受访者表示，过去五年中与热相关的病例或并发症有所增加，而 81% 的受访者则担心或非常担心，如果不采取更多行动，极端高温将日益使孕产妇、胎儿和新生儿的健康面临风险。

paras.en: Nearly all respondents had cared for a pregnant woman or baby whose health they considered had been affected by extreme heat.
paras.zh: 几乎所有受访者都曾照顾过孕妇或婴儿，他们认为这些孕妇或婴儿的健康受到了酷热的影响。

paras.en: “Behind those numbers are human stories: an expectant mother’s journey to clinic delayed by dangerous heat; a midwife working through unsafe temperatures; a newborn needing specialist care,” Mr. Stiell said.
paras.zh: “这些数字的背后是人类的故事：一位准妈妈因危险的高温而延误了去诊所的时间；一位助产士在不安全的温度下工作；一位需要专科护理的新生儿，”斯蒂尔先生说。

paras.en: While no one is immune, he stressed that the risks and impacts are not shared equally. People working outdoors, living in unregulated housing, travelling far to a clinic or relying on facilities without water, power or cooling “cannot be protected by advice alone”.
paras.zh: 虽然没有人能幸免，但他强调，风险和影响并不是平等分担的。在户外工作、住在不受管制的住房中、长途跋涉去诊所或依赖没有水、电或冷却设施的人们“不能仅靠建议得到保护”。

paras.en: “‘Staying cool’ is simply not an option when there is no cool place to go,” he said.
paras.zh: “当没有凉爽的地方可去时，‘保持凉爽’根本不是一个选择，”他说。

paras.en: “A safe birth is already too often shaped by geography, income and access to care. Without action, extreme heat will widen that injustice.”
paras.zh: “安全分娩往往受到地理位置、收入和护理机会的影响。如果不采取行动，极端高温将会加剧这种不公正现象。”

paras.en: For small islands and other nations that “did practically nothing to create this climate crisis”, Mr. Stiell said, the findings underscore the need for support at scale.
paras.zh: 斯蒂尔表示，对于“实际上没有采取任何措施制造这场气候危机”的小岛屿和其他国家来说，调查结果强调了大规模支持的必要性。

paras.en: He called for the tripling of adaptation finance agreed at COP30 in Belém to be delivered and for nations to work with the whole financial system to make $1.3 trillion a year for developing countries a reality.
paras.zh: 他呼吁将贝伦 COP30 上商定的适应资金增加两倍，并呼吁各国与整个金融体系合作，使每年为发展中国家提供的 1.3 万亿美元成为现实。

paras.en: - Making pregnancy and newborn care part of adaptation, heat and health planning;
paras.zh: - 将怀孕和新生儿护理纳入适应、高温和健康规划；

paras.en: - Turning evidence into protection through guidance, training, heat alerts and safer facilities;
paras.zh: - 通过指导、培训、高温警报和更安全的设施，将证据转化为保护；

paras.en: - Improving data to show where risks are growing and which interventions work;
paras.zh: - 改进数据以显示风险在哪里增长以及哪些干预措施有效；

paras.en: “What is not named in a plan is too often not funded, not measured and not protected,” he said. “Harm that is not counted is too easily ignored.”
paras.zh: “计划中未提及的内容往往得不到资助、得不到衡量、也得不到保护，”他说。 “没有被计算在内的伤害很容易被忽视。”

paras.en: He commended the COP31 Presidency of Türkiye and Australia’s President of Negotiations for making health a key priority, building on Brazil’s work last year.
paras.zh: 他赞扬 COP31 主席国土耳其和澳大利亚谈判主席在巴西去年工作的基础上将健康作为一个关键优先事项。

paras.en: “A changing climate must never be accepted as a reason pregnancy and birth become less safe,” he said.
paras.zh: “决不能将气候变化视为怀孕和分娩变得不安全的原因，”他说。

paras.en: “A newborn’s healthy start must never depend on a family’s ability to escape the heat.”
paras.zh: “新生儿的健康开始绝不能取决于家庭是否有能力躲避炎热。”

articles.title: Security, sacrifice or opportunity: Visions differ over effective climate action

paras.en: Security, sacrifice or opportunity: Visions differ over effective climate action
paras.zh: 安全、牺牲还是机会：有效气候行动的愿景不同

paras.en: That question underpinned many of the speeches from global leaders at this year's High-level Week General Debate in New York, as climate change emerged as one of the defining fault lines dividing Member States.
paras.zh: 这一问题成为今年纽约高级别周一般性辩论上全球领导人许多演讲的基础，因为气候变化已成为划分成员国的决定性断层线之一。

paras.en: UN News reviewed some of the key speeches to assess where those divisions are.
paras.zh: 联合国新闻回顾了一些关键演讲，以评估这些分歧的所在。

paras.en: Leaders offered sometimes very different visions of what action should look like – from Pacific nations demanding a rapid move away from fossil fuels to energy producers stressing security, affordability and a more gradual transition.
paras.zh: 领导人有时对于采取何种行动提出截然不同的愿景——从要求迅速摆脱化石燃料的太平洋国家到强调安全、可负担性和更加渐进的过渡的能源生产国。

paras.en: Across the statements, the main points of division were about how fast energy systems should change, what role fossil fuels should continue to play, and who should shoulder the cost of both the transition and the damage already being inflicted.
paras.zh: 在这些声明中，主要的分歧点是能源系统应该以多快的速度改变、化石燃料应该继续发挥什么作用，以及谁应该承担转型的成本和已经造成的损害。

paras.en: UN Secretary-General António Guterres – who made climate a central theme to this year’s High-level Week – opened the General Debate by calling for immediate action.
paras.zh: 联合国秘书长安东尼奥·古特雷斯将气候问题作为今年高级别周的中心主题，他在一般性辩论中呼吁立即采取行动。

paras.en: “A future beyond fossil fuels is in sight. The question is how?” he said, urging governments to adopt national plans to transition away from fossil fuels, with clear timelines and protection for workers and communities.
paras.zh: “超越化石燃料的未来就在眼前。问题是如何实现？”他敦促各国政府制定摆脱化石燃料的国家计划，并为工人和社区提供明确的时间表和保护。

paras.en: Some of the strongest calls for speed came from low-lying Pacific Island States, whose territories face threats to their very existence due to rising sea levels and intensifying floods.
paras.zh: 一些对速度的最强烈呼吁来自地势低洼的太平洋岛屿国家，由于海平面上升和洪水加剧，这些国家的领土面临着生存威胁。

paras.en: The President of the Marshall Islands said the growing likelihood of overshooting the limit set by global leaders in Paris 10 years ago to keep an increase in temperatures to 1.5°C above pre-industrial levels, demanded a much faster response.
paras.zh: 马绍尔群岛总统表示，超过十年前全球领导人在巴黎设定的将气温升高控制在工业化前水平以上 1.5°C 的限制的可能性越来越大，因此需要更快地做出反应。

paras.en: “A much accelerated transition away from fossil fuels is the only logical response. Continued investment in fossil fuels is not only immoral but irrational,” she said.
paras.zh: “加速摆脱化石燃料是唯一合乎逻辑的反应。持续投资化石燃料不仅不道德，而且不合理，”她说。

paras.en: Tuvalu similarly called for a “fast, fair, just, and orderly transition away from fossil fuels”, alongside action to reduce both methane and carbon dioxide emissions.
paras.zh: 图瓦卢同样呼吁“快速、公平、公正和有序地摆脱化石燃料”，同时采取行动减少甲烷和二氧化碳排放。

paras.en: But other countries laid out more gradual or mixed pathways.
paras.zh: 但其他国家则制定了更为渐进或混合的道路。

paras.en: Saudi Arabia argued that climate action and energy security are compatible. It stressed “the importance of not excluding any source of energy” and of pursuing “realistic and comprehensive transition pathways” that deliver energy security, climate protection and economic development together.
paras.zh: 沙特阿拉伯认为，气候行动和能源安全是相容的。它强调“不排除任何能源来源”以及追求“现实和全面的转型路径”的重要性，以实现能源安全、气候保护和经济发展。

paras.en: Nigeria stressed that the climate transition should not come at the detriment of development.
paras.zh: 尼日利亚强调，气候转型不应损害发展。

paras.en: “We reject the false choice between development and climate action,” the Vice President said.
paras.zh: “我们拒绝在发展和气候行动之间做出错误的选择，”副总统说。

paras.en: Nigeria’s Energy Transition Plan aims for net-zero emissions by 2060 while combining renewable energy and clean cooking with gas as a transitional fuel.
paras.zh: 尼日利亚的能源转型计划旨在到 2060 年实现净零排放，同时将可再生能源和清洁烹饪与天然气作为过渡燃料结合起来。

paras.en: Venezuela also backed decarbonisation, but warned that an imposed transition could threaten food security, employment, production and affordable energy.
paras.zh: 委内瑞拉也支持脱碳，但警告说，强制转型可能会威胁粮食安全、就业、生产和负担得起的能源。

paras.en: Brazil similarly prioritised energy security.
paras.zh: 巴西同样重视能源安全。

paras.en: “We have achieved self-sufficiency in oil and will continue to explore the potential of new reserves, such as those in the Equatorial Margin. But we will not abandon the environmental agenda,” its President said, before pledging to advance the country’s decarbonisation roadmap.
paras.zh: “我们已经实现了石油自给自足，并将继续探索新储备的潜力，例如赤道边缘的储备。但我们不会放弃环境议程，”该国总统在承诺推进该国脱碳路线图之前表示。

paras.en: On the other hand, several States sold climate action as an economic opportunity rather than sacrifice.
paras.zh: 另一方面，一些国家将气候行动视为经济机会而不是牺牲。

paras.en: The UK linked clean energy, of the type provided by wind and solar, to jobs, growth and reindustrialisation.
paras.zh: 英国将风能和太阳能等清洁能源与就业、增长和再工业化联系起来。

paras.en: In a similar vein, Lesotho launched a Just Energy Transition Fund, which is intended to strengthen renewable energy capacity, achieve energy independence for the country, and help build an economy based in part on renewable-energy exports – with potential jobs for young people and women.
paras.zh: 同样，莱索托推出了正义能源转型基金，旨在加强可再生能源能力，实现国家能源独立，并帮助建立部分基于可再生能源出口的经济——为年轻人和妇女提供潜在就业机会。

paras.en: Portugal also presented renewables as a way to reduce dangerous energy dependencies. It said more than 70 per cent of its energy production comes from renewable sources and that its carbon-neutrality target has been brought forward to 2045.
paras.zh: 葡萄牙还提出可再生能源作为减少危险的能源依赖的一种方式。该公司表示，其70%以上的能源生产来自可再生能源，其碳中和目标已提前至2045年。

paras.en: The United States stood further apart from much of the climate framing.
paras.zh: 美国在气候框架的大部分内容中表现得更远。

paras.en: President Donald Trump promoted expanded fossil fuel production and mocked previous warnings about global warming.
paras.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普总统提倡扩大化石燃料生产，并嘲笑之前有关全球变暖的警告。

paras.en: He cited “people who said we'll all be dead in 12 years because of global warming, a name since reborn to climate change because the planet was cooling, not warming, and nobody was dead.”
paras.zh: 他引用了“有人说我们将在 12 年内因全球变暖而死亡，这个名字因气候变化而重生，因为地球正在变冷，而不是变暖，而且没有人死亡。”

paras.en: He stated that his administration successfully halted an international “global carbon tax” on shipping from Member States of the International Maritime Organization (IMO), asserting that “there is no global government.”
paras.zh: 他表示，他的政府成功停止了对国际海事组织（IMO）成员国的航运征收国际“全球碳税”，并声称“不存在全球政府”。

paras.en: For many developing and climate-vulnerable countries, financing emerged as another major fault line.
paras.zh: 对于许多发展中国家和气候脆弱国家来说，融资成为另一个主要问题。

paras.en: Nepal described climate disasters as a development emergency: damaged roads, schools, homes and clean-energy infrastructure can wipe out years of progress, while forcing poorer countries to borrow to rebuild.
paras.zh: 尼泊尔将气候灾难描述为发展紧急情况：受损的道路、学校、房屋和清洁能源基础设施可能会毁掉多年来取得的进步，同时迫使较贫穷的国家借贷进行重建。

paras.en: It called for grant-based support rather than more debt and criticised the difficulty of accessing existing mechanisms.
paras.zh: 它呼吁基于赠款的支持而不是更多的债务，并批评了利用现有机制的困难。

paras.en: “Climate finance must not become a bureaucratic maze through which vulnerable countries spend years proving that they need help,” Nepal’s Prime Minister said.
paras.zh: 尼泊尔总理表示：“气候融资绝不能成为官僚迷宫，让脆弱国家花费数年时间证明它们需要帮助。”

paras.en: Seychelles went further, bringing in international law. It argued that mitigation, adaptation, technology transfer and loss-and-damage finance “are not acts of charity—they are legal obligations,” and called for affordable long-term finance and debt relief.
paras.zh: 塞舌尔走得更远，引入了国际法。它认为，缓解、适应、技术转让以及损失和损害融资“不是慈善行为，而是法律义务”，并呼吁提供负担得起的长期融资和债务减免。

paras.en: For small island States, climate change also became a question of sovereignty.
paras.zh: 对于小岛屿国家来说，气候变化也成为一个主权问题。

paras.en: “The sea does not negotiate. It does not read communiqués. And it does not recognise a veto,” the Bahamas Prime Minister told the Assembly.
paras.zh: “海洋不会谈判。它不会阅读公报。而且它不承认否决权，”巴哈马总理告诉大会。

paras.en: The Bahamas endorsed the Declaration on Sea-Level Rise, saying it affirmed that its statehood and boundaries would endure despite rising seas. Tuvalu likewise highlighted provisions affirming continuity of statehood and sovereignty and safeguarding established maritime zones and rights.
paras.zh: 巴哈马签署了《海平面上升宣言》，表示尽管海平面上升，巴哈马的国家地位和边界仍将持续。图瓦卢同样强调了确认国家地位和主权连续性以及维护既定海域和权利的条款。

paras.en: The Marshall Islands also said its existing boundaries and baselines should endure as seas rise, while calling for accessible finance for adaptation and loss and damage.
paras.zh: 马绍尔群岛还表示，随着海平面上升，其现有边界和基线应该持续下去，同时呼吁为适应和损失和损害提供可用资金。

paras.en: Several leaders also pointed to practical measures already underway.
paras.zh: 几位领导人还指出了已经采取的实际措施。

paras.en: Pointing to commitments to protect 30 per cent of land and seas, France’s President held up recent progress on environmental protection as proof that multilateral action can work.
paras.zh: 法国总统在谈到保护 30% 陆地和海洋的承诺时，将最近在环境保护方面取得的进展作为多边行动能够发挥作用的证据。

paras.en: Others proposed concrete ideas for furthering cooperation. Nepal, for example, proposed a Himalayan Climate Resilience Mechanism, led by Nepal, India and China, to share satellite data and expertise, monitor dangerous glacial lakes, strengthen early-warning systems and coordinate cross-border disaster assistance.
paras.zh: 其他人就进一步合作提出了具体设想。例如，尼泊尔提出了由尼泊尔、印度和中国牵头的喜马拉雅气候恢复机制，以共享卫星数据和专业知识、监测危险的冰川湖、加强预警系统并协调跨境灾害援助。

paras.en: At the same time, several leaders voiced frustration with the gap between commitments and delivery.
paras.zh: 与此同时，几位领导人对承诺与交付之间的差距表示失望。

paras.en: Türkiye said it wanted the major upcoming UN-backed international climate conference, COP31, which it will host in November, to become an “Implementation COP.”
paras.zh: 土耳其表示，希望即将于 11 月主办的联合国支持的重要国际气候会议 COP31 成为“实施缔约方会议”。

paras.en: Denmark made a similar argument. “The challenge before us is no longer a lack of solutions. We have the solutions. We know what is required. Now we need to deliver,” the Danish Ambassador said, also calling for COP31 to focus on implementation and “real-world results”.
paras.zh: 丹麦也提出了类似的论点。丹麦大使表示：“我们面临的挑战不再是缺乏解决方案。我们有解决方案。我们知道需要什么。现在我们需要兑现承诺。”他还呼吁 COP31 将重点放在实施和“现实世界的结果”上。

articles.title: Robinson and Falcons blow away Saints for second NFL win

paras.en: NFL 2026 results and highlights: Bijan Robinson stars as Atlanta Falcons blow away New Orleans Saints 45-24 in second win of NFL season
paras.zh: NFL 2026 赛果和亮点：Bijan Robinson 主演亚特兰大猎鹰队以 45-24 击败新奥尔良圣徒队，取得 NFL 赛季第二场胜利

paras.en: Bijan Robinson scores two rushing touchdowns while Brian Robinson runs in three as the Atlanta Falcons beat the New Orleans Saints 45-24; watch the second NFL London game of the season between the Jacksonville Jaguars and Philadelphia Eagles at 2.30pm Sunday, live on Sky Sports
paras.zh: 比扬·罗宾逊 (Bijan Robinson) 两次冲球达阵，布莱恩·罗宾逊 (Brian Robinson) 跑进三分，亚特兰大猎鹰队 (Atlanta Falcons) 以 45-24 击败新奥尔良圣徒队 (New Orleans Saints)；周日下午 2.30 观看天空体育直播的杰克逊维尔美洲虎队和费城老鹰队之间的本赛季第二场 NFL 伦敦比赛

paras.en: Bijan Robinson rushed for 145 yards and two touchdowns as the Atlanta Falcons posted a dominant 45-24 victory over the New Orleans Saints on Monday night.
paras.zh: 周一晚上，亚特兰大猎鹰队以 45-24 战胜新奥尔良圣徒队，毕扬·罗宾逊 (Bijan Robinson) 冲球 145 码并两次达阵。

paras.en: NFL Commissioner Roger Goodell was among those in attendance on the night as New Orleans commemorated the 20th anniversary of the Superdome's reopening after Hurricane Katrina.
paras.zh: NFL 专员罗杰·古德尔 (Roger Goodell) 出席了当晚新奥尔良超级圆顶体育场在卡特里娜飓风过后重新开放 20 周年纪念活动。

paras.en: Brian Robinson ran for three short touchdowns for the Falcons (2-2), who never trailed and controlled the line of scrimmage while outgaining the Saints (1-3) on the ground, 207 yards to 50.
paras.zh: 布莱恩·罗宾逊 (Brian Robinson) 为猎鹰队 (2-2) 完成了 3 次短达阵，他从未落后并控制了争球线，同时以 50 码 207 码击败了圣徒队 (1-3)。

paras.en: Atlanta continued rolling behind quarterback Michael Penix Jr, who returned to the lineup for a 35-14 victory at Green Bay. Penix was an efficient 15 of 20 for 223 yards and a touchdown. His 31-yard scoring strike to Jahan Dotson in the fourth quarter would prompt a mass exodus of Saints fans.
paras.zh: 亚特兰大队继续在四分卫迈克尔·佩尼克斯（Michael Penix Jr）的带领下继续前进，后者重返阵容并以 35-14 战胜了绿湾队。佩尼克斯20投15中，推进223码并达阵。他在第四节对贾汉·多特森 (Jahan Dotson) 的 31 码得分让圣徒队球迷大批离去。

paras.en: Saints running back Alvin Kamara scored his first two touchdowns of the season, the second cutting Atlanta's lead to 31-17 early in the fourth quarter.
paras.zh: 圣徒队跑卫阿尔文·卡马拉 (Alvin Kamara) 取得本赛季前两次达阵，第二次达阵在第四节初将亚特兰大队的领先优势缩小到 31-17。

paras.en: Tyler Shough passed for 286 yards and a late touchdown to Devaughn Vele.
paras.zh: 泰勒·肖 (Tyler Shough) 传球 286 码，最后达阵给德沃恩·维勒 (Devaughn Vele)。

paras.en: The game kicked off following festivities commemorating the Saints' return to the Superdome after Katrina had displaced the team from New Orleans for the entire 2005 season. In addition to causing levee breaks and a storm surge that flooded about 80 per cent of the city, the hurricane also ripped a hole in the Superdome's roof while evacuees sheltered there.
paras.zh: 这场比赛是在纪念圣徒队在 2005 年整个赛季因卡特里娜飓风而将球队从新奥尔良赶出后重返超级圆顶体育场的庆祝活动之后开始的。除了造成堤坝决堤和风暴潮淹没该市约 80% 的地区外，飓风还在超级圆顶体育场的屋顶上撕开了一个洞，而疏散人员则在那里避难。

paras.en: Ignited by Steve Gleason's punt block for a touchdown following the 2006 game's opening possession, the Saints beat the Falcons 23-3 in that Week 3, Monday night matchup.
paras.zh: 2006 年比赛开场控球后，史蒂夫·格里森 (Steve Gleason) 的弃踢盖帽触地得分，圣徒队在第三周周一晚上的比赛中以 23-3 击败猎鹰队。

paras.en: Like that meeting two decades ago, the Falcons, wearing red, received the opening kickoff. This time, however, there would be no punt to block. Bijan Robinson burst through a hole on the left side of the line and raced 59 yards for a touchdown.
paras.zh: 就像二十年前的那场比赛一样，猎鹰队身着红衣，开球。然而，这一次，没有任何弃踢可以阻挡。比扬·罗宾逊 (Bijan Robinson) 突破线左侧的一个洞，冲出 59 码达阵。

paras.en: For a fourth time in four games, the Saints were playing from behind early - a challenge made more difficult by Daniel Carlson's missed 52-yard field goal attempt and running back Kendre Miller's lost fumble on the New Orleans 22-yard line one possession later.
paras.zh: 圣徒队在四场比赛中第四次在比赛初期就处于落后状态——丹尼尔·卡尔森 (Daniel Carlson) 的 52 码射门失误以及跑卫肯德雷·米勒 (Kendre Miller) 在一次控球后在新奥尔良 22 码线上失球，使得这一挑战变得更加困难。

paras.en: Atlanta cashed in on the turnover when Bijan Robinson made it 14-0 on a 4-yard power run, set up in part by cornerback Kool-Aid McKinstry's third-down defensive holding penalty.
paras.zh: 亚特兰大队利用失误，毕扬·罗宾逊(Bijan Robinson)在4码长距离冲球中将比分打成14-0，部分原因是角卫库尔·艾德·麦金斯特里(Kool-Aid McKinstry)的第三次防守控球罚球。

articles.title: NFL suspends official for swearing at player

paras.en: NFL suspends official Jeff Seeman for two games for swearing at Arizona Cardinals tight end Trey McBride
paras.zh: NFL 裁判杰夫·西曼因辱骂亚利桑那红雀队近端锋特雷·麦克布莱德而被停赛两场

paras.en: The NFL suspended two officials for separate incidents on Sunday, including Jeff Seeman after he was caught swearing at Arizona's Trey McBride; watch the second NFL London game of the season between the Jacksonville Jaguars and Philadelphia Eagles at 2.30pm Sunday, live on Sky Sports
paras.zh: 周日，美国国家橄榄球联盟因不同事件而对两名官员停职，其中包括杰夫·西曼(Jeff Seeman)，他因咒骂亚利桑那州的特雷·麦克布莱德(Trey McBride)而被抓。周日下午 2.30 观看天空体育直播的杰克逊维尔美洲虎队和费城老鹰队之间的本赛季第二场 NFL 伦敦比赛

paras.en: The NFL has suspended a line judge for two games for swearing at Arizona Cardinals tight end Trey McBride.
paras.zh: 一名司线裁判因辱骂亚利桑那红雀队近端锋特雷·麦克布莱德而被美国国家橄榄球联盟 (NFL) 停赛两场。

paras.en: Jeff Seeman was caught on camera cursing at McBride during the Cardinals' loss to the New York Giants on Sunday.
paras.zh: 周日红雀队输给纽约巨人队的比赛中，杰夫·西曼被镜头拍到咒骂麦克布莱德。

paras.en: "Obviously, you hate to see it, for obvious reasons," Arizona coach Mike LaFleur said. "I do want to give the man a little bit of grace, too. I know Jeff. He's a good man. It's unfortunate it happened. It can't happen, obviously, and I'll leave it at that."
paras.zh: “显然，你不想看到它，原因显而易见，”亚利桑那州教练迈克·拉弗勒尔说。 “我确实也想给这个人一点恩典。我了解杰夫。他是个好人。不幸的是它发生了。显然，它不可能发生，我就这样吧。”

paras.en: The incident drew the ire of union leader JC Tretter, a retired offensive lineman who played eight seasons.
paras.zh: 这一事件引起了工会领袖 JC Tretter 的愤怒，他是一位退役的进攻前锋，打了八个赛季。

paras.en: "This kind of behaviour from an official towards a player is unacceptable," Tretter, the NFL Players Association's executive director, said on social media along with a video clip of the incident.
paras.zh: NFL球员协会执行董事特雷特在社交媒体上表示：“官员对球员的这种行为是不可接受的。”

paras.en: "Players are consistently held accountable when the roles are reversed. We expect the NFL to hold officials to the same standard."
paras.zh: “当角色互换时，球员始终要承担责任。我们希望 NFL 能够以同样的标准来要求官员。”

paras.en: The interaction took place with just under five minutes left after officials did not call a pass interference or illegal contact penalty on New York's Dru Phillips, who made contact with McBride before the ball arrived from Jacoby Brissett on a third-and-two play.
paras.zh: 这次互动发生在比赛还剩不到五分钟时，裁判没有对纽约队的德鲁·菲利普斯进行传球干扰或非法接触处罚，德鲁·菲利普斯在第三次和第二次比赛中从雅各比·布里塞特传球之前与麦克布莱德发生了接触。

paras.en: Arizona punted and the Giants went on to win 36-24 after Deonte Banks intercepted Brissett's pass and ran it back for a pick-6 as time expired.
paras.zh: 亚利桑那队弃踢，在德昂特·班克斯 (Deonte Banks) 拦截布里塞特 (Brissett) 传球并在时间结束时回击以 6 挡后，巨人队以 36-24 获胜。

paras.en: Referee Adrian Hill was also suspended one game for unprofessional conduct in the Miami-Minnesota game. Hill yelled at Eric Wilson and pointed for him to get away after the Vikings linebacker tried to help him to his feet after a collision knocked him over.
paras.zh: 在迈阿密对阵明尼苏达的比赛中，裁判阿德里安·希尔也因不专业行为被停赛一场。希尔对埃里克·威尔逊大喊大叫，并指着他离开，因为埃里克·威尔逊在一次碰撞中撞倒了他，试图帮助他站起来。

paras.en: "I just think it's one of those situations in kind of a high-energy moment there," Minnesota coach Kevin O'Connell said Monday.
paras.zh: “我只是认为这是一种充满活力的时刻，”明尼苏达州教练凯文·奥康奈尔周一表示。

paras.en: "I think stuff like that can happen sometimes, but I don't have any major concerns, and I think Adrian's a really good official and does a really good job. I think that was just kind of fast moment that happened, and we can put it behind us, hopefully."
paras.zh: “我认为这样的事情有时会发生，但我没有任何重大担忧，我认为阿德里安是一位非常好的官员，做得非常好。我认为这只是发生的一个快速时刻，希望我们可以把它抛在脑后。”

paras.en: The league's vice president of officiating, Ramon George, issued the suspensions. The NFL Referees Association did not immediately respond to a message seeking comment.
paras.zh: 联盟执法副总裁拉蒙·乔治宣布了禁赛令。 NFL 裁判协会没有立即回复寻求评论的消息。

paras.en: This isn't the first time an official has been punished for interactions with a player on the field.
paras.zh: 这并不是第一次有官员因与场上球员互动而受到处罚。

paras.en: Umpire Roy Ellison was punished twice for his behavior. In 2018, he was fined $9,300 and placed on administrative leave for one game after he was accused of calling Buffalo defensive end Jerry Hughes a derogatory term.
paras.zh: 裁判罗伊·埃里森因其行为受到两次处罚。 2018年，他被指控侮辱布法罗防守端锋杰里·休斯，被罚款9,300美元并被行政休假一场。

paras.en: Ellison was also suspended for one game in 2013 for making "a profane and derogatory statement" to Washington left tackle Trent Williams
paras.zh: 2013年，埃里森还因向华盛顿左截锋特伦特·威廉姆斯发表“亵渎和贬损性言论”而被禁赛一场

articles.title: 'Painful as hell' - Norris uncertain McLaren can fix issue for Singapore

paras.en: Lando Norris uncertain McLaren can fix 'painful' straight-line speed issue ahead of Singapore Grand Prix
paras.zh: 兰多·诺里斯不确定迈凯轮能否在新加坡大奖赛前解决“痛苦的”直线速度问题

paras.en: Lando Norris has endured disappointing weekends in Azerbaijan and Malaysia, with a straight-line speed issue frustrating the British driver; watch F1's first ever Singapore Grand Prix Sprint weekend live on Sky Sports F1, with Sprint Qualifying at 1pm on Friday
paras.zh: 兰多·诺里斯在阿塞拜疆和马来西亚经历了令人失望的周末，直线速度问题让这位英国车手感到沮丧；在天空体育 F1 上观看 F1 首个新加坡大奖赛冲刺周末直播，冲刺排位赛将于周五下午 1 点举行

paras.en: Lando Norris has admitted he is unsure whether McLaren will be able to fix an issue with his car that is causing a loss of straight-line speed ahead of this weekend's Singapore Grand Prix.
paras.zh: 兰多·诺里斯承认，他不确定迈凯轮是否能够在本周末的新加坡大奖赛之前解决导致直线速度损失的赛车问题。

paras.en: The reigning world champion was in fine form as he claimed three pole positions and two victories in four races spread either side of the summer break, but he has since been off the pace in Azerbaijan and Malaysia.
paras.zh: 这位卫冕世界冠军状态良好，在暑假前后的四场比赛中获得了三个杆位和两次胜利，但此后他在阿塞拜疆和马来西亚的比赛中表现不佳。

paras.en: Norris only qualified fifth at both events, was taken out of the Azerbaijan Grand Prix in a crash and could only manage ninth in an error-strewn display as Malaysia hosted the Bahrain Grand Prix.
paras.zh: 诺里斯在两项赛事中仅获得第五名，在阿塞拜疆大奖赛中因撞车事故而退出，在马来西亚主办巴林大奖赛时，由于失误较多，仅获得第九名。

paras.en: The issue, which made Norris slower than his team-mate Oscar Piastri in certain parts of the Sepang International Circuit, appears to be being caused by his power unit, but McLaren have yet to find the exact issue.
paras.zh: 这个问题导致诺里斯在雪邦国际赛车场的某些部分比他的队友奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里慢，似乎是由他的动力装置引起的，但迈凯伦尚未找到确切的问题。

paras.en: Asked whether the team can fix it for the upcoming Sprint weekend in Singapore, Norris told Sky Sports F1: "I have no idea.
paras.zh: 当被问及车队是否可以在新加坡即将到来的冲刺周末修复这个问题时，诺里斯告诉天空体育F1：“我不知道。

paras.en: "The team are trying but I'm losing almost two tenths a lap. Two tenths a lap over 55 laps is just painful as hell. It's making my life pretty damn difficult.
paras.zh: “车队正在努力，但我几乎每圈损失了十分之二。在 55 圈中，每圈损失十分之二实在是太痛苦了。这让我的生活变得非常困难。

paras.en: "There are also other things. In Malaysia I could have done better. I can't just have that. That's not just an excuse.
paras.zh: “还有其他事情。在马来西亚我可以做得更好。我不能仅仅这样。这不仅仅是一个借口。

paras.en: "There are things I can do better and the team as well."
paras.zh: “有些事情我可以做得更好，团队也可以做得更好。”

paras.en: Stella: Rivals may have developed car with bigger steps
paras.zh: 斯特拉：竞争对手可能已经开发出步伐更大的汽车

paras.en: McLaren boss Andrea Stella admitted that some of the team's rivals may have "developed their car with bigger steps" after successive underwhelming showings.
paras.zh: 迈凯伦老板安德里亚·斯特拉承认，在连续表现不佳后，车队的一些竞争对手可能已经“以更大的步伐开发了他们的赛车”。

paras.en: The reigning constructors' champions appeared to be back in the mix for victories when their upgrade package at the Hungarian Grand Prix before the summer break helped Norris deliver the team's first grand prix pole and victory of the season.
paras.zh: 卫冕车队冠军似乎又重返胜利之列，暑假前的匈牙利大奖赛上他们的升级包帮助诺里斯获得了车队的首个大奖赛杆位和本赛季的胜利。

paras.en: However, despite McLaren having added more upgrades to their car, Mercedes' George Russell claimed a dominant win in Azerbaijan before Max Verstappen exhibited Red Bull's progress by triumphing in Malaysia.
paras.zh: 然而，尽管迈凯伦对他们的赛车进行了更多升级，梅赛德斯的乔治·拉塞尔在阿塞拜疆取得了压倒性的胜利，随后马克斯·维斯塔潘在马来西亚取得了胜利，展示了红牛的进步。

paras.en: Stella said: "We see a scenario in Formula 1 which seems to be changing pretty rapidly.
paras.zh: 斯特拉说：“我们在一级方程式赛车中看到的情况似乎正在迅速变化。

paras.en: "In Hungary, we took some upgrades, and we were in condition to have a pole position in Hungary and Zandvoort and then we were in condition to do pole position and pretty much victory in Madrid without the Virtual Safety Car.
paras.zh: “在匈牙利，我们进行了一些升级，我们有条件在匈牙利和赞德沃特获得杆位，然后我们有条件在马德里获得杆位并几乎在没有虚拟安全车的情况下取得胜利。

paras.en: "Then very rapidly and interestingly, as we took upgrades as well, the picture changes.
paras.zh: “然后非常迅速且有趣的是，当我们也进行升级时，情况发生了变化。

paras.en: "I think we have to take a look at our own development. We don't see any anomaly in our data, but we have to acknowledge that potentially some competitors have developed their car with bigger steps than we did."
paras.zh: “我认为我们必须审视我们自己的发展。我们在数据中没有看到任何异常，但我们必须承认，可能有一些竞争对手在开发他们的汽车时比我们采取了更大的步伐。”

paras.en: The extremely high temperatures and rough track surface in Malaysia created a potential outlier in terms of conditions, which has left Stella with some hope that McLaren could return to form in Singapore.
paras.zh: 马来西亚的极高气温和粗糙的赛道表面造成了潜在的异常情况，这让斯特拉对迈凯伦能够在新加坡恢复状态抱有一些希望。

paras.en: "There are very specific conditions in Malaysia, so I think we should give ourselves more time," he added.
paras.zh: “马来西亚的情况非常特殊，所以我认为我们应该给自己更多的时间，”他补充道。

paras.en: "I'm sure this is the same kind of review that we'll have next door at Mercedes. It's a very special condition in Malaysia, so I think we have to understand better the behaviour of the cars.
paras.zh: “我确信这与我们将在隔壁的梅赛德斯进行的审查相同。这在马来西亚是一个非常特殊的情况，所以我认为我们必须更好地了解汽车的行为。

paras.en: "I think we need to give ourselves some more time. I'm personally not in condition to say if Singapore will be now more suitable or not, because from a track layout point of view, we thought that Sepang would be a decent circuit for us.
paras.zh: “我认为我们需要给自己更多的时间。我个人没有资格说新加坡现在是否更合适，因为从赛道布局的角度来看，我们认为雪邦对我们来说是一个不错的赛道。

paras.en: "This is because of the uncertainty caused by the new scenario from a competitiveness point of view, but also because we might have to understand a bit better the upgrades that we took ourselves, and Singapore will give us a better answer."
paras.zh: “这是因为从竞争力的角度来看，新的场景带来了不确定性，但也因为我们可能必须更好地理解我们自己进行的升级，新加坡会给我们更好的答案。”
