articles.title: What to know about pneumonic plague after woman in Russia dies from mysterious illness
articles.author: Erika Edwards

paras.en: The death of a 28-year-old woman who worked in an anti-plague laboratory in Russia is raising concerns about what caused her illness.
paras.zh: 一名在俄罗斯抗鼠疫实验室工作的 28 岁女性的死亡引发了人们对她患病原因的担忧。

paras.en: The woman died Friday, according to the World Health Organization, with no cause of death confirmed. A Russian official said the woman died of pneumonia of “undetermined” origin and did not link her death to her work at the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Institute of Siberia and the Far East. The U.S. State Department said, however, that it’s monitoring reports of a fatal case of suspected pneumonic plague in the Irkutsk region, in southeastern Siberia, in coordination with the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention.
paras.zh: 据世界卫生组织称，这名妇女于周五死亡，死因尚未得到证实。一名俄罗斯官员表示，这名妇女死于“不明原因”的肺炎，并没有将她的死亡与她在西伯利亚和远东伊尔库茨克抗鼠疫研究所的工作联系起来。不过，美国国务院表示，正在与疾病控制和预防中心协调，监测西伯利亚东南部伊尔库茨克地区疑似肺鼠疫死亡病例的报告。

paras.en: “While the circumstances of this reported case remain unconfirmed, plague is a serious bacterial disease that is treatable with antibiotics, particularly when recognized and treated early,” a spokeswoman for the Department of Health and Human Services said in a statement. “At this time, there is no indication from available reporting of a broader threat to the United States.”
paras.zh: 美国卫生与公众服务部发言人在一份声明中表示：“虽然该病例的具体情况尚未得到证实，但鼠疫是一种严重的细菌性疾病，可以用抗生素治疗，特别是在及早识别和治疗的情况下。” “目前，现有报告没有迹象表明美国面临更广泛的威胁。”

paras.en: Key details aren’t known, including whether the woman was infected with plague at all and, if so, whether it was naturally occurring plague or bacteria studied in the lab. Scientists also don’t know how quickly her illness progressed and what treatment she received. Nearly 200 people who came into contact with the woman are under precautionary medical observation, according to Russian media.
paras.zh: 关键细节尚不清楚，包括该妇女是否感染了鼠疫，如果感染了，是自然发生的鼠疫还是实验室研究的细菌。科学家们也不知道她的病情进展有多快以及她接受了什么治疗。据俄罗斯媒体报道，近200名与该女子有过接触的人正在接受预防性医学观察。

paras.en: “Maybe it’s going to come out that she died from something unrelated and it was just a coincidence” that she worked in an anti-plague lab, said Lisa Morici, a microbiologist and immunologist in the Tulane University School of Medicine.
paras.zh: 杜兰大学医学院微生物学家和免疫学家丽莎·莫里奇 (Lisa Morici) 表示，“也许最终会发现她死于无关的事情，而她在抗鼠疫实验室工作只是一个巧合”。

paras.en: Dr. Ashish Jha, the White House’s former Covid response coordinator, told NBC News in an interview, “If there were weapons programs, biological weapons programs in these labs, that would be much more concerning to me.”
paras.zh: 白宫前新冠疫情应对协调员阿什什·贾博士在接受 NBC 新闻采访时表示，“如果这些实验室有武器计划、生物武器计划，那我会更担心。”

paras.en: “We need to understand that now,” he added.
paras.zh: “我们现在需要了解这一点，”他补充道。

paras.en: The situation is still rapidly unfolding. But here’s what we know about the pneumonic plague, how it spreads and how dangerous it is.
paras.zh: 事态仍在迅速发展。但以下是我们对肺鼠疫的了解、它的传播方式以及它的危险性。

paras.en: Plague is an infection caused by Yersinia pestis bacteria. Known as the “Black Death” during the 14th century, the plague triggered several global pandemics over centuries before the discovery of antibiotics.
paras.zh: 鼠疫是由鼠疫耶尔森菌引起的感染。鼠疫在 14 世纪被称为“黑死病”，在抗生素发现之前的几个世纪里引发了数次全球流行病。

paras.en: It presents in three main forms: bubonic, pneumonic and septicemic, according to the World Health Organization. All three are caused by Yersinia pestis, but they occur in different parts of the body.
paras.zh: 据世界卫生组织称，它主要表现为三种形式：腺鼠疫、肺炎和败血症。这三种病毒都是由鼠疫耶尔森氏菌引起的，但它们发生在身体的不同部位。

paras.en: Bubonic is the most common form, Morici said. It is primarily transmitted through bites of infected fleas or direct contact with infected rodents, which can cause painful, swollen lumps in the lymph nodes. It is usually not contagious.
paras.zh: 莫里奇说，腺鼠疫是最常见的形式。它主要通过受感染的跳蚤叮咬或直接接触受感染的啮齿动物传播，这可能会导致淋巴结疼痛、肿块。它通常不具有传染性。

paras.en: Left untreated, however, it can spread to the lungs and become pneumonic plague, which can pass from person to person through respiratory droplets, Morici said.
paras.zh: 然而，莫里奇说，如果不及时治疗，它可能会传播到肺部并成为肺鼠疫，并可以通过呼吸道飞沫在人与人之间传播。

paras.en: Septicemic plague occurs when the bacteria grow and spread in the blood.
paras.zh: 当细菌在血液中生长和传播时，就会发生败血性鼠疫。

paras.en: Pneumonic plague can spread through the air when an infected person or animal coughs or sneezes.
paras.zh: 当感染者或动物咳嗽或打喷嚏时，肺鼠疫可以通过空气传播。

paras.en: The respiratory droplets don’t travel very far, maybe three to six feet, said Dr. Dave Wagner, director of the Pathogen and Microbiome Institute at Northern Arizona University. “They drop to the ground pretty quickly.”
paras.zh: 北亚利桑那大学病原体和微生物组研究所所长戴夫·瓦格纳博士说，呼吸道飞沫不会传播很远，可能三到六英尺。 “它们很快就会掉到地上。”

paras.en: It’s the rarest form of the disease, according to WHO.
paras.zh: 据世界卫生组织称，这是这种疾病中最罕见的一种。

paras.en: Dr. William Schaffer, an infectious diseases expert at Vanderbilt University Medical Center, said close contacts are most at risk. Pneumonic plague isn’t something that spreads “distantly across a room, but to face-to-face contacts,” he said.
paras.zh: 范德比尔特大学医学中心传染病专家威廉·谢弗博士表示，密切接触者面临的风险最大。他说，肺鼠疫并不是“在一个房间里远距离传播，而是通过面对面的接触”。

paras.en: “It’s highly unlikely for most people to get the pneumonic form of the disease,” Morici said.
paras.zh: 莫里奇说：“对于大多数人来说，患上这种疾病的肺炎形式的可能性极小。”

paras.en: Covid, for example, spreads like wildfire through the air, traveling beyond six feet.
paras.zh: 例如，新冠病毒就像野火一样在空气中传播，传播范围超过六英尺。

paras.en: “It’s nothing like the Covid-19 pandemic,” she said.
paras.zh: “这与 Covid-19 大流行完全不同，”她说。

paras.en: While pneumonic plague is the rarest form of the disease, it’s also the deadliest.
paras.zh: 虽然肺鼠疫是这种疾病中最罕见的一种，但它也是最致命的。

paras.en: “It’s the one that’s so frightening because it can kill so quickly,” Morici said.
paras.zh: 莫里奇说：“它之所以如此可怕，是因为它能如此迅速地致人死亡。”

paras.en: It progresses remarkably fast, Wagner said. Symptoms typically appear within one to two days of exposure, and patients require treatment within 48 hours of showing symptoms to prevent fatal complications. Symptoms can include shortness of breath and coughing or blood in the phlegm.
paras.zh: 瓦格纳说，它的进展非常快。症状通常会在接触后一到两天内出现，患者需要在出现症状后 48 小时内接受治疗，以防止致命的并发症。症状可能包括呼吸短促、咳嗽或痰中带血。

paras.en: Because of how rapidly it attacks the respiratory system, public health experts consider this strain the most likely candidate for a biological attack, according to Morici.
paras.zh: 莫里奇表示，由于它攻击呼吸系统的速度如此之快，公共卫生专家认为这种菌株最有可能遭受生物攻击。

paras.en: People with pneumonic plague are often quarantined, she said. Healthcare workers will often wear personal protective equipment, such as an N95 mask, or even a full body suit in case of accidental exposure.
paras.zh: 她说，患有肺鼠疫的人经常被隔离。医护人员通常会穿戴个人防护装备，例如 N95 口罩，甚至穿着全身防护服，以防意外接触。

paras.en: “We’re using the strictest levels of biocontainment,” she said.
paras.zh: “我们正在使用最严格的生物防护水平，”她说。

paras.en: Antibiotics are highly effective against plague, including pneumonic plague.
paras.zh: 抗生素对鼠疫（包括肺鼠疫）非常有效。

paras.en: “This is why we don’t have big plague outbreaks anymore,” Wagner said.
paras.zh: “这就是为什么我们不再爆发大规模鼠疫，”瓦格纳说。

paras.en: Schaffner said there’s no evidence to suggest that the plague bacteria are evolving in a way to become resistant to antibiotics. “We will not turn 2026 into the Middle Ages, where the Black Death caused vast amounts of death throughout Europe. That will not happen.”
paras.zh: 沙夫纳说，没有证据表明鼠疫细菌正在进化以对抗生素产生抗药性。 “我们不会把 2026 年变成中世纪，黑死病在整个欧洲造成大量死亡。这种情况不会发生。”

paras.en: Wagner said he has no reason to believe this suspected case of plague is “going to take off and spread.”
paras.zh: 瓦格纳表示，他没有理由相信这起疑似鼠疫病例会“迅速蔓延”。

paras.en: “The plague that we have today is the same plague that was the scourge of humanity for so long during great pandemics,” he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“我们今天遇到的瘟疫与大流行期间长期以来对人类造成的祸害是同一种瘟疫。”

paras.en: About seven cases of plague are reported in the U.S. each year, according to the CDC. Most occur in rural parts of the Southwest, including Arizona, California, Colorado and New Mexico. These are areas where Yersinia pestis bacteria naturally circulate among wild rodents like prairie dogs and their fleas.
paras.zh: 据疾病预防控制中心称，美国每年报告大约七例鼠疫病例。大多数发生在西南部的农村地区，包括亚利桑那州、加利福尼亚州、科罗拉多州和新墨西哥州。这些地区是鼠疫耶尔森氏菌在草原土拨鼠及其跳蚤等野生啮齿动物中自然传播的地区。

paras.en: Most people are treated quickly with antibiotics and recover. Deaths from the plague in the U.S. are rare but do happen.
paras.zh: 大多数人很快就能接受抗生素治疗并康复。在美国，死于鼠疫的情况很少见，但确实发生过。

paras.en: Last July, a man in Arizona died of pneumonic plague after he was exposed to sick cats. Within a week, the man went to an emergency department with shallow breathing, a fast heart rate, chest pain and a dry cough. Despite getting antibiotics and oxygen, the man died within eight hours of his admission to the hospital. Testing later showed he had pneumonic plague.
paras.zh: 去年七月，亚利桑那州一名男子在接触病猫后死于肺鼠疫。一周内，该男子因呼吸浅、心率快、胸痛和干咳而被送往急诊室。尽管接受了抗生素和氧气治疗，该男子还是在入院后八小时内死亡。后来的测试显示他患有肺鼠疫。

articles.title: Here's how Labor, the Coalition and One Nation's migration cuts compare
articles.author: Jake Evans

paras.en: The Coalition's long-awaited migration plan has been revealed, completing the set of competing policies being offered by the government, the opposition and One Nation, who have risen in the polls in particular due to the party's promise to drive immigration to its lowest levels in Australia's history.
paras.zh: 联盟党期待已久的移民计划已经公布，完成了政府、反对党和一国党提出的一系列相互竞争的政策。由于该党承诺将移民数量降至澳大利亚历史上的最低水平，一国党在民意调查中的支持率上升。

paras.en: Migration rates to Australia since 2019 have been much higher than many comparable countries, with more than double the growth in population from migration compared to the United Kingdom, and three times Germany.
paras.zh: 自 2019 年以来，澳大利亚的移民率远高于许多同类国家，移民人口增长是英国的两倍多，是德国的三倍多。

paras.en: One Nation has vowed to cut migration to negative levels in its first years, the Coalition has promised to temporarily halve migration to 100,000, and Labor wants migration rates to return to the longer-term trend of 225,000 — but it quickly gets more complicated.
paras.zh: 一国党誓言在第一年将移民人数削减至负数，联盟党承诺暂时将移民人数减少一半至 100,000 人，工党希望移民率恢复到 225,000 人的长期趋势——但情况很快就会变得更加复杂。

paras.en: Every attempt to lower migration removes workers from some sector, risks hitting already slow economic growth, and potentially puts already in-need industries like health and aged care into deeper workforce shortages.
paras.zh: 每一次减少移民的尝试都会使某些行业的工人流失，有可能打击本已缓慢的经济增长，并可能使医疗和老年护理等本已急需的行业陷入更深的劳动力短缺。

paras.en: One Nation, the Coalition and the federal government have each sought to strike a different balance — with One Nation also explicitly stating its intentions to up-end migration to Australia as part of its policy to end multiculturalism.
paras.zh: 一国党、联盟党和联邦政府都试图取得不同的平衡——一国党还明确表示其打算阻止澳大利亚移民，作为其结束多元文化主义政策的一部分。

paras.en: What does each party want to do with migration levels?
paras.zh: 各方希望如何调整移民水平？

paras.en: The federal government, the Coalition and One Nation have all proposed net migration rates lower than today, though their plans differ significantly.
paras.zh: 联邦政府、联盟党和一国党都提议将净移民率低于现在，尽管他们的计划差异很大。

paras.en: One Nation has promised net negative migration for the first three years, before settling to a longer-term net migration ceiling of below 130,000.
paras.zh: 一国党承诺前三年净移民人数为负，然后将长期净移民上限定为低于 130,000 人。

paras.en: The party has vowed to cut net migration by 750,000 in its first three years in order to reach its goal of more people leaving the country than arriving, providing "breathing space" for housing construction to catch up. Spread evenly, it would amount to a net migration rate of negative 25,000 based on Treasury's migration forecasts for those years.
paras.zh: 该党誓言要在头三年内将净移民人数削减75万，以实现出境人数多于入境人数的目标，为住房建设提供“喘息空间”。根据财政部对这些年的移民预测，如果平均分配的话，净移民率将达到负 25,000 人。

paras.en: The Coalition has proposed to more than halve net migration for two years to 100,000, 130,000 in its third year and 160,000 in its fourth year. After that, net migration would be tied to the pace of housing completions.
paras.zh: 联盟党提议在两年内将净移民人数减少一半以上，达到 10 万，第三年减少 13 万，第四年减少 16 万。此后，净移民将与住房竣工速度挂钩。

paras.en: Meanwhile, Home Affairs Minister Tony Burke has announced measures to achieve a net migration rate of 225,000 a year by 2028, though there are no further cuts proposed in the future years when One Nation and the Coalition have both promised serious reductions.
paras.zh: 与此同时，内政部长托尼·伯克（Tony Burke）宣布了到 2028 年实现每年 225,000 人净移民率的措施，尽管一国党和联盟党都承诺大幅削减，但在未来几年没有提出进一步削减的建议。

paras.en: That 225,000 a year figure was already forecast in the federal budget, but actual migration to Australia has repeatedly come in higher than forecast, and the politics around net overseas migration has changed.
paras.zh: 联邦预算中已经预测了每年 225,000 人的数字，但澳大利亚的实际移民数量一再高于预测，围绕净海外移民的政治也发生了变化。

paras.en: Once considered more of an indicator, the government itself has now acknowledged that net overseas migration figure as a hard target it is committed to reaching.
paras.zh: 曾经更多地被认为是一个指标的政府本身现在也承认海外净移民人数是其致力于实现的硬性目标。

paras.en: How do the parties plan to cut migration?
paras.zh: 各方计划如何减少移民？

paras.en: One Nation promises to achieve deep cuts by severely restricting international student visa places to just over 100,000 a year. That compares to about 290,000 visas granted to students last financial year.
paras.zh: One Nation 承诺通过严格限制国际学生签证名额每年仅超过 10 万个来实现大幅削减。相比之下，上一财年向学生发放了约 29 万份签证。

paras.en: Additionally, visas for families of international students and skilled migrants would be ended almost entirely.
paras.zh: 此外，国际学生和技术移民家庭的签证将几乎完全终止。

paras.en: There were just shy of 46,000 visas granted to family and dependents of students last financial year — all of those would have been refused except for roughly 6,500 partners and children attached to postgraduate researchers, who are exempt from the plan.
paras.zh: 上一财年，大约有 46,000 份签证发放给了学生的家人和家属——除了大约 6,500 名研究生研究人员的伴侣和子女（他们不受该计划的约束）之外，所有这些签证都会被拒绝。

paras.en: That commitment was effectively made by the federal government last month.
paras.zh: 联邦政府上个月实际上做出了这一承诺。

paras.en: In relation to skilled migrants, the most recent migration trend data showed fewer than half of the visas being granted under Australia's skilled worker program were actually for the workers Australia is seeking, like nurses and builders.
paras.zh: 就技术移民而言，最新的移民趋势数据显示，根据澳大利亚技术工人计划发放的签证中，只有不到一半实际上是针对澳大利亚正在寻找的工人，例如护士和建筑工人。

paras.en: Out of about 132,000 skilled worker visas issued in the 2025 financial year, 71,650 were actually granted to partners and children of those workers. That would be cut to zero under One Nation.
paras.zh: 在 2025 财年发放的约 132,000 个技术工人签证中，有 71,650 个实际上授予了这些工人的伴侣和子女。在“一国党”统治下，这一数字将降至零。

paras.en: The rest of the party's migration cuts would be achieved by deporting visa overstayers and other unlawful non-citizens, and clearing the backlog of people on bridging visas — generally people awaiting a decision on an application, or challenging a decision to refuse or cancel a visa.
paras.zh: 该党削减移民的其余部分将通过驱逐签证逾期居留者和其他非法非公民，并清理积压的过桥签证人员——通常是等待申请决定的人，或对拒绝或取消签证的决定提出质疑的人来实现。

paras.en: With migration playing a significant role in maintaining Australia's economy in recent years, critics warned migration cuts of that magnitude would drive the country into recession.
paras.zh: 近年来，移民在维持澳大利亚经济方面发挥着重要作用，批评者警告称，如此大规模的移民削减将导致该国陷入衰退。

paras.en: Senator Hanson responded that "a larger economic pie doesn't mean anything if individual Australians' slice of it is getting smaller".
paras.zh: 汉森参议员回应说，“如果澳大利亚人所占的份额越来越小，那么经济蛋糕再大也没有任何意义”。

paras.en: The Coalition will also target international student visa places, cutting commencements down from their current planning level of 295,000 a year to 240,000, and abolishing temporary graduate visas.
paras.zh: 联盟还将针对国际学生签证名额，将开学人数从目前每年 295,000 个的计划水平削减至 240,000 个，并废除临时毕业生签证。

paras.en: More than 100,000 temporary graduate visas are issued every year, which typically allow people to live and work in Australia for up to three years after graduation depending on the qualification. That would be ended by the Coalition with some limited exceptions.
paras.zh: 每年签发超过 100,000 个临时毕业生签证，通常允许人们在毕业后在澳大利亚生活和工作长达三年，具体取决于资格。除一些有限的例外情况外，联盟党将结束这种情况。

paras.en: The visas are meant to keep in-demand graduates in Australia while they search for work, but the Coalition says they are instead being used as a pathway to citizenship, with some people never working in the field they graduated from.
paras.zh: 这些签证的目的是让炙手可热的毕业生在寻找工作时留在澳大利亚，但联盟表示，这些签证反而被用作获得公民身份的途径，因为有些人从未在他们毕业的领域工作过。

paras.en: Like One Nation, the Coalition says it will clear the caseload of more than 400,000 people on bridging visas, mainly by requiring subsequent visa applications to be made offshore (except for working holiday-makers), which it says will "virtually eliminate" bridging visas.
paras.zh: 与一国党一样，联盟党表示将清理超过 40 万人的过桥签证，主要是要求后续签证申请在海外进行（打工度假者除外），该联盟称这将“实际上消除”过桥签证。

paras.en: The permanent humanitarian visa program would also be halved from 20,000 to 10,000, with the ability to temporarily lift that amount to respond to major incidents, like the Coalition did following the civil war in Syria in 2015.
paras.zh: 永久人道主义签证计划也将从 20,000 人减半至 10,000 人，并有能力暂时提高这一数额以应对重大事件，就像联军在 2015 年叙利亚内战后所做的那样。

paras.en: Its reductions in international students, temporary graduates and bridging visa holders would make space for more skilled workers, with construction workers to be "heavily prioritised" although net migration overall would still be at some of the lowest levels in Australia's history.
paras.zh: 国际学生、临时毕业生和过桥签证持有者的减少将为更多技术工人腾出空间，其中建筑工人将被“优先考虑”，尽管整体净移民仍将处于澳大利亚历史上的最低水平。

paras.en: The Coalition says its plan is focused on reducing migration while improving the skills mix, rather than "simply cutting numbers without regard to the economic consequences".
paras.zh: 该联盟表示，其计划的重点是减少移民，同时改善技能组合，而不是“简单地削减人数而不考虑经济后果”。

paras.en: The federal government has promised to end the practice of international students "visa hopping" to stay in Australia longer by requiring that students can only be granted a visa for further qualifications that are a higher level of study, such as moving from a bachelor degree to a masters.
paras.zh: 联邦政府承诺结束国际学生“跳签证”以在澳大利亚停留更长时间的做法，要求学生只能获得更高级别学习资格的签证，例如从学士学位转到硕士学位。

paras.en: It is also limiting family visas for international students, except those from Pacific and South-East Asian nations, as well as dependents of students studying PhDs.
paras.zh: 它还限制了国际学生的家庭签证，来自太平洋和东南亚国家的学生以及攻读博士学位的学生的家属除外。

paras.en: But it will not do the same for families of skilled workers, as promised by One Nation, warning that doing so could make it harder for Australia to get workers already in short supply.
paras.zh: 但它不会像一国集团所承诺的那样，为技术工人的家庭做同样的事情，并警告说，这样做可能会使澳大利亚更难获得已经供不应求的工人。

paras.en: While One Nation and the Coalition have promised not to touch working holiday-maker visa levels, which are heavily depended on by farmers and regional communities, the federal government says it is tightening the second and third years of the scheme, reducing year-two visas by 12,000 places to 45,000, and year-three places by 31,000 places to just 5,000, with a ballot system to determine who can extend their stay.
paras.zh: 虽然一国党和联盟党承诺不会触及农民和偏远地区严重依赖的打工度假者签证水平，但联邦政府表示，正在收紧该计划的第二年和第三年，将第二年的签证名额减少12,000个至45,000个，将第三年的签证名额减少31,000个至仅5,000个，并通过投票制度来决定谁可以延长居留期限。

paras.en: Finally, the government is establishing a team of 100 Border Force officials to assist in the removal of the roughly 77,000 visa overstayers in the country, as well as adding more facilities to hold overstayers awaiting deportation.
paras.zh: 最后，政府正在建立一个由 100 名边境部队官员组成的团队，协助驱逐该国大约 77,000 名签证逾期居留者，并增加更多设施来拘留等待驱逐出境的逾期居留者。

paras.en: What does each party want to do with who comes to Australia?
paras.zh: 各方想对来澳大利亚的人做什么？

paras.en: One Nation's proposal would cut the number of people coming to Australia who do not have a work-related purpose for migrating.
paras.zh: 一国党的提案将减少没有与工作相关的移民目的来澳大利亚的人数。

paras.en: But the party is also campaigning on a platform of much higher standards for visa holders, with stricter punishments for those who breach visa conditions or Australia's laws.
paras.zh: 但该党也在为签证持有者提出更高标准的竞选纲领，对违反签证条件或澳大利亚法律的人实施更严厉的惩罚。

paras.en: It would toughen rules that currently require the mandatory cancellation of a visa if a person is sentenced to a prison term of more than a year to deport anyone who commits a crime at all, regardless of the length of sentence. People deported from Australia would be banned from ever returning.
paras.zh: 它将加强目前规定，如果一个人被判处一年以上监禁，以驱逐任何犯罪的人，无论刑期长短，都必须强制取消签证。被驱逐出澳大利亚的人将被禁止返回。

paras.en: A blanket visa refusal would be enacted on people from certain countries, with the party saying people from countries "known to foster extremist ideologies" would not be allowed to enter.
paras.zh: 将对来自某些国家的人实行全面拒签，该党表示，来自“已知助长极端主义意识形态”国家的人将不被允许入境。

paras.en: That list of countries would be determined using the Foreign Affairs Department's "do not travel" advice where it relates to security concerns.
paras.zh: 该国家名单将根据外交部关于安全问题的“不要旅行”建议来确定。

paras.en: The Coalition also wants to lift the standards for visa holders, including stricter adherence to an Australian values test and more enforcement to ensure people on student visas are not working beyond permitted hours.
paras.zh: 联盟党还希望提高签证持有者的标准，包括更严格地遵守澳大利亚价值观测试，以及加强执法力度，以确保持有学生签证的人不会超出允许的工作时间。

paras.en: The party would remove appeal rights for people whose visas are cancelled on character grounds, including those facing deportation due to criminal offences.
paras.zh: 该党将取消因品格原因签证被取消的人的上诉权利，包括因刑事犯罪而面临驱逐出境的人。

paras.en: The federal government already legislated new powers to deport people inciting hate in the wake of the Bondi terror attack.
paras.zh: 邦迪恐怖袭击发生后，联邦政府已经立法赋予驱逐煽动仇恨的人的新权力。

paras.en: Mr Burke's address last month did not detail any further changes related to safety or national values.
paras.zh: 伯克上个月的讲话没有详细说明与安全或国家价值观相关的任何进一步变化。

paras.en: But the minister did say directions to the Home Affairs department would be tweaked to add construction, agriculture, fisheries and teaching to the priority list, encouraging more workers in those sectors, after temporarily forcing a slowdown in processing of visa applications.
paras.zh: 但部长确实表示，在暂时放慢签证申请处理速度后，将对内政部的指示进行调整，将建筑、农业、渔业和教学纳入优先考虑范围，鼓励更多工人进入这些行业。

articles.title: Traffic delays expected for Bathurst 1000 with major highway still shut
articles.author: Hamish Cole and Xanthe Gregory

paras.en: Spectators are being warned of major travel delays to and from the Bathurst 1000 while a major highway from Sydney remains shut.
paras.zh: 观众收到警告称，往返巴瑟斯特 1000 公路的交通将出现严重延误，而来自悉尼的一条主要高速公路仍处于关闭状态。

paras.en: Bathurst Regional Council is hosting an Australian rock concert on Monday night to keep people in the region for an extra night.
paras.zh: 巴瑟斯特地区议会将于周一晚上举办一场澳大利亚摇滚音乐会，让该地区的人们多住一晚。

paras.en: Practice laps commence on Thursday ahead of the main event on Sunday.
paras.zh: 练习圈于周四开始，然后于周日进行主赛事。

paras.en: More than 200,000 motor racing fans are expected to attend the Bathurst 1000 this weekend but transport authorities are warning major traffic delays are inevitable.
paras.zh: 预计将有超过 200,000 名赛车迷参加本周末的巴瑟斯特 1000 大赛，但交通部门警告说，严重的交通延误是不可避免的。

paras.en: On Monday, drivers heading from Central West NSW were backed up for about 12 kilometres heading into Lithgow, blowing out trips over the Blue Mountains by several hours.
paras.zh: 周一，从新南威尔士州中西部前往利斯戈的司机遭遇了约 12 公里的堵车，使得穿越蓝山的行程提前了几个小时。

paras.en: The main route to the region, the Great Western Highway at Victoria Pass, has been shut since March, pushing all traffic onto the Darling Causeway and Bells Line of Road.
paras.zh: 通往该地区的主要路线，位于维多利亚山口的大西部高速公路，自三月以来已关闭，所有交通都被迫转向达令堤道和贝尔斯线公路。

paras.en: With racegoers from Sydney forced onto a single road through Lithgow to get to and from Bathurst, the gridlock this weekend is expected to be far worse.
paras.zh: 由于来自悉尼的赛马观众被迫走一条穿过利斯戈的道路往返巴瑟斯特，预计本周末的交通堵塞将会更加严重。

paras.en: "Expect big queues," Transport for NSW's coordinator-general Howard Collins said.
paras.zh: 新南威尔士州交通部协调员霍华德·柯林斯 (Howard Collins) 表示：“预计会出现大排长龙。”

paras.en: The four-day event kicks off with practice laps on Thursday ahead of the main race on Sunday, which will pay tribute to racing legend Peter Brock, who died 20 years ago.
paras.zh: 为期四天的赛事于周四以练习圈拉开帷幕，随后于周日举行主赛，主赛将向 20 年前去世的赛车传奇人物彼得·布洛克致敬。

paras.en: Transport for New South Wales (TfNSW) is urging drivers to allow extra travel time for the expected traffic.
paras.zh: 新南威尔士州交通局 (TfNSW) 敦促司机为预计的交通流量留出额外的出行时间。

paras.en: Alternative routes to avoid crossing the Blue Mountains have been suggested, such as using the Golden Highway from the north or the Hume Highway via Goulburn.
paras.zh: 有人建议避免穿越蓝山的替代路线，例如从北部使用黄金高速公路或途经古尔本的休姆高速公路。

paras.en: "It's going to be slow in both directions through the diversion from Mount Victoria," TfNSW's Howard Collins said.
paras.zh: 新南威尔士州交通局的霍华德·柯林斯说：“从维多利亚山改道后，两个方向的速度都会很慢。”

paras.en: "It might be frustrating, but be patient with everyone around you."
paras.zh: “这可能会令人沮丧，但请对周围的每个人保持耐心。”

paras.en: TfNSW has deployed drones and additional tow trucks to monitor conditions and deal with breakdowns and accidents.
paras.zh: 新南威尔士州交通局部署了无人机和额外的拖车来监控情况并处理故障和事故。

paras.en: Some fans have followed the authorities' advice to arrive early and have already set up camp on Mount Panorama.
paras.zh: 一些粉丝按照当局的建议提早抵达，并已经在帕诺拉马山扎营。

paras.en: "The pilgrimage is on," Bathurst Regional Council Mayor Ben Fry said.
paras.zh: 巴瑟斯特地区议会市长本·弗莱 (Ben Fry) 表示：“朝圣活动正在进行中。”

paras.en: "People are coming into our city, our region sooner; they know that there's going to be delays, they're taking it easy," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“人们越来越早地进入我们的城市、我们的地区；他们知道会出现延误，所以他们会放轻松。”

paras.en: The council will put on a concert on Monday night in a bid to convince people to spend another night out west, staggering the number of fans heading home.
paras.zh: 该委员会将在周一晚上举行一场音乐会，以说服人们在西部度过另一个夜晚，使回家的粉丝数量惊人。

paras.en: The concert will be headlined by Australian rock bands The Angels and The Choirboys, and is supported by $185,000 in state government funding.
paras.zh: 这场音乐会将由澳大利亚摇滚乐队 The Angels 和 The Choirboys 领衔主演，并得到州政府 185,000 美元的资助。

paras.en: Campers on the mountain and at council-run sites have been given the option to stay longer than the traditional departure time of midday on Monday.
paras.zh: 山上和议会管理的露营地的露营者可以选择比周一中午传统的出发时间更长的时间。

paras.en: "We're trying to ease the traffic flow, the egress, out of Bathurst for our neighbours in Lithgow," Cr Fry said.
paras.zh: 弗莱市长说：“我们正在努力缓解利思戈邻居离开巴瑟斯特的交通流量和出口。”

paras.en: A major high-visibility police operation began today and will continue through until Monday, with local officers assisted by specialist teams from Sydney.
paras.zh: 警方今天开始了一项大规模的高知名度行动，并将持续到周一，当地官员在悉尼专家小组的协助下。

paras.en: Assistant Commissioner Greg Moore said police will be out targeting speeding, drink-driving, fatigue and dangerous driver behaviour.
paras.zh: 助理局长格雷格·摩尔表示，警方将重点打击超速、酒后驾驶、疲劳驾驶和危险驾驶行为。

paras.en: "We will be surging in hundreds of extra police as we do every year to make sure this family-friendly event is safe and secure," Assistant Commisioner Moore said.
paras.zh: 助理专员摩尔表示：“我们将像每年一样增派数百名警察，以确保这场家庭友好型活动的安全。”

articles.title: Former American Idol singer gets life in prison for wife's murder

paras.en: Former Ohio music pastor and American Idol contestant Caleb Flynn has been sentenced to life in prison without the possibility of parole for murdering his wife.
paras.zh: 前俄亥俄州音乐牧师、《美国偶像》参赛者卡莱布·弗林因谋杀妻子而被判处终身监禁，不得假释。

paras.en: Prosecutors said Flynn staged a home invasion while his wife was asleep and claimed a burglar shot her.
paras.zh: 检察官称，弗林趁妻子熟睡时策划入室盗窃，并声称一名窃贼开枪射杀了她。

paras.en: Flynn's former mistress Alleigha Botner told jurors that he said he hated his wife and had thoughts of killing her.
paras.zh: 弗林的前情妇阿莉哈·博特纳告诉陪审员，他说他恨他的妻子，并想过杀了她。

paras.en: A former music pastor from Ohio who appeared briefly on American Idol has been sentenced to life in prison without the possibility of parole after a jury convicted him of murdering his wife while he was having an affair.
paras.zh: 俄亥俄州一位曾短暂出现在《美国偶像》节目中的前音乐牧师在陪审团判定他在有外遇时谋杀了妻子后被判处终身监禁，不得假释。

paras.en: Caleb Flynn, 40, used his Christian faith to manipulate others and showed no remorse for his actions, which were marked by "layers of deceit, manipulation and cruelty", Judge Jeannine Pratt said.
paras.zh: 法官珍妮·普拉特 (Jeannine Pratt) 表示，40 岁的卡勒布·弗林 (Caleb Flynn) 利用自己的基督教信仰来操纵他人，并且对自己的行为毫无悔意，其特点是“层层欺骗、操纵和残忍”。

paras.en: Just before he was sentenced, Flynn tearfully apologised to his family, starting with his two young daughters, who were home when he shot his wife in her sleep. He called their births the "greatest joy in this life".
paras.zh: 就在他被判刑之前，弗林泪流满面地向他的家人道歉，首先是他的两个年幼的女儿，当他在睡梦中开枪射杀了妻子时，她们正在家里。他称他们的出生是“此生最大的快乐”。

paras.en: Flynn accepted responsibility for his words and decisions, but remained adamant that he was innocent.
paras.zh: 弗林承认对自己的言论和决定负责，但仍然坚称自己是无辜的。

paras.en: "As I stand here before God, who is my ultimate judge, I am not lying when I say I did not kill my wife," he said.
paras.zh: “当我站在上帝面前时，他是我的最终法官，当我说我没有杀死我的妻子时，我并没有撒谎，”他说。

paras.en: Prosecutors said Flynn staged a home invasion in February and claimed a burglar killed his wife, Ashley Flynn, a 37-year-old schoolteacher and volleyball coach.
paras.zh: 检察官称，弗林在 2 月份实施了入室盗窃，并声称一名窃贼杀死了他的妻子阿什利·弗林 (Ashley Flynn)，她是一名 37 岁的学校教师兼排球教练。

paras.en: In his 2013 appearance on American Idol, Flynn credited his wife with encouraging him to chase his dreams on the singing contest.
paras.zh: 2013 年，弗林出现在《美国偶像》节目中，他称赞妻子鼓励他在歌唱比赛中追逐自己的梦想。

paras.en: He did not advance to the main competition in Hollywood.
paras.zh: 他没有晋级好莱坞的主要比赛。

paras.en: Flynn did not testify on his own behalf during the trial, nor did anybody else.
paras.zh: 弗林在审判期间没有代表自己作证，其他任何人也没有。

paras.en: Family members, including Ms Flynn's parents, spoke in favour of the harsh sentence, but said they had forgiven Flynn because they did not want her legacy to be hatred.
paras.zh: 包括弗林女士父母在内的家庭成员表示支持严厉的判决，但表示他们已经原谅了弗林，因为他们不希望她的遗产成为仇恨。

paras.en: Her sister, Kayla Keyt, said Flynn's actions had scarred the entire church community, prompting children to run into their parents' bedrooms to make sure their fathers had not killed their mothers.
paras.zh: 她的妹妹凯拉·凯特（Kayla Keyt）表示，弗林的行为给整个教会社区带来了创伤，促使孩子们跑进父母的卧室，以确保他们的父亲没有杀死他们的母亲。

paras.en: As a family member read a statement written by his daughter Ava, Flynn sobbed uncontrollably as a pile of tissues grew on the defence table in front of him.
paras.zh: 当一名家庭成员读到他女儿艾娃写的一份声明时，弗林无法控制地抽泣，他面前的辩护桌上堆满了纸巾。

paras.en: At one point, it appeared he might fall over.
paras.zh: 有那么一刻，他似乎可能会摔倒。

paras.en: "The absolute perfect person. What did she ever do to you to make you hate her so much?"
paras.zh: “绝对完美的人，她对你做了什么，让你这么恨她？”

paras.en: Flynn's other daughter, Alyssa, said in her statement that she would not visit him in prison.
paras.zh: 弗林的另一个女儿艾莉莎在声明中表示，她不会去监狱探望他。

paras.en: During closing arguments, prosecutors told jurors that Flynn wanted out of his marriage when he shot his wife at their house in the small town of Tipp City, about 25 kilometres north of Dayton, Ohio.
paras.zh: 在结案陈词中，检察官告诉陪审员，弗林在位于俄亥俄州代顿以北约 25 公里处的小镇蒂普城的家中枪杀了妻子，当时他想要结束婚姻。

paras.en: Prosecutors said he sent a text message to his lover, Alleigha Botner, on the night before the shooting that said: "I choose you. I'm free. Actions will come tomorrow."
paras.zh: 检察官称，枪击事件发生前一天晚上，他给情人阿莱哈·博特纳(Alleigha Botner)发了一条短信，短信中写道：“我选择你。我有空。明天就会采取行动。”

paras.en: During the trial, Ms Botner testified that she met Flynn in 2022 when she was 20 and working as an intern at his church. Ms Botner said she had an affair with Flynn for more than a year.
paras.zh: 在审判期间，博特纳女士作证说，她在 2022 年认识了弗林，当时她 20 岁，在他的教堂担任实习生。博特纳女士说，她与弗林的恋情已经一年多了。

paras.en: She told jurors that Flynn said he hated his wife and had thoughts of killing her.
paras.zh: 她告诉陪审员，弗林说他恨他的妻子，并想过杀了她。

paras.en: The gun used to kill Ashley Flynn was not found at the scene and Flynn's lawyer told jurors that investigators found no evidence that his client had fired a gun that day.
paras.zh: 现场没有发现用来杀死阿什利·弗林的枪，弗林的律师告诉陪审员，调查人员没有发现任何证据表明他的当事人当天开枪。

paras.en: Prosecutors said his fingerprints and DNA were at the scene and that his devices showed him moving around the house even though he claimed he was asleep at the time of the shooting.
paras.zh: 检察官称，现场有他的指纹和 DNA，而且他的设备显示他在房子里走动，尽管他声称枪击发生时他正在睡觉。

paras.en: The jury found him guilty of multiple counts, including murder, felonious assault and tampering with evidence.
paras.zh: 陪审团裁定他犯有多项罪名，包括谋杀、重罪袭击和篡改证据。
