articles.title: Australia's Rugby League World Cup squad is a sign of the changing times
articles.author: Nick Campton

paras.en: Fri, 11 Sept, 7:50 pm, Final score, Rabbitohs 10, Knights 20
paras.zh: 9 月 11 日星期五，晚上 7:50，最终比分，Rabbitohs 10，Knights 20

paras.en: The depths of Australia's star power means the Kangaroos will always name squads oozing with class and Kevin Walters's combination for this year's World Cup is no exception.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚明星力量的深厚意味着袋鼠队总是会选出充满魅力的球队，凯文·沃尔特斯今年世界杯的组合也不例外。

paras.en: It's a side with major success stories, young and old and in-between.
paras.zh: 这是一支拥有重大成功故事的球队，无论年轻的、年长的还是介于两者之间的。

paras.en: James Tedesco's return three years after his last Test caps the 33-year old's resurrection and after he ran the ball to hell and back in the grand final to win the Clive Churchill Medal, there can be no doubt that, at an age where many players best days are only just a memory, he is once again the best fullback in the world.
paras.zh: 詹姆斯·特德斯科在上次测试三年后回归，为这位 33 岁的球员带来了复活，在他在总决赛中带球跑进地狱并返回并赢得了克莱夫·丘吉尔奖章后，毫无疑问，在许多球员最好的日子只是回忆的年龄，他再次成为世界上最好的后卫。

paras.en: The inclusion of Dolphins flyer Jack Bostock, who will almost certainly see a Test debut in the World Cup opener given the side's shortage of wingers, heralds the start of a new generation wearing green and gold.
paras.zh: 海豚队飞人杰克·博斯托克（Jack Bostock）的加盟，预示着新一代身着绿色和金色球衣的开始，鉴于球队边锋短缺，他几乎肯定会在世界杯揭幕战中首次亮相。

paras.en: At 26, David Fifita is no longer a youngster in rugby league terms but his looming Australian debut is both a long time coming and well-earned following his strong finish to the year with Souths.
paras.zh: 26 岁的大卫·菲菲塔 (David Fifita) 在橄榄球联盟中不再是一名年轻人，但他即将在澳大利亚首次亮相，这既是一场漫长的等待，也是他在索斯队 (Souths) 取得优异成绩后应​​得的。

paras.en: The one-time prodigy has longed seemed a player of limitless possibilities but only now, eight years after his NRL debut and three years since he last played for Queensland, will he get the chance to be a Kangaroo.
paras.zh: 这位曾经的神童一直渴望成为一名拥有无限可能性的球员，但直到现在，在他首次亮相 NRL 八年后，距离他上次为昆士兰队效力三年后，他才有机会成为一名袋鼠。

paras.en: But the Australian squad also reveals the new truths about representative football, that the disconnect between State and Origin and Test matches is wider than ever before and may never be stitched back together again.
paras.zh: 但澳大利亚队也揭示了代表足球的新真相，即州比赛和起源比赛和测试比赛之间的脱节比以往任何时候都更大，并且可能永远不会再缝合在一起。

paras.en: It's a process that began with Origin's gradual but unmistakeable rise past Test football as rugby league's biggest stage then continued when a host of players chose to represent Pasifika nations over Australia while retaining their Origin eligibility.
paras.zh: 这个过程始于 Origin 逐渐但不容置疑地超越测试橄榄球，成为橄榄球联盟最大舞台的过程，然后，当许多球员选择代表太平洋岛民国家对阵澳大利亚，同时保留他们的 Origin 资格时，这一过程继续进行。

paras.en: The final change came earlier this year when the NRL allowed players to represent New Zealand or England and still being available for Origin selection.
paras.zh: 最后的改变发生在今年早些时候，当时 NRL 允许球员代表新西兰或英格兰，但仍然可以参加原籍选拔。

paras.en: Both of those eligibility changes reflect the changing face of rugby league and the people who play it and the game is better for them.
paras.zh: 这两项资格变化都反映了橄榄球联盟的面貌以及参加橄榄球比赛的人的变化，而且这项运动对他们来说变得更好了。

paras.en: But it does require a reset of over a century's worth of thinking that interstate football is the pathway to national selection.
paras.zh: 但这确实需要重新审视一个多世纪以来的思想，即州际足球是国家选拔的途径。

paras.en: This has not been true for some years now, but there's a reason old habits have a hard time dying.
paras.zh: 多年来情况并非如此，但旧习惯难以改掉是有原因的。

paras.en: And while Australia will never be hard up for talent, some of the more eyebrow-raising picks prove this old adage is as antiquated as Kangaroo tours that travel to England by boat.
paras.zh: 尽管澳大利亚永远不会缺乏人才，但一些更令人惊讶的选择证明，这句古老的格言和乘船前往英国的袋鼠之旅一样过时。

paras.en: Not one of the Queensland outside backs is in the side at all. Kalyn Ponga, Robert Toia, Jojo Fifita, Hamiso Tabuai-Fidow all would be, but they're playing for other nations while Selwyn Cobbo is injured.
paras.zh: 昆士兰队的外后卫没有一个在场上。卡林·蓬加、罗伯特·托亚、乔乔·菲菲塔、哈米索·塔布艾-菲多都可以，但他们在塞尔温·科博受伤时为其他国家队效力。

paras.en: That's how we end up with Brisbane's Kotoni Staggs, a fine centre who had a tough year, making the side despite being dropped by New South Wales for the Origin decider after a horror night in Game II at the MCG.
paras.zh: 这就是我们最终得到布里斯班的科托尼·斯塔格斯的原因，他是一名优秀的中锋，经历了艰难的一年，尽管在MCG的第二场比赛中经历了一个恐怖的夜晚后被新南威尔士州淘汰出局，但仍进入了球队。

paras.en: Latrell Mitchell missed the entire series through injury and has only started one match in the past five months but he's made it, while Tom Trbojevic is a likely starter on one wing despite not having played rep football for two years and not playing a match on the flank since 2018.
paras.zh: 拉特雷尔·米切尔因伤缺席了整个系列赛，在过去五个月里只首发了一场比赛，但他做到了，而汤姆·特尔博耶维奇很可能成为一侧翼的首发球员，尽管他已经两年没有踢过代表足球了，而且自 2018 年以来就没有参加过一场边路比赛。

paras.en: Likewise of the 12 men who played in the forwards for New South Wales, only Blayke Brailey, Isaah Yeo, Liam Martin and Cameron Murray have made the squad.
paras.zh: 同样，在新南威尔士州的 12 名前锋中，只有布莱克·布雷利、伊萨·杨、利亚姆·马丁和卡梅伦·穆雷入选了球队。

paras.en: Hudson Young and Payne Haas are both out with injury, but Haumole Olakau'atu and Addin Fonua-Blake will both line up for Tonga while Victor Radley is with England.
paras.zh: 哈德森·杨和佩恩·哈斯都因伤缺阵，但哈莫勒·奥拉卡图和阿丁·福努阿-布莱克都将代表汤加队出场，而维克多·拉德利则代表英格兰队。

paras.en: So Reuben Cotter makes the squad despite an underwhelming season with the Cowboys and a lacklustre series for Queensland.
paras.zh: 因此，尽管牛仔队的赛季表现平平，昆士兰队的系列赛也表现平平，鲁本·科特还是入选了球队。

paras.en: His selection over Dolphins hardman Max Plath, who does a similar job with similar attributes whilst offering the same versatility and is coming off a far superior season for club and state, is perhaps the hardest pick to understand.
paras.zh: 他选择了海豚队的硬汉马克斯·普拉斯（Max Plath），后者从事类似的工作，具有相似的属性，同时提供相同的多才多艺，并且在俱乐部和州队中度过了一个远为出色的赛季，这可能是最难理解的选择。

paras.en: Plath, along with Newcastle's Fletcher Sharpe and South Sydney's Tallis Duncan can count himself most aggrieved at missing out but it's hard to take up too much issue with Walters's squad, even if it's short of wingers.
paras.zh: 普拉斯、纽卡斯尔联的弗莱彻·夏普和南悉尼的塔利斯·邓肯都对自己的缺席感到最委屈，但很难对沃尔特斯的球队提出太多问题，即使球队缺少边锋。

paras.en: This is the hand the Australian coach has been dealt for his final tournament before he departs to take over Super League side St Helens.
paras.zh: 这是这位澳大利亚教练在接手超级联赛球队圣海伦斯队之前在最后一场比赛中所拿到的牌。

paras.en: The eligibility changes and the fact that Test football misses out on players who pick up injuries during club seasons that are getting longer and longer all the time means sometimes his options are a bit more limited than he would have liked.
paras.zh: 资格的变化以及测试足球错过了在俱乐部赛季中受伤的球员的事实，而俱乐部赛季的时间越来越长，这意味着有时他的选择比他希望的要有限一些。

paras.en: Australia are still the pick to win the World Cup and will be warm favourites in every game they play, beginning with their tournament opener against New Zealand next Thursday night in Sydney.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚仍然是赢得世界杯的热门人选，并且在每场比赛中都将成为热门热门，从下周四晚上在悉尼对阵新西兰的揭幕战开始。

paras.en: Walters is attempting to solve a puzzle no other Kangaroos coach has ever had to face and there is no one-size-fits-all philosophy in the battle between fitness, function and form when it comes to selecting a player.
paras.zh: 沃尔特斯试图解决其他袋鼠队教练从未遇到过的难题，并且在选择球员时，在体能、功能和状态之间的斗争中不存在一刀切的哲学。

paras.en: But when numbers are scarce, and for the Kangaroos they're a lot shorter than they used to be, the first two are more important than the last.
paras.zh: 但是，当数量稀少，并且对于袋鼠来说，它们比以前矮很多时，前两个比后一个更重要。

articles.title: Runner honours mother in epic Perth to Sydney relay for DV awareness

paras.en: Runners complete 4,000km relay from Cottesloe to Bondi for domestic violence awareness
paras.zh: 跑步者完成从科特斯洛到邦迪的 4,000 公里接力，以提高家庭暴力意识

paras.en: Six ultra-endurance athletes have run a 4,000 kilometre relay from Cottesloe Beach in WA to Bondi Beach in NSW to raise awareness about domestic violence.
paras.zh: 六名超耐力运动员从西澳科茨洛海滩到新南威尔士州邦迪海滩进行了 4,000 公里的接力赛，以提高人们对家庭暴力的认识。

paras.en: The runners took shifts to complete the trek across the Nullarbor in 15 days.
paras.zh: 跑步者们轮流在 15 天内完成了穿越纳拉伯河的跋涉。

paras.en: Funds raised as part of the initiative will go towards Beyond DV.
paras.zh: 该计划筹集的资金将用于 Beyond DV。

articles.title: Make the most of spring asparagus with these recipes
articles.author: Anna Chisholm

paras.en: It's the perfect time to be cooking asparagus.
paras.zh: 现在正是烹饪芦笋的最佳时机。

paras.en: Blossoms and hay fever concerns aside, spring is really about asparagus season. A time for asparagus lovers to rejoice and an annual opportunity for sceptics to get onside.
paras.zh: 抛开花朵和花粉症的担忧不谈，春天确实是芦笋的季节。这是芦笋爱好者欢欣鼓舞的时刻，也是怀疑论者一年一度站在一边的机会。

paras.en: From one-pot pasta to a crunchy green salad, these four recipes will help you embrace those delicious green spears while they are affordable.
paras.zh: 从一锅意大利面到松脆的绿色沙拉，这四种食谱将帮助您在价格实惠的情况下拥抱这些美味的绿色矛。

paras.en: With a cooking time of just 15 minutes and minimal prep, this one-pot pasta recipe from Heidi Sze combines about two bunches of asparagus and a lot of staple ingredients.
paras.zh: Heidi Sze 的这款一锅意大利面食谱仅需 15 分钟的烹饪时间和最少的准备工作，结合了大约两束芦笋和许多主食成分。

paras.en: Lemon and capers will help brighten the dish and either tinned or cooked salmon fillet could be substituted for the tuna, she says.
paras.zh: 她说，柠檬和刺山柑有助于提亮菜肴，罐装或煮熟的鲑鱼片可以代替金枪鱼。

paras.en: Hetty Lui McKinnon's galette recipe is an unfussy and adaptable vehicle for your favourite spring vegetables.
paras.zh: 海蒂·路易·麦金农 (Hetty Lui McKinnon) 的国王饼食谱是您最喜欢的春季蔬菜的简单且适应性强的载体。

paras.en: The corn could be replaced with fresh peas, podded broad beans, green beans, thinly shaved fennel, broccoli, or crunchy sugar snap or snow peas, Hetty says.
paras.zh: 海蒂说，玉米可以用新鲜豌豆、蚕豆、青豆、切成薄片的茴香、西兰花、脆脆的糖脆或荷兰豆来代替。

paras.en: And it can be enjoyed either warm or at room temperature, making any leftovers a potentially perfect work lunch candidate.
paras.zh: 它可以在温暖或室温下享用，使任何剩菜成为潜在的完美工作午餐候选者。

paras.en: Another recipe from Hetty Lui McKinnon, who says this salad is "high on texture and assertive with spring vibes".
paras.zh: 海蒂·路易斯·麦金农 (Hetty Lui McKinnon) 的另一道食谱，她说这款沙拉“质感高，充满春天的气息”。

paras.en: If you're not familiar with sauce gribiche, it brings together vinegar, cornichons, capers, mustard and chopped hard-boiled eggs.
paras.zh: 如果你不熟悉酱汁 gribiche，它融合了醋、酸黄瓜、刺山柑、芥末和切碎的煮鸡蛋。

paras.en: "The iconic French sauce is part chunky vinaigrette, part punchy mayonnaise," according to Hetty.
paras.zh: “标志性的法国酱汁一半是厚实的油醋汁，一半是浓郁的蛋黄酱，”海蒂说。

paras.en: This quiche recipe from Thalia Ho is simple to assemble and includes beginner-friendly pastry.
paras.zh: Thalia Ho 的这款乳蛋饼食谱制作起来很简单，并且包含适合初学者的糕点。

paras.en: Asparagus, lemon and goats' cheese is a tried and tested flavour combination, but Thalia says "you can play around with the filling, depending on taste, craving and what's available".
paras.zh: 芦笋、柠檬和山羊奶酪是一种久经考验的风味组合，但塔利亚说“你可以根据口味、渴望和可用的东西来调整馅料”。

articles.title: Lula, Bolsonaro head to run-off after neither secure majority in Brazil election's 1st round

paras.en: Lula, Bolsonaro head to run-off after neither secure majority in Brazil election's 1st round
paras.zh: 卢拉和博尔索纳罗在巴西大选第一轮均未获得多数席位后进入决选

paras.en: Run-off between incumbent and son of previous president to be held Oct. 25
paras.zh: 现任总统和前任总统之子之间的决选将于 10 月 25 日举行

paras.en: Sen. Flávio Bolsonaro, an ally of U.S. President Donald Trump, and Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, Brazil's incumbent president, will face off on Oct. 25 in a run-off for the top job of Latin America's powerhouse economy after neither won a majority in Sunday's vote.
paras.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普的盟友、参议员弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗和巴西现任总统路易斯·伊纳西奥·卢拉·达席尔瓦将于 10 月 25 日进行决选，争夺拉丁美洲经济强国的最高职位，此前两人在周日的投票中均未获得多数席位。

paras.en: The country's electoral court in Brasília said neither the 80-year-old Lula, seeking his fourth non-consecutive term, nor the 45-year-old son of former president Jair Bolsonaro would garner the majority vote needed for an outright win.
paras.zh: 巴西利亚选举法院表示，寻求第四个非连续任期的 80 岁卢拉和前总统雅伊尔·博尔索纳罗 45 岁的儿子都无法获得彻底获胜所需的多数票。

paras.en: The court had Bolsonaro with just over 55.8 million votes to Lula's nearly 53.2 million. Both candidates were poised to address supporters.
paras.zh: 法院认为，博尔索纳罗的票数略高于 5580 万票，而卢拉的票数则接近 5320 万票。两位候选人都准备向支持者发表讲话。

paras.en: The winner will be in charge of Latin America's biggest economy and a population of 214 million. A win for Bolsonaro would increase U.S. influence in Latin America. If Lula wins, Brazil is expected to keep its distance from Washington and continue to deepen its relationship with China.
paras.zh: 获胜者将掌管拉丁美洲最大的经济体和2.14亿人口。博尔索纳罗的胜利将增加美国在拉丁美洲的影响力。如果卢拉获胜，巴西预计将与华盛顿保持距离，并继续深化与中国的关系。

paras.en: The next presidential term is set to begin on Jan. 5, 2027.
paras.zh: 下一届总统任期定于 2027 年 1 月 5 日开始。

articles.title: Trump names U.S. intelligence chief Jay Clayton as new AI czar

paras.en: Trump names U.S. intelligence chief Jay Clayton as new AI czar
paras.zh: 特朗普任命美国情报局长杰伊·克莱顿为新任人工智能沙皇

paras.en: Clayton will head Trump's newly created AI task force, the 'Super Intelligence Force'
paras.zh: 克莱顿将领导特朗普新成立的人工智能特别工作组“超级情报部队”

paras.en: U.S. President Donald Trump said on Sunday he had named Jay Clayton, the director of national intelligence, as the administration's artificial intelligence czar, tasking him with co-ordinating the government's efforts to maintain U.S. leadership in the technology.
paras.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普周日表示，他已任命国家情报总监杰伊·克莱顿为政府的人工智能沙皇，责成他协调政府的努力，以维持美国在该技术领域的领先地位。

paras.en: Trump, who has pushed to rename AI as "super intelligence," said Clayton would head the newly created "Super Intelligence Force" (SIF), overseeing the government's engagement with consumers, religious groups, AI companies and other stakeholders.
paras.zh: 特朗普推动将人工智能重新命名为“超级智能”，他表示克莱顿将领导新成立的“超级智能部队”（SIF），监督政府与消费者、宗教团体、人工智能公司和其他利益相关者的互动。

paras.en: In a post on his Truth Social platform, Trump wrote that SIF would aim to "ensure that America continues to lead the World in Super Intelligence" and to "protect the interests, and improve the lives, of all Americans."
paras.zh: 特朗普在其“真相社交”平台上发表的一篇文章中写道，SIF 的目标是“确保美国在超级情报方面继续引领世界”并“保护所有美国人的利益并改善他们的生活”。

paras.en: - How AI could usher in a 'new scientific golden age' — if it doesn't kill us all first
paras.zh: - 人工智能如何开创“新科学黄金时代”——如果它不首先杀死我们所有人

paras.en: - Video Trump praises AI companies for self-policing plan, but critics want more oversight
paras.zh: - 视频 特朗普赞扬人工智能公司的自我监管计划，但批评者希望加强监督

paras.en: The announcement confirmed a Wall Street Journal report in which Clayton, appointed national intelligence chief in August, said Trump had tapped him to lead the administration's push to keep the United States at the forefront of AI.
paras.zh: 该声明证实了《华尔街日报》的一篇报道，其中八月份被任命为国家情报总监的克莱顿表示，特朗普已任命他领导政府推动美国保持在人工智能领域的领先地位。

paras.en: "The risk of not being first is high," Clayton told the newspaper.
paras.zh: “不成为第一的风险很高，”克莱顿告诉该报。

paras.en: Clayton said the task force would have 120 days to produce a report assessing the risks and opportunities posed by AI and recommending what role the federal government should play.
paras.zh: 克莱顿表示，工作组将有 120 天的时间编写一份报告，评估人工智能带来的风险和机遇，并就联邦政府应扮演的角色提出建议。

paras.en: The safety of AI has become a major issue in recent weeks, with some researchers warning that people building the technology believe it could kill humans within a decade. Several Democratic and Republican lawmakers have responded with alarm and calls for more action.
paras.zh: 最近几周，人工智能的安全性已成为一个主要问题，一些研究人员警告说，开发这项技术的人相信它可能在十年内杀死人类。一些民主党和共和党议员对此表示震惊，并呼吁采取更多行动。

paras.en: Trump has appeared to take a light touch toward AI regulation, arguing that excessive oversight could weaken competitiveness against China. He said on Tuesday that he does not want to work with Chinese President Xi Jinping on governing AI technology.
paras.zh: 特朗普似乎对人工智能监管态度温和，认为过度监管可能会削弱对中国的竞争力。他周二表示，他不想与中国国家主席习近平合作管理人工智能技术。

paras.en: Clayton's panel will review AI-related risks and current government reporting mechanisms for breaches, hacks and other incidents, and recommend ways to strengthen federal response capabilities under existing authorities, the Journal said, citing the task force's charter.
paras.zh: 《华尔街日报》援引该工作组的章程称，克莱顿的小组将审查与人工智能相关的风险以及当前政府针对违规、黑客和其他事件的报告机制，并就如何在现有当局的领导下加强联邦响应能力提出建议。

paras.en: This is the second time Trump has named an adviser to oversee AI-related decisions across the administration. Venture capitalist David Sacks held the AI czar role at the beginning of Trump's second term.
paras.zh: 这是特朗普第二次任命顾问来监督整个政府与人工智能相关的决策。风险投资家戴维·萨克斯（David Sacks）在特朗普第二任期之初担任人工智能沙皇。

paras.en: In addition to Clayton, the task force's leaders will include Andrew Ferguson, Federal Trade Commission chair; Pentagon chief technology officer Emil Michael; and Scott Kupor, director of the Office of Personnel Management, Trump wrote.
paras.zh: 除克莱顿外，该工作组的领导人还包括联邦贸易委员会主席安德鲁·弗格森；五角大楼首席技术官埃米尔·迈克尔；特朗普写道，人事管理办公室主任斯科特·库波尔(Scott Kupor)。

paras.en: The panel will report to the president and Susie Wiles, the White House chief of staff, he said.
paras.zh: 他说，该小组将向总统和白宫办公厅主任苏西·怀尔斯汇报。

articles.title: Jane Doe at centre of Cornell rape case targeted with threats, her lawyer says

paras.en: Jane Doe at centre of Cornell rape case targeted with threats, her lawyer says
paras.zh: 无名氏是康奈尔大学强奸案的中心人物，她的律师称她受到威胁

paras.en: Cornell under scrutiny following outcry over university's handling of allegations
paras.zh: 康奈尔大学因处理指控的方式遭到强烈抗议而受到审查

paras.en: The woman who has alleged she was drugged and raped by Cornell University students has been the target of threats, her lawyer said on Sunday.
paras.zh: 这名女子的律师周日表示，这名女子声称自己被康奈尔大学的学生下药并强奸，她一直是威胁的目标。

paras.en: Thomas Giuffra, who represents the woman identified as Jane Doe, told CNN that people have threatened to silence or harm her if she does not withdraw her civil lawsuit alleging that several members of a Cornell fraternity drugged and raped her in 2024.
paras.zh: 这名名叫无名氏 (Jane Doe) 的妇女的代表托马斯·吉弗拉 (Thomas Giuffra) 告诉 CNN，如果她不撤回民事诉讼，人们就威胁要让她闭嘴或伤害她，指控康奈尔大学兄弟会的几名成员在 2024 年对她下药并强奸了她。

paras.en: "She's received multiple threats," Giuffra said on CNN's State of the Union, adding that he had also been threatened.
paras.zh: 朱夫拉在美国有线电视新闻网（CNN）的国情咨文节目中表示，“她受到了多次威胁”，并补充说他自己也受到了威胁。

paras.en: "I'm not afraid of these people," he said. "But the threats, the abuse to protect what's going on, the status quo — these guys are disgusting. They should stay in their mother's basement and stay out of the world."
paras.zh: “我不怕这些人，”他说。 “但是威胁、为了保护正在发生的事情而进行的虐待、维持现状——这些人太恶心了。他们应该呆在母亲的地下室里，远离这个世界。”

paras.en: The identity of Jane Doe has become part of the fevered online conversation surrounding the case. Women on social media have been posting #IamJaneDoe in solidarity with the accuser and to counter some who have sought to publicly name her.
paras.zh: 无名氏的身份已成为围绕此案的网上热烈讨论的一部分。社交媒体上的女性一直在发布 #IamJaneDoe 声援原告，并反击一些试图公开指名道姓的人。

paras.en: Michael Tracey, an independent journalist and commentator, posted on Friday what he said was the accuser's name, which Reuters was unable to verify, before quickly deleting it, saying his point had been made.
paras.zh: 独立记者兼评论员迈克尔·特雷西 (Michael Tracey) 周五发布了他所说的原告姓名，但路透社无法核实该姓名，但他很快将其删除，并表示他的观点已经表达。

paras.en: He has expressed sympathy for the accused men over what he says is the harassment they have faced and described his effort to name the Cornell accuser as journalistic diligence protected under the U.S. Constitution as free speech.
paras.zh: 他对被告所面临的骚扰表示同情，并称他将康奈尔大学原告点名的努力是受美国宪法保护的新闻尽职调查和言论自由。

paras.en: - What to know about Cornell's alleged frat house gang-rape case and the 'Cornell 7'
paras.zh: - 关于康奈尔大学所谓的兄弟会轮奸案和“康奈尔七人案”的了解

paras.en: - 'I am Jane Doe': Online rally to protect Cornell rape accuser's identity becomes a reckoning
paras.zh: - “我是无名氏”：保护康奈尔强奸指控者身份的在线集会成为一场清算

paras.en: He told Reuters on Sunday that he did not wish to encourage threats or harassment against the woman.
paras.zh: 他周日告诉路透社，他不希望鼓励对这名女子的威胁或骚扰。

paras.en: "The point, from my perspective, was more about the public-policy implications of this increasingly commonly used tactic in civil litigation, for plaintiffs' attorneys to introduce sensational, reputation-harming allegations using the cloak of anonymity for their clients," Tracey said in an interview.
paras.zh: 特雷西在接受采访时表示：“从我的角度来看，这一点更多的是关于这种在民事诉讼中越来越常用的策略对公共政策的影响，即原告律师利用匿名的方式为客户提出耸人听闻的、有损声誉的指控。”

paras.en: Cornell University president Michael Kotlikoff said in a video message on Saturday that the university will examine the role of fraternities and sororities on campus following the outcry over the school's handling of the rape allegations.
paras.zh: 康奈尔大学校长迈克尔·科特里科夫（Michael Kotlikoff）在周六的视频消息中表示，在学校处理强奸指控的方式引发强烈抗议后，该大学将研究校园兄弟会和姐妹会的作用。

paras.en: "At their best, these organizations can provide students with friendship, belonging, mentorship and a powerful sense of community," he said. "But being part of a group can never diminish individual responsibility."
paras.zh: “在最好的情况下，这些组织可以为学生提供友谊、归属感、指导和强大的社区意识，”他说。 “但成为团队的一部分永远不会减少个人的责任。”

paras.en: Since the lawsuit was filed last month, prosecutors in New York's Tompkins County have been criticized for their initial handling of the allegations in 2024.
paras.zh: 自上个月提起诉讼以来，纽约汤普金斯县检察官因其 2024 年对指控的初步处理而受到批评。

paras.en: New York Gov. Kathy Hochul last week named state Attorney General Letitia James as special prosecutor to look into the case.
paras.zh: 纽约州州长凯西·霍赫尔 (Kathy Hochul) 上周任命州总检察长利蒂西亚·詹姆斯 (Letitia James) 为特别检察官，负责调查此案。

paras.en: U.S. President Donald Trump, a critic of James for years, lambasted the decision to appoint her. "And I feel badly for whoever she's looking at because they won't get a fair shake," he told reporters on Friday.
paras.zh: 多年来一直批评詹姆斯的美国总统唐纳德·特朗普痛斥了任命她的决定。 “无论她看到的是谁，我都感到很难过，因为他们得不到公平的对待，”他周五告诉记者。

paras.en: Asked about Trump's comment, Giuffra said the case shouldn't be politicized. "It has nothing to do with politics," he said.
paras.zh: 当被问及特朗普的评论时，朱弗拉表示，此案不应政治化。 “这与政治无关，”他说。

articles.title: Flydubai co-pilot attempted 'terrorist attack,' UAE says

paras.en: The co-pilot accused of stabbing his captain during Flydubai Flight 1073 was wielding a crash ax and attempted to carry out a "terrorist attack," UAE investigators said Saturday, according to Emirati state news agency WAM.
paras.zh: 据阿联酋国家通讯社 WAM 报道，阿联酋调查人员周六表示，被指控在迪拜航空 1073 号航班上刺伤机长的副驾驶当时挥舞着一把坠毁斧，并试图实施“恐怖袭击”。

paras.en: A crash ax is typically stored in the plane's cockpit for use in case of an emergency.
paras.zh: 防撞斧通常存放在飞机驾驶舱内，以备紧急情况使用。

paras.en: According to a Reuters media report based on unnamed sources familiar with the matter, the suspect is an Omani national.
paras.zh: 据路透社媒体根据未透露姓名的知情人士报道，嫌疑人是阿曼国民。

paras.en: The Wall Street Journal reported on Friday that the co-pilot had been barred from flying by Oman over concerns that he had adopted radical ideological views.
paras.zh: 《华尔街日报》周五报道称，由于担心副机长采取了激进的意识形态观点，阿曼已禁止他乘坐飞机。

paras.en: The attack that took place on a flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv has raised many questions about how the incident unfolded as well as about background checks in aviation hiring.
paras.zh: 从迪拜飞往特拉维夫的航班上发生的袭击引发了许多关于事件如何展开以及航空招聘背景调查的疑问。

paras.en: There were 182 people on board, including four pilots.
paras.zh: 机上共有182人，其中包括4名飞行员。

paras.en: After the co-pilot stabbed the captain in an apparent attempt to crash the plane, two other pilots in the cabin took control and landed the aircraft safely in Tabuk, Saudi Arabia.
paras.zh: 副驾驶刺伤了机长，显然是试图让飞机坠毁，机舱内的另外两名飞行员控制了飞机，并将飞机安全降落在沙特阿拉伯塔布克。

paras.en: Anwar Gargash, an Emirati presidential adviser, referred to the Flydubai incident on X, saying the latest "terrorist operation" showed the Mideast region's "fight against extremism continues."
paras.zh: 阿联酋总统顾问安瓦尔·加尔加什(Anwar Gargash)在X上提到了迪拜航空事件，称最新的“恐怖行动”表明中东地区“打击极端主义的斗争仍在继续”。

paras.en: Flydubai co-pilot was barred from flying by Oman over security concerns
paras.zh: 迪拜航空副驾驶因安全问题被阿曼禁止飞行

paras.en: The Wall Street Journal report said the co-pilot was hired by Flydubai despite the ban by Oman, allowing him to fly the jet on a sensitive route connecting the UAE and Israel.
paras.zh: 《华尔街日报》报道称，尽管阿曼禁止，但迪拜航空还是聘请了副驾驶，允许他在连接阿联酋和以色列的敏感航线上驾驶这架飞机。

paras.en: Israel and the UAE, which includes Dubai, signed the Abraham Accords normalizing relations in 2020.
paras.zh: 以色列和包括迪拜在内的阿联酋于 2020 年签署了关系正常化的《亚伯拉罕协议》。

paras.en: The newspaper said it could not be determined whether Oman shared concerns about the pilot's radicalization with other countries or airlines.
paras.zh: 该报称，无法确定阿曼是否与其他国家或航空公司一样担心该飞行员的激进行为。

paras.en: The nature of his radicalization was also not clear.
paras.zh: 他的激进化性质也不清楚。

paras.en: US broadcaster CNN cited two sources saying the co-pilot was removed from a job at Oman's national airline last year over concerns about extremist views.
paras.zh: 美国有线电视新闻网 (CNN) 援引两名消息人士的话称，去年，由于担心极端主义观点，阿曼国家航空公司副驾驶被免职。

paras.en: Saudi broadcaster Al Arabiya, also citing an informed source, reported that Omani authorities determined that the co-pilot held extremist views.
paras.zh: 沙特广播公司阿拉伯电视台也援引知情人士的话报道称，阿曼当局确定副驾驶持有极端主义观点。

paras.en: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said Thursday in a video statement that they know the co-pilot "underwent Islamist radical indoctrination" and intended to crash the jet.
paras.zh: 以色列总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡周四在一份视频声明中表示，他们知道副驾驶“受到了伊斯兰激进主义的灌输”，并打算撞毁这架飞机。

paras.en: Netanyahu also said they were also looking into whether the co-pilot had acted under anyone's direction, warning that whoever was involved would pay a "heavy price."
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡还表示，他们还在调查副驾驶是否在任何人的指示下行事，并警告说，无论谁参与其中，都将付出“沉重的代价”。

paras.en: The investigation is ongoing. A Gulf diplomat, in comments to AP, said authorities were attempting to find out whether the Omani co-pilot was a "lone wolf or has any connection with any extremist groups."
paras.zh: 调查正在进行中。一名海湾外交官在接受美联社采访时表示，当局正在试图查明阿曼副驾驶是否是“独狼或与任何极端主义团体有任何联系”。

paras.en: If you rely on our team for trusted reporting, please take a moment to select us as your Preferred Source on Google so you'll always see our verified news first.
paras.zh: 如果您信赖我们团队的可信报道，请花点时间选择我们作为您在 Google 上的首选来源，这样您就可以始终首先看到我们经过验证的新闻。

paras.en: Edited by: Sean Sinico and Natalie Muller
paras.zh: 编辑：肖恩·西尼科和娜塔莉·穆勒

articles.title: In Tigray, Ethiopian government forces have advanced against a northern rebel group, reports indicate

paras.en: Government forces in Ethiopia said they have recaptured an airport in Tigray's capital that was seized by rebel groups last week, in the northern region's worst outbreak of violence since a bloody civil war ended in 2022.
paras.zh: 埃塞俄比亚政府军表示，他们已夺回提格雷首都的一个机场，该机场上周被反叛组织占领，这是该北部地区自 2022 年血腥内战结束以来最严重的暴力事件。

paras.en: Several news agencies cited anonymous government sources on Saturday as saying Ethiopian federal forces now control Alula Aba Nega Airport in Mekelle.
paras.zh: 几家新闻机构周六援引匿名政府消息人士的话说，埃塞俄比亚联邦部队现在控制着默克莱的阿卢拉阿巴内加机场。

paras.en: "The military is in full control of the airport. That much I can confirm," an Ethiopian general told the Associated Press on condition of anonymity.
paras.zh: “军方完全控制了机场。这一点我可以证实，”一位不愿透露姓名的埃塞俄比亚将军告诉美联社。

paras.en: The AFP news agency, citing a "humanitarian source," reported rebel groups were leaving the city as Ethiopian government forces moved in.
paras.zh: 法新社援引“人道主义消息来源”的话说，随着埃塞俄比亚政府军的进驻，反叛组织正在离开该市。

paras.en: Neither side has issued an official statement on the status of who controls Mekelle, and reporting is complicated by communication blackouts and restricted media access.
paras.zh: 双方都没有就谁控制着梅克莱的状况发表正式声明，而且由于通讯中断和媒体访问受限，报道变得复杂。

paras.en: Pulling out of Tigray's capital would be a setback for the Tigray People's Liberation Front (TPLF), which recently aligned with several other armed opposition groups in northern Ethiopia.
paras.zh: 从提格雷首都撤军对提格雷人民解放阵线（TPLF）来说将是一个挫折，该阵线最近与埃塞俄比亚北部的其他几个武装反对派组织结盟。

paras.en: The TPLF has been the dominant force in Tigray since ousting a government-appointed administration earlier this year, and then appointing former wartime regional leader Debretsion Gebremichael as regional president.
paras.zh: 自从今年早些时候推翻政府任命的政府，然后任命前战时地区领导人德布雷森·格布雷迈克尔（Debretsion Gebrmichael）为地区主席以来，蒂格雷人阵一直是提格雷的主导力量。

paras.en: The Addis Ababa-based government's Ethiopian National Defense Force has been fighting off a renewed rebel offensive since late September.
paras.zh: 自九月下旬以来，总部位于亚的斯亚贝巴的埃塞俄比亚国防军一直在击退叛军的新攻势。

paras.en: The TPLF seized the airport in Mekelle on September 23, along with launching attacks on government positions in the neighboring regions of Afar and Amhara, initially having made gains before being pushed back this week.
paras.zh: TPLF 于 9 月 23 日占领了默克莱机场，同时对邻近的阿法尔和阿姆哈拉地区的政府阵地发动了袭击，最初取得了进展，但本周被击退。

paras.en: Gebremichael issued a statement on Thursday, promising to continue guerrilla attacks on government forces, similar to what took place when rebels lost control of Mekelle in 2020.
paras.zh: 格布雷迈克尔周四发表声明，承诺继续对政府军进行游击攻击，类似于 2020 年叛军失去对梅克莱的控制时所发生的情况。

paras.en: The TPLF, which ruled Ethiopia from 1991 to 2018, seeks to topple Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed's government. More than 600,000 people were killed in a civil war from 2020 to 2022.
paras.zh: TPLF于1991年至2018年统治埃塞俄比亚，旨在推翻总理阿比·艾哈迈德政府。 2020年至2022年间，超过60万人在内战中丧生。

paras.en: The renewed unrest in northern Ethiopia has led to tensions spilling across the region, with fears of wider regional conflict in the Horn of Africa.
paras.zh: 埃塞俄比亚北部再次发生的骚乱导致整个地区紧张局势蔓延，人们担心非洲之角可能发生更广泛的地区冲突。

paras.en: For years, Ethiopia has accused its northern neighbor Eritrea of providing support to Tigray rebels, alongside Sudan and Egypt. All three countries deny this.
paras.zh: 多年来，埃塞俄比亚一直指责其北部邻国厄立特里亚与苏丹和埃及一起向提格雷叛乱分子提供支持。这三个国家均否认这一点。

paras.en: Last week, Ethiopia and Eritrea cut diplomatic ties, with both countries expelling diplomats and closing embassies.
paras.zh: 上周，埃塞俄比亚和厄立特里亚断绝外交关系，两国驱逐外交官并关闭大使馆。

paras.en: The African Union said it was concerned by the growing tensions between Ethiopia, Eritrea and Egypt, and has called on all sides to show maximum restraint.
paras.zh: 非洲联盟表示对埃塞俄比亚、厄立特里亚和埃及之间日益紧张的局势感到关切，并呼吁各方表现出最大限度的克制。

paras.en: Eritrea accuses landlocked Ethiopia of planning to invade and seize access to the Red Sea
paras.zh: 厄立特里亚指责内陆埃塞俄比亚计划入侵并夺取红海通道

paras.en: The TPLF's Debretsion said in his video message that "the war is regional and it is a war to control the Red Sea."
paras.zh: TPLF的德布雷西翁在视频讲话中表示，“这场战争是地区性的，是一场控制红海的战争。”

paras.zh: 如果您信赖我们团队的可信报道，请花点时间选择我们作为您在 Google 上的首选来源，这样您就可以始终首先看到我们经过验证的新闻。

articles.title: Hundreds of French schools closed amid protests

paras.en: Several hundred schools in France will close totally or partially on Monday amid security fears following a wave of nationwide student protests, the education minister has said.
paras.zh: 法国教育部长表示，由于全国学生抗议浪潮引发的安全担忧，法国数百所学校将于周一全部或部分关闭。

paras.en: The protests by pupils complaining of poor conditions began at one Paris school on September 17 but last week mutated into sometimes violent demonstrations across the nation.
paras.zh: 9月17日，学生们在巴黎一所学校发起抗议活动，抗议学校的恶劣条件，但上周演变为全国范围内有时发生的暴力示威活动。

paras.en: Education Minister Edouard Geffray said on Sunday that lessons would be totally or partly suspended" in some "400-500" high schools on Monday, as the security conditions "have not been fulfilled."
paras.zh: 教育部长爱德华·格弗雷 (Edouard Geffray) 周日表示，由于安全条件“尚未满足”，部分“400-500”所高中周一将全部或部分停课。

paras.en: According to Geffray, the schools were being closed mainly as a precaution, with more large protests planned for Tuesday.
paras.zh: 格弗雷表示，学校关闭主要是出于预防措施，并计划在周二举行更大规模的抗议活动。

paras.en: Geffray said the number of schools remaining closed on Monday would be similar to that on Friday but that there was planned to be a "partial, progressive return to lessons."
paras.zh: 格弗雷表示，周一仍然关闭的学校数量将与周五相似，但计划“部分、逐步恢复上课”。

paras.en: He said 24 schools had been "burned or ransacked" and 78 education staff members injured since the protests began.
paras.zh: 他说，自抗议活动开始以来，已有 24 所学校被“烧毁或洗劫”，78 名教育工作人员受伤。

paras.en: "There are activists — particularly from the far left — who have infiltrated the high school student movement, hijacked it from the students themselves, and engaged in extreme violence," Geffray said.
paras.zh: 格弗雷说：“有些活动人士，特别是来自极左翼的活动人士，渗透到了高中学生运动中，从学生手中劫持了运动，并从事极端暴力活动。”

paras.en: "Clearly, this poses a risk to both our staff and our students," he added.
paras.zh: “显然，这对我们的员工和学生都构成了风险，”他补充道。

paras.en: Valerie Pecresse, the president of the Ile-de-France region surrounding the capital, said that more than a third of the 468 schools in the region would be shut on Monday.
paras.zh: 首都周边法兰西岛大区主席瓦莱丽·佩克雷斯 (Valerie Pecresse) 表示，该地区 468 所学校中的三分之一以上将于周一关闭。

paras.en: The protesting teenagers at French high schools, called lycees, have complained of high rates of absenteeism by teachers, school days that are too long and dilapidated facilities.
paras.zh: 法国高中的抗议青少年抱怨教师缺勤率高、上课时间过长以及设施破旧。

paras.en: They have also protested at the lack of adequate cooling on hot summer days, with some towns seeing temperatures of 40 degrees Celsius (104 Fahrenehit) last summer in a country without widespread air conditioning.
paras.zh: 他们还对炎热的夏季缺乏足够的冷却设施提出抗议，去年夏天，在一个没有普遍安装空调的国家，一些城镇的气温高达 40 摄氏度（104 华氏度）。

paras.en: Organizers have called for the protests to continue on Tuesday, saying the government was still failing to proposed "concrete measures" to remedy the situation.
paras.zh: 组织者呼吁周二继续举行抗议活动，称政府仍未提出“具体措施”来纠正这种情况。

paras.en: On Sunday, Prime Minister Sebastien Lecornu urged local authorities to make it a priority to fill gaps left by long-term absences and unfilled posts.
paras.zh: 周日，总理塞巴斯蒂安·勒科尔努敦促地方当局优先考虑填补长期缺席和空缺职位留下的空缺。

paras.en: He also called a meeting for Tuesday with regional presidents to discuss renovating school buildings that are often in poor condition.
paras.zh: 他还召集周二与地区校长举行会议，讨论翻修状况不佳的校舍的问题。

paras.en: Violent incidents at the school protests
paras.zh: 学校抗议中发生暴力事件

paras.en: The protests have been marked by several violent incidents, with security forces sometimes using tear gas and batons to disperse the young protesters.
paras.zh: 抗议活动发生了几起暴力事件，安全部队有时使用催泪瓦斯和警棍驱散年轻抗议者。

paras.en: More than 5,000 people, 85% of them minors, have been arrested since the start of the movement.
paras.zh: 自运动开始以来，已有 5,000 多人被捕，其中 85% 是未成年人。

paras.en: On Sunday, a 16-year-old was detained after a 59-year-old teacher was hit and doused with gasoline on the sidelines of a protest in the southern town of La Ciotat.
paras.zh: 周日，在南部小镇拉西奥塔的一次抗议活动中，一名 59 岁的教师被击中并被浇汽油，随后一名 16 岁的青少年被拘留。

paras.en: Last week, a group of young people was filmed beating and kicking a policeman on the ground in the eastern town of Belfort.
paras.zh: 上周，在东部城镇贝尔福，一群年轻人被拍到在地上殴打和踢打一名警察。

paras.en: The French branch of rights group Amnesty International last week described the action taken by police as "disproportionate."
paras.zh: 人权组织国际特赦组织法国分会上周称警方采取的行动“不成比例”。

paras.en: Interior Minister Laurent Nunez has, however, defended security forces, saying they were "not cracking down on young people" but rather "protecting" school and university students wishing to "peacefully voice their demands."
paras.zh: 然而，内政部长洛朗·努涅斯为安全部队辩护，称他们“不是镇压年轻人”，而是“保护”希望“和平表达诉求”的中学生和大学生。

articles.title: Samoa PM apologises after Nazi salute video emerges

paras.en: Samoa’s Prime Minister La’auli Leuatea Schmidt has apologised after previously unseen video showed him leading a Nazi salute and saying “Heil Hitler” at a family gathering.
paras.zh: 萨摩亚总理拉奥利·卢阿泰亚·施密特 (La'auli Leuatea Schmidt) 已道歉，因为之前未公开的视频显示他在一次家庭聚会上行纳粹礼并喊出“希特勒万岁”。

paras.en: Schmidt issued the apology on Monday after the Samoa Observer, a local newspaper, published the seven-second clip the previous day.
paras.zh: 当地报纸《萨摩亚观察家报》前一天发布了这段七秒的剪辑后，施密特于周一发表了道歉声明。

paras.en: The footage was recorded at a Schmidt family reunion on the island of Savai‘i in July 2007, when he was an MP and deputy speaker of parliament.
paras.zh: 这段视频是 2007 年 7 月在萨瓦伊岛的施密特家庭聚会上录制的，当时施密特是国会议员兼副议长。

paras.en: In the video, Schmidt is holding a microphone as he leads a “hip hip” exchange with the group before telling those present to raise their right hands and say “Heil Hitler”.
paras.zh: 在视频中，施密特拿着麦克风，与大家进行“嘻哈”交流，然后告诉在场的人举起右手并说“希特勒万岁”。

paras.en: About a dozen people visible in the footage appear to follow him.
paras.zh: 视频中可见大约十几个人似乎在跟随他。

paras.en: Radio New Zealand said it had independently verified the footage through its correspondent in Samoa.
paras.zh: 新西兰广播电台表示，它已通过萨摩亚记者独立核实了这段视频。

paras.en: Schmidt said on Monday that the words and gesture were inappropriate regardless of what was intended at the gathering and apologised for the offence they could cause.
paras.zh: 施密特周一表示，无论聚会的目的如何，这些言语和手势都是不恰当的，并为可能造成的冒犯表示歉意。

paras.en: “I reject Nazism, antisemitism, racism and all forms of political extremism,” he said, adding that the episode did not represent his beliefs or the values of Samoa’s government and people.
paras.zh: 他说：“我拒绝纳粹主义、反犹太主义、种族主义和一切形式的政治极端主义。”他补充说，这一事件并不代表他的信仰或萨摩亚政府和人民的价值观。

paras.en: The apology followed criticism from academics contacted by the Samoa Observer.
paras.zh: 该道歉是在《萨摩亚观察家报》联系学者提出批评后做出的。

paras.en: Richard Evans, a historian of Nazi Germany, told the Samoa Observer by email that the footage was “shocking and disturbing”.
paras.zh: 纳粹德国历史学家理查德·埃文斯通过电子邮件告诉《萨摩亚观察家报》，这段视频“令人震惊和不安”。

paras.en: The paper also quoted University of Canterbury academic Anne-Marie Brady as saying Schmidt should explain and apologise.
paras.zh: 该报还援引坎特伯雷大学学者安妮-玛丽·布雷迪的话说，施密特应该做出解释并道歉。

paras.en: Schmidt, who became prime minister in 2025, has made strong public expressions of support for Israel.
paras.zh: 2025年就任总理的施密特公开表达了对以色列的强烈支持。

paras.en: He wore a Jewish prayer shawl at his swearing-in, where a shofar, a horn used in Jewish religious ceremonies, was sounded.
paras.zh: 他在宣誓就职时戴着犹太祈祷披肩，宣誓时吹响了号角（犹太宗教仪式中使用的号角）。

paras.en: He has also pledged to open a Samoan embassy in Jerusalem before the end of 2026, a step taken by only a handful of countries because of the city’s disputed status and Palestinian claims to East Jerusalem as the capital of a future state.
paras.zh: 他还承诺在 2026 年底之前在耶路撒冷开设萨摩亚大使馆，由于该城市的地位存在争议，而且巴勒斯坦声称东耶路撒冷是未来国家的首都，因此只有少数国家采取了这一举措。

paras.en: In his Monday statement, Schmidt said he considered the controversy addressed and would focus on the country’s economic and social challenges.
paras.zh: 施密特在周一的声明中表示，他认为争议已经得到解决，并将重点关注该国的经济和社会挑战。

articles.title: Who were the top teen athletes at the Asian Games?

paras.en: Teenage athletes have headlined some of the biggest Asian Games triumphs, leading their countries to historic gold medals, breaking records and cementing their legacy as formidable forces in the field.
paras.zh: 青少年运动员在亚运会的一些重大胜利中占据了主导地位，带领他们的国家获得了历史性的金牌，打破了记录，并巩固了他们作为该领域强大力量的遗产。

paras.en: Far from being intimidated by competitors double or triple their age, these schoolchildren remained cool and unfazed as they cruised to gold at their Asian Games debut.
paras.zh: 这些学童并没有被年龄比自己大一倍或三倍的竞争对手吓倒，而是在首次亮相亚运会时保持冷静、泰然自若，夺得金牌。

paras.en: Many are already familiar with the pressure and expectations of the world stage and have dominated their sport all season.
paras.zh: 许多人已经熟悉了世界舞台的压力和期望，并在整个赛季统治了他们的运动。

paras.en: Al Jazeera Sport looks at some of the stars who left their mark in Japan:
paras.zh: 半岛电视台体育频道回顾了一些在日本留下印记的明星：

paras.en: At just 13, Yu was named female Most Valuable Player (MVP), as she bagged three gold medals and broke as many Asian Games records in a fairytale debut.
paras.zh: 于年仅 13 岁，就凭借童话般的首秀斩获三枚金牌并打破多项亚运会纪录，被评为女性最有价值球员 (MVP)。

paras.en: The schoolgirl stormed to victory in the women’s 200m butterfly, 200m and 400m individual medley (IM) and had a comfortable lead over her competitors.
paras.zh: 这位女学生在女子 200m 蝶泳、200m 和 400m 个人混合泳 (IM) 比赛中一举夺得冠军，轻松领先对手。

paras.en: Her time of two minutes and 6.10 seconds (2:06.10) in the 200m IM stands as a world junior record and second-fastest time ever.
paras.zh: 她在 200m IM 比赛中以 2 分 6.10 秒（2:06.10）的成绩创造了世界青少年纪录，也是有史以来第二快的成绩。

paras.en: “I don’t think I am what people describe as a prodigy,” she said after being crowned MVP. “I will continue to train hard, push myself and work alongside young athletes across Asia to inspire more young people to love and take part in sports, especially swimming.”
paras.zh: “我不认为我是人们所说的神童，”她在加冕 MVP 后说道。 “我将继续努力训练，鞭策自己，与亚洲各地的年轻运动员一起努力，激励更多年轻人热爱和参与运动，特别是游泳。”

paras.en: Zhang held up seven fingers after his 400m freestyle win to count out his gold medals at the Games – the most at this edition, and more than what 27 of the 45 participating nations had in their medal tally at the conclusion of the event.
paras.zh: 张在获得 400 米自由泳冠军后举起七个手指数着自己在本届奥运会上获得的金牌——这是本届奥运会上获得的金牌数，超过了 45 个参赛国家中 27 个国家在赛事结束时的奖牌总数。

paras.en: He set Games records in the 400m and 800m freestyle, an Asian record in the 200m, and helped power China to gold and Asian records in the men’s 4x100m and 4x200m freestyle relays.
paras.zh: 他创造了400米和800米自由泳的奥运会纪录、200米的亚洲纪录，并帮助中国队在男子4x100米和4x200米自由泳接力赛中夺得金牌并打破亚洲纪录。

paras.en: But the 19-year-old has bigger victories in sight.
paras.zh: 但这位 19 岁的年轻人即将取得更大的胜利。

paras.en: “The Asian Games is not the goal. I’m still aiming for the Olympics and competing with the best,” he said.
paras.zh: “亚运会不是目标。我的目标仍然是奥运会，与最优秀的选手竞争，”他说。

paras.en: The teenager’s haul helped China sign off from swimming with 30 golds out of 41 medal events in the pool, with chief rival Japan a distant second with seven titles.
paras.zh: 这位少年的出色表现帮助中国队在泳池项目的 41 枚奖牌中夺得 30 枚金牌，而主要竞争对手日本队则以 7 枚冠军的成绩位列第二。

paras.en: Ohashi broke the world record in the men’s 200m breaststroke (2:04.83) in front of a home crowd to become the first swimmer under the 2:05 mark.
paras.zh: 大桥在国内观众面前打破了男子 200 米蛙泳世界纪录（2:04.83），成为第一位低于 2:05 大关的游泳运动员。

paras.en: The gold added to his title in the 100m breaststroke shared with China’s Dong Zhihao, bronze in the 50m breaststroke, and silver in the mixed and men’s 4x100m medley relays.
paras.zh: 他在100米蛙泳比赛中与中国选手董志浩并列夺得金牌，在50米蛙泳比赛中获得铜牌，在混合泳和男子4x100米混合泳接力比赛中获得银牌。

paras.en: The teenager said he was surprised and honoured that Olympic champion Leon Marchand knew who he was, after the Frenchman described the 17-year-old as a “scary” prospect ahead of the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics.
paras.zh: 这位青少年表示，奥运会冠军莱昂·马尔尚知道他是谁，他感到惊讶和荣幸，此前这位法国人在 2028 年洛杉矶奥运会之前将这位 17 岁的年轻人形容为“可怕”的前景。

paras.en: “I respect him because I know just how strong he is. But if I want to win, he’s someone I know I’ll have to beat.”
paras.zh: “我尊重他，因为我知道他有多强大。但如果我想赢，我知道我必须击败他。”

paras.en: Ohashi’s world record performance came just a week after the teenager recovered from COVID-19.
paras.zh: 大桥的世界纪录表现是在这名少年从 COVID-19 中康复一周后实现的。

paras.en: Yan was already javelin world number one and Asian record holder when she stepped onto the field for her Games debut – her first and only throw of 70.46 metres was enough for gold and a Games record.
paras.zh: 当她首次亮相奥运会时，她已经是标枪世界第一和亚洲纪录保持者——她的第一次也是唯一一次投掷70.46米，足以获得金牌和奥运会纪录。

paras.en: It was the sixth-best of all time and well ahead of Olympic champion and home hero Haruka Kitaguchi’s 62.70m.
paras.zh: 这是有史以来第六好的成绩，远远领先于奥运会冠军兼家乡英雄北口遥香的 62.70m。

paras.en: Yan is closing in on the world record of 72.28m set by Barbora Spotakova in 2008. In May, she hurled a world-leading, record-breaking 71.74m to open an unprecedented season.
paras.zh: 颜正在接近芭芭拉·斯波塔科娃 (Barbora Spotakova) 在 2008 年创下的 7228m 世界纪录。5 月，她投出了世界领先、破纪录的 7174m，开启了前所未有的赛季。

paras.en: Chen stormed to a new Games record in the women’s 100m en route to her first gold as she announced herself as the new sprint queen in Asia.
paras.zh: 陈在女子 100 米比赛中创下了新的奥运会纪录，并在夺得第一枚金牌的过程中宣布自己成为亚洲新的短跑女王。

paras.en: “I have no limits,” was her response when asked how much faster she hopes to run.
paras.zh: 当被问及她希望跑多快时，她回答说：“我没有限制。”

paras.en: She followed up her podium finish with a silver in the 200m and gold in the women’s and mixed 4x100m relays.
paras.zh: 在登上领奖台后，她在 200 米接力赛中获得银牌，在女子和混合 4x100 米接力赛中获得金牌。

paras.en: Goto narrowly missed gold in the men’s 400m hurdles, but his 47.93s was enough for a world under-18 best time, Asian under-20 best time, and a new personal best.
paras.zh: 后藤在男子 400 米栏上以微弱的优势与金牌失之交臂，但他的 47.93 秒足以创造 18 岁以下世界最佳成绩、亚洲 20 岁以下最佳成绩以及新的个人最好成绩。

paras.en: The teen star has run sub-50 seconds eight times this season alone, an impressive feat for a 17-year-old. His Asian Games silver added to the World Under-20 one he bagged in August.
paras.zh: 仅在本赛季，这位青少年明星就跑出了 8 次低于 50 秒的成绩，这对于 17 岁的年轻人来说是一项令人印象深刻的壮举。他在 8 月份的世界 20 岁以下青年队比赛中又获得了一枚亚运会银牌。

paras.en: Mohod scripted history for India when she became the first Indian to win an individual recurve archery gold at the Games. The 17-year-old helped India to gold in the women’s team recurve, and partnered with Dhiraj Bommadevara for mixed team silver.
paras.zh: 莫霍德成为第一个在奥运会上赢得个人反曲弓射箭金牌的印度人，为印度书写了历史。这位 17 岁的选手帮助印度在女子反曲弓团体赛中获得金牌，并与迪拉吉·博马德瓦拉 (Dhiraj Bommadevara) 搭档获得混合团体银牌。

paras.en: Mohod’s gold was no stroke of luck; she defeated South Korea’s reigning world champion and Olympic medallist Kang Chaeyoung in the quarterfinals before dominating China’s Zhu Jingyi in the semifinals.
paras.zh: 莫霍德的金牌绝非侥幸。她在四分之一决赛中击败了韩国卫冕世界冠军、奥运会奖牌获得者姜彩瑛，然后在半决赛中击败了中国选手朱静怡。

paras.en: “Ever since I’ve made it to the national team, I’ve been visualising this moment. I had visualised shooting an X, and that is exactly what happened,” she told reporters after the match, according to Indian media.
paras.zh: 据印度媒体报道，“自从我进入国家队以来，我就一直在想象这一刻。我想象过射出一个X，而这正是发生的事情，”据印度媒体报道，她在赛后告诉记者。

paras.en: World junior champion Anahat Singh has been India’s finest in the sport for several years now. Despite only being 18, Aichi-Nagoya was Singh’s second Asian Games outing after competing at Hangzhou 2023, where she won two bronze medals in the mixed doubles and women’s team events.
paras.zh: 世界青少年冠军阿纳哈特·辛格多年来一直是印度这项运动中最优秀的球员。尽管年仅 18 岁，但爱知名古屋赛是辛格继 2023 年杭州奥运会后第二次参加亚运会，她在混合双打和女子团体项目中获得了两枚铜牌。

paras.en: This time round, she won a silver in the women’s singles against world number five Sivasangari Subramaniam of Malaysia. However, her semifinal match against Japan’s Satomi Watanabe was what she called the “best win” of her career after producing a stellar comeback to defeat the world number six.
paras.zh: 这一次，她在女单比赛中对阵世界排名第五的马来西亚选手西瓦桑加里·苏布拉马尼亚姆，获得银牌。然而，她在半决赛对阵日本选手渡边聪美的比赛中，凭借出色的逆转击败世界排名第六的选手，被她称为职业生涯“最好的一场胜利”。

paras.en: At just 11 years of age, e-sports prodigy Kurihara became the youngest gold medallist in Asian Games history when he won Puyo Puyo Champions.
paras.zh: 年仅11岁的电子竞技神童栗原就赢得了Puyo Puyo冠军，成为亚运会历史上最年轻的金牌获得者。

paras.en: “I’m really happy. The gold medal is really beautiful, shiny and heavy,” Kurihara said after his final, where he barely broke a sweat.
paras.zh: “我真的很高兴。这枚金牌真的很漂亮、闪亮、沉重，”栗原在决赛后说道，他几乎没有流汗。

paras.en: Kurihara started playing Puyo Puyo in his first year of primary school – where he still studies – and soon started competing and winning in tournaments. He obtained his pro licence in April this year and regularly beats adults, often triple his age.
paras.zh: 栗原在小学一年级时就开始玩《Puyo Puyo》（他现在仍在学校学习），并很快开始参加比赛并赢得比赛。他于今年四月获得了职业执照，经常击败成年人，通常是他年龄的三倍。

paras.en: Ku took silver in the men’s skateboarding park with 87.33 points, and was just one of several teenagers – in his case, a pre-teen – who medalled in skateboarding at the Games.
paras.zh: 库在男子滑板公园比赛中以 87.33 分获得银牌，他只是几名在奥运会上获得滑板奖牌的青少年之一（他是一名未成年人）。

paras.en: Japan’s Izuru Nagahara, 15, took gold in the event. China’s Zhu Yuanling, also 15, won gold in the women’s street skateboarding competition.
paras.zh: 15 岁的日本选手长原 Izuru 在此次比赛中获得金牌。同样15岁的中国选手朱元玲在女子街头滑板比赛中获得金牌。

paras.en: China’s Cao Shiqi finished fourth in women’s skateboarding park and was the youngest athlete in China’s delegation at the Games.
paras.zh: 中国选手曹士奇在女子滑板公园获得第四名，是本届奥运会中国代表团中最年轻的运动员。

articles.title: Middle East oil exports surpass pre-war levels despite tensions, data shows

paras.en: Crude oil exports from the Middle East have risen above pre-war levels on four of the seven days in the last week of September, provisional data from ship-tracking firm Kpler showed.
paras.zh: 船舶追踪公司 Kpler 的临时数据显示，在 9 月最后一周的 7 天中，有 4 天中东原油出口量已超过战前水平。

paras.en: However, senior Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) commander Ali Fadavi said in a televised interview on Sunday night that only three to four million barrels of oil per day (bpd) are now moving through the route, dismissing the amount as “negligible” when compared with pre-war traffic.
paras.zh: 然而，伊斯兰革命卫队 (IRGC) 高级指挥官阿里·法达维 (Ali Fadavi) 在周日晚间的电视采访中表示，目前每天只有 3 到 400 万桶石油 (bpd) 通过该路线，与战前的交通量相比，这一数量“微不足道”。

paras.en: Fadavi said, for the first time, no US vessels were present in the Gulf, the Strait of Hormuz, the Sea of Oman or even the northern Indian Ocean and US warships are “100 percent vulnerable” to IRGC attacks.
paras.zh: 法达维表示，海湾地区、霍尔木兹海峡、阿曼海甚至北印度洋首次没有美国船只出现，美国军舰“100%容易”受到伊斯兰革命卫队的攻击。

paras.en: Kpler data showed crude exports from the region exceeded pre-war levels on September 24 and between September 27 and 29, rising to 19.5-22.5 million bpd.
paras.zh: Kpler数据显示，该地区的原油出口量在9月24日和9月27日至29日期间超过了战前水平，升至19.5-2250万桶/日。

paras.en: Around that time, Iran claimed success in attacking ships – including US Navy vessels – near the Strait of Hormuz, saying the strikes had forced Washington to move its warships further from the Iranian coast.
paras.zh: 大约在那个时候，伊朗声称成功袭击了霍尔木兹海峡附近的船只，包括美国海军舰艇，并称这些袭击迫使华盛顿将其军舰移离伊朗海岸更远的地方。

paras.en: Before the US-Israel war on Iran began, exports averaged 18 million bpd between March 2025 and February 2026.
paras.zh: 在美以对伊朗的战争开始之前，2025年3月至2026年2月期间平均出口量为1800万桶/日。

paras.en: According to Kpler data, the overall tally for crude, oil products, chemicals and non-gas liquids averaged 22.4 million bpd in the seven days to September 30.
paras.zh: 根据 Kpler 数据，截至 9 月 30 日的 7 天内，原油、石油产品、化学品和非天然气液体的总产量平均为 2240 万桶/日。

paras.en: On October 1, the seven-day moving average for crude exports was at 18.5 million bpd. This includes transits via the Strait of Hormuz, the Red Sea, exports from terminals and ship-to-ship transfers in the Gulf of Oman.
paras.zh: 10 月 1 日，原油出口 7 天移动平均数为 1,850 万桶/日。这包括通过霍尔木兹海峡、红海的过境、从码头的出口以及阿曼湾的船对船转运。

paras.en: The number of liquefied natural gas cargoes exiting the Strait of Hormuz also rose in September to its highest monthly level since February.
paras.zh: 9月份离开霍尔木兹海峡的液化天然气货物数量也升至2月份以来的最高月度水平。

paras.en: The figures exclude any vessels that might have crossed the strait with their automatic identification system transponders turned off to avoid detection.
paras.zh: 这些数字不包括任何可能在穿越海峡时关闭自动识别系统应答器以避免被发现的船只。

paras.en: The United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations agency reported at least one attack a day in the Strait of Hormuz or in the Gulf of Aden since October 2.
paras.zh: 英国海事贸易运营机构报告称，自10月2日以来，霍尔木兹海峡或亚丁湾每天至少发生一起袭击事件。

paras.en: On Sunday, Iran’s top negotiator and parliament speaker, Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf, said the Strait of Hormuz would remain closed until the United States accepts Tehran’s seven-day plan to reopen the waterway.
paras.zh: 周日，伊朗最高谈判代表兼议会议长穆罕默德·巴格尔·加利巴夫表示，霍尔木兹海峡将保持关闭，直到美国接受德黑兰重新开放该水道的七日计划。

articles.title: Brazil's election could shift its ties with the U.S. and China
articles.author: Carrie Kahn

paras.en: Brazil's election could shift its ties with the U.S. and China
paras.zh: 巴西大选可能会改变其与美国和中国的关系

paras.en: Brazil is a global supplier of oil, soybeans and critical minerals. Americas Quarterly editor in chief Brian Winter explains how Brazil's presidential election could impact trade with the U.S. and China.
paras.zh: 巴西是石油、大豆和重要矿产的全球供应国。 《美洲季刊》主编布莱恩·温特解释了巴西总统选举将如何影响与美国和中国的贸易。

paras.en: CARRIE KAHN, BYLINE: Joining us now is Brian Winter. He's the editor in chief of Americas Quarterly. He's a seasoned analyst of Latin American politics, who lived in Brazil for many, many years. Thanks so much for coming on with us.
paras.zh: 嘉莉·卡恩连线：布莱恩·温特现在加入我们。他是《美洲季刊》的主编。他是一位经验丰富的拉丁美洲政治分析师，在巴西生活了很多很多年。非常感谢您与我们同行。

paras.en: KAHN: Let's start with Brazil's relationship with the U.S. President Trump has made it clear that he sees Brazil as strategically important. I think you described Brazil as Trump's biggest prize. Why does this Brazilian election matter so much to Washington?
paras.zh: 卡恩：让我们从巴西与美国的关系开始。特朗普总统明确表示，他认为巴西具有战略重要性。我认为你将巴西描述为特朗普的最大奖品。为什么这次巴西选举对华盛顿如此重要？

paras.en: WINTER: Over the last two years or so, we've seen numerous countries in Latin America swing to the right. In fact, of the last 16 elections in the region, 13 have been won by right or center-right candidates. And of course, Brazil is Latin America's biggest country, and President Trump has gotten in the middle of some of these elections, including Brazil's. He has some personal ties with the Bolsonaro family. So this is the big prize for President Trump. He's eager to see Brazil swing right.
paras.zh: 温特：在过去两年左右的时间里，我们看到许多拉丁美洲国家向右转。事实上，在该地区过去 16 次选举中，有 13 次是右翼或中右翼候选人获胜。当然，巴西是拉丁美洲最大的国家，特朗普总统参与了其中一些选举，包括巴西的选举。他与博尔索纳罗家族有一些私人关系。所以这是特朗普总统的大奖。他渴望看到巴西队向右转。

paras.en: KAHN: But when you say he's eager to see it, what would he do with a right-wing government in Brazil now?
paras.zh: 卡恩：但是当你说他渴望看到这一点时，他现在会对巴西的右翼政府做什么？

paras.en: WINTER: You know, this is the White House that has been most focused on Latin America in 40 years - the involvement in the border with Mexico, the capture of Nicolás Maduro earlier this year, the financial bailout of Javier Milei's Argentina last year, among other examples. The Trump administration believes that Latin America is absolutely key to a couple of issues, including stopping irregular immigration and reducing the flow of drugs into the United States.
paras.zh: 温特：你知道，这是白宫40年来最关注拉丁美洲的事情——介入墨西哥边境、今年早些时候抓获尼古拉斯·马杜罗、去年对哈维尔·米莱领导的阿根廷进行金融救助等等。特朗普政府认为，拉丁美洲绝对是解决几个问题的关键，包括阻止非正常移民和减少流入美国的毒品。

paras.en: And of course, it's also true that President Trump likes having other leaders around the world who think the same way that he does and who will join at meetings like CPAC and other meetings designed to sort of show that his brand of right-wing politics is on the up and up throughout the world.
paras.zh: 当然，特朗普总统也确实喜欢世界各地有与他想法相同的其他领导人，他们会参加 CPAC 等会议和其他会议，这些会议旨在表明他的右翼政治品牌在全世界范围内不断上升。

paras.en: KAHN: Yet, he hasn't come out and publicly outright endorsed Bolsonaro. Why do you think that's so? If this is his big prize, why not just come out and say it?
paras.zh: 卡恩：然而，他还没有公开公开支持博尔索纳罗。你认为为什么会这样？如果这是他的大奖，为什么不直接出来说出来呢？

paras.en: WINTER: President Trump's story with Brazil over the last year or so has been, frankly, a bit of a telenovela. It's true, as you know, that President Trump announced these big tariffs on Brazil in July of 2025. The tariffs ended up damaging the U.S. economy, but they also helped President Lula and probably politically damaged the Bolsonaro family.
paras.zh: 冬天：坦率地说，特朗普总统在过去一年左右与巴西的故事有点像电视剧。如您所知，特朗普总统确实于 2025 年 7 月宣布对巴西征收巨额关税。这些关税最终损害了美国经济，但也帮助了卢拉总统，并可能在政治上损害了博尔索纳罗家族。

paras.en: President Trump may also be hedging his bets a bit because it's also true that it's the world's second-biggest reserves of rare Earths. And there are other people in the U.S. government who are thinking less about ideology and trying to be more pragmatic, saying things like, look, this is a big, important country, and it's better if we have a more institutional relationship rather than trying to get very involved in this election.
paras.zh: 特朗普总统也可能会两面下注，因为它确实是世界第二大稀土储量。美国政府中还有其他人较少考虑意识形态，并试图更加务实，他们说，看，这是一个重要的大国，如果我们有更多的制度性关系，而不是试图过多地参与这次选举，那就更好了。

paras.en: KAHN: Let's look at the economics of this now, too, given Brazil's size. You know, it's the largest economy in Latin America. It's a member of the G20, with GDP greater than Canada or Mexico. But the economy has been faltering, and that's big on voters' minds.
paras.zh: 卡恩：考虑到巴西的国土面积，我们现在也来看看这方面的经济意义。你知道，它是拉丁美洲最大的经济体。它是二十国集团成员，国内生产总值高于加拿大或墨西哥。但经济一直步履蹒跚，这是选民最关心的问题。

paras.en: WINTER: There are so many parallels with the United States. While the headline numbers for the Brazilian economy are pretty good - GDP is growing at a good pace, unemployment's at a historic low - if you talk to Brazilians and you look at the polls, people are actually pretty upset about the way things are going. They feel like their salary doesn't go as far. Affordability is a huge issue.
paras.zh: WINTER：与美国有很多相似之处。虽然巴西经济的总体数据相当不错——国内生产总值正在以良好的速度增长，失业率处于历史最低水平——但如果你与巴西人交谈并查看民意调查，就会发现人们实际上对事情的进展感到非常不安。他们觉得自己的工资没有那么高。负担能力是一个大问题。

paras.en: KAHN: Yeah. And I'm just curious - you know, China is Brazil's other largest trading partner. Could a Bolsonaro government really pivot toward the U.S. and toward Trump?
paras.zh: 卡恩：是的。我只是好奇 - 你知道，中国是巴西的另一个最大贸易伙伴。博尔索纳罗政府真的会转向美国和特朗普吗？

paras.en: WINTER: There would probably be more alignment with the United States under Flavio Bolsonaro, especially on security - there, there's no doubt. But on economics, it's more complicated for Brazil because China has been their No. 1 trading partner for several years now. It's the market that receives most of their soy and iron ore and many of the other commodities that they produce.
paras.zh: 温特：在弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗的领导下，可能会与美国更加结盟，特别是在安全方面——这是毫无疑问的。但在经济方面，对巴西来说情况更为复杂，因为中国多年来一直是其第一大贸易伙伴。该市场接收了他们生产的大部分大豆和铁矿石以及许多其他商品。

paras.en: And there's a track record here. Flavio Bolsonaro's father, Jair Bolsonaro, when he was president from 2018 to 2022, he talked a big anti-China game during his campaign. But once he got into office, many people, including Brazil's agricultural lobby, prevailed on him to kind of leave the status quo in place. Daniel Noboa, the president of Ecuador, also a very strong U.S. ally, just made a state visit to China. Leaders have been hesitant to choose between Washington and Beijing, no matter their ideological orientation.
paras.zh: 这里有一个记录。弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗的父亲雅伊尔·博尔索纳罗在2018年至2022年担任总统期间，在竞选期间大肆宣扬反华言论。但他一上任，包括巴西农业游说团体在内的许多人都劝说他保持现状。美国的强大盟友厄瓜多尔总统丹尼尔·诺博亚刚刚对中国进行了国事访问。无论意识形态倾向如何，领导人在华盛顿和北京之间做出选择时一直犹豫不决。

paras.en: KAHN: And finally, do you see Brazil's place in the world changing depending on who becomes the next leader?
paras.zh: 卡恩：最后，您认为巴西在世界上的地位是否会根据谁成为下一任领导人而发生变化？

paras.en: WINTER: Look, Brazil is an important country. It's the world's sixth-biggest country by population. It has so much in terms of natural resources. It's home to about two-thirds of the Amazon, the world's biggest rainforest. That's critical to everybody on the planet. It's also true that under President Lula deforestation has fallen sharply. So that's important.
paras.zh: 温特：看，巴西是一个重要的国家。按人口计算，它是世界第六大国家。它拥有如此多的自然资源。它是世界上最大的雨林亚马逊雨林约三分之二的所在地。这对地球上的每个人都至关重要。在卢拉总统的领导下，森林砍伐确实大幅减少。所以这很重要。

paras.en: Lula, when he was reelected, he had grand plans to help mediate peace deals, including in the Middle East and with Ukraine. None of those obviously came to pass. So, you know, I think under either leader, I think we'll see a Brazil that continues to be important at bodies like the United Nations, the G20 and elsewhere.
paras.zh: 卢拉，当他再次当选时，他制定了帮助调解和平协议的宏伟计划，包括在中东和与乌克兰的和平协议。这些显然都没有实现。所以，我认为在任何一位领导人的领导下，我们都会看到巴西在联合国、二十国集团和其他机构中继续发挥重要作用。

paras.en: KAHN: Well, thank you so much for your time. We've been speaking with Brian Winter. He's the editor in chief of Americas Quarterly and is the author of several books about Brazil. Thank you so much, Brian.
paras.zh: 卡恩：好的，非常感谢您抽出时间。我们一直在与布莱恩·温特交谈。他是《美洲季刊》的主编，也是多本有关巴西的书籍的作者。非常感谢你，布莱恩。

paras.en: That was Carrie Kahn in Rio de Janeiro, who has been covering the Brazilian election.
paras.zh: 那是里约热内卢的卡丽·卡恩（Carrie Kahn），她一直在报道巴西大选。

paras.en: (SOUNDBITE OF HERMANOS GUTIERREZ'S "LOW SUN")
paras.zh: （HERMANOS GUTIERREZ 的《LOW SUN》原声片段）

articles.title: The Amazon's future is on the ballot in Brazil. Many voters aren't focused on it
articles.author: Júlia Dias Carneiro

paras.en: The Amazon's future is on the ballot in Brazil. Many voters aren't focused on it
paras.zh: 亚马逊的未来取决于巴西的选票。许多选民并没有关注它

paras.en: Brazil's environment is a global concern. But on the campaign trail, it's struggling to get voters' attention.
paras.zh: 巴西的环境是全球关注的问题。但在竞选过程中，它很难吸引选民的注意力。

paras.en: CARRIE KAHN, BYLINE: But there's another issue at stake in this election that could have consequences far beyond Brazil's borders. That's the environment. You know, Brazil is home to much of the Amazon rainforest, a vast store of carbon that plays a critical role in regulating the global climate. Yet, on the presidential campaign trail, environmental issues have largely taken a backseat to voters' more immediate concerns. Let's listen to Julia Carneiro.
paras.zh: 嘉莉·卡恩连线：但这次选举还有另一个问题，其后果可能远远超出巴西国界。这就是环境。您知道，巴西是亚马逊雨林大部分地区的所在地，这里蕴藏着巨大的碳，在调节全球气候方面发挥着关键作用。然而，在总统竞选过程中，环境问题在很大程度上已经退居次要地位，让位于选民更紧迫的担忧。让我们听听朱莉娅·卡内罗的声音。

paras.en: JULIA CARNEIRO, BYLINE: On a sunny morning, flowers, fresh fish and tropical fruit fill the stalls of a bustling farmers market in Rio.
paras.zh: 朱莉娅·卡内罗连线：在一个阳光明媚的早晨，里约热内卢一个熙熙攘攘的农贸市场的摊位上摆满了鲜花、新鲜的鱼和热带水果。

paras.en: CARNEIRO: At one stall, vendor Ezequiel Gomes (ph) is selling cassava. I ask what's on his mind as he decides how to vote.
paras.zh: 卡内罗：在一个摊位上，小贩 Ezequiel Gomes（ph）正在出售木薯。我问他在决定如何投票时在想什么。

paras.en: CARNEIRO: He doesn't hesitate - healthcare, education, security.
paras.zh: 卡内罗：他毫不犹豫——医疗保健、教育、安全。

paras.en: CARNEIRO: And what about the environment? Does he worry about that, too?
paras.zh: 卡内罗：那么环境呢？他也担心这个吗？

paras.en: CARNEIRO: He pauses. "The environment," he says. It's something he's never really thought about.
paras.zh: 卡内罗：他停顿了一下。 “环境，”他说。这是他从来没有真正思考过的事情。

paras.en: CARNEIRO: He's voting for Flavio Bolsonaro because he likes change.
paras.zh: 卡内罗：他投票给弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗，因为他喜欢变革。

paras.en: CARNEIRO: Shopping at a poultry stall, Cristiana Bittencourt (ph) says the environment is at the top of her agenda.
paras.zh: 卡内罗：在一家家禽摊位购物时，克里斯蒂安娜·比特当古 (Cristiana Bittencourt)（博士）表示，环境问题是她的首要任务。

paras.en: CRISTIANA BITTENCOURT: (Speaking Portuguese).
paras.zh: 克里斯蒂安娜·比坦古：（葡萄牙语）。

paras.en: CARNEIRO: Wearing red in support of President Lula, she says, "Brazil must protect the Amazon, especially after the Jair Bolsonaro years."
paras.zh: 卡内罗：她身穿红色衣服支持卢拉总统，她说：“巴西必须保护亚马逊，尤其是在贾尔·博尔索纳罗执政之后。”

paras.en: MARY LOUISE KELLY: The world is increasingly worried about the future of the Amazon rainforest.
paras.zh: 玛丽·路易丝·凯利：世界越来越担心亚马逊雨林的未来。

paras.en: CARNEIRO: Four years ago, former President Jair Bolsonaro was making headlines over his environmental record.
paras.zh: 卡内罗：四年前，前总统雅伊尔·博尔索纳罗因其环境记录而成为头条新闻。

paras.en: JUANA SUMMERS: Bolsonaro has spent the past four years encouraging logging, mining and ranching in the Amazon rainforest.
paras.zh: 胡安娜·萨默斯：博尔索纳罗在过去四年里一直鼓励亚马逊雨林的伐木、采矿和畜牧业。

paras.en: CARNEIRO: His government faced widespread opposition as deforestation surged and environmental agencies were weakened. Under Lula, climate action and multilateralism returned to the agenda. Environmental enforcement was restored, and deforestation in the Amazon fell sharply. But Lula's environmental record has also drawn criticism, especially over his government's decision to pursue oil exploration near the mouth of the Amazon River.
paras.zh: 卡内罗：随着森林砍伐激增和环境机构被削弱，他的政府面临广泛的反对。在卢拉的领导下，气候行动和多边主义重新回到议程上。环境执法得到恢复，亚马逊地区的森林砍伐大幅减少。但卢拉的环境记录也招致了批评，尤其是他的政府决定在亚马逊河口附近进行石油勘探。

paras.en: MARCIO ASTRINI: Look, Lula's government - there are a lot of contradictions inside the Lula's government but also a lot of achievements that must be recognized.
paras.zh: 马西奥·阿斯特里尼：卢拉政府——卢拉政府内部存在很多矛盾，但也有很多成就必须得到认可。

paras.en: CARNEIRO: Marcio Astrini heads the Brazilian Climate Observatory, a network of 170 civil society groups that have analyzed the candidates' government plans. Astrini fears Flavio Bolsonaro would follow his father's playbook.
paras.zh: 卡内罗：马西奥·阿斯特里尼 (Marcio Astrini) 领导巴西气候观测站，该观测站由 170 个民间社会团体组成，对候选人的政府计划进行了分析。阿斯特里尼担心弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗会效仿他父亲的做法。

paras.en: ASTRINI: We are really concerned to have, again, this kind of hell to the climate agenda that we face along the Bolsonaro's agenda.
paras.zh: 阿斯特里尼：我们真的很担心我们在博尔索纳罗的议程中再次面临这样的气候议程地狱。

paras.en: CARNEIRO: Around 90% of Brazilians link extreme weather to climate change, according to a Climate Observatory survey. But that concern doesn't necessarily translate into votes.
paras.zh: 卡内罗：根据气候观测站的调查，大约 90% 的巴西人将极端天气与气候变化联系起来。但这种担忧并不一定会转化为选票。

paras.en: UNIDENTIFIED COMMENTATOR: (Speaking Portuguese).
paras.zh: 身份不明的评论员：（葡萄牙语）。

paras.en: CARNEIRO: This initiative was created to help make this match. Vote for Climate is a platform that connects voters with more than 300 candidates running for Congress on climate action platforms.
paras.zh: 卡内罗：发起这一举措是为了帮助完成这场比赛。 Vote for Climate 是一个平台，将选民与在气候行动平台上竞选国会议员的 300 多名候选人联系起来。

paras.en: UNIDENTIFIED COMMENTATOR: (Speaking Portuguese).
paras.zh: 身份不明的评论员：（葡萄牙语）。

paras.en: CARNEIRO: At the Lula rally in Rio, I met one of the candidates featured on the platform - City Councilor Taina de Paula. She's running for federal MP with the Workers' Party.
paras.zh: 卡内罗：在里约卢拉集会上，我会见了该平台上的一位候选人——市议员泰娜·德保拉。她正在与工人党一起竞选联邦议员。

paras.en: CARNEIRO: She says the election is a chance to put climate on the political agenda and wants to get a chance to challenge the conservative BBB caucus in Congress, standing for bull, bullet and Bible.
paras.zh: 卡内罗：她说这次选举是将气候问题纳入政治议程的机会，并希望有机会挑战国会中代表公牛、子弹和圣经的保守派 BBB 核心小组。

paras.en: CARNEIRO: "I like to joke that I will be part of the CCC caucus, for city, culture and climate," she says. "If we elect enough lawmakers, we'll be able to beat them."
paras.zh: 卡内罗：“我喜欢开玩笑说，我将成为 CCC 核心小组的一员，为城市、文化和气候服务，”她说。 “如果我们选出足够多的立法者，我们将能够击败他们。”

paras.en: UNIDENTIFIED ANNOUNCER: (Speaking Portuguese).
paras.zh: 身份不明的播音员：（葡萄牙语）。

paras.en: CARNEIRO: But with climate competing against more immediate concerns, getting voters to put it at the top of the agenda may be a harder task. For NPR News, I'm Julia Carneiro in Rio.
paras.zh: 卡内罗：但是，由于气候问题与更紧迫的问题相互竞争，让选民将其置于议程的首位可能是一项艰巨的任务。我是 NPR 新闻的里约热内卢的朱莉娅·卡内罗 (Julia Carneiro)。
