articles.title: Brazil's presidential race heads to Lula–Bolsonaro run-off as right gains ground
articles.author: Catherine Osborn

paras.en: Brazil's presidential race heads to Lula–Bolsonaro run-off as right gains ground
paras.zh: 随着右翼势力的崛起，巴西总统竞选将进入卢拉-博尔索纳罗决选阶段

paras.en: RIO DE JANEIRO —Brazil's presidential race is heading to a runoff between left-wing President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and right-wing Senator Flávio Bolsonaro after neither candidate secured the more than 50% of valid votes needed to win outright.
paras.zh: 里约热内卢——巴西总统竞选即将在左翼总统路易斯·伊纳西奥·卢拉·达席尔瓦和右翼参议员弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗之间进行决选，两位候选人都没有获得彻底获胜所需的超过 50% 的有效选票。

paras.en: The race was tight, with Flávio Bolsonaro finishing ahead of Lula in Sunday's first-round election. With more than 99% of the vote counted, Bolsonaro secured roughly 47% of the vote, while Lula came in second place with 45%.
paras.zh: 竞争十分激烈，弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗在周日的第一轮选举中领先卢拉。超过99%的选票已清点，博尔索纳罗获得了大约47%的选票，而卢拉以45%的得票率位居第二。

paras.en: If that sounds like déjà -vú, it's because in many ways, this election is a rerun: Lula narrowly defeated Bolsonaro's father, former right-wing President Jair Bolsonaro, in 2022. Jair Bolsonaro is now serving a 27-year prison sentence under house arrest after being convicted of plotting to overturn that election and prevent Lula from taking office.
paras.zh: 如果这听起来似曾相识，那是因为从很多方面来说，这次选举都是一次重演：卢拉在 2022 年以微弱优势击败了博尔索纳罗的父亲、前右翼总统贾尔·博尔索纳罗。贾尔·博尔索纳罗因密谋推翻选举并阻止卢拉上任而被定罪，目前正在软禁中服刑 27 年。

paras.en: Flávio has pledged to carry on his father's legacy. Speaking to journalists and supporters outside his home in Brasília after the results came in, he said the vote showed Brazilians were ready for a political change.
paras.zh: 弗拉维奥承诺继承父亲的遗产。选举结果公布后，他在巴西利亚的家外对记者和支持者发表讲话说，这次投票表明巴西人已经做好了政治变革的准备。

paras.en: "Brazil wants change, that's the reading of what happened today," Bolsonaro said. "It's the end of the Workers' Party era," he added, referring to Lula's political party.
paras.zh: 博尔索纳罗说：“巴西想要改变，这就是对今天发生的事情的解读。” “这是工人党时代的结束，”他补充说，指的是卢拉的政党。

paras.en: Sunday's results also pointed to a broader rightward shift in Brazilian politics, with the Bolsonaro camp performing strongly across the country.
paras.zh: 周日的结果还表明巴西政治出现更广泛的右倾，博尔索纳罗阵营在全国范围内表现强劲。

paras.en: Lula sought to rally his supporters in São Paulo, framing the next stage of the campaign as a fresh contest.
paras.zh: 卢拉试图在圣保罗团结他的支持者，将下一阶段的竞选活动视为一场新的竞赛。

paras.en: "Tomorrow we start a new campaign," Lula said. "I am very good in the knockout stage. We will see who has the best plan."
paras.zh: “明天我们将开始一项新的竞选活动，”卢拉说。 “我在淘汰赛阶段表现得很好。我们会看看谁有最好的计划。”

paras.en: Lula also took aim at his opponent, warning voters about Bolsonaro's political background. "On the other side we have an uncertainty with a biography of a dark past," he said.
paras.zh: 卢拉还瞄准了他的对手，警告选民有关博尔索纳罗的政治背景。 “另一方面，我们对黑暗过去的传记感到不确定，”他说。

paras.en: The presidential candidates who came in third, fourth, and fifth place are all right-wing, suggesting that Bolsonaro could have a natural pool of voters to draw from in the runoff. That could set the stage for another extremely tight contest on October 25.
paras.zh: 排名第三、第四和第五位的总统候选人都是右翼人士，这表明博尔索纳罗在决选中可能拥有天然的选民资源。这可能为 10 月 25 日另一场极其激烈的比赛奠定基础。

paras.en: Brazilians also chose governors and state and federal lawmakers Sunday, with early results showing that the right also made significant gains in Congress, particularly in the Senate. That could give Bolsonaro a stronger political base if he wins the presidency.
paras.zh: 周日，巴西人还选出了州长以及州和联邦议员，初步结果显示，右翼在国会，特别是参议院也取得了重大进展。如果博尔索纳罗赢得总统职位，这可能会给他带来更强大的政治基础。

paras.en: Lula, 80, is aiming for his fourth nonconsecutive term and has pledged to continue broad social spending and to stand up to Trump's aggressive policies toward Latin America.
paras.zh: 现年 80 岁的卢拉正瞄准第四个非连续任期，并承诺继续广泛的社会支出，并抵制特朗普对拉丁美洲的侵略政策。

paras.en: Bolsonaro, 45, pledges to slash the deficit and realign the country's foreign policy with Washington. The result suggests Lula will now have to do more than defend his record: he will need to rebuild the broad coalition that returned him to power in 2022, including among younger voters who have shown less enthusiasm for his campaign.
paras.zh: 45 岁的博尔索纳罗承诺削减赤字，并与华盛顿重新调整该国的外交政策。结果表明，卢拉现在要做的不仅仅是捍卫自己的记录：他需要重建使他在 2022 年重新掌权的广泛联盟，其中包括对他的竞选表现出不那么热情的年轻选民。

paras.en: This year's presidential campaign featured smaller rallies compared to past years, perhaps because both of the candidates felt like known quantities to voters.
paras.zh: 与往年相比，今年的总统竞选活动集会规模较小，这或许是因为两位候选人都让选民觉得他们的人数已经众所周知。

paras.en: "I think the campaign feels more muted because people are tired of fighting," said 38-year-old nutritionist Raysa Tavares after she voted Sunday afternoon in the Rio de Janeiro favela of Vidigal.
paras.zh: 38 岁的营养师雷莎·塔瓦雷斯 (Raysa Tavares) 周日下午在里约热内卢维迪加尔贫民窟投票后表示：“我认为竞选活动感觉更加平静，因为人们厌倦了战斗。”

paras.en: Businessman Caio Farias, 37, who voted in Rio's upscale neighborhood of Leblon, said that he preferred other right-wing candidates to Bolsonaro, but voted for Bolsonaro in an effort to try to get the election over in one round.
paras.zh: 37岁的商人凯奥·法里亚斯(Caio Farias)在里约高档社区莱布隆(Leblon)投票，他表示，与博尔索纳罗相比，他更喜欢其他右翼候选人，但投票给博尔索纳罗是为了试图在一轮内完成选举。

paras.en: Now, Brazilians are gearing up for another three weeks of campaigning. In the 2022 election, the second round of the election saw a sharp uptick in political violence, with dozens of people physically attacking each other for political reasons, Brazilian news site Pública reported.
paras.zh: 现在，巴西人正在为另外三周的竞选活动做准备。据巴西新闻网站 Pública 报道，2022 年选举第二轮选举中政治暴力急剧增加，数十人出于政治原因互相攻击。

paras.en: Beyond the fact that this year's contest features a younger Bolsonaro, there's something else setting it apart from the last one: Trump is in the White House, with big ambitions for drawing politics in Latin America to the right. Lula has accused the United States of trying to meddle in Brazil's election, which the U.S. State Department has denied.
paras.zh: 除了今年的竞选主角是年轻的博索纳罗这一事实之外，今年的竞选还有一个与上届不同的地方：特朗普入主白宫，雄心勃勃地将拉丁美洲的政治拉向右翼。卢拉指责美国试图干预巴西选举，美国国务院对此予以否认。

paras.en: Bolsonaro rallies have featured American flags and a giant inflatable doll of Trump holding a jailed Lula, while Lula has campaigned on the idea of protecting Brazilian sovereignty from foreign interference—a rarely-heard watchword in 2022. In Rio on election day, voters could be seen on the streets both with Trump T-shirts and "out with Trump" stickers.
paras.zh: 博尔索纳罗的集会以美国国旗和抱着被监禁的卢拉的特朗普巨型充气娃娃为特色，而卢拉的竞选理念是保护巴西主权免受外国干涉——这是 2022 年很少听到的口号。在里约选举日，街上可以看到选民穿着特朗普 T 恤，贴着“与特朗普站在一起”的贴纸。

paras.en: The topic of Brazil's relationship with the United States is sure to feature in second-round campaigning, as are domestic themes of security policy, corruption, and the economy, which polls say are top of voters' minds.
paras.zh: 巴西与美国关系的话题肯定会成为第二轮竞选的重点，安全政策、腐败和经济等国内主题也是如此，民意调查显示这些是选民最关心的话题。

paras.en: But the first-round results have added another defining issue to the runoff: whether Brazil wants to continue with Lula or embrace the broader rightward shift that emerged from Sunday's vote.
paras.zh: 但第一轮结果给决选增加了另一个决定性问题：巴西是想继续支持卢拉，还是接受周日投票中出现的更广泛的右倾倾向。

articles.title: San Diego Padres blow late lead as star closer Mason Miller crumbles in brutal walk-off to Brewers

paras.en: The San Diego Padres carried strong momentum into October after winning 20 of 23 games to finish the regular season and sweeping the Chicago Cubs in the Wild Card round. That energy disappeared Sunday in Milwaukee. A 4-3 loss to the Brewers in Game 2 leaves the Padres trailing 2-0 in the National League Division Series and facing elimination.
paras.zh: 圣地亚哥教士队在 10 月份保持强劲势头，在常规赛 23 场比赛中赢下 20 场，并在外卡赛中横扫芝加哥小熊队。周日，这种能量在密尔​​沃基消失了。在第二场比赛中以 4-3 输给酿酒人队，教士队在全国联盟分区系列赛中以 2-0 落后并面临淘汰。

paras.en: San Diego built an early lead behind RBI plays from Ty France and Dustin Harris. Milwaukee answered on Sal Frelick's RBI single and a Padres fielding error to keep the score tight.
paras.zh: 圣地亚哥队在泰·弗朗斯和达斯汀·哈里斯的打点打点后建立了领先优势。密尔沃基队回应了萨尔·弗里利克的打点单打和教士队的防守失误，以保持比分紧缩。

paras.en: Padres manager Craig Stammen turned to All-Star closer Mason Miller for a six-out save. Miller worked a clean 12-pitch eighth inning, but his command collapsed in the ninth. Miller walked three batters to load the bases without giving up a hit, setting up Jackson Chourio’s walk-off two-run single.
paras.zh: 教士队主教练克雷格·斯塔曼求助于全明星终结者梅森·米勒，进行了六次出局的扑救。米勒在第八局打出了12球，但他的指挥在第九局崩溃了。米勒保送三名击球手上垒，没有放弃一安打，为杰克逊·乔里奥的保送两分安打奠定了基础。

paras.en: Miller was direct about his performance in the clubhouse after the game.
paras.zh: 赛后米勒直接谈到了他在俱乐部会所的表现。

paras.en: "Terrible," Miller said. "I didn't do my job today, so instead of being in here with a win and a series tie, we're in a hole, so it feels pretty bad."
paras.zh: “太糟糕了，”米勒说。 “我今天没有做好我的工作，所以我们不是带着胜利和系列赛平局来到这里，而是陷入了困境，所以感觉非常糟糕。”

paras.en: Miller pointed directly to his loss of control in the final frame.
paras.zh: 米勒直接指出他在最后一帧中失去了控制。

paras.en: "The cardinal rule is pretty much: You don't beat yourself. And I beat myself today," Miller said. "I mean, a base hit with nobody on doesn't win them the game. A base hit after you walk the bases loaded does."
paras.zh: “基本规则就是：你不要打败自己。而我今天打败了自己，”米勒说。 “我的意思是，无人上垒的情况下安打不会让他们赢得比赛。在你满垒跑垒后安打才可以。”

paras.en: Stammen defended using Miller for two innings.
paras.zh: 斯塔曼用米勒防守了两局。

paras.en: "Top of the lineup in the eighth probably made that decision for Mason," Stammen said. "Going into the game, we were thinking of Mason for six outs anyway, especially how quick the eighth inning went for him. He was just battling the strike zone there at the end."
paras.zh: “第八局的首发阵容可能为梅森做出了这个决定，”斯塔曼说。 “进入比赛时，无论如何，我们都在考虑梅森六次出局，特别是第八局对他来说有多快。他只是在最后与好球区作战。”

paras.en: The Padres locker room was all out of funk after the game, and for good reason. Coughing up a winnable playoff game on three unforced walks is an absolute gut punch.
paras.zh: 赛后，教士队的更衣室一片狼藉，这是有充分理由的。在一场可以获胜的季后赛比赛中，通过三次非受迫保送，绝对是一次重击。

paras.en: San Diego had World Series aspirations coming into October, but Milwaukee flexed a better killer instinct to tear them to shreds.
paras.zh: 圣地亚哥队在十月份有进入世界职业棒球大赛的渴望，但密尔沃基队展现出了更好的杀手本能，将他们撕成碎片。

paras.en: Game 3 is Tuesday at Petco Park. Down 2-0, San Diego must win three straight games to keep its season alive.
paras.zh: 第三场比赛将于周二在佩科公园举行。 0-2 落后的情况下，圣地亚哥队必须连胜三场才能保住赛季。

paras.en: Send us your thoughts: alejandro.avila@outkick.com / Follow along on X: @alejandroaveela
paras.zh: 将您的想法发送给我们：alejandro.avila@outkick.com / 关注 X：@alejandroaveela

articles.title: Tetairoa McMillan career day spoils Jared Goff's huge game as soft Lions defense flops on SNF

paras.en: Tetairoa McMillan put on a clinic, Bryce Young stayed hot and Dan Campbell’s defense folded in a 58-point track meet. And if you pegged Detroit for a drop-off this season, Sunday night gave you all the validation you needed.
paras.zh: 特泰罗亚·麦克米伦 (Tetairoa McMillan) 表现出色，布莱斯·杨 (Bryce Young) 保持火热状态，丹·坎贝尔 (Dan Campbell) 的防守在田径比赛中拿下 58 分。如果你认为底特律本赛季会下滑，那么周日晚上就给了你所需的所有验证。

paras.en: Featuring nearly 900 combined yards, Dan Campbell’s squad fell 32-26 to the Panthers in Carolina.
paras.zh: 丹·坎贝尔 (Dan Campbell) 的球队合计推进近 900 码，在卡罗莱纳州以 32-26 不敌黑豹队 (Panthers)。

paras.en: The Lions dropped to 2-2 after failing to keep pace with an offense that out-executed them when it mattered most.
paras.zh: 雄狮队在最关键的时刻未能跟上他们的进攻节奏，战绩跌至 2-2。

paras.en: Panthers top wideout Tetairoa McMillan tormented Detroit's secondary, more than living up to his first-round selection. The 6-foot-5 target hauled in 14 passes for 192 yards and two touchdowns. His clutch toe-tap catch on the sideline with under three minutes remaining kept the drive alive and iced the victory for Carolina.
paras.zh: 黑豹队的头号外接手特泰罗亚·麦克米伦（Tetairoa McMillan）折磨了底特律的二线球员，不仅仅是辜负了他在第一轮的选择。这位身高 6 英尺 5 英寸的目标完成 14 次传球，推进 192 码并两次达阵。在比赛还剩不到三分钟时，他在边线用脚尖接球，保持了进攻的活力，为卡罗莱纳队锁定了胜利。

paras.en: Bryce Young sliced through Detroit in Dave Canales' quick, play-action scheme, completing 29 of 41 passes for 329 yards and two scores.
paras.zh: 布莱斯·杨 (Bryce Young) 在戴夫·卡纳莱斯 (Dave Canales) 的快速战术中横扫底特律，41 次传球完成 29 次，推进 329 码，取得两分。

paras.en: Chuba Hubbard provided the hammer on the ground for Carolina, rushing 20 times for 122 yards and two touchdowns.
paras.zh: 丘巴·哈伯德 (Chuba Hubbard) 为卡罗莱纳队提供了场上的锤子，他冲球 20 次，推进 122 码并两次达阵。

paras.en: Carolina's core has clicked into place since last postseason's jab-for-jab loss to the Rams, establishing the Panthers as the team to beat in the NFC South.
paras.zh: 自从上赛季季后赛惨败给公羊队以来，卡罗莱纳队的核心已经就位，使黑豹队成为国联南部地区的必胜球队。

paras.en: Jared Goff threw for 412 yards and a touchdown on 32-of-52 passing, but the Lions stalled repeatedly inside the red zone and settled for four field goals before a late touchdown cut into the lead.
paras.zh: 贾里德·戈夫 (Jared Goff) 52 次传球 32 次传出 412 码并取得达阵，但雄狮队在红区内反复陷入停滞，最终取得 4 次射门得分，随后最后一次达阵取得领先。

paras.en: As the clock hit zero, Goff sat slumped on the bench.
paras.zh: 当时钟指向零时，戈夫瘫坐在板凳上。

paras.en: Dan Campbell’s brand for Detroit is built on physical dominance, but his defense got pushed around at Carolina's will.
paras.zh: 丹·坎贝尔在底特律的品牌是建立在身体优势之上的，但他的防守却被卡罗莱纳的意志所左右。

paras.en: Send us your thoughts: alejandro.avila@outkick.com / Follow along on X: @alejandroaveela
paras.zh: 将您的想法发送给我们：alejandro.avila@outkick.com / 关注 X：@alejandroaveela

articles.title: Dramatic footage shows alleged narco boat erupt in fireball during US military strike

paras.en: The U.S. military on Sunday announced a lethal strike on another vessel in the Caribbean carrying alleged narco-traffickers, killing four people on board.
paras.zh: 美国军方周日宣布对加勒比海另一艘涉嫌贩毒的船只进行致命袭击，造成船上四人死亡。

paras.en: The U.S. Southern Command said the vessel was traveling along "established narco-trafficking routes" in the Caribbean. The military shared a video that showed what appeared to be an explosion destroying a moving boat it described as a go-fast vessel.
paras.zh: 美国南方司令部表示，这艘船正沿着加勒比地区“既定的贩毒路线”行驶。军方分享了一段视频，视频显示爆炸摧毁了一艘移动的船只，据称这是一艘快速船只。

paras.en: "Under the direction of U.S. Southern Command, Joint Task Force Western Hemisphere executed a lethal, kinetic strike on a go-fast vessel operating along established narco-trafficking routes in the Caribbean," the military said in a statement.
paras.zh: 军方在一份声明中表示：“在美国南方司令部的指导下，西半球联合特遣部队对一艘沿着加勒比海既定毒品贩运路线航行的快速船只进行了致命的动能打击。”

paras.en: Southern Command claimed that intelligence revealed the vessel's "active involvement in narco-trafficking." The military did not provide evidence to back up this allegation.
paras.zh: 南方司令部声称，情报显示该船“积极参与毒品贩运”。军方没有提供证据支持这一指控。

paras.en: "The operation killed four narco-terrorists," the statement added.
paras.zh: 声明补充说：“这次行动杀死了四名毒品恐怖分子。”

paras.en: This is the latest attack that the Trump administration has argued was launched in an attempt to eliminate alleged narco-terrorists, with the death toll in these strikes carried out since September 2025 sitting at more than 235.
paras.zh: 这是特朗普政府声称发起的最新一次袭击是为了消灭所谓的毒品恐怖分子，自 2025 年 9 月以来这些袭击造成的死亡人数已超过 235 人。

paras.en: The Pentagon has refused to release the identities of those killed in the strikes since last year. It has also refused to provide evidence of drugs on board.
paras.zh: 自去年以来，五角大楼一直拒绝公布在袭击中丧生的人的身份。它还拒绝提供船上有毒品的证据。

paras.en: The administration has been scrutinized in the past year by Democrats and even some Republicans, including Sen. Rand Paul, R-Ky., who has raised concerns about killing people without due process and the possibility of killing innocent people.
paras.zh: 去年，政府受到了民主党甚至一些共和党人的审查，其中包括肯塔基州共和党参议员兰德·保罗，他对未经正当程序杀人以及可能杀害无辜者表示担忧。

paras.en: The attacks have also been denounced by human rights groups as "extrajudicial killings."
paras.zh: 这些袭击事件也被人权组织谴责为“法外处决”。

paras.en: The administration is pursuing deals with allied nations to extend its military attacks to land in multiple Latin American countries. Pentagon chief Pete Hegseth said during a visit to Panama in August that Colombia, Guatemala and Honduras had agreed to allow the U.S. to carry out joint military operations against criminal groups on their soil, although Guatemala denied reaching a deal.
paras.zh: 政府正在寻求与盟国达成协议，将军事攻击范围扩大到多个拉丁美洲国家。五角大楼负责人皮特·赫格斯8月访问巴拿马时表示，哥伦比亚、危地马拉和洪都拉斯已同意美国在其领土上对犯罪团伙开展联合军事行动，但危地马拉否认达成协议。

paras.en: Ecuador launched similar operations with the U.S. in March.
paras.zh: 厄瓜多尔三月份与美国启动了类似的行动。

paras.en: The Associated Press contributed to this report.
paras.zh: 美联社对此报道作出了贡献。

articles.title: Authorities issue shark warning over whale that swam 11km upstream in Clarence River and later died
articles.author: Petra Stock

paras.en: While the case of a whale found 11km upstream in a New South Wales river this weekend was unusual, it was not unprecedented, experts say.
paras.zh: 专家表示，虽然本周末在新南威尔士州一条河流上游 11 公里处发现一头鲸鱼的情况并不寻常，但这并非史无前例。

paras.en: The juvenile humpback, which swam into the Clarence River on the state’s mid-north coast and later died, was towed out to sea on Sunday, according to NSW authorities.
paras.zh: 据新南威尔士州当局称，这只幼年座头鲸游进了该州中北部海岸的克拉伦斯河，后来死亡，并于周日被拖出海。

paras.en: Members of the public first reported a sick whale swimming into the river near Bundjalung national park on Saturday afternoon. “The whale subsequently swam on to a sandbar and became grounded in shallow water, and within 30 minutes observers indicated the whale had died,” a spokesperson for NSW National Parks and Wildlife Service said.
paras.zh: 周六下午，公众首次报告称一头病鲸游入本加隆国家公园附近的河流中。新南威尔士州国家公园和野生动物管理局发言人表示：“这头鲸鱼随后游到了沙洲上，并搁浅在浅水中，30 分钟内观察者就发现这头鲸鱼已经死亡。”

paras.en: Increased shark activity in the surrounding area had been reported, with beachgoers advised to avoid surfing, swimming, or diving at surrounding beaches, SharkSmart NSW said in a post to social media.
paras.zh: SharkSmart NSW 在社交媒体上发帖称，据报道，周边地区的鲨鱼活动有所增加，建议海滩游客避免在周边海滩冲浪、游泳或潜水。

paras.en: Whale scientist Dr Vanessa Pirotta said while the circumstances were rare, whales were known to explore rivers and estuaries from “time to time”. This could be the result of “misadventure” or “curiosity”, or due to ill health, as appeared likely for the animal in Clarence River, which looked “extremely unwell”.
paras.zh: 鲸鱼科学家凡妮莎·皮罗塔博士表示，虽然这种情况很少见，但众所周知，鲸鱼会“时不时”探索河流和河口。这可能是“意外事故”或“好奇心”的结果，也可能是由于健康状况不佳造成的，就像克拉伦斯河中的动物看起来“非常不适”一样。

paras.en: Most whales wouldn’t be aiming for the river at this time of year, she said. “Right now the main bulk of the east and the west coast populations are heading south to Antarctica. They’re on their way back for their summertime extended Christmas dinner where they’ll be going to Antarctica to feed on krill.”
paras.zh: 她说，每年的这个时候，大多数鲸鱼不会瞄准河流。 “目前，东海岸和西海岸的大部分人口正在向南前往南极洲。他们正在返回夏季延长圣诞晚餐的途中，在那里他们将前往南极洲以磷虾为食。”

paras.en: Earlier this year, in April, another whale became stranded on a sandbar in Wallis Lake on the NSW coast after swimming under the Forster Tuncurry Bridge.
paras.zh: 今年四月初，另一头鲸鱼在福斯特坦卡里大桥下游过后，搁浅在新南威尔士州海岸沃利斯湖的沙洲上。

paras.en: Last year, two humpbacks swam under Melbourne’s West Gate Bridge and into the mouth of the Yarra River.
paras.zh: 去年，两只座头鲸从墨尔本西门大桥下游进亚拉河河口。

paras.en: In 2020, three humpback whales entered the East Alligator River in Kakadu national park, with one travelling 30km upstream. All three eventually made their way back out to sea.
paras.zh: 2020年，三头座头鲸进入卡卡杜国家公园的东鳄河，其中一头向上游游了30公里。三个人最终都回到了大海。

paras.en: While these air-breathing mammals could survive in freshwater environments, it probably wasn’t good for their skin, Pirotta said. Anyone spotting a whale in an unusual location such as a river, or an animal that appeared to be in distress, should alert environmental authorities, she said.
paras.zh: 皮罗塔说，虽然这些呼吸空气的哺乳动物可以在淡水环境中生存，但这可能对它们的皮肤不利。她说，任何人在河流等不寻常的地方发现鲸鱼，或者发现似乎陷入困境的动物，都应该向环境部门发出警报。

paras.en: A spokesperson for Orrca, the cetacean rescue organisation, said while it was unusual for a whale to travel several kilometres into a river system, it was not unprecedented. “Humpback whales regularly travel close to the NSW coastline and may enter bays, harbours and estuarine environments temporarily during their annual migration.”
paras.zh: 鲸类救援组织 Orrca 的发言人表示，虽然鲸鱼进入河流系统数公里的情况并不常见，但这并非史无前例。 “座头鲸经常在新南威尔士州海岸线附近游动，并可能在每年的迁徙过程中暂时进入海湾、港口和河口环境。”

paras.en: Based on the large number of barnacles and other organisms on its skin, the juvenile in the Clarence River could have been experiencing a chronic illness, injury or another underlying health issue, the spokesperson said. “However, the cause of death cannot be determined from imagery alone,” they noted.
paras.zh: 发言人说，根据其皮肤上大量的藤壶和其他生物，克拉伦斯河中的幼鱼可能患有慢性疾病、受伤或其他潜在的健康问题。 “然而，仅凭图像无法确定死因，”他们指出。

paras.en: “Each year, approximately 50,000 humpback whales migrate along Australia’s east coast. Across a population of this size, it is unfortunately not uncommon for a small proportion of animals to be observed in poor body condition or displaying other signs of illness, injury or compromised health.”
paras.zh: “每年，大约有 50,000 头座头鲸沿着澳大利亚东海岸迁徙。不幸的是，在如此规模的种群中，一小部分动物的身体状况不佳或表现出其他疾病、受伤或健康受损的迹象并不罕见。”

paras.en: The unusual event occurred less than a week after a humpback whale carcass washed ashore at Perth city beach, attracting multiple sharks before the body was removed on Thursday.
paras.zh: 这一不寻常的事件发生在珀斯城市海滩上一头座头鲸尸体被冲上岸后不到一周，吸引了多只鲨鱼，尸体于周四被移走。

paras.en: “As with any deceased marine animal, people should avoid entering the water close to the location of the whale carcass, including surrounding beaches, and follow any local warnings or closures that may be in place. Whale carcasses can attract scavengers, including sharks,” the Orrca spokesperson said.
paras.zh: “与任何死去的海洋动物一样，人们应该避免进入靠近鲸鱼尸体位置的水域，包括周围的海滩，并遵守当地可能发布的任何警告或关闭规定。鲸鱼尸体可能会吸引包括鲨鱼在内的食腐动物，”奥尔卡发言人说。

articles.title: California woman arrested and accused of spying on Taiwan president’s son for China
articles.author: Reuters

paras.en: US authorities arrested a California woman on Sunday, accusing her of spying on the son of Taiwan’s president at the behest of Chinese officials, the FBI said.
paras.zh: 美国联邦调查局称，美国当局周日逮捕了一名加州妇女，指控她应中国官员的要求对台湾总统的儿子进行间谍活动。

paras.en: The FBI arrested Wanying Zhang, also known as Heather, at Los Angeles International Airport on Sunday before her planned departure to China, the agency said in a statement. Authorities charged Zhang, 34, of Irvine, California, with acting as an unregistered foreign agent.
paras.zh: 联邦调查局在一份声明中表示，周日，张婉莹（又名希瑟）在计划前往中国之前在洛杉矶国际机场逮捕了她。当局指控 34 岁的张某（来自加利福尼亚州欧文市）担任未注册的外国代理人。

paras.en: Zhang surveilled a son of Taiwanese President Lai Ching-te, the FBI alleged. The agency did not directly name Zhang’s alleged target, but later shared a New York Post report identifying him as Lai Ting-yu, a US resident.
paras.zh: 美国联邦调查局称，张监视了台湾总统赖清德的儿子。该机构没有直接透露张所谓的目标，但后来分享了《纽约邮报》的一篇报道，称他是美国居民赖廷宇。

paras.en: Taiwan’s presidential office described Zhang’s alleged actions as a “typical case of transnational repression” and thanked the US government for protecting Taiwanese citizens.
paras.zh: 台湾总统府将张的指控行为描述为“跨国镇压的典型案例”，并感谢美国政府保护台湾公民。

paras.en: “Our country expresses the strongest condemnation of such barbaric conduct that disregards human rights and the sovereignty of nations,” spokesperson Karen Kuo said in a statement.
paras.zh: 发言人郭在一份声明中表示：“我国对这种无视人权和国家主权的野蛮行为表示最强烈的谴责。”

paras.en: China’s foreign ministry did not respond to a request for comment.
paras.zh: 中国外交部没有回应置评请求。

paras.en: The Justice Department alleged Zhang travelled to Seattle in 2025 at the direction of Chinese officials and sent them photos, video and licence plate information of the Taiwanese president’s son and his family.
paras.zh: 司法部称，张于 2025 年在中国官员的指示下前往西雅图，并向他们发送了台湾总统儿子及其家人的照片、视频和车牌信息。

paras.en: Zhang used tradecraft to avoid detection and never notified Washington that she was acting for a foreign government, Bill Essayli, the first assistant US attorney for the Central District of California, alleged in a statement.
paras.zh: 加州中区第一助理美国检察官比尔·埃赛利 (Bill Essayli) 在一份声明中称，张利用间谍手段来避免被发现，并且从未通知华盛顿她正在为外国政府行事。

paras.en: It was not immediately clear whether Zhang had a defence attorney. She will appear on Monday in a Los Angeles federal court, Essayli said.
paras.zh: 目前尚不清楚张是否有辩护律师。埃萨利说，她将于周一在洛杉矶联邦法院出庭。

paras.en: Lai and his Democratic Progressive Party champion Taiwan’s separate identity from China, a position that frequently angers Beijing, which views the island as Chinese territory. Lai says only Taiwan’s people can decide their future.
paras.zh: 赖清德和他的民进党主张台湾与中国的独立地位，这一立场经常激怒北京，因为北京将台湾视为中国领土。赖表示，只有台湾人民才能决定自己的未来。

paras.en: Washington does not have formal diplomatic ties with Taiwan, but the US is the island’s most important international backer and weapons supplier.
paras.zh: 华盛顿与台湾没有正式外交关系，但美国是台湾最重要的国际支持者和武器供应商。

articles.title: Alleged flydubai attacker left Australia without finishing engineering course, university says
articles.author: Nino Bucci and Adeshola Ore

paras.en: An Australian university has confirmed a flydubai co-pilot who allegedly tried to hijack an Israel-bound flight studied at its Melbourne campus, but left before completing his qualification.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚一所大学证实，迪拜航空的一名副驾驶涉嫌在墨尔本校区学习期间试图劫持一架飞往以色列的航班，但在获得资格之前就离开了。

paras.en: Disaster was narrowly averted on 30 September when passengers and crew intervened to stop the alleged attempt of the co-pilot, identified by media outlets as Hammam al-Hammami, to take control of a flight to Tel Aviv with 182 people onboard.
paras.zh: 9 月 30 日，乘客和机组人员进行干预，阻止副驾驶（媒体称其为 Hammam al-Hammami）试图控制飞往特拉维夫的航班，机上载有 182 人，灾难才得以避免。

paras.en: The United Arab Emirates’ prosecutor general said the co-pilot allegedly used a crash axe in the attempted “terrorist attack”, in which the pilot was stabbed mid-air. Numerous media outlets have named the co-pilot al-Hammami, an Omani national.
paras.zh: 阿拉伯联合酋长国总检察长表示，副飞行员据称在未遂的“恐怖袭击”中使用了一把坠毁斧，飞行员在半空中被刺伤。许多媒体都提到了副驾驶哈马米（al-Hammami）的名字，他是阿曼人。

paras.en: On Monday, the RMIT university in Melbourne said in a statement that it “is aware of media reporting of a former student alleged to be involved in the Flydubai flight incident”.
paras.zh: 周一，墨尔本皇家墨尔本理工大学在一份声明中表示，“了解媒体报道一名涉嫌卷入迪拜航空航班事件的前学生”。

paras.en: “The individual was enrolled at RMIT but did not successfully complete an engineering qualification,” the university
paras.zh: “此人已就读于皇家墨尔本理工大学，但没有成功完成工程学资格，”该大学

paras.en: “As this is an ongoing investigation, the University is unable to provide further comment.”
paras.zh: “由于这是一项正在进行的调查，大学无法提供进一步的评论。”

paras.en: Former RMIT engineering students contacted by Guardian Australia said they did not remember al-Hammami.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚卫报联系的前皇家墨尔本理工大学工程系学生表示，他们不记得哈马米。

paras.en: RMIT university’s confirmation came after the Australian federal police (AFP) on Sunday said agencies were investigating the man’s time in the country.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚联邦警察（法新社）周日表示，各机构正在调查该男子在该国的时间，随后皇家墨尔本理工大学做出了这一确认。

paras.en: A source familiar with the case, but not authorised to speak publicly, has said the man was granted an Australian student visa in 2014, before arriving in the country to commence a university course the next year.
paras.zh: 一位熟悉此案但未获授权公开发言的消息人士表示，该男子于 2014 年获得澳大利亚学生签证，并于次年抵达该国开始大学课程。

paras.en: He left Australia in 2017, and his visa was cancelled in 2019 after authorities confirmed he was no longer enrolled in the course, the source said.
paras.zh: 消息人士称，他于 2017 年离开澳大利亚，当局确认他不再参加该课程后，他的签证于 2019 年被取消。

paras.en: The AFP on Sunday said multiple agencies – including the Australian Security Intelligence Organisation (Asio) – were probing the man’s connections to the country.
paras.zh: 法新社周日表示，包括澳大利亚安全情报组织（Asio）在内的多个机构正在调查该男子与该国的联系。

paras.en: “The Victorian Joint Counter Terrorism Team (VIC JCTT), comprising the AFP, Victoria Police and ASIO, can confirm it is investigating the man’s links to Australia,” an AFP spokesperson said.
paras.zh: 法新社发言人表示：“由法新社、维州警方和澳大利亚情报组织组成的维州联合反恐小组（VIC JCTT）可以证实正在调查该男子与澳大利亚的联系。”

paras.en: “An update will be provided at an appropriate time.”
paras.zh: “将在适当的时候提供更新。”

paras.en: Court records and previous media reporting show that a number of Australians charged with terror offences or suspected of Islamic extremism studied at RMIT around the same time as al-Hammami, but there was no indication he knew any of these individuals.
paras.zh: 法庭记录和之前的媒体报道显示，一些被指控犯有恐怖罪行或涉嫌伊斯兰极端主义的澳大利亚人与哈马米大约同时在皇家墨尔本理工大学学习，但没有迹象表明他认识这些人中的任何人。

paras.en: A British university, Buckinghamshire New University, has confirmed a student named Hamam al-Hammami had “previously completed a distance-learning course in aviation management”. It added: “He did not undertake any pilot training at the university.”
paras.zh: 英国白金汉郡新大学证实，一名名叫哈马姆·哈马米的学生“之前完成了航空管理的远程学习课程”。它补充说：“他没有在大学接受任何飞行员培训。”

paras.en: A flydubai spokesperson on Saturday said the circumstances surrounding the incident were still under investigation and the airline was not in a position to comment further.
paras.zh: 迪拜航空发言人周六表示，事件相关情况仍在调查中，该航空公司无法进一步置评。

paras.en: The airline’s flights between Dubai and Tel Aviv were suspended after the attack. The Omani co-pilot and the flight’s Indian captain, Smit Machchhar, were taken to the UAE, as it leads the investigation. Officials have said a number of countries including Israel are participating.
paras.zh: 袭击发生后，该航空公司往返迪拜和特拉维夫的航班暂停。阿曼副驾驶和该航班的印度机长斯密特·马赫恰尔 (Smit Macchhar) 被带到阿联酋，由阿联酋领导调查。官员们表示，包括以色列在内的许多国家都参与其中。

paras.en: The Wall Street Journal has reported that the co-pilot had been barred from flying by Oman over concerns he had adopted extremist views. He was then moved to an administrative job at Oman Air, according to the official, before being hired by the UAE-based budget airline flydubai.
paras.zh: 据《华尔街日报》报道，由于担心副机长采纳极端主义观点，阿曼已禁止该副机长乘坐飞机。据该官员称，随后他被调往阿曼航空担任行政职务，之后被阿联酋廉价航空公司迪拜航空聘用。

articles.title: Watch: How Brazil's dramatic election unfolded

paras.en: Watch: How Brazil's dramatic election unfolded
paras.zh: 观看：巴西戏剧性的选举如何展开

paras.en: Millions of Brazilians took to the polls on Sunday for the first round of the country's presidential elections.
paras.zh: 周日，数百万巴西人参加了该国第一轮总统选举的投票。

paras.en: President Luiz InÃ¡cio Lula da Silva, 80, is running for his fourth non-consecutive term in office, while his challenger, right-winger FlÃ¡vio Bolsonaro, 45, is competing in his first presidential race.
paras.zh: 80 岁的总统路易斯·伊纳西奥·卢拉·达席尔瓦正在竞选他的第四个非连续任期，而他的挑战者、45 岁的右翼人物弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗正在参加他的第一次总统竞选。

paras.en: His father, former President Jair Bolsonaro, governed Brazil from 2019 to 2022.
paras.zh: 他的父亲、前总统雅伊尔·博尔索纳罗 (Jair Bolsonaro) 于 2019 年至 2022 年执政巴西。

paras.en: With the election now heading to a run-off on 25 October, BBC correspondent Ione Wells unpacks the results.
paras.zh: 随着选举即将于 10 月 25 日进行决选，BBC 记者艾恩·威尔斯 (Ione Wells) 揭晓了结果。

articles.title: US air force removes all bombers from British military base RAF Fairford

paras.en: The US has withdrawn all of its bombers from RAF Fairford, the UK military base at the centre of an incident being investigated by counter terror police.
paras.zh: 美国已从英国皇家空军费尔福德军事基地撤回了所有轰炸机，该基地是反恐警察正在调查的事件中心。

paras.en: A statement from a Pentagon official confirmed on Sunday it had removed its bombers - thought to be about a dozen B-1s - from the base back to their home stations in America.
paras.zh: 五角大楼官员周日发表声明证实，五角大楼已将轰炸机（据信大约有十几架 B-1）从基地移回美国本土基地。

paras.en: The US did not give a reason for the withdrawal, but it follows a major incident on 27 September when police were alerted to three "suspicious vehicles" near the airbase.
paras.zh: 美国没有给出撤军的理由，但此前9月27日发生了一起重大事件，当时警方接到警报称空军基地附近有三辆“可疑车辆”。

paras.en: Five men were initially arrested on suspicion of terror offences near the base and subsequently released on bail. A sixth man, a UK-Iranian national, was also later arrested and released on bail.
paras.zh: 五名男子最初因涉嫌在基地附近实施恐怖犯罪而被捕，随后被保释。第六名男子是一名英国伊朗公民，后来也被捕并被保释。

paras.en: Whitehall sources have not disputed the decision from Washington was in response to the incident at the airbase in Gloucestershire.
paras.zh: 白厅消息人士并没有否认华盛顿的决定是对格洛斯特郡空军基地事件的回应。

paras.en: The BBC has also been told it was a military rather than a political decision - taken at an operational level - and communicated from the US military to its British counterparts.
paras.zh: 英国广播公司还被告知，这是一项军事决定，而非政治决定，是在行动层面做出的，并由美国军方传达给英国同行。

paras.en: The UK's Ministry of Defence has not commented.
paras.zh: 英国国防部尚未发表评论。

paras.en: Tracking websites showed B-1 bombers flying out of RAF Fairford on Sunday.
paras.zh: 跟踪网站显示 B-1 轰炸机周日从英国皇家空军费尔福德起飞。

paras.en: Days after the incident at RAF Fairford, Prime Minister Andy Burnham said there were "strong indications" that Iran had played a part in the incident but did not provide further details. Tehran has strongly denied any involvement.
paras.zh: 英国皇家空军费尔福德事件发生几天后，英国首相安迪·伯纳姆表示，有“强烈迹象”表明伊朗参与了该事件，但没有提供进一步的细节。德黑兰强烈否认有任何参与。

paras.en: Initially, five men aged between 23 and 25 were arrested in the early hours of the morning after vehicles were reported to be travelling towards the base operated by the US Air Force (USAF). All five were UK nationals from London.
paras.zh: 最初，五名年龄在 23 至 25 岁之间的男子在凌晨被捕，原因是据报道有车辆驶向美国空军 (USAF) 运营的基地。这五人都是来自伦敦的英国国民。

paras.en: They were arrested on suspicion of explosives offences and later on suspicion of preparing a terrorist act, before being released on bail in what police called an "investigative decision" that was "grounded in experience and strategy".
paras.zh: 他们因涉嫌爆炸罪被捕，后来因涉嫌准备恐怖行为而被捕，随后被保释，警方称这是“基于经验和策略”的“调查决定”。

paras.en: The sixth man, aged 25, was arrested in London on Thursday on suspicion of preparation of terrorist acts. Counter terror police confirmed on Saturday he had also been released on bail.
paras.zh: 第六名男子，25 岁​​，周四在伦敦因涉嫌准备恐怖活动而被捕。反恐警方周六证实，他也已被保释。

paras.en: RAF Fairford has been used as a forward operating location by the US Air Force (USAF) for decades.
paras.zh: 几十年来，英国皇家空军费尔福德基地一直被美国空军 (USAF) 用作前沿作战地点。

paras.en: In recent months, the US has flown B-1 and B-52 bombers from the base for the Middle East, after the UK approved a US request to use it for defensive strikes on Iran.
paras.zh: 近几个月来，在英国批准美国使用 B-1 和 B-52 轰炸机对伊朗进行防御性打击后，美国已从该基地向中东派遣了 B-1 和 B-52 轰炸机。

paras.en: In July, Iran said "any base used for aggression against Iranian territory constitutes a legitimate target for our forces".
paras.zh: 7月，伊朗表示“任何用于侵略伊朗领土的基地都构成我们军队的合法目标”。

paras.en: Days after the incident, and before the arrest of the sixth man, US Secretary of State Marco Rubio said on Fox News that it "clearly involve[d] the hands of a foreign actor".
paras.zh: 事件发生几天后，第六人被捕之前，美国国务卿马可·卢比奥在福克斯新闻上表示，这“显然涉及外国演员之手”。

paras.en: Rubio did not provide further details - saying at the time he was limited on what he could say on air.
paras.zh: 卢比奥没有提供更多细节，他表示当时他在直播中能说的话受到限制。

paras.en: US President Donald Trump separately said he was "surprised" the five men had been released on bail.
paras.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普另外表示，他对这五人被保释感到“惊讶”。

paras.en: "We know everything about them, we would not have released them," he said, adding that the UK had worked with the US "very closely" on this.
paras.zh: 他说：“我们知道有关他们的一切，我们不会释放他们。”他补充说，英国在这方面与美国“非常密切”地合作。

paras.en: Many B-1 bombers flown from the UK were armed with precision-guided "bunker busting" bombs, with thicker casings to penetrate hardened or buried targets such as weapons stores.
paras.zh: 许多从英国起飞的 B-1 轰炸机都配备了精确制导的“掩体破坏”炸弹，这些炸弹具有较厚的外壳，可以穿透坚固或掩埋的目标，例如武器库。

paras.en: They also carried air-to-surface missiles used against more heavily defended targets deeper inside Iran.
paras.zh: 它们还携带空对地导弹，用于打击伊朗境内防御更严密的目标。

paras.en: Each bombing mission, depending on the location of the target, would likely have taken around 12 to 15 hours in total there and back, with air-to-air refuelling both ways.
paras.zh: 每次轰炸任务，根据目标的位置，来回总共可能需要大约 12 到 15 个小时，并且双向进行空中加油。

paras.en: The Pentagon has stressed its bombing aircraft remain able to conduct missions "anywhere, anytime", including through "operations that launch and recover from the continental United States".
paras.zh: 五角大楼强调，其轰炸机仍然能够“随时随地”执行任务，包括通过“从美国大陆发射和回收的行动”。

paras.en: Additional reporting by Chris Partridge.
paras.zh: 克里斯·帕特里奇的补充报道。

articles.title: Supporters of jailed ex-PM Imran Khan march to Pakistan capital

paras.en: Thousands of supporters of Pakistan's jailed ex-prime minister Imran Khan are marching to the capital Islamabad as they call for his release.
paras.zh: 巴基斯坦被监禁的前总理伊姆兰·汗的数千名支持者正在向首都伊斯兰堡游行，要求释放他。

paras.en: Concerns over the 73-year-old's health have grown louder in recent months. His family claims he has lost most of his vision in his right eye after prison authorities failed to take action.
paras.zh: 近几个月来，人们对这位 73 岁老人健康状况的担忧日益强烈。他的家人声称，由于监狱当局未能采取行动，他的右眼大部分视力都丧失了。

paras.en: The cricket star-turned-politician, who faces charges in more than 100 cases, was jailed for 17 years over corruption last year. Khan said all the cases against him are politically motivated.
paras.zh: 这位板球明星转型为政治家，面临 100 多起案件的指控，去年因腐败被判入狱 17 年。汗表示，所有针对他的案件都是出于政治动机。

paras.en: Even behind bars, he remains a force in Pakistani politics, and demonstrations in support for him have led to deadly violence and crackdowns in the past.
paras.zh: 即使身陷囹圄，他仍然是巴基斯坦政坛的一股力量，支持他的示威活动过去曾导致致命的暴力和镇压。

paras.en: Sunday's march, which began in Lakki Marwat, a city 275km away from Islamabad, had paused for the night and is expected to resume around midday local time on Monday.
paras.zh: 周日的游行从距伊斯兰堡 275 公里的拉基马尔瓦特市开始，游行暂停了一晚，预计将于当地时间周一中午恢复。

paras.en: Originally scheduled for last week, it was postponed to allow for talks between the government and Khan's Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf (PTI) party but the talks ended in a deadlock.
paras.zh: 原定于上周举行的会议被推迟，以便政府与汗领导的巴基斯坦正义运动党（PTI）进行会谈，但会谈陷入僵局。

paras.en: Khan, who faces charges ranging from leaking state secrets to selling state gifts, was first imprisoned in August 2023. His wife Bushra Bibi was jailed along with him last year.
paras.zh: 汗面临泄露国家机密和出售国家礼品等多项指控，他于 2023 年 8 月首次入狱。他的妻子布什拉·比比 (Bushra Bibi) 去年与他一起入狱。

paras.en: Sohail Afridi, chief minister for Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province ruled by PTI, expects that the march will make its way to a town about 80km (50 miles) west of Islamabad by Thursday.
paras.zh: PTI 管辖的开伯尔-普赫图赫瓦省首席部长苏海尔·阿夫里迪 (Sohail Afridi) 预计，游行将于周四抵达伊斯兰堡以西约 80 公里（50 英里）的一个城镇。

paras.en: "[By then] this movement will have reached every corner of the country and every square will have become a centre of activity," he said on Sunday, urging the people to "play an active role in the political process".
paras.zh: 他周日表示，“到那时，这场运动将遍及全国每一个角落，每个广场都将成为活动中心”，并敦促人民“在政治进程中发挥积极作用”。

paras.en: Authorities in Islamabad have stacked up shipping containers to block key access routes to the capital city.
paras.zh: 伊斯兰堡当局堆积了集装箱，封锁了通往首都的主要通道。

paras.en: The PTI said talks with government failed because authorities rejected the party's request for access to Khan so that its leaders could consult him on national and political issues.
paras.zh: PTI表示，与政府的谈判失败，因为当局拒绝了该党与汗接触的请求，以便其领导人就国家和政治问题咨询他。

paras.en: The party also said it had demanded that Khan be given an immediate medical examination and treatment.
paras.zh: 该党还表示，已要求立即对汗进行医疗检查和治疗。

paras.en: Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi meanwhile accused Afridi of "sabotaging" negotiations, saying the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa government had backed out of earlier commitments on counter-terrorism issues, according to Pakistan's local media reports.
paras.zh: 据巴基斯坦当地媒体报道，内政部长穆赫辛·纳克维同时指责阿夫里迪“破坏”谈判，称开伯尔-普赫图赫瓦省政府背弃了早先在反恐问题上的承诺。

paras.en: In August, Khan was briefly transferred from jail to a state-run hospital for medical examination and treatment following complaints about his deteriorating health. The doctors later deemed him "medically fit".
paras.zh: 八月，在接到有关汗健康状况恶化的投诉后，汗被短暂从监狱转移到一家公立医院接受医疗检查和治疗。医生后来认为他“身体健康”。

paras.en: The intervention was the most significant relief Khan has received from the courts since he was imprisoned in 2023 on corruption charges, which he says were politically motivated.
paras.zh: 这次干预是汗自 2023 年因腐败指控入狱以来从法院获得的最重大救济，他表示腐败指控是出于政治动机。

paras.en: Khan's family and the PTI, however, criticised the authorities for defying a court order that he be examined by physicians at a specific private hospital.
paras.zh: 然而，汗的家人和 PTI 批评当局无视法院命令，要求他在一家特定的私人医院接受医生的检查。

paras.en: On 20 September, Khan's sister Aleema Khanum was arrested in the eastern city of Lahore.
paras.zh: 9月20日，汗的妹妹阿莉玛·哈努姆在东部城市拉合尔被捕。

paras.en: The arrest order said Khanum had been mobilising people to "create law and order situations" and "raising/chanting objectionable slogans amongst the general public against the Government".
paras.zh: 逮捕令称，卡努姆一直在动员人们“创造法律和秩序局势”并“在公众中提出/高喊反对政府的令人反感的口号”。

paras.en: Khan, who previously captained the Pakistan national cricket team, served as the country's prime minister from 2018 to 2022.
paras.zh: 汗曾担任巴基斯坦国家板球队队长，并于 2018 年至 2022 年担任该国总理。

paras.en: His arrest in May 2023 sparked large-scale, violent protests by supporters, who ransacked the corps commander's residence in Lahore, smashing chandeliers and making away with furniture, paintings, and even peacocks, among other things.
paras.zh: 他于 2023 年 5 月被捕，引发了支持者的大规模暴力抗议，他们洗劫了这位军团指挥官在拉合尔的住所，砸碎了枝形吊灯，抢走了家具、画作，甚至孔雀等物品。

paras.en: At least eight people died in the protests and the army had to be called in to quell the violence.
paras.zh: 抗议活动中至少有八人死亡，不得不出动军队平息暴力。

paras.en: Former international cricket captains have made several appeals in recent months to Pakistan's Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif urging Khan be accorded proper medical care.

articles.title: Ed Sheeran Taps Former Fray Singer Isaac Slade as Atlanta Opener After Macklemore Dropped, Support Acts Quit
articles.author: Mitchell Peters

paras.en: Ed Sheeran enlisted a familiar face as a surprise opener for his Loop Tour stop in Atlanta.
paras.zh: 艾德·希兰 (Ed Sheeran) 邀请了一位熟悉的面孔作为他在亚特兰大的环游赛站的惊喜开场曲。

paras.en: During his Saturday (Oct. 3) concert at Mercedes-Benz Stadium, the English singer-songwriter welcomed Isaac Slade, the former frontman of The Fray, as a special guest to perform an abbreviated set before Sheeran took the stage.
paras.zh: 周六（10 月 3 日）在梅赛德斯-奔驰体育场举行的音乐会上，这位英国歌手兼作曲家迎来了 The Fray 前主唱艾萨克·斯莱德 (Isaac Slade) 作为特邀嘉宾，在希兰登台之前表演了一段简短的演出。

paras.en: Slade performed The Fray’s “How to Save a Life” and “You Found Me” while also addressing the war in Gaza and urging the audience to seek common ground amid the polarization surrounding the conflict.
paras.zh: 斯莱德表演了 The Fray 的《How to Save a Life》和《You Found Me》，同时还谈到了加沙战争，并敦促观众在围绕冲突的两极分化中寻求共同点。

paras.en: “Everybody seems to be taking sides in this world and that’s good,” Slade told the crowd in fan-captured video. “What’s happening over there [in Gaza] is wrong but if we’re going to get through it, we’re going to need people to step into that middle place, that common ground.”
paras.zh: “这个世界上每个人似乎都站在一边，这很好，”斯莱德在粉丝拍摄的视频中告诉观众。 “（加沙）那里发生的事情是错误的，但如果我们要渡过难关，我们就需要人们进入那个中间位置，那个共同点。”

paras.en: The singer continued, “That bonfire in the middle of the field that sees both sides, that understands that peace is not a lack of conflict. Peace is not a blank canvas that we need to guard and be polite.”
paras.zh: 这位歌手继续说道：“场中央的篝火可以看到双方，它明白和平并不缺乏冲突。和平不是我们需要守护和保持礼貌的空白画布。”

paras.en: “[Peace] holds enough beauty, enough tragedy, enough sorrow, enough joy and life if we learn how to integrate it and hold each other in balance. We will find a way through this together,” he added.
paras.zh: “如果我们学会如何整合并保持彼此平衡，[和平]就拥有足够的美丽、足够的悲剧、足够的悲伤、足够的欢乐和生命。我们将共同找到解决这个问题的方法，”他补充道。

paras.en: Slade’s appearance came amid the fallout from the removal of Sheeran’s previous opening act Macklemore from the U.S. leg of the tour. The “Thrift Shop” rapper took the stage at Sheeran’s Sept. 4 and 5 shows at New Jersey’s MetLife Stadium, where he performed “Hind’s Hall” and called for a “Free Palestine.”
paras.zh: 斯莱德的出现正值希兰之前的开场表演麦克莫尔从美国巡演中被取消的影响之际。这位“Thrift Shop”说唱歌手于 9 月 4 日和 5 日登上了希兰在新泽西州大都会人寿体育场举行的演出，在那里他表演了“Hind’s Hall”并呼吁“自由巴勒斯坦”。

paras.en: Macklemore was scheduled to open several remaining Loop Tour dates, including Saturday’s show in Atlanta. Sheeran later said the decision to remove him was made by the tour’s promoter after venues indicated they would not allow the shows to proceed with Macklemore on the lineup.
paras.zh: 麦克莫尔原计划开放剩余的几个环巡演出日期，包括周六在亚特兰大的演出。希兰后来说，取消他的决定是巡演发起人在场馆表示不允许麦克莫尔参加演出后做出的。

paras.en: Following Macklemore’s removal, the other scheduled supporting acts — Aaron Rowe, Finneas and Lukas Graham — withdrew from the tour. Sheeran’s backing band, Beoga, also departed.
paras.zh: 麦克莫尔被解职后，其他预定的配角——亚伦·罗、芬尼斯和卢卡斯·格雷厄姆——退出了巡演。希兰的伴奏乐队 Beoga 也离开了。

paras.en: Since leaving Sheeran’s tour, Macklemore has launched his own headlining Free Palestine Tour, with dates already sold out.
paras.zh: 离开希兰的巡演后，麦克莫尔推出了自己的头条新闻“自由巴勒斯坦巡演”，日期已经售完。

paras.en: Sheeran subsequently performed his Sept. 19 show in Philadelphia without an opening act. During the concert, he addressed the controversy and said he wanted his shows to focus on “love, hope and unity,” while also acknowledging the suffering in both Israel and Gaza.
paras.zh: 希兰随后于 9 月 19 日在费城举行了演出，但没有开场表演。在音乐会期间，他谈到了这一争议，并表示他希望自己的演出能够聚焦于“爱、希望和团结”，同时也承认以色列和加沙所遭受的苦难。

paras.en: Slade previously joined Sheeran onstage during the singer’s Loop Tour stop in Toronto in August, where they performed “How to Save a Life.” Sheeran told the audience he had been a fan of Slade’s music and songwriting during his formative years as a teenager.
paras.zh: 斯莱德此前曾在 8 月份希兰在多伦多举行的 Loop 巡回演唱会期间与希兰一起登上舞台，表演了《如何拯救生命》。希兰告诉观众，在斯莱德青少年时期，他一直是斯莱德音乐和歌曲创作的粉丝。

articles.title: Marjoe Gortner, Child Preacher and ‘Earthquake,’ ‘Falcon Crest’ Actor, Dies at 82
articles.author: Mike Barnes

paras.en: Marjoe Gortner, the celebrity child preacher who was the subject of an Oscar-winning documentary and an actor with roles in Earthquake, When You Comin’ Back, Red Ryder? and Falcon Crest, has died. He was 82.
paras.zh: 玛乔·戈特纳 (Marjoe Gortner) 是一位名人儿童传教士，曾是一部奥斯卡获奖纪录片的主角，也是一位演员，曾在《地震》、《当你回来时》、《雷德·莱德》中扮演角色？和Falcon Crest，已经死了。他82岁了。

paras.en: Gortner died Friday of complications from congestive heart failure, his family announced.
paras.zh: 戈特纳的家人宣布，戈特纳于周五因充血性心力衰竭并发症去世。

paras.en: With a contract at Universal Pictures, Gortner made his onscreen acting debut as the junkie Teddy Hopper in the 1973 Joseph Sargent-directed telefilm The Marcus-Nelson Murders, which served as the pilot for the CBS crime series Kojak, starring Telly Savalas.
paras.zh: 与环球影业签订合同后，戈特纳在 1973 年约瑟夫·萨金特执导的电视剧《马库斯-尼尔森谋杀案》中饰演瘾君子泰迪·霍珀，首次在银幕上表演，该片是哥伦比亚广播公司犯罪系列剧《科贾克》的试播集，由特利·萨瓦拉斯主演。

paras.en: He had another featured role as Jody Joad, a grocery store manager turned National Guardsman, in the Mark Robson-directed disaster movie Earthquake (1974), and he played a psychopathic, hostage-taking Vietnam veteran in Milton Katselas’ When You Comin’ Back, Red Ryder? (1979).
paras.zh: 他在马克·罗布森执导的灾难电影《地震》（1974）中扮演了另一个重要角色乔迪·乔德，一个从杂货店经理转型为国民警卫队士兵的角色；他还在米尔顿·卡特拉斯的《当你回来时，红莱德？》中扮演了一名精神变态、劫持人质的越南老兵。 （1979）。

paras.en: On the sixth season (1986-87) of the CBS primetime soap opera Falcon Crest, Gortner drew on his real-life experience to portray Vince Karlotti, a colorful polygamist and faux psychic medium over 17 episodes.
paras.zh: 在 CBS 黄金时段肥皂剧《Falcon Crest》第六季（1986-87 年）中，戈特纳利用自己的现实生活经历，在 17 集的剧集中描绘了文斯·卡洛蒂（Vince Karlotti），一位丰富多彩的一夫多妻制和人造通灵媒介。

paras.en: Hugh Marjoe (a combination of Mary and Joseph) Ross Gortner was born on Jan. 14, 1944, in Long Beach, California. He spoke eloquently as a child, so his parents, Vernon, a Christian evangelical minister, and mother, Marge, had him ordained as a preacher at age 4, when he performed a marriage ceremony for a Paramount newsreel.
paras.zh: 休·玛乔（玛丽和约瑟夫的组合）·罗斯·戈特纳 1944 年 1 月 14 日出生于加利福尼亚州长滩。他小时候就能言善道，所以他的父母弗农（基督教福音派牧师）和母亲玛姬在他 4 岁时就任命他为传教士，当时他为派拉蒙新闻片的一部婚礼进行了婚礼。

paras.en: Now a celebrity, the long-haired Gortner delivered gyrating, dramatic sermons at revival meetings across the U.S. as his family amassed a fortune estimated to be worth $3 million, but he said his father took off with the money shortly before Gortner turned 16.
paras.zh: 长发的戈特纳现已成为名人，他在美国各地的复兴会议上发表了激动人心、戏剧性的布道，他的家人积累了估计价值 300 万美元的财富，但他说，他的父亲在戈特纳 16 岁之前不久就带着这笔钱离开了。

paras.en: He rejoined the ministry as a way to earn a living and in 1971 granted a film crew access to him during his final revival tour. The resulting 1972 documentary, Marjoe, produced and directed by Howard Smith and Sarah Kernochan, debuted at Cannes and won the Oscar for best feature documentary. (The poster called it “a real story millions of people refuse to believe.”)
paras.zh: 作为谋生的一种方式，他重新加入了该部门，并于 1971 年在他最后一次复兴之旅中允许电影摄制组接触他。 1972 年，霍华德·史密斯 (Howard Smith) 和莎拉·科诺坎 (Sarah Kernochan) 制作并执导的纪录片《玛乔》(Marjoe) 在戛纳电影节首映，并获得了奥斯卡最佳纪录片奖。 （海报称其为“数百万人拒绝相信的真实故事。”）

paras.en: In the film, Gortner — who said he studied Mick Jagger as a model for his routine — talks about how he and other evangelists manipulated regular folks during revivals, and he’s seen in his hotel room counting the money he had collected one day.
paras.zh: 在影片中，戈特纳——他说他以米克·贾格尔为榜样——讲述了他和其他传教士如何在复兴期间操纵普通人，还看到他在酒店房间里数着有一天他筹集的钱。

paras.en: In his review for The New York Times, Vincent Canby described the film as “less a documentary about Marjoe’s final weeks on the Pentecostal church-and-tent circuit than a feature-length screen test for a career in show biz.”
paras.zh: 文森特·坎比在《纽约时报》的评论中将这部电影描述为“与其说是一部关于玛乔在五旬节教堂和帐篷巡回演出中的最后几周的纪录片，不如说是对演艺界职业生涯的一部长篇屏幕测试。”

paras.en: In 1972, Gortner recorded an album, Bad, but Not Evil, which featured him singing Bob Dylan’s “I Shall Be Released” and “Lo and Behold!,” and with all this notoriety, he was signed to a contract at Universal.
paras.zh: 1972 年，戈特纳录制了一张专辑《Bad, but Not Evil》，其中他演唱了鲍勃·迪伦的《I Shall Be Released》和《Lo and Behold!》，尽管声名狼藉，但他还是与环球影业签约。

paras.en: Gortner also starred with Lynda Carter in Bobbie Jo and the Outlaw (1976), appeared in the daredevil biopic Viva Knievel! (1977) and toplined a low-budget space opera, Starcrash (1978).
paras.zh: 戈特纳还与琳达·卡特一起主演了《鲍比·乔与亡命之徒》(1976)，并出现在勇敢的传记片《万岁·克尼维尔！》中。 （1977）并主演了一部低成本太空歌剧《星际坠毁》（Starcrash，1978）。

paras.en: His résumé included appearances on Barnaby Jones, Medical Center, Police Story, Laugh-In, The A-Team, Fantasy Island, Airwolf and Hotel, and he played a preacher in Wild Bill (1995), one of his final roles.
paras.zh: 他的履历包括出演《巴纳比琼斯》、《医疗中心》、《警察故事》、《Laugh-In》、《天龙特工队》、《幻想岛》、《飞狼》和《酒店》，并在《狂野比尔》（1995）中扮演一名牧师，这是他最后的角色之一。

paras.en: He also produced Circus of the Stars specials and celebrity sports invitationals that helped raise money for charity.
paras.zh: 他还制作了明星马戏团特别节目和名人体育邀请赛，帮助为慈善事业筹集资金。

paras.en: Survivors include his fifth wife, Susan, whom he married in 2019. He was briefly married to American Graffiti actress Candy Clark — they starred together in When You Comin’ Back, Red Ryder? — in the late ’70s.
paras.zh: 幸存者包括他的第五任妻子苏珊（Susan），她于 2019 年结婚。他与美国涂鸦女演员坎迪·克拉克（Candy Clark）有过一段短暂的婚姻——他们一起主演了《当你回来时，红莱德？ ——七十年代末。

articles.title: ‘Edward Said: Between Worlds’ Review: A Crucial Palestinian Scholar, Revived for a New Generation
articles.author: Lovia Gyarkye

paras.en: In his 1979 book The Question of Palestine, Edward Said, the Palestinian writer and academic, frames the relationship between Palestinians and Zionists as a “contest between an affirmation and a denial.” Making sense of it requires us to “understand what the instruments of this contest were, and how they shaped subsequent history so that this history now appears to confirm the validity of the Zionist claims to Palestine, thereby denigrating the Palestinian claim. In other words, we must understand the struggle between Palestinians and Zionism as a struggle between a presence and an interpretation, the former constantly appearing to be overpowered and eradicated by the latter.”
paras.zh: 巴勒斯坦作家兼学者爱德华·赛义德 (Edward Said) 在 1979 年出版的《巴勒斯坦问题》一书中将巴勒斯坦人和犹太复国主义者之间的关系描述为“肯定与否定之间的较量”。要理解这一点，我们需要“理解这场竞赛的工具是什么，以及它们如何塑造了后来的历史，使得这段历史现在似乎证实了犹太复国主义对巴勒斯坦的主张的有效性，从而诋毁了巴勒斯坦人的主张。换句话说，我们必须将巴勒斯坦人和犹太复国主义之间的斗争理解为存在与解释之间的斗争，前者似乎不断被后者压倒和根除。”

paras.en: To criticize the popular interpretation of Zionism, to frame Israel as a settler-colonial project and to recognize the humanity and history of Palestinians was — and, unfortunately in the Western world, often remains — a radical thesis.
paras.zh: 批评对犹太复国主义的流行解释，将以色列视为定居者殖民计划，并承认巴勒斯坦人的人性和历史，这些都是——不幸的是，在西方世界，往往仍然是——一个激进的论点。

paras.en: In the new documentary Edward Said: Between Worlds, Danish filmmaker and producer Maiken Baird explores, among other things, how the publication of this book and Said’s consistent advocacy for Palestinian self-determination made him both a model of intellectual integrity and an enemy of the United States. The doc carries the legacy of other Said film projects, including Mike Dobbs’ Edward Said: The Last Interview, released in 2004, but Between Worlds still offers a useful political education. Through impressive archival footage (interviews and lectures, home videos and family photos), Baird, who executive produced Icarus and Orwell: 2+2=5, revives the voice of a crucial public figure and indicts the U.S. and its mainstream media outlets for the role they have played — and continue to play — in abetting the annihilation of Palestinians. She wraps these major themes in a poignant narrative about how Said, exiled from Palestine and alienated from his Arab identity, eventually found his way back to both.
paras.zh: 在新纪录片《爱德华·萨义德：世界之间》中，丹麦电影制作人和制片人麦肯·贝尔德探讨了这本书的出版以及萨义德对巴勒斯坦自决的一贯倡导如何使他成为知识分子正直的典范和美国的敌人。这部纪录片继承了其他萨义德电影项目的遗产，包括迈克·多布斯 (Mike Dobbs) 于 2004 年上映的《爱德华·萨义德：最后的采访》，但《世界之间》仍然提供了有用的政治教育。 《伊卡洛斯与奥威尔：2+2=5》的执行制片人贝尔德通过令人印象深刻的档案片段（采访和讲座、家庭视频和家庭照片），重新唤起了一位重要公众人物的声音，并指责美国及其主流媒体在教唆灭绝巴勒斯坦人方面已经发挥并将继续发挥的作用。她将这些主要主题包裹在一个令人心酸的叙述中，讲述了萨义德如何从巴勒斯坦流亡并疏远了他的阿拉伯身份，最终找到了回到两者的道路。

paras.en: Between Worlds, still seeking distribution following well-received showings at the Toronto and New York film festivals, opens with an audio compilation of news anchors describing Said. They refer to him as a Palestinian activist, and remark on his eloquence in a subtle nod to the way he defies the expectations of a public taught to dehumanize Arabs. In one early clip, Said says he would “like to be identified as a professor of literature at Columbia University.” A voice off-camera repeats the title, with an interrogative intonation, and Said responds with humorous exasperation: “That’s right. I mean that’s what I do for a living.” This moment captures a tension that Said faced in battling assumptions that deep political engagement somehow foreclosed the possibility of other interests.
paras.zh: 《世界之间》在多伦多和纽约电影节上放映后广受好评，目前仍在寻求发行，以描述萨义德的新闻主播的音频汇编开场。他们称他为巴勒斯坦活动家，并在评论他的口才时微妙地认可了他无视公众被教导非人化阿拉伯人的期望的方式。在早期的一段视频中，赛义德表示，他“希望被认定为哥伦比亚大学的文学教授”。镜头外的声音以疑问的语调重复了这个标题，萨义德以幽默的愤怒回应道：“没错。我的意思是，这就是我的谋生之道。”这一刻捕捉到了萨义德在与各种假设作斗争时所面临的紧张局势，即深入的政治参与在某种程度上排除了其他利益的可能性。

paras.en: The beginning of Between Worlds functions as a kind of prelude, offering a straightforward primer on Said. Using the scholar’s own words, Baird lays out Said’s role in public life and defines one of his principle intellectual projects. “Whenever there is a Palestinian effort to tell a story, to put in a dramatic and realizable way the story of Palestine, it’s been assaulted and stopped,” he says in voiceover. “So we appear as if we are orphans, as if we have no origins, we have no narrative as a people. We are being told in a certain sense that we don’t really exist.”
paras.zh: 《世界之间》的开头起到了某种前奏的作用，为赛义德提供了简单的入门知识。贝尔德用这位学者自己的话说，阐述了萨义德在公共生活中的角色，并定义了他的主要智力项目之一。 “每当巴勒斯坦人试图讲述一个故事，以一种戏剧性和可实现的方式讲述巴勒斯坦的故事时，它就会遭到攻击和阻止，”他在画外音中说道。 “所以我们看起来就像是孤儿，好像我们没有起源，我们没有作为一个民族的叙述。从某种意义上说，我们被告知我们并不真正存在。”

paras.en: A violent estrangement from land, history and culture defined Said’s early years. Between Worlds smartly shapes itself around Said’s intellectual ideas without giving up the ease of a chronological timeline. After the intro, Baird introduces Said’s interest in memory and who gets to define history, focusing on the scholar’s early years. Said was born into a middle-class family in Jerusalem, Palestine, in 1935. In 1947, he and his family moved to Cairo, ahead of the 1948 mass expulsion of Palestinians from Israel widely known as the Nakba. Through archival interviews, Said explains how his parents rarely talked about their home country except when vaguely citing what they lost. As a result, Said grew up rather politically disengaged and with no real connection to his identity.
paras.zh: 萨义德的早年经历了与土地、历史和文化的强烈疏远。 《世界之间》巧妙地围绕萨义德的智慧思想塑造了自己，同时又不放弃按时间顺序排列的时间线的轻松性。引言结束后，贝尔德介绍​​了萨义德对记忆的兴趣以及谁来定义历史，重点介绍了这位学者的早年经历。赛义德 1935 年出生于巴勒斯坦耶路撒冷的一个中产阶级家庭。1947 年，他和家人搬到了开罗，当时正值 1948 年以色列大规模驱逐巴勒斯坦人（俗称“浩劫”）。通过档案采访，萨义德解释了他的父母很少谈论他们的祖国，除非含糊地引用他们失去的东西。结果，萨义德在成长过程中与政治脱节，与他的身份没有真正的联系。

paras.en: Despite not having the language for it, the young Palestinian understood his position as a marginalized person very early on. In school, he identified with stories of indigenous Americans and Black people in America, and noticed how much of his education was filled with historical elisions of the harm done to them. Said’s teaching style was informed by this keenness, as he encouraged his students to approach their studies with healthy skepticism and to question historical silences.
paras.zh: 尽管没有语言表达这一点，这位年轻的巴勒斯坦人很早就明白了自己作为边缘人的地位。在学校里，他认同美国原住民和黑人的故事，并注意到他的教育中有多少充满了对他们所受伤害的历史遗漏。萨义德的教学风格体现了这种热忱，他鼓励学生以健康的怀疑态度进行学习，并对历史的沉默提出质疑。

paras.en: When he was further into adolescence, Said was sent to the United States for boarding school, where the severance from his Arab identity was reinforced. He went on to study at Princeton and then Harvard before landing a teaching job at Columbia University. It’s at this institution that Said would go on to formulate his most enduring theses about Arab identity in relation to the West (Orientalism, 1978); Palestinian history and self-determination (The Question of Palestine, 1979); and the afterlives of imperialism (Culture and Imperialism, 1993). It’s ironic that today the university that served as Said’s intellectual home is at the forefront of sanctioning students and faculty advocating for Palestinians.
paras.zh: 当萨义德进入青春期时，他被送往美国的寄宿学校，在那里，他与阿拉伯身份的分离得到了加强。他继续在普林斯顿大学和哈佛大学学习，然后在哥伦比亚大学找到了一份教学工作。正是在这个机构，萨义德继续阐述了他关于阿拉伯身份与西方关系的最持久的论点（Orientalism，1978）；巴勒斯坦历史和自决（巴勒斯坦问题，1979）；以及帝国主义的余生（文化与帝国主义，1993）。具有讽刺意味的是，如今，作为萨义德知识分子家园的大学却站在了制裁支持巴勒斯坦人的学生和教师的最前线。

paras.en: The most emotionally poignant parts of the film focus on how the intellectual rebuilt his relationship to his Palestinian identity. After he married Mariam, a Lebanese writer and activist, Said traveled to Beirut with her, connected with people involved in the liberation of Palestine, and embarked on an intensive study of Arabic. Through this re-engagement, he began to notice how the Western media participated in disseminating anti-Arab propaganda, and these observations would go on to inspire many of his books.
paras.zh: 影片中最令人心酸的部分集中在这位知识分子如何重建他与巴勒斯坦身份的关系。赛义德与黎巴嫩作家兼活动家玛丽亚姆结婚后，与她一起前往贝鲁特，与参与巴勒斯坦解放的人们建立了联系，并开始深入学习阿拉伯语。通过这次重新接触，他开始注意到西方媒体如何参与传播反阿拉伯宣传，这些观察后来启发了他的许多书籍。

paras.en: There’s substantial attention paid as well to Said’s intellectual development after his early writings, notably how he became disappointed with and estranged from Palestinian comrades like Yasser Arafat, who he believed harmfully capitulated to American and Israeli demands. While Between Worlds touches on Said’s evolving politics, particularly his later advocacy for a nation where Israelis and Palestinians could live in equality, it leaves the viewer wanting additional context.
paras.zh: 赛义德在早期著作之后的智力发展也受到了广泛关注，特别是他如何对亚西尔·阿拉法特等巴勒斯坦同志感到失望和疏远，他认为阿拉法特对美国和以色列的要求做出了有害的投降。虽然《世界之间》触及了萨义德不断演变的政治，特别是他后来倡导的以色列人和巴勒斯坦人可以平等生活的国家，但这让观众想要更多的背景。

paras.en: One of the most jarring elements of Baird’s documentary — as with most nonfiction projects about Palestinians released in the last few years — is how much of the language featured in the film echoes the contemporary moment. It can feel uncanny to watch Said, interviewed throughout the 80s, 90s and early 2000s, argue the same issues that are being litigated today. And it’s striking to see how being asked repeatedly to defend Palestinian self-determination wears on the scholar, who also had other intellectual interests. He was a talented pianist, a prolific literary critic and a founder of what we now call postcolonial studies, a multidisciplinary field that examines the cultural, economic and political afterlife of imperialism.
paras.zh: 与过去几年发布的大多数有关巴勒斯坦人的非小说类项目一样，贝尔德纪录片中最刺耳的元素之一是影片中的语言在很大程度上呼应了当代时刻。看着赛义德在整个 80 年代、90 年代和 2000 年代初期接受采访，并就今天正在提起诉讼的相同问题进行辩论，会让人感到不可思议。令人震惊的是，多次被要求捍卫巴勒斯坦自决对这位也有其他知识兴趣的学者来说是多么沉重。他是一位才华横溢的钢琴家，一位多产的文学评论家，也是我们现在所说的后殖民研究的创始人，这是一个研究帝国主义文化、经济和政治来世的多学科领域。

paras.en: I first learned about Said as an undergraduate studying English literature at Princeton, our shared alma mater. His debut book Orientalism offered me, as well as many others, a renewed understanding of the violent legacy of colonization and reinvigorated my understanding of identity as fluid and relational. If there’s one tension in Between Worlds, it’s the constant reminder that there’s so much more to learn about its subject.
paras.zh: 我第一次了解萨义德是在我们共同的母校普林斯顿大学学习英国文学的本科生时期。他的处女作《东方主义》让我和其他许多人重新认识了殖民主义的暴力遗产，并重新激发了我对身份的流动性和关系性的理解。如果说《世界之间》有什么紧张的话，那就是它不断地提醒我们，关于它的主题还有很多东西需要了解。

articles.title: Starting a watch collection? What beginners should know before buying

paras.en: Though smartphones and wearable devices like fitness bands can accurately tell time, many people still prefer using traditional watches whether for convenience, aesthetics or an appreciation of a well-constructed analog device. In fact, though the luxury market has been in a bit of a slump, watches are a big industry, with a global market exceeding $135 billion and annual growth projections exceeding 5.6%, according to the data aggregator Statista.
paras.zh: 尽管智能手机和健身手环等可穿戴设备可以准确地显示时间，但许多人仍然更喜欢使用传统手表，无论是为了方便、美观还是为了欣赏结构良好的模拟设备。事实上，尽管奢侈品市场有些低迷，但根据数据聚合商 Statista 的数据，手表是一个大产业，全球市场超过 1,350 亿美元，年增长率预计超过 5.6%。

paras.en: A watch can convey status or accessorize an outfit, but they're also popular as collectibles. For beginners, watch collecting is best treated as a hobby first: Most watches lose value, while those that do appreciate can be difficult to identify and buy at retail.
paras.zh: 手表可以彰显身份或装饰服装，但它们也作为收藏品很受欢迎。对于初学者来说，收藏手表最好首先将其视为一种爱好：大多数手表都会贬值，而那些升值的手表可能很难在零售店中识别和购买。

paras.en: CNBC recently spoke with experts in the business to find out what a beginner might want to consider when starting a watch collection.
paras.zh: CNBC 最近采访了业内专家，了解初学者在开始收藏手表时可能需要考虑的因素。

paras.en: Start collecting for love, not for investment returns
paras.zh: 为热爱而开始收藏，而不是为了投资回报

paras.en: First and foremost, building a collection because you enjoy the looks, mechanical details or history of watches can be satisfying. Collectibles are also becoming more accepted as an alternative investing asset class. But experts advise that you aren't likely to outperform more traditional investments.
paras.zh: 首先也是最重要的是，因为喜欢手表的外观、机械细节或历史而建立一个系列可能会令人满意。收藏品作为另类投资资产类别也越来越被接受。但专家建议，你不太可能跑赢更传统的投资。

paras.en: Charles Tian, the founder and CEO of WatchCharts, a market-research platform that tracks used-watch prices, explained that it's possible to make money buying and selling watches, but collectors are unlikely to beat investments such as an S&P 500 Index over the long term. "I would not get into watch collecting purely from a financial perspective," Tian said.
paras.zh: 跟踪二手手表价格的市场研究平台 WatchCharts 的创始人兼首席执行官查尔斯·田 (Charles Tian) 解释说，买卖手表可以赚钱，但从长远来看，收藏家不太可能击败标准普尔 500 指数等投资。 “我不会纯粹从经济角度来收藏手表，”田说。

paras.en: He noted, however, that desirable watches can still appreciate over time, pointing out that the Rolex Submariner – a diving-style watch that retails new starting at roughly $10,000 – tripled in value on the secondary market from 2010 to a peak price in 2022 during the Covid-era collectibles boom.
paras.zh: 不过，他指出，随着时间的推移，令人向往的手表仍然会升值，并指出，劳力士潜航者型手表（一款潜水式手表，全新零售价约为 10,000 美元）在二级市场上的价值从 2010 年增加了两倍，在新冠病毒时代收藏品热潮期间于 2022 年达到峰值。

paras.en: "As a collector and watch enthusiast you'd expect me to say that watches are a great investment, but they mostly aren't," said Mike Johnson, founder of WatchPatrol, a site that aggregates data on the secondary watch market. "The majority of watches depreciate and it's hard to tell which new references will ascend into 'modern classic' territory."
paras.zh: “作为一名收藏家和手表爱好者，你可能会认为我会说手表是一项很好的投资，但它们大多不是，”WatchPatrol 的创始人迈克·约翰逊 (Mike Johnson) 说，WatchPatrol 是一个汇总二手手表市场数据的网站。 “大多数手表都会贬值，很难判断哪些新手表将跻身‘现代经典’领域。”

paras.en: In its index over the past year, quality timepieces such as the Breitling Superocean 42 and the Panerai Luminor GMT both saw material declines in value.
paras.zh: 在过去一年的指数中，百年灵超级海洋 42 和沛纳海 Luminor GMT 等优质时计的价值均出现大幅下跌。

paras.en: "These are fine watches with shrinking prices, and that's the normal case, not the exception," Johnson said.
paras.zh: “这些都是精品手表，价格却在下降，这是正常情况，而不是例外，”约翰逊说。

paras.en: There are some exceptions, of course. In special (and exceedingly rare) cases, a watch can appreciate dramatically. For instance, a Rolex Daytona owned by actor Paul Newman, a watch which originally retailed at a price as low as $210 in 1972, sold at auction in 2017 for a then-record $17.8 million.
paras.zh: 当然，也有一些例外。在特殊（且极为罕见）的情况下，手表可以大幅升值。例如，演员保罗·纽曼(Paul Newman)拥有的劳力士迪通拿(Rolex Daytona)，这款手表在1972年最初零售价仅为210美元，但在2017年的拍卖会上以1780万美元的创纪录价格售出。

paras.en: What makes a watch desirable and what holds value
paras.zh: 手表的魅力所在以及价值所在

paras.en: Many factors affect the desirability of a watch.
paras.zh: 许多因素都会影响腕表的受欢迎程度。

paras.en: While there are roughly 450 Swiss watch brands, sales are concentrated in top brands, including Rolex, Cartier, Patek Philippe, Audemars Piguet, Omega, and Richard Mille, according to an annual report on watchmakers from Morgan Stanley and LuxeConsult.
paras.zh: 摩根士丹利和 LuxeConsult 的制表商年度报告显示，虽然瑞士手表品牌大约有 450 个，但销售额主要集中在顶级品牌，包括劳力士、卡地亚、百达翡丽、爱彼、欧米茄和理查德米勒。

paras.en: "Brand reputation will usually be the most significant driver, but rarity, where it was manufactured, and a documented history of ownership are also major factors," said Sean Makovsky, the manager of the luxury division at Max Pawn, a Las Vegas-based pawn broker that deals in watches and other valuables. "Limited editions, retired models or watches tied to significant events tend to attract collectors," he added.
paras.zh: “品牌声誉通常是最重要的驱动因素，但稀有性、制造地以及拥有记录的所有权历史也是主要因素，”Max Pawn 奢侈品部门经理肖恩·马科夫斯基 (Sean Makovsky) 说，Max Pawn 是一家总部位于拉斯维加斯的典当经纪商，经营手表和其他贵重物品。 “限量版、退役型号或与重大事件相关的手表往往会吸引收藏家，”他补充道。

paras.en: The watch brands experts most frequently cited for appreciating (or at least holding) their value are Rolex, Audemars Piguet and Patek Philippe. Recent prices for new watches from these brands started at $6,200, $11,300, and $18,000 respectively, but pricing in the market is always subject to change and the luxury market can be volatile.
paras.zh: 最常被专家认为欣赏（或至少持有）其价值的手表品牌是劳力士（Rolex）、爱彼（Audemars Piguet）和百达翡丽（Patek Philippe）。这些品牌的新款手表最近的起价分别为 6,200 美元、11,300 美元和 18,000 美元，但市场定价总是会发生变化，奢侈品市场可能会波动。

paras.en: If you can buy a new watch from one of these brands from a certified dealer at retail price, you might be able to sell it immediately on the secondary market for a profit, Tian said.
paras.zh: 田说，如果你能以零售价从认证经销商处购买这些品牌之一的新手表，你也许可以立即在二级市场上出售它以获取利润。

paras.en: Johnson said it can be difficult to obtain a hot selling watch from a dealer. "You're on a wait list, and the boutique decides when and whether you get to buy," he explained.
paras.zh: 约翰逊表示，从经销商处获得热销手表可能很困难。 “你在等待名单上，精品店会决定你何时以及是否可以购买，”他解释道。

paras.en: "In general, prices on the pre-owned market are a bit softer than new watches, especially when they are still available," said Robert-Jan Broer, founder of Fratello Watches, an online horology magazine based in the Netherlands. "However, this is not the case for watches that have such a high demand that they can't be easily bought new. Many Rolex sports models, but also watches from Patek Philippe and Audemars Piguet are simply unavailable new because the market is hot for them."
paras.zh: 荷兰在线钟表杂志 Fratello Watches 的创始人 Robert-Jan Broer 表示：“一般来说，二手手表市场上的价格比新手表要便宜一些，尤其是当它们仍然有货时。” “然而，对于需求如此高而不容易买到新手表的情况来说，情况并非如此。许多劳力士运动型号，还有百达翡丽和爱彼的手表，根本就买不到新的，因为市场对它们来说很热门。”

paras.en: The Swiss brand Vacheron Constantin is also collectible, but generally does not hold value on the secondary market as well as Audemars Piguet, Patek Philippe or Rolex. New prices for a Vacheron Constantin start at $14,300 and the brand appeals to collectors for the beauty and craftsmanship of its watches. The brand also has historic appeal; it was established in 1755 and is the oldest watchmaker in continuous operation.
paras.zh: 瑞士品牌江诗丹顿也具有收藏价值，但在二级市场上的价值一般不如爱彼、百达翡丽或劳力士。江诗丹顿 (Vacheron Constantin) 的新价格起价为 14,300 美元，该品牌以其手表的美观和工艺吸引了收藏家。该品牌还具有历史吸引力；它成立于 1755 年，是持续经营的最古老的钟表制造商。

paras.en: Some less expensive watches also draw interest from collectors.
paras.zh: 一些较便宜的手表也引起了收藏家的兴趣。

paras.en: Johnson cited vintage Seiko diver watches, Omega sports watches, and modern Tudor watches as decent collectibles. "The discontinued Seiko SKX007 dive watch trades around $257 and creeps up a little every year, which is about as dependable as watch values get at that price," Johnson said. He called out the Hamilton Khaki Field and Tissot PRX as popular entry points for new collectors, with used prices in the range of $400.
paras.zh: 约翰逊将老式精工潜水表、欧米茄运动表和现代都铎表视为不错的收藏品。 “已停产的精工 SKX007 潜水表的交易价格约为 257 美元，并且每年都会上涨一点，这与该价格下的手表价值一样可靠，”约翰逊说。他称 Hamilton Khaki Field 和 Tissot PRX 是新收藏家的热门入手点，二手价格在 400 美元左右。

paras.en: Makovsky also cited Hamilton automatic watches along with vintage Bulova Accutrons as offering value and long-term collectability without requiring a substantial investment.
paras.zh: 马科夫斯基还指出，汉密尔顿自动腕表和复古 Bulova Accutron 腕表具有价值和长期收藏价值，且无需大量投资。

paras.en: At the other end of the affordability spectrum, Tian said MB&F (Maximilian Büsser & Friends), F.P. Journe, and Richard Mille are collectible brands that can also hold their value. New watches from these brands start at start at $3,300, $15,000, and $120,000, respectively.
paras.zh: Tian 表示，在负担能力范围的另一端，MB&F (Maximilian Büsser & Friends)、F.P. Journe、Richard Mille都是具有收藏价值的品牌，也能保值。这些品牌的新款手表起价分别为 3,300 美元、15,000 美元和 120,000 美元。

paras.en: Aside from the samples noted above, most watches can be expected to lose value over time. That doesn't mean they can't be collected, just that it might be wiser to buy used. "For most brands, you can get a used watch in great condition, for 40-50% off on the secondary market, Tian said.
paras.zh: 除了上面提到的样品之外，大多数手表都会随着时间的推移而贬值。这并不意味着它们不能被收集，只是购买二手的可能更明智。 “对于大多数品牌来说，你可以在二级市场上以 40-50% 的折扣买到状况良好的二手手表，”田说。

paras.en: Buying new or pre-owned watches comes down to circumstances and personal preference.
paras.zh: 购买新手表或二手手表取决于具体情况和个人喜好。

paras.en: "Buying new is simple," Johnson said. "You get a warranty, a brand new product, and the satisfaction of being the only person to ever wear it."
paras.zh: “购买新的很简单，”约翰逊说。 “你会得到保修、全新产品，并且会因为成为唯一佩戴过它的人而感到满足。”

paras.en: "The secondary market is a little more nuanced," Johnson said. "Everything on the used market already has the retail depreciation baked into the price and every single discontinued reference can be found somewhere, if you look hard enough. The trade-offs are real though: no warranty, mysterious service histories, and you have to do your own homework on both the watch and the seller. The money you save buying used could easily be lost to a surprise service or repair bill."
paras.zh: “二级市场有点微妙，”约翰逊说。 “二手市场上的所有东西都已经将零售折旧纳入了价格，而且如果你足够仔细的话，每一个停产的参考都可以在某个地方找到。不过，权衡是真实的：没有保修，神秘的服务历史，而且你必须在手表和卖家身上做好自己的功课。你购买二手手表节省的钱很容易被意外的服务或维修账单所损失。”

paras.en: When buying used, it pays to be extra diligent. "Condition is critical," noted Makovsky, "An unpolished case, original dial, matching serial numbers, original bracelet, and complete box and papers can add substantial value. In many cases, two seemingly identical watches can differ in value by thousands of dollars simply because one is completely original and the other has replacement parts or has been over-restored."
paras.zh: 购买二手货时，需要格外小心。 “状况很关键，”马科夫斯基指出，“未经抛光的表壳、原装表盘、匹配的序列号、原装表链以及完整的盒子和纸张可以增加可观的价值。在许多情况下，两块看似相同的手表的价值可能相差数千美元，仅仅是因为一块是完全原装的，另一块有替换零件或经过过度修复。”

paras.en: Additional costs, mechanical issues, and scammers
paras.zh: 额外费用、机械问题和诈骗

paras.en: Though there are digital watches that people collect and trade — such as the Casio G-Shock, which ranges in price from $40 to $80,000 — most high-end collectible watches are mechanical and operate through the complex interplay of tiny gears, forks, levers and springs. These wear out with regular use. A mechanical watch typically needs servicing every seven to 10 years, according to the experts, and cost depends on the brand, type and model of watch. This can be as low as $200-300, but more expensive watches, or those with mechanical complications such as dials for power-reserve, dates or the phases of the moon can cost thousands of dollars for one service or repair.
paras.zh: 尽管人们收藏和交易一些数字手表，例如卡西欧 G-Shock，其价格从 40 美元到 80,000 美元不等，但大多数高端收藏手表都是机械手表，通过微小齿轮、拨叉、杠杆和弹簧的复杂相互作用来操作。这些会随着经常使用而磨损。专家表示，机械手表通常每七到十年需要维修一次，费用取决于手表的品牌、类型和型号。价格可以低至 200-300 美元，但更昂贵的手表，或者那些带有机械复杂功能的手表，例如动力储存、日期或月相表盘，一次服务或维修可能要花费数千美元。

paras.en: "Repair costs as such are hard to predict," Broer said. "If it needs a new crystal, winding crown, etc., the prices are fairly low. But if there's something wrong with the mechanism inside, or a special dial is cracked or damaged, it can become very expensive."
paras.zh: “维修成本本身很难预测，”布罗尔说。 “如果需要新的表镜、上链表冠等，价格相当低。但如果内部机制出现问题，或者特殊表盘破裂或损坏，价格就会变得非常昂贵。”

paras.en: Proper storage is an essential part of protecting and preserving a luxury watch collection. "Watches should be kept in a dry, secure environment away from magnets, excessive humidity, and extreme temperatures, all of which can negatively affect their performance and long-term condition," Makovsky said. "A high-quality safe provides both security and a stable environment for most collections. For particularly valuable collections, professionally managed vault storage may be appropriate, offering an added layer of protection against theft, damage, and environmental risks."
paras.zh: 适当的存放是保护和保存豪华手表系列的重要组成部分。 “手表应存放在干燥、安全的环境中，远离磁铁、湿度过高和极端温度，所有这些都会对其性能和长期状况产生负面影响，”马科夫斯基说。 “高质量的保险箱为大多数藏品提供安全和稳定的环境。对于特别有价值的藏品，专业管理的保险库存储可能是合适的，可以提供额外的保护，防止盗窃、损坏和环境风险。”

paras.en: Equally important is preserving everything that came with the watch. "Original boxes, warranty cards, certificates, manuals, hang tags, receipts, and service records should be kept in excellent condition and stored safely," Makovsky said, noting that a complete set of original packaging and documentation can significantly increase a watch's value.
paras.zh: 同样重要的是保留手表附带的所有物品。马科夫斯基表示：“原包装盒、保修卡、证书、手册、吊牌、收据和服务记录应保持良好状态并安全存放。”他指出，一套完整的原包装和文件可以显着增加手表的价值。

paras.en: Finally, look out for shady business practices or outright scams when buying or selling a watch.
paras.zh: 最后，在购买或出售手表时，请留意不正当的商业行为或彻头彻尾的骗局。

paras.en: "Where there's money to be made, there are crooks," Broer said. He said it's important to deal with trusted sources, including authorized dealers and brand boutiques. He noted that collectors can look into the reputation of those they deal with through word of mouth or when these companies have a good rating on watch marketplace sites, such as Chrono24.
paras.zh: “哪里有钱可赚，哪里就有骗子，”布罗尔说。他说，与值得信赖的来源打交道很重要，包括授权经销商和品牌精品店。他指出，收藏家可以通过口碑或这些公司在 Chrono24 等手表市场网站上获得良好评价来了解与他们打交道的公司的声誉。

paras.en: "Outright fakes are the famous problem, but the sneakier one is the 'franken-watch'," Johnson said.
paras.zh: “众所周知的问题是彻头彻尾的假货，但更狡猾的问题是‘弗兰肯手表’，”约翰逊说。

paras.en: He explained that some dishonest sellers will combine components of different watches together and try to sell it as all-original. Other issues are scratched, damaged, or overly polished watches sold as mint, sellers who disappear after receiving payment, and shill bidding at online auctions.
paras.zh: 他解释说，一些不诚实的卖家会将不同手表的部件组合在一起，试图以纯正品的形式出售。其他问题包括作为全新手表出售的手表有划痕、损坏或过度抛光，卖家收到付款后消失，以及在网上拍卖中抬价出价。

paras.en: "Even a completely genuine watch can come attached to a dishonest deal," Johnson said. "The defense is to use common sense: buy the seller before you buy the watch."
paras.zh: 约翰逊说：“即使是完全正品的手表也可能会被附在不诚实的交易中。” “防御方法是运用常识：在购买手表之前先购买卖家的产品。”

paras.en: He also recommended that watch enthusiasts use payment methods with recourse, insist on original photos and serial numbers, and get anything expensive authenticated by an independent watchmaker.
paras.zh: 他还建议手表爱好者使用有追索权的付款方式，坚持使用原始照片和序列号，并购买由独立制表师认证的昂贵物品。

articles.title: OPEC+ agrees to keep November oil output targets steady

paras.en: OPEC+ agreed to keep oil production targets steady for November at a meeting on Sunday, the producer group said, in line with expectations that further output policy adjustments are unlikely until next year.
paras.zh: OPEC+在周日的会议上同意维持11月石油产量目标不变，该生产国集团表示，这符合明年之前不太可能进一步调整产量政策的预期。

paras.en: Seven core members of the group comprising the Organization of the Petroleum Exporting Countries and allies including Russia made the decision for November in a brief online meeting on Sunday. The core members are Saudi Arabia, Russia, Iraq, Kuwait, Algeria, Kazakhstan and Oman.
paras.zh: 由石油输出国组织和包括俄罗斯在内的盟友组成的该组织的七名核心成员在周日举行的简短在线会议上做出了 11 月份的决定。核心成员为沙特阿拉伯、俄罗斯、伊拉克、科威特、阿尔及利亚、哈萨克斯坦和阿曼。

paras.en: Gulf OPEC+ producers have been pumping well below output targets in the face of continuing export disruptions from the U.S.-Israeli war on Iran, with exports fluctuating at 60% to 80% of normal levels in recent months.
paras.zh: 面对美以对伊朗战争造成的出口持续中断，海湾 OPEC+ 产油国的产量一直远低于产量目标，近几个月出口波动幅度为正常水平的 60% 至 80%。

paras.en: "The OPEC+ group of seven kept their production ceilings unchanged, in line with market expectations. That said, despite rising flows through the Strait of Hormuz, their output levels remain well below quota," said UBS analyst Giovanni Staunovo.
paras.zh: “OPEC+七国集团维持产量上限不变，符合市场预期。尽管如此，尽管通过霍尔木兹海峡的流量有所增加，但其产量水平仍远低于配额，”瑞银分析师乔瓦尼·斯塔诺沃(Giovanni Staunovo)表示。

paras.en: "Consequently, the oil market remains tight."
paras.zh: “因此，石油市场仍然紧张。”

paras.en: Oil prices had dropped on Friday after European leaders agreed to U.S. President Donald Trump's request to release diesel reserves. Crude oil prices settled lower after the Group of Seven nations announced the release of diesel and crude stocks to ease surging fuel prices.
paras.zh: 在欧洲领导人同意美国总统唐纳德·特朗普释放柴油储备的请求后，周五油价下跌。在七国集团宣布释放柴油和原油库存以缓解飙升的燃料价格后，原油价格走低。

paras.en: International benchmark Brent crude futures slipped 6 cents to close at $102.25 per barrel, while U.S. West Texas Intermediate crude slid $1.76 to $91.11 a barrel.
paras.zh: 国际基准布伦特原油期货下跌 6 美分，收于每桶 102.25 美元，而美国西德克萨斯中质原油下跌 1.76 美元，收于每桶 91.11 美元。

paras.en: The G7 will release 100 million barrels of reserves over the next four months "with a frontloaded substantial diesel release within the first 20 days," the group's leaders said in a joint statement. The G7 includes France, Canada, Germany, Italy, Japan, the United Kingdom and the U.S.
paras.zh: 七国集团领导人在一份联合声明中表示，七国集团领导人将在未来四个月内释放 1 亿桶储备，“并在头 20 天内提前释放大量柴油”。七国集团包括法国、加拿大、德国、意大利、日本、英国和美国。

paras.en: Despite the G7 announcement, Brent crude remains above $100 a barrel, up from about $73 before the Iran war started in late February.
paras.zh: 尽管七国集团宣布了这一消息，但布伦特原油仍高于每桶 100 美元，高于 2 月底伊朗战争爆发前的约 73 美元。

paras.en: The Iran war has also delayed the group's output capacity review — crucial to determine members' 2027 output quotas — because it has thrown estimates of future production potential into uncertainty, industry sources told Reuters last week.
paras.zh: 行业消息人士上周告诉路透社，伊朗战争还推迟了该组织的产能审查——这对于确定成员国2027年的产量配额至关重要——因为它使对未来生产潜力的估计陷入不确定性。

paras.en: OPEC+ has been raising output targets for much of 2026 after years of production cuts, but most of the increases stayed on paper because of the Middle East conflict.
paras.zh: 经过多年减产后，OPEC+一直在提高2026年大部分时间的产量目标，但由于中东冲突，大部分增产目标仍停留在纸面上。

paras.en: The seven core OPEC+ members pumped 25 million barrels per day in August, up 630,000 bpd from July, yet still roughly 5 million bpd below prewar levels in February, OPEC data shows.
paras.zh: OPEC 数据显示，OPEC+ 七个核心成员国 8 月份日产量为 2500 万桶，较 7 月份增加 63 万桶，但仍比 2 月份战前水平低约 500 万桶。

paras.en: OPEC+ still has about 2 million bpd of output cuts in place covering most members. It needs the result of the capacity review to decide how to distribute increases, and any changes to output are unlikely before 2027, sources have said.
paras.zh: OPEC+ 仍实施约 200 万桶/日的减产计划，涵盖大多数成员国。消息人士称，需要根据产能审查的结果来决定如何分配增量，并且在 2027 年之前不太可能对产量做出任何改变。

paras.en: A separate OPEC+ ministerial group, the Joint Ministerial Monitoring Committee, which does not set policy, also met on Sunday to review the market.
paras.zh: 一个单独的欧佩克+部长级小组，即联合部长级监测委员会，不制定政策，也在周日举行会议以审查市场。

articles.title: This NYC startup requires 4 days in office but just let everyone work remote for a whole month
